text: Ntoma ya Italie na Ekolo Congo démocratique Luca Attanasio akufi na masasi na bitumba basimba minduki bayebani te basali na molongo ya mituka miye azalaki na kati na Goma na Nord-Kivu. Ministre ya mambi ma bapaya ya RDC alaki bokangami bwa babomi. Molobeli ya mampinga ma Ekolo Congo démocratique na Nord-Kivu, major Guillaume Djike alobi ete bato babale basusu bakufi mpe lokola na masasi basima minduki bayebani te babetaki na mituka miye. Ezali mokumbi mutoka mpe mobateli na ya ntoma ya Italie. Ntoma Luca Attanasio, na mibu tuku minei na misato, azalaki kotala misala PAM (Mabongisi ma molongo mpo na Bilei) ntango basimba minduki babetaki mituka myango masasi. Biyano bipesami mingi nsima na sango ya liwa lya ye. Mbulamatari ya Italie elobi ezali na nkanda mpe epameli mbulamatari ya RDC ya bolembu na yango, Président ya Conseil européen, Charles Michel alobi ayoki mpasi mingi mpo bitumba biye na mituka ya PAM mpe asengi ete bokengi bopesamela baye basala kuna. Ministre ya mambi ya pabaya Marie Ntumba Nzeza mpe andimi sango yango mpe alaki na mbulamatari Italie ete RDC ekosala makasi mpo kotia maboko na baye babomi ntoma Attanasio mpe apesi bana ba Italie maloba ma kobondisa mitema.

headline: Ouganda na RDC bapusi bosambi na bango na Cour internationale ya justice
text: Cour internationale ya justice to misala ya bosembo ya Nations unies mizongisi nsima bosambisi ya matata kati na ekolo Congo démocratique na Ouganda. Bosambisi bwango bosengelaki kosalama banda le 18 kino le 22 ya sanza eye ya libwa. Tribunal eye elobi bakonzi ya Ouganda na Congo démocratiquende basengi bozongisi nsima noye. Nzonkande président Félix Tshisekedi azalaki mposo moleki na Ouganda. Congo démocratique efundaka Ouganda mpe esengaka yango misosolo milliards pene na zomi na moko mpo na misala ya kopunza, koyiba mpe koboma miye mampinga ya Ouganda, UPDF (Uganda People's Defence Force) masala na mabele ya ba Congolais ata basengamaki kolongwa.

headline: Haute cour militaire eboyi kobengisa Kabila na basusu na bosambisami ya liwa lya Chebeya
text: Haute Cour militaire ebwakisi bosenga ya bafundi ya komona mokonzi ya kala Joseph Kabila na bato basusu batangami na bobomi ya Floribert Chebeya na Fidèle Bazana koyanola na bazuzi. Haute cour militaire ezongisi epusi mpe le 26 janvier bobandeli ya bosambisami. Basambeli ya bafundi (parties civiles) basepeli te na mokano ya Haute cour, elobi Me Richard Bondo. Mpo na Me Richard Bondo, mokambi ya Haute cour azwi mokano motali bazuzi basusu te kasi mozali nde kaka mayele maye. Ba avocats ya bafundi balobi bakosenga ete Haute cour militaire epesa ekateli na yango o’mokolo mwa le 26 janvier. VSV (La Voix de Sans Voix) lingomba lya makoki ma bomoto nkondo Floribert Chebeya akelaka mpe akambaka kino liwa na ye, esengaki mpe bosambisami ya Joseph Kabila na bato basusu major Paul Milambwe atangaki. Major Milambwe azalaki kosala na secretariat ya mokambi ya police ya ntango wana, general John Numbi mpe alobaka ete amonaka na camera ya surveillance lolenge naninga baye babobamaki MM. Chebeya na Bazana na Inspection générale ya police na Kinshasa. Major Milambwe abakisaki na bosambisami ete M. Kabila nde atindaki bobomi yango na général Numbi, na bato basusu.

headline: BCDC etekami na Eguity Group Holdings ya Kenya
text: Equity Group Holdings ya Kenya esakoli mercredi ete esombi 66,53% ya ba actions ya Banque commerciale du Congo (BCDC), banque privée ya kala koleka na RDC (wuto 1909). Millionnaire belge George Forrest, oyo azali na mibu 30, actionnaire ya monene koleka nde atekli Equity Group Holdings ba parts na ye. Ntalo na yango ezalaki 95 millions ya ba dollars. "Nateki ba actions na ngai na Equity Group Holdings na elikya ete ekokoma banque ya monene koleka na Congo," elobi M. Forrest na liyebisi. Misala mya Forrestmivandisama na RDC wuto 1922. Misala myango mizali mingi na makele (mines) na Katanga ya kala. M. Frorrest asombaki 2/3 ya actions ya BCDC na 2009. Bosangani ya BCDC na Equity Group Holdings bosalami ntango Raw Bank, banque mosusu privée ya monene, ezali afundami na kaniaka ya kobenwisa mi misolo mizalaki mpo misala mya botongi mpo na mikolo nkama ya président Félix Tshisekedi.

headline: Bosambisami bwa Trump bobandi kasi basambeli ba ye balobi akozala te mpo asi alongwa
text: Basambeli ba Donald Trump balobi mokonzi ya kala ya Amerika akoki te kotelema na bosimbisami bwa ye boye misala mya yango bozali kobanda (lelo) mardi 9 février mpo asi atika bokonzi. Ba avocats ba 45e président ya Etats-Unis bakundoli ete bosambisami to “empeachment” boye bozali mpo na kolongola Donald Trump na bokonzi nzonkande ye asi atikaki ebonga ya bakonzi. Wuto le 20 janvier, Joe Biden akomaki 46e président ya Etats-Unis nsima na kolapa ndayi mpe kovandisama na bokonzi na kokitana na M. Trump. Lelo, mardi 9 février misala mya “empeachment” to bosambisami bwa M. Trump bozali kobanda nsima na ye kofundama na suku ya ba Représentants (ba députés na Etats-Unis) mpo na eyoma balandi ba ye basalaki le 6 janvier na ntina ya kopesi Congrès kondima elonga ya Joe Biden na maponami ma mokonzi ya mboka. O’mokolo mwa yambo ya bosambisami bwango, ngambo inso nde ekoloba liboso lya Senat mpo etali loboko lya bosambisami bwango kolanda Buku likonzi. Ekomi mbala ya mibale ete M. Trump asamba liboso lya Congrès. Mbala ya yambo ezalaki mpo na kofundama na boyokani bwa ya nkunku na Russie.

headline: COVID-19: Président ya Burkina Faso apesi sanza motoba ya lifuta na ye
text: Président ya Burkina Faso, Jean Marc Kaboré, akopesa sanza motoba ya lifuta na ye mpo na kobundisa coronavirus ya sika, eyebisi mbula lamatari ya Burkina Faso. Bayi mbulamatari mpe bakopesa sanza mike, mpe ba masques manso ekokelama na mboka, kolanda mokano ya bankonzi. "Président ya Faso akopesa sanza motoba ya lifuta na ye, Ministre wa yambo sanza minei, ba ministres d’Etat sanza mibale mpe ba ministres sanza moko mpo kosangisami misolo ya kobindisa COIVD-29," elobi ministre molebeli ya mbulamatari, Remis Dandjinou. Bakonzi bazwi mokano ete kolata masque ekoma lotomo kobanda le 27 avril. Mbulamatari ya Burkina Faso ezwi mpe mokano ete ba masques manso to pizipelo ya zolo esala na mboka na bango. Bakosalela biloko biwuti na cotton, bibengami na mboka na bango "Faso Danfani". Bavandi ya mboka baiike basepelina mokano yango, Baiike basengi ete bankonzi ya mboka bakabola ba masques ofele mpo eliki ntalo mpe bapesa bana mboka biloko misusu basengeli na yango lokola bilei mpo bavandi na ndako.

headline: Stade des martyrs ebongi nanu te mpo na ba matches ya qualitifaction ya Mondial (CAF)
text: CAF (Confédération africaine de footb epesi nzela te ete ba matches ya qualifications ya mondiale ya Qatar 2022 ebetama na Stade des martyrs. CAF elobi misala mya bobongisi Statde eye misengeli misila malamu. "Tomoni ete bopusami ya misala ya stade (des Martyrs) bozali nanu kosalama mpo na kokoma na esika esengeli na ntina ya kopesa bolamu na basani, ba officilesi mpe ba suporters," ekomi CAF na mokanda etindeli FECOFA (Fédération congolaise ya football association). Na mokano na yango, CAF epekisi FECOFA kobetisa ba matches ya qualification ya mondial ya Fifa Qatar 2022 mpo na ba journées ya misato na minei na stade des Martyrs. CAF epesi FECOFA kino le 22 septembre kopona stade mosusu mpo na ba matches yango. Mokano ya CAF mozwamaki nsima na botindami ya inspecteurs ya CAF na stade ya Martyrs baye bazwaki ba photos mpe bililingi. Batindami ya CAF bakoya kotala soki ba matches ekoki kobetama na novembre.

headline: Lucha epesi mbano na ba sango mpo mpiko na bango
text: Mouvement citoyen Lucha (Lutte pour le changement) epesi palata to mbano ya 2019 na nkombo ya Luc Nkulula na ba nganga Nzambe ya katoliko ya doyenné ya Kinshasa mpo na oyo etali mpiko ma bango. Mbano yango epesameli bango lokola bazalaki na molongo mwa yambo na milulu misalamaki kati na 2017 na 2018 mpo na kosenga botosi ya Mobeko likonzi mpe bosali ya maponami na bonsomi mpe bosembo. Ezali mpe mpo na botamboli bonso bosalamaki le 31 décembre 2017, le 21 janvier 2018 mpe le 28 février 2018. Mbano yango epesami na bokanisi Luc Nkulula moko ya babundi ya Lucha oyo akufaki kati na moto na ndako na ye le 11 juin 2018. Mpo na baye ya LUCHA mpe mangomba misusu ya bitumba mpo na botosi ya ekolo ezali misala ya bokengi nde mibomaki Luc Nkulula.

headline: Mgr Gérard Mulumba atiyami mokambi ya Maison civile ya mokonzi ya mboka
text: Mgr Gérard Mulumba atiyami mokambi ya Maison civile ya président Félix Tshisekedi. Elongo na ye, bakonzi ya Maison militaire mpe batiyami, kolanda ba décrets présidentiels bisakolami mardi. Mgr Gérard Mulumba, episkopo ya kala ya diocese ya Mweka na Kasaï, azali leki ya nkondo Etienne Tshisekedi. Elongo moko na ye, officier général François Kabamba atiyami conseiller militaire ya mokonzi ya ekolo. Général - major Jean Claude Yav Kabey ye nde atiyami mokambi ya Maison militaire tata mokonzi. Général Augustin Mwanda akomi chargé des opérations. Mpe Général MArcel Lukwikila, chargé de l'administration.

headline: Bismack Biyombo basketteur ya NBA apesi million $ moko ya ba masques na RDC
text: Bismack Biyombo, basketteur congolais ya NBA na Etats-Unis apesi ba masques ya misolo millions moko ya ba dollars mpo na mboka na ye awuta Ekolo Congo démocratique na ntina ya kobundisa coronavirus ya sika (COVID19). Kolanda fondation ebangami na nkombo na ye Bismark Biyombo, mosani oyo ya Charlotte Hornets atindi ba containers minei ya ba masques nkoto zomi mpe na bilamba ya kobatela nzoto nkama sambo na tuku mwambe. Crise tozali komona nanu tomona yango te. Kotala ndenge mboka nga ezali komonyokwama na lolenge ya makasi boye, elobi Biyombo. Mobeti basket oyo akanisi ete esengeli kozwa bisaleli mingi ya bokolongono mpo na système sanitaire ya RDC ebebisama uto mibu mingi likolo na bokono mingi lokola Ebola mpe malaria oyo bopesanaka kowuta na moto mosusu. RDC esi ezwi bato 267 baye bayebani kozala naCOVID-19, 22 bakufi mpe 23 babikisami, kolanda INRB, Institut national ya recherches biomédicales.

headline: Owek. Mayiga akuutidde abavubuka ku buyiiya n’obumalirivu
text: Kamalabyonna Charles Peter Mayiga akuutidde abavubuka wonna mu ggwanga okubeera abayiiya, abagumiikiriza, era abeesimbu bwebaba baagala okugenda mu maaso basobole okwekalakaanya. Entanda Katikkiro Mayiga agiwadde bw’abadde asisinkanye abavubuka abakulisitaayo okuva mu matendekero ag’enjawulo abeegattira mu kibiina ki National Christian Association. “Obulamu buli emijiji ena, ogusooka nga tuli mabujje, ogw’okubiri ogw’obuvubuka bwemulimu, Ogw’okusajjakula awamu n’obukadde. Naye omujiji ogusinga okubeera omukulu gwe gw’obuvubuka. Byokola ku myaka gino byebisalawo onaaba otya nga osajjakudde. Mulaba abantu abakulu nga babagamba nti yeeyisa nga omwana omuto ekitegeeza nti alina byatakola,” Owek. Mayiga. Abasabye okulemerako mwebyo byebakola basobole okugenda mu maaso mwebyo byebakola kibayambe okulaakulana. Owek. Mayiga abasabye okuwaayo obudde bweba baagala okulaba ku magoba geebyo byebatandiseewo awatali kufaayo ku kiseera era nabasaba babeere beetegefu okuyiga bulijjo okugatta kwebyo byebamanyi. Katikkiro Mayiga bano abagambye nti buli kyebakola tebalina kwerabira buwangwa bwabwe mwebasibuka kuba kijja kubeera kyangu okusobola okukola emirimu emirala.  Bano Ow’omumbuga abeebazizza olw’okunyweza obumu nga beegattira mu kibiina kyabwe era abawadde entanda esobola okubasomesa mu lugendo lwabwe olwobuvubuka. Ye Minisita avunaanyizibwa ku bavubuka, emizannyo n’okwewummuzaamu, Owek. Henry Kiberu Ssekabembe ategeezezza nti ekibiina kino kiri mu nkwatagana naba Buganda Youth Council era nabasaba okukola buli kimu n’obukugu okusobola okuvuganya mu nsi. Akulembeddemu abavubuka bano munnamateeka, Simon Ssenyonga agamba nti ekibiina kino kyatandikibwa mu mwaka gwa 2018 nekigendererwa kyakulaba ng’ abavubuka bwebamaliriza okusoma babaako kyebeekolera wakati nga tebanafuna mirimu.

headline: Aba NUP balumirizza aba NRM ku by’okulumba woofiisi zaabwe e Gulu
text: Bannakibiina kya National Unity Platform(NUP) bavuddeyo ne balumiriza ekibiina ekiri mu buyinza ekya National Resisitance Movement ku by’okulumba woofiisi zaabwe olwaleero mu kibuga Gulu.  Okusinziira ku mwogezi w’ekibiina kino, Joel Ssenyonyi, bw’abadde ayogerako eri bannamawulire, ategeezezza nti obulumbaganyi n’effujjo ebikoleddwa ku woofiisi yaabwe bwe bikulembeddwamu eyaliko omukulembeze mu kibiina kya NUP, Tonny Olenge ng’ono yasala dda eddiiro ne yeegatta ku kibiina kya NRM. Ssenyonyi agamba nti tewali kubuusabuusa ku bigendererwa bya Olenge kubanga eyali mukwanaganya w’ekibiina mu kibiina mu kitundu kino ne bamusaba addeko wabbali olw’okumuzuulamu ebirumira. “Abavubuka bano baalumbye ekitebe ky’ekibiina nga beefudde bannakibiina abalina ensonga ze baagala zigonjoolwe naye ng’ekituufu baagadde kuvumaganyisa bakulembeze baffe wamu n’okuteekawo akavuyo. Eyakulembeddemu okulumba kuno yaliko owa NUP n’adda mu NRM gy’akola ng’omukunzi w’ekibiina,” Ssenyonyi bw’agambye. Ssenyonyi ategeezezza nti mu bulumbaganyi obukoleddwa, ebintu bingi ebyonooneddwa era nebibbibwa nga n’ebipande by’ekibiina kino nabyo birekeddwa ku ttaka. Wabula Ssenyonyi alaze obwennyamivu eri ebitongole ebikuumaddembe olw’okuba nti wadde nga bino baabiyise mu budde okutaakiriza embeera wabula tebalina kuyambibwa kwonna kwe baafunye okuva ku poliisi. Ono alabudde abo bonna ababadde mu lukwe luno n’ategeeza nti ebikolwa nga bino bibongera maanyi ng’aba NUP era n’awera nti bagenda kugenda mu maaso n’emirimu gyabwe mu kitundu kino eky’e Gulu.

headline: ‘Quarter Final’ z’ekikopo ky’Amasaza ya Ssande eno – Omuk. Ssejjengo
text: Olukiiko oluddukanya emipiira gy’ Amasaza mu Buganda, lutegeezezza nga oluzannya lwa ‘Quarter Finals’ olwali luyimiriziddwa, lugenda luzannyibwa ku Ssande eno. Kino kirangiriddwa Ssentebe w’olukiiko oluddukanya empaka zino, Sulaiman Ssejjengo mu lukung’aana lwa bannamawulire ku Lwokubiri e Bulange Mmengo.  “Twetegereza embeera eno era twebuzizza ku bakugu ab’enjawulo okuva mu bitongole ebikwatibwako netusalawo ‘Quarter’ fayinolo zizanyizibwa ku Ssande nga 2/10/2022 mu masaza Busiro nga Mawokota ekyaza Buddu, Busiro ekyaza Gomba, Ssingo ekyaza Kyaggwe ne Buweekula ejja kuba ekyaza Bulemeezi,” Omuk. Ssejjengo bw’agambye. Omuk. Ssejjengo agamba nti bakukozesa amakubo gonna abakugu gebabalambise okusobola okutangira ensaasaana y’ekirwadde kino. Ono akubiriza ttiimu n’abawagizi okuteekawo ebifo abawagizi webanaanaabira engalo awamu n’okwambala masiki era banywerere ku biragiro ebinabaweebwa okusobola okuziyiza ekirwadde kino. Omuk. Ssejjengo bannabyamizannyo abasabye okubeera obulindaala basobole okukuuma obulamu bwabwe obulungi.

headline: Mubuulire abantu gavumenti by’ekoze okubataasa ku bulimba bwa Opozisoni – Museveni
text: Kampala Pulezidenti Yoweri Kaguta Museveni asabye ababaka okubuulira abalonzi ebintu bye basobodde okukolera  eggwanga nga National Resistance Movement (NRM), kiyambe okukendeeza ku bulimba obutambuzibwa ab’oludda oluvuganya.Wadde emabegako Pulezidenti Museveni yali yategeeza nga bw’ateeteega kubuulira bantu Birungi NRM byekoze, yeefukuludde eggulo ku Mmande n’asaba bannaNRM okulaga ensi ebikoleddwa gavumenti ye.  “Enkola yaffe nga bannansiko ey’okukola ebintu mu kasirise, tutandike okwogera ku ebyo bye tutuuseeko. Bino bye tubaddeko eby’okutulabira ku bikolwa byaffe erina okukoma tulabe twetutambula.” Museveni bwe yannyonnyodde. Museveni bwe yabadde akuba ttooci mu bituukiddwako mu kisanja ‘Hakuna Mchezo’ Manifesto 2016-2021  era n’alaga ebimu ku bintu ebisobodde okutuukibwako ebyetaaga okulagibwa ensi. “Essaawa ya leero, Uganda etunda ebweru amajaani agaweza kkiro obukadde 60, ensawo z’emmwanyi obukadde 70, Obulimi bwa Ppamba bweyongedde ate nga n’ebyobulambuzi byali bituwa ensimbi mpitirivu nga Corona tannabalukawo.” Museveni bwe yagambye. Museveni agamba nti ebyenfuna byongera okukula buli lunaku kuba emmere yonna eyalimibwanga okuliibwa omuli amata n’ebirala byokka kati bifunibwamu ssente. Ono akunze ababaka okuteeka essira ku kutondawo emirimu wamu n’okuyamba abantu ab’enjawulo okukulaakulana. Yasabye abantu okutandika okulima mu bungi basobole okutundako era bafube okugatta omutindo ku ebyo bye balima. Mu kwogera kwe, Ssaabaminisita Ruhakana Rugunda alaze ebimu ku bituukiddwako mu kisanja Hakuna Mchezo omuli; okwongera ku bungi bw’amasannyalaze, okuzzaawo ennyonyi y’eggwanga, okukola enguudo ez’enjawulo wamu n’okutuusa amazzi amayonjo ku bantu. Museveni yakuutidde ababaka abapya okugoberera era baagazise abantu enteekateeka za gavumenti ez’enjawulo, basobole okuyambibwako okweggya mu bwavu.

headline: Ssaabasajja Kabaka asiimye okulabikako eri Obuganda ng’atongoza empaka z’Ebika
text: Ssaabasajja Kabaka, Ronald Muwenda Mutebi II asiimye okulabikako eri Obuganda nga aggulawo empaka z’Ebika bya Buganda, nga 28th May 2022, ku kisaawe kya Kasana – Luweero mu Bulemeezi. Bino byogeddwa Minista w’Abavubuka, Ebyemizannyo n’Okwewummuzaamu Owek. Henry Sekabembe Kiberu ku Lwokuna e Bulange- Mengo “Ssaabasajja Kabaka asiimye okulabikako eri Obuganda nga 28, omwezi guno ogw’ okutaano, omwaka guno gwennyini mu ssaza lye erye Bulemeezi e Kasana Luweero nga aggulawo empaka z’ebika z’omwaka guno, ttiimu ezigenda okuggulawo tujja kuzibategeeza mu bwangu ddala nga tumaze okwetegereza ensonga eziwerako,” Owek. Ssekabembe bw’agambye. Okusinziira ku Ssekabembe, empaka zino zigenda kutegekebwa mu bbago eppya eryavudde mu kunoonyereza okwakoleddwa akakiiko akaweebwa omulimu gw’okuzza ekitiibwa, ettutumu n’omutindo gw’ empaka zino akakulirwa Kabugo Julius. Owek. Ssekabembe agambye nti ebika 30 byebimaze okwewandiisa mu nteekateeka eno era wabaddewo ensisinkano n’enkiiko eziwerako okuddabulula ekikopo kino. Ono annyonnyodde obukulu bw’ekikopo kino nategeeza nti kye kyokka ekyetabwamu bazzukulu na Nambi okuviira ddala ku bukulembeze waggulu okutuuka wansi ku bazannyi. Minisita Ssekabembe akunze abantu ba Buganda yonna gyebali okuvaayo okuwagira enteekateeka eno era bakomye okunenya n’okwekubagiza basobole okuzzaawo ekitiibwa n’ettutumu ly’ ekikopo kino nga bwekyali mu myaka gya 90.  Owek. Henry Sekabembe Kiberu, era ategezeza nti Gavumenti ya Ssaabasajja Kabaka, esiimye nekolamu enkyukakyuka mu lukiiko olugenda okuddukanya empaka zino, era neyebaza nyoo bonna ababaddeko kuba baweerereza mu kiseera ekijjudde okusomoozebwa. Kati olukiiko olupya lukulirwa Ssentebe, Katambala Hajji Sulaiman Magala, omumyuka we Asooka ye Hajji Jamir Ssewanyana ng’ono avunaanyizibwa ku mipiira ogw’ebigere, Omumyuka ow’okubiri, Dr. Sarah Nkonge ng’ono avunaanyizibwa ku mupiira gw’engalo oba okubaka. Omuwandiisi w’olukiiko ye Gerald Katamba ate Omuwanika ye Micheal Nsereko, avunaanyizibwa ku bannamikago n’abavujirizi ye Rebecca Nassuna, Clive Kyazze ne James Ntambi bavunaanyizibwa ku mawulire ate Manisur Kabugo wa kikugu mu mupiira gw’ ebigere ate Kaala Rose wa kubaka. Minisita Ssekabembe agamba nti emyaka egisoose 3, Abataka bagenda kukiikirira naye mu maaso awo baveeko era ng’omukiise w’abataka ye Nakigoye Nabimba ate alina okulondoola buli kimu okuteekebwa mu nkola ye Julius Kabugo olwo Catherine Nakigudde akiikirire abakyala.

headline: Bannayuganda Abalala Baakuddamu Okuzzibwa Mu Ggwanga
text: Minisitule evunaanyizibwa ku nsonga z’ebweru erangiridde nti yakuddamu okuleeta bannayuganda abakonkomalidde mu mawanga amalala olwekirwadde kya coronavirus. Enteekateeka eno yayimirizibwa ssabiiti bbiri emabega.Gavumenti yayimiriza enteekateeka eno olw’omujjuzo bubifo awakuumirwa abantu abaakatuuka mu ggwanga biyite kalantiini centre. Gavumenti yali yassaawa ebifo bino 37 nga bisuubirwamu abantu 2500. Newankubadde nga minisitule y’ebyobulamu yali esuubira abantu 300 buli wiiiki bbiri, abantu 100 bayiika mu ggwanga mu wiiki emu yokka. Abantu abalala 1000 bakyakonkomalidde mu mawanga amalala. Okusinziira ku kiwandiiko ekifulimiziddwa minisitule y’ensonga z’e bweru, kyategeezezza nti batereezezza embeera abantu mwebagenda okubeera nga bazze. Bannayuganda abalala basuubirwa okutuuka mu ggwanga nga July 18. Minisitule yasuubizza okuzza kuno Bannayuganda bonna abakyakonkomalidde ebweru. Bannayuganda okuva e South Africa, Turkey, India, United Kingdom, Switzerland, Italy ne United Arab Emirates bebaakomezeddwawo kuno nga bonna bateekebwa mu kalantiini okumala ssabbiiti bbiri. URN

headline: Abakazi baleseewo obufumbo ne bagenda ku byeyo – Alipoota
text: Minisitule y’ekikula ky’abantu n’enkulaakulana yaabwe, etegeezezza ng’omuwendo gw’abasajja abeemulugunya ku bakyala baabwe ababadduseeko ne bagenda okukuba ekyeyo mu mawanga g’Abawarabu bwe gweyongedde. Okusinziira ku Ministule eno, okwemulugunya kuno okusingakuva mu basajja abawangaalira mu byalo era nga bagamba nti tebalina kye bamanyi abakyala baabwe gye bali, ekintu ekireeseewo okwekyawa mu baami bano nga weetaaga okubaawo ekikolebwa. Minisitule egamba nti abakyala bava mu maka gaabwe ng’abaami tebategedde ne bagenda okwenogera ku nsimbi mu kyondo kya Buwarabu. “Mu kitongole kyaffe ekirwanyisa okukusa abantu mu minisitule y’ekikula ky’abantu ekya ‘ National Centre for Coordination and Prevention of Trafficking in Persons,’ twongedde okufuna okwemulugunya okuva mu basajja ku bakyala baabwe okubabulako ne bagenda ku kyeyo.” Amyuka akulira ekitongole kino Agnes Igoye bw’ategeezezza. Ebiri mu Minisitule eno biraga nti omuwendo gw’abavubuka abawalaabagenda ku kyeyo gweyongedde nnyo okusinga ku gw’abalenzi. Wabula Igoye agamba nti wadde abasajja beemulugunya kyokka bwe bagenze mu maaso n’okukebera ekituufu oba bano babadde bakyala baabwe, kizuuse nti tebaabawasa mu mateeka nga bwe baba bagamba. Ono asabye abakyala okwesonyiwa okudduka ku basajja n’ategeeza nti singa wabaawo obutakkaanya ekisinga kutuula na kwogerezeganya okusinga okugumaza embiro. Minisitule eraze nti ekimu ku bintu ebisinze okuvaako abakyala okuddukira ku kyeyo bwe bufumbo n’omukwano gwe babaddemu okusasika. Ku nsonga z’omuwala Judith Nakintu eyaggyibwamu ensigo bwe yali akola mu kiyumba muSaudi Arabia, Igoye agamba nti Ssaabawaabi wa gavumenti yamaze dda okuggula emisango ku bannannyini kkampuni ya Nile Treasure Gates Company abaatwala omuwala ono okukola era mu bwangu baakusimbibwa mu maaso g’omulamuzi. Abavunaanibwa kuliko; Kato Abubaker, Muhammad Mariam, Ali Hassan ne Salma Muhammad. Kigambibwa nti Nakintu yatwalibwa kkampuni ya Nile Treasure mu 2019 okukola e Saudi Arabia ng’omukozi wa waka naye mu 2021 bakama be baamutwala mu ddwaliro okumugema COVID-19 naye n’amaliriza ng’ensigo bazitutte.

headline: Bobi Wine akunze abawangaalira ebweru okwenyigira mu kukyusa obuyinza
text: Pulezidenti w’ekibiina kya National Unity Platform (NUP), Robert Kyagulanyi aka Bobi Wine, ategeezezza nti obuvunaanyizibwa bwa bannayuganda abawangaalira ebweru bulina okuggumizibwa n’okwongerwamu amaanyi. Kyagulanyi yagambye nti gwe mulundi ogusookedde ddala, okulaba nga bannayuganda ebweru bonna beenyigidde butereevu mu nsonga z’okununula eggwanga lyabwe. Bino Kyagulanyi yabyogeredde mu lukung’aana lwa bannayuganda abawangaalira ebweru ku wiikendi ewedde. Kyagulanyi yasiimye bannayuganda olw’omulimu amatendo gwe bakoze era n’abeebaza olw’okubafunira emikago awamu n’okwongera amaanyi mu lutalo luno nga bawaayo ku ebyo bye balina era n’abasaba okugutwala mu maaso. Okusinziira ku Kyagulanyi, Pulezidenti Museveni atya nnyo bannayuganda abali ebweru kuba naye baamuyamba nnyo mu lutalo olwamuleeta mu buyinza. “Mu myaka gya 1980 nga Museveni alwana, yeesigama nnyo ku kiwayi kya bannayuganda abaali ebweru aba National Resistance Army, (NRA) okuwangula Obote awamu n’okumukyayisa ensi.” Bobi Wine bw’agambye. Ono yannyonnyodde nti gavumenti ebataddeko abantu mu bitundu ebyenjawulo okugezaako okubaggya ku mulamwa wamu n’okubamalamu amaanyi naye n’abasaba babeere banywevu. “Eyo y’ensonga lwaki gavumenti ebataddemu bambega okubatambulizaako amaaso. Nsaba buli omu abeere bulindaala era yeekengere wakati nga tugezaako okutwala olutabaalo luno mu maaso.” Kyagulanyi bwe yalambuludde. Ono bannayuganda abawangaalira ebweru abasabye okukimanya nti okulwanyisa gavumenti si kintu kya lunaku lumu, oba misinde gya mubunabyalo. Noolwekyo balina okwetegeka okutwala olutalo luno mu maaso. Bobi Wine agamba nti okuwanika kibeera kitegeeza kwewaayo mu mikono gya Pulezidenti Museveni ne banne, abaliisa bannayuganda akakanja.

headline: Kyagulanyi asabye ab’e Tanzania okumuyamba aggyeko Museveni
text: Pulezidenti w’ekibiina ki National Unity Platform (NUP), Robert Kyagulanyi, amanyiddwa nga Bobi Wine asabye ekibiina ekivuganya gavumenti mu Tanzania ki Demokrasia na Maendeleo (CHADEMA) okubayambako okuggyako obukulembeze bwa Pulezidenti Yoweri Kaguta Museveni. Kyagulanyi okusaba kuno akukoze ku Lwakuna bweyabadde ayogerera mu Ttabamiruka w’ekibiina ki CHADEMA gyeyayitiddwa ng’omugenyi omukulu. Mu kwogera kwe, Bobi Wine yategeezezza nti abantu be Tanzania bakoze nnyo okuyambako bannayuganda mu mbeera yonna naddala okulwanyisa obufuzi bwa bannakyemalira n’okugezaako okutumbula nenfuga eya Demokulaasiya. “Obumu buno bwe bwayatuyamba okufuna obwetwaaze okuva ku bafuzi b’Amatwale okuva mu 1961 Tanzania bweyefuga, Uganda mu 1962 ne Kenya mu 1963,” Kyagulanyi bwe yagambye. Okusinziira ku Kyagulanyi singa bakozesa omutima gwebalina okuggyako Idi Amin mu 1970 basobola bulungi okuyambako bannayuganda okuggyako Museveni kuba akolera ddala ebyo Amin byeyali akola. Ono agamba nti wadde ekibiina ki CHADEMA kikoze nnyo okutuusa Demokulaasiya n’okulwanirira enkyukakyuka mu Tanzani naye okufananako n’amawanga amalala basanze olusozi okutuukiriza kino. “Ssentebe w’ekibiina Freeman Mbowe yakayimbulwa mu kkomera gyamaze emyezi 7 ku misango egyekuusa ku by’obufuzi n’obutujju. Omumyuka we Tundu Mughwai Lissu, akyali mu buwang’anguse oluvannyuma lw’okusimattuka okutemulwa,” Bobi Wine bwe yalambuludde. Kyagulanyi yatenderezza bannakibiina ki CHADEMA olw’okuyimirirawo mu mbeera yonna nebasobola okulwanirira eddembe ly’ abantu babwe. Bino webijjidde nga Pulezidenti wa Tanzania Samia Suluhu Hassan, yakakyaluka okuva mu Uganda gyabadde ku bugenyi bw’ennaku ebiri gyabadde nga asisinkana Pulezidenti Museveni. Abakulu bano bakubaganyiza ebirowoozo ku masanyalaze, obusuubuzi, entambula n’ebyobulamu wakati w’amawanga gombi awamu n’engeri gyebasobola okunywezaamu enkolagana.

headline: Okukuza olunaku lwa White Canes mu Buganda.
text: Obwakabaka bwa Buganda buwagidde enteekateeka y’okukuza olunaku lwa international white canes n’obuuma obweyambisibwa abalema okutambula amakumi ataano. Owekitiibwa Kyewalabye Male nga akwas Ssentebe wa ba muzibe emigo (White canes). Emiggo gino (white canes) giwereddwayo Obwakabaka nga bukikiriddwa Owekitiibwa David Kyewalabye Male ono nga Minisita w’Obuwangwa, Obulambuzi n’Embiri mu bwa Kabaka era nga emiggo gino gikwasiddwa Ssentebe w’ekibiina kya bamuzibwe ekya Uganda National Association for the Blind (UNAB).

headline: Christopher Aine agudde mu bintu; Museveni amulonze okumyuka RDC w’e Mbarara
text: Pulezidenti Yoweri Kaguta Museveni alonze Christopher Aine, okubeera omumyuka w’omubaka wa Pulezidenti e Mbarara. Aine nga ye yali akulira ebyokwerinda bye yali Ssaabaminisita era eyavuganya ku kalulu k’Obwapulezidenti aka 2021, John Patrick Amama Mbabazi, kati agenda kumyukaLt. Col James Mwsigye. Lt. Col. Mwesigye okulondebwa kwa Aine yakukakasizza ng’ayita ku lukomo lw’essimu era n’awayaamu n’omukutu gwa Chimpreports. Ekifo kino kibadde kimaze akaseera nga temuli muntu okuva omwaka oguwedde, oluvannyuma lwa Emmy Kateera eyakirimu okusindikibwa eRwampara ng’omubaka wa Pulezidenti ow’ekiseera mu kitundu ekyo. Aine ensi yamutegeerera ku kalulu ka 2016 ak’obwapulezidenti, bwe yalwanagana n’abeebykwerinda nga bagezaako okulemesa mukama we, Amama Mbabazi okukuba enkung’aana. Aine teyaddamu kulabikako oluvannyuma lw’okukwatibwa ab’ebyokwerinda era ekyaddako by’ebigambo okuyiting’ana ng’ono bwe yali attiddwa era omutimbagano ne gusaasaanirako ebifaananyi by’omulambo ogwali gugambibwa nti gugwe. Emyezi ebiri ng’akalulu kawedde, ono yalabika ng’ali ne Gen. Salim Saleh era ne yeewaayo mu mikono gy’abeebyokwerinda era n’ategeeza nti abadde yeekwese. Okulondebwa kwa Aine kuggumiza okutabagana wakati wa Amama Mbabazi ne Pulezidenti Museveni era bano baasalawo okuteeka embiranye yaabwe ku bbali baddemu okukolagana era bino bye bimu ku bibala.

headline: Ab’e Kira batandise okulwanyisa Corona ku mikolo gy’okuziika
text: Kampala  Abakulembeze mu Munisipaali y’e Kira, batandise kaweefube w’okwongera okutangira ensaasaana y’ekirwadde kya Ssennyiga Corona naddalaku mikolo egikung’aanya abantu abangi omuli okuziika. Omu ku batuula ku kakiiko akalwanyisa Corona mu Kira, Lubega Hussein, ategeezezza nti ekiseera kituuse abantu bafunirwe ebyambalo ebikozesebwa okuziika abafudde Corona, kiyambe okutangira obulwadde buno era n’okukendeeza ku ssente obulindo ezisasulwa kkampuni eziziika ababeera bafudde Corona. Okwogera bino Lubega asinzidde ku Kampala bw’abadde ayogerako ne bannamawulire ku kituufu ekirina okukolebwa okwewala ekirwadde kino. “Tulina eggombolola 3 mu Kira era twagala buli ggombolola efune ebyambalo by’okuziika 10 bannannyini bafu batandike okweziikira abantu. Kino kijja kuluma aba kkampuni eziziika naye tewali kyakukola kubanga abantu baffe abasinga tebalina busobozi bwa ssente zisabibwa okuziika abaagalwa baabwe abafudde Corona olwo abaavu ne basalawookubakweka ne babeezikira.” Lubega bw’agambye. Lubega annyonnyola nti ebyambalo bino bisobola bulungi okwozebwa mu ddagala nga Jik buli lwe bimala okwozebwa era n’asaba ababaka ba Palamenti okwenyigira mu nteekateeka eno, bayambeko abatuuze baabwe. Ono asabye bassentebe b’ebyalo bafeeyo mu kutumbula enteekateeka y’ebyambalo nga bazuula abafudde Corona ate ne bakakasa nti okuziika kugoberera emitendera emituufu. Lubega agamba nti basazeewo okulwanyisa Corona nga basomesa abantu ku byalo ebyenjawulo ku ngeri gye bayinza okwetangira ekirwadde kino n’engeri gye basobola okulwanyisaamu obulwadde buno.

headline: COVID-19: Poliisi eyongedde amaanyi mukukwata abajeemera ebiragiro bya Museveni
text: Luke Oweyesigire ayogerera poliisi y’e Kampala n’emirirwano Poliisi ya Uganda eyongedde amaanyi mu bikwekweto okukwata abo bonna abajeemera ebiragiro by’Omukulembeze w’eggwanga ku kulwanyisa ekirwadde kya senyiga owa COVID-19.  Olwaleero, poliisi ekutte abasomesa 53 eb’essomero lya Daffodil erisangibwa e Naggulu wamu n’abalala 23 aba Kabojja Junior school erisangibwa e Kamwokya. Bano bavunaanibwa okugenda mu maaso n’okusisinkana mu bungi ng’ate Museveni yalagira amasomero gonna gaggale okumala ennaku 32 ng’omu ku kaweefube w’okulemesa COVID-19 okusaasaana mu Uganda. Ayogerera poliisi y’e Kampala n’emirirwano Luke Oweyesigire yagambye nti abasomesa bano baatwaliddwa ku poliisi ya Kira Road gyebaalabuliddwa obutaddamu kukungaana. Poliisi era eggulo yakutte abasumba ab’enjawulo abaabadde bajeemedde ekiragiro kino ne bakungaanya abantu okusaba. Muno mwabaddemu ne Vicar General w’essaza ly’Ekeleziya ekkulu ery’e Kampala Musingnor Gerald Kalumba.  Essabbiiti ewedde, Omukulembeze w’eggwanga Yoweri Kaguta Museveni yalangirira nti yali aweze enkugaana ezaabuli kika omuli ez’ebyobufuzi, okuziika, okusaba mu mizikiti n’amakanisa, okuggala amabaala n’obutale wamu n’ebintu ebirala bingi mu kaweefube w’okulwanyisa ekirwadde kya COVID-19. Kyokka ku Lwomukaaga ekiro, minisita avunanyizibwa ku by’obulamu Jane Ruth Aceng yalangirira nti ekirwadde kyali kigobye mu Uganda. Munnayuganda amannya ge agaasirikirwa nga mutuuze w’e Kibuli yesangibwa n’ekirwadde kino oluvanyuma lw’okudda okuva e Dubai.

headline: Bannalotale beyanzizza Beene olw’okukyuusa embeera z’abantu
text: Kampala Bannalotale abeegattira mu disitulikiti etwala Uganda ne Tanzania nga bakulembedwamu abe Mmengo bawadde Ssaabasajja Kabaka Ronald Muwenda Mutebi II ejjinja ery’omuwendo okumusiima olw’okukyuusa embeera z’abantu mu Buganda. Bano eyanzizza Ssaabasajja Kabaka olw’okusiima nakwata omumuli gw’okulwanyisa ekirwadde kya Mukenenya ng’ali wamu n’ekitongole ekivunaanyizibwa ku kulwanyisa Mukenenya mu nsi yonna ekya UNAIDS. Kulwa Nnyinimu  ejjinja lino likwasiddwa omulangira David Kintu Wassajja, omuzaana Marion Nankya, omumyuka w’omukubiriza w’olukiiko lwa buganda owek Hajji Ahmed Lwasa wamu n’omukubiriza w’olukiiko lwabuganda eyawummula owek Nelson Kawalya. Omulangira Wasajja yagambye nti, “ Kibeere eky’okulabirako eri abantu abalala okuyamba abantu baffe ffenna tusobole okubeera mu nsi eyeyagaza. Nziramu okweyanza abalotale ye Mmengo abawadde Ssaabasajja ekirabo kino wamu n’omulimu gwebakola okukyuusa obulamu bw’abantu. ” Okusinziira ku Mulangira Wasajja Obwakabaka ne Lotale balina bingi byebafaananya nga enkola y’okuyamba abantu Buganda egiyita Bulungibwansi ate abalotale bagiyita ‘Above Self’. Akulira Lotale ye Mmengo, Ernest Kavulu yeyanzizza Kabaka Mutebi II olwokukolera  abantu be ng’ ayita mu kibiina kino. “Kabaka yatuwa amaanyi era natusongera ku  bwetaavu obuli e Kiyindi Najja eri mu Buikwe nga abantu baayo beetaaga okuyamba era netulwana okulaba nti tufunayo puloojekiti enayamba abantu baayo,” Kavulu bwe yagambye. Munnalotale era Minisita w’obuwangwa, ennono n’obulambuzi mu bwakabaka owek.David Kyewalabye Male agamba nti kituufu omuntu akola obulungi asiimibwe era akubiriza abantu ab’enjawulo naddala abavubuka okwegata ku lotale bakyuuse embeera zabantu. Kinajjukirwa nti Omuteregga alina enteekateeka ez’enjawulo ezigendereddwamu okukyusa embeera z’abantu nga atumbula eby’enjigiriza, eby’obulamu, ebyobulamu saako n’ebyenkulakulana.

headline: FDC eyagala ebyemizannyo byawulwe ku by’enjigiriza
text: Kampala  Ekibiina kya Forum for Democratic Change (FDC) kisabye gavumenti eyawule Minisitule y’ebyenjigiriza ku by’emizannyo okusobola okubiwa ensimbi ezimala n’okutumbula ebitone. Bano kino baakiyisizza mu amyuka omwogezi w’ekibiina, John Kikonyogo,bwe yabadde ayogerako eri bannamawulire ku Mmande n’ategeeza nti eno yeemu ku ngeri gavumenti gy’eyinza okulaga nti efaayo ku by’emizannyo. “Bw’oba oyagala okufuna mu by’emizannyo, eby’emizannyo byawule ku by’enjigiriza. Ebisaawe byonna bitundiddwa tulina okubizzaawo. Nga FDC tulowooza nti okufuna mu by’emizannyo tulina okuteekamu ssente, okutendeka era tuliise bannabyamizannyo baffe.” Kikonyogo bwe yagambye. Bino we/bijjidde n’eggwanga likyali mu kujaguza olw’abaddusi b’emisinde okuli Joshua Cheptegi ne Peruth Chemutai, okuwangulira Uganda emidaali gya zzaabu mu mpaka za Olympics eza 2020 ezayindidde mu kibuga Tokyo ekya Japan. Uganda yawangudde emidaali 4, n’ekwata kyakubiri mu mawanga ga Africa. Kikonyogo yagambye nti ekiseera kituuse gavumenti eyongere ssente mu by’emizannyo kuba singa bakola kino kibeera tekyetaagisa kupangisa kampuni z’ebweru okutunda ekifaananyi kya Uganda mu mawanga amalala okutumbula eby’obulambuzi. Ono asabye n’ensimbi eziweebwa bannabyamizannyo nga bagenda ebweru w’eggwanga zongerweko kuba embeera nga bw’eri kati bannabyamizannyo naddala abaddusi kumpi be beeyimirizaawo era gavumenti ebalowoozaako nga bamaze kuwangula. Kinajjukirwa nti ababaka nga Allan Ssewanyana bazze basaba gavumenti eyawule ebyemizannyo ku by’enjigiriza kuba enkizo eweebwa Minisitule y’ebyenjigiriza so si byamizannyo. Bwe yali asiibula ttiimu eyagenda mu Olympics, Pulezidenti Museveni yagamba nti gavumenti ye ekoze kinene okutumbula ebyemizannyo era n’asaba bannayuganda okujjumbira ebyemizannyo kisobozese eggwanga obutasindika bakungu bangi okusinga abazannyi. Kikonyogo era asabye gavumenti okuggula omukutu gwa Facebook n’ategeeza nti kino kiremesezza bbizineesi z’abantu nnyingi era ne kiremesa abantu okutunda ebintu byabwe ku mutimbagano.

headline: Owek. Kaawaase alaze ensi yonna engeri Buganda gyekuttemu olutalo lwa Mukenenya
text: Omumyuka wa Katikkiro Asooka, era Minisita Avunaanyizibwa ku Nzirukanya y’Emirimu; Tekinologiya n’Obuyiiya, Oweek. Prof. Twaha K. Kaawaase, alaze Buganda yeeyimiride ku lutalo lw’okulwanyisa Mukenenya okulaba nti afuuka olufumo 2030, wanaatuukira. Obubaka buno Owek. Kaawaase abuweeredde Thailand gyagenze okukiikirira Obwakabaka mu lukiiko olwategekeddwa ekitongole eky’ensi yonna ekirwanyisa mukenenya ki UNAIDS. Olukungaana lw’atudde n’ekigendererwa eky’ongera amaanyi mu kulwanyisa mukenenya n’okumumalirawo ddala omwaka 2030, wegunaatuukira. Owek. Kaawaase, alaze emirimu emirungi n’amaanyi Kabaka g’atadde ku kaweefube w’okulwanyisa mukenenya okuva lwe yakwasibwa obuvunaanyizibwa obw’okukulemberamu OMUMULI gw’okulwanyisa obulwadde buno. Kabaka alwanyisizza mukenenya ng’ayita mu kutumbula eby’emizannyo, nga emisinde gy’amazaalibwa ge, egyetabwamu abantu abasukka 80,000; omupiira gw’amasaza, ogwetabwako abantu abasukka 30,000; awamu n’omupiira gw’ebika. Gino gyonna mu kiseera kino gizannyibwa ku mulamwa ogw’okulwanyisa mukenenya. Ono annyonnyodde ku byooto ebikumibwa mu Buganda wonna okusomesezaako abavubuka ebikwata ku mukenenya n’ensonga ez’ebyobulamu.  So ng’ate n’obukulembeze bw’Obwakabaka obutambulizibwa mu masaza busaale nnyo mu kutambuza obubaka ku mukenenya. Owek. Kaawaase ategeezezza olukiiko nti omulimu Kabaka gw’akoze guyambye nnyo okukendeeza ku kusaasaana kwa mukenenya n’ebitundu 52 ku 100. Abantu beeyongedde okutegeera n’okumanya ebikwata ku mukenenya okuva ku bitundu 89 okutuuka ku 94, so nga n’abalwadde abakkiriza okujjanjabwa beeyongedde okuva ku bitundu 64 okutuuka ku 92. Era abakakasizza olukiiko nti Obwakabaka bwa kugenda mu maaso ne kaweefube w’okulwanyisa mukenenya, butaase abantu. Kinajjukirwa nti ekitongole k’ensi yonna ekirwanyisa mukenenya, kikulirwa omukyala Munnayuganda, Winnie Byanyima. Mu lutuula luno, olukiiko lwonna awamu lusiimye nnyo Ssaabasajja Kabaka olwa kaweefube w’okulwanyisa mukenenya, ate n’okubeera eky’okulabirako nti kisoboka okumulwanyisa nga tuyita mu buwangwa bwaffe.

headline: 4 bavudde mu lwokaano lwa Lubaga South, balekedde Mukaaku
text: Bya Gladys Nanyombi Lubaga Akalulu katuuse wekanyumira, abeesimbyewo  mu lwokaano lw’omubaka wa Lubaga South mu Palamenti abawera bana, basazeewo okuwagira munnakibiina ki National Unity Platform (NUP) Samuel Walter Lubega Mukaaku ku kifo kino. Mukaaku wamu n’abamwegasseeko Bano okuli; Joel Yiga, Masembe Moses, Ssemusu Mugobansonga ne Denis Kiyingi bategeezezza olupapula luno olwa Gambuuze nti, beetunuddemu nebalaba nga Mukaaku abasinza obuwagizi era ajja kusobola okutuusayo ensonga zabwe. “Bwetwabadde mu nteseganya, nze nabadde omukubiriza w’enkiiko zonna era mubwerufu twagenze mu maaso n’okuba akalulu era kawanguddwa Lubega Mukaaku,”Omu ku babadde bavuganya ku kifo kino Denis Kiyingi bweyategeezezza. Wabula bino Aloysious Mukasa ali ku mbiranye ne Mukaaku yabiwakkanyiza nagamba nti, olukiiko olw’engeri eno terunabaawo bano bali mu katemba wabwe, yye akalulu akyakalimu. Ate yye Masembe Moses yagambye nti, Mukaaku bamuwadde omukisa nga bbo abavubuka era namulabula nti singa ava ku bigendererwa bya NUP bakukola kyonna ekisoboka okudda bamwesimbeko. Mukaaku yeebazizza banne era nalaga nti, mwetegefu okukyusa ekitundu kya Lubaga South wamu nokwongera okutunda ekibiina ki NUP mu bantu. “Ndi mwetegeefu okwanganga ekifo ekimpereddwa era singa mba nkwasiddwa Kaadi ya NUP, nkakasa nti benvuganya nabo mu bibiina ebirala njakubawangula,” Mukaaku bweyanyonyodde. Mukaaku yakkiriza nti, ekibiina tekinavaayo mubutongole kulaga gwebagenda kuwa kkaadi naye ye n’abamuvuganya basazeewo bawewule ku mulimu gw’ ekibiina mukukkiriziganya. Mukaaku yakakasizza nti, ku lw’ekibiina nebwabeera tawereddwa kkaadi mwetegefu okuwagira oyo anabeera ayiseemu mu mazima n’obwenkanya era ajja kumunoonyeza akalulu. Abawagizi b’ekibiina ki NUP mu Lubaga basiimye ekikolwa ekyakoleddwa Kiyingi ne banne nebategeeza nti kiraga obuzira n’okwagaliza abalala.

headline: Balonze ebisaawe omunaazannyirwa egy’Amasaza
text: Olukiiko oluddukanya empaka z’omupiira gw’amasaza lutegeezezza nti lulonze ebisaawe emipiira mwe gigenda okusambibwa wakati mu kwekuuma ekirwadde kya Ssennyiga Corona. Akulira akakiiko Sulaiman Ssejjengo Okusinziira ku ssentebe w’olukiiko luno, Sulaiman Ssejjengo, olukalala lw’ebisaawe ebigenda okukozesebwa sizoni eno bamaze okubiweereza mu kibiina ekiddukanya omupiira mu ggwanga ekya FUFA era nga basuubira nti mu bwangu bigenda kulambulwa. “ Ebisaawe twabironze nga tutunuulira ebyo ebizimbe ebisobola okubeera nti tetukozesa maanyi mangi okuziyiza abawagizi obutayingira mu bisaawe,” Ssejjengo bw’agambye. Ono agasseeko nti ekirala kye baataddeko essira by’ebitundu ebirina ebisulo ebiriraanye ekisaawe okulaba ng’abazannyi bakuumirwa mu bifo eby’okumpi okusobola okubatangira ekirwadde kino. Ssejjengo annyonnyodde nga bwe bafuddeyo ennyo ku by’okwerinda n’obujjanjabi nga balonze ebisaawe ebiriraanye amalwaliro amanene we basobola okuggya obujjanjabi obwamangu nga waliwo ekyetaagisizza. Ono agambye nti kati balinze FUFA okukakasa ebisaawe bino n’oluvannyuma bateese n’abakulembera ttiimu wansi mu Masaza babawe amagezi ku ngeri gye banaasengeka ebibinja eby’enjawulo. Empaka z’amasaza ze zimu ku mpaka ezisinga obuganzi era ezisinga okubeerako abawagizi naye olw’ekirwadde kya COVID-19 abategesi babadde bakyanoonya engeri gye giyinza okuzannyibwamu nga temuli bantu bangi. Kati ekirindiriddwa lwe lukalala lw’ebisaawe olugenda okufulumizibwa oluvannyuma lw’okukakasibwa ekibiina kya FUFA.

headline: Gavumenti erabudde abatandise okuleeta obukubagano mu kulonda
text: Kampala Gavumenti erabudde ku bantu abatandise okukola obuvuyo n’okuleeta obukubagano mu kalulu ka 2021 nti tebagenda kubakkiriza kutabangula mirembe. Minisita Betty Amongi Okulabula kuno kukoleddwa Minisita wa Kampala Betty Amongi leero ku Lwokusatu ku Media Centre mu Kampala bwabadde ayogerako eri bannamawulire, nategeeza nti nga abakulira ekibuga tebagenda kutunula butunuzi nga bannabyabufuzi batabangula emirembe. “Tetugenda kusibamu okukola kwoyo yenna aleeta obuvuyo wamu n’okutulugunya abantu abalina endowooza ezawuka ku zaabwe. Abo bonna abatandise okuyuza ebifananyi bya balala wamu nabaagala okukozesa akaseera k’obululu okuddizaamu emisango, amateeka gagenda kubakolako,” Minisita Amongi bw’agambye. Kino kiddiridde poliisi okulwanagana n’abawagizi b’ekibiina kya NUP ekya Robert Kyagulanyi (Bobi Wine) naba FDC aba Patrick Oboi Amuriat bwebabadde beewandiisa okuvuganya ku bwapulezidenti mu kalulu ka bonna aka 2021. Poliisi leero yavuddeyo netegeeza nti bano babadde bagijeemedde nebamenya ebiragiro bya sennyiga Corona ebyateekebwa akakiiko k’ebyokulonda. Minisita Amongi annyonnyodde nga bwewaliwo abantu abatandise okwawula mu bantu nga basinziira ku mawanga n’okusaasaanya obukyayi nti bino tekigenda kukkirizibwa mu kibuga. Ono asinzidde wano nalabula abeesimbyewo abeetabye mu kukungaanya abantu olunaku lw’eggulo nga tebambadde bukookolo era awatali kwewa mabanga okukimanya nti bateeka obulamu bw’abawagizi babwe mu matigga. Amongi alaze ng’ebikolwa bya bannabyabufuzi ababadde beewandiisa olunaku lw’eggulo bwebyatabangudde ekibuga nebiremesa bannakampala okukola ekintu ekyongera obufiiriza bannansi ne gavumenti.

headline: Ssemujju Nganda :  “Eby’okuwa Oulanyah obutwa biraga bannaansi tebakyesiga gavumenti “
text: Omwogezi w’ekibiina ki ‘Forum for Democratic Change(FDC)’, Ibrahim Ssemujju Nganda, ategeezezza nti gavumenti eri mubuyinza okuggwamu ensa kye kireese abantu okugirumiriza buli kimu omuli nebyo byetakoze. Ebigambo bino Ssemujju yabyogeredde wakati nga abamu ku bantu bagenda mu maaso n’okukakasa nga abadde Sipiika Jacob Oulanyah bweyaweebwa obutwa wadde kino Nganda akiwakanya. “ Sirowooza nti Jacob Oulanyah yaweebwa butwa, abadde mulwadde okumala ebbanga ddene naye bw’owangaalira munsi gavumenti gyetirimbula abantu baayo, ebigambo nga obutwa birina okubaawo,” Ssemujju bwe yannyonnyodde. Ssemujju yagasseeko nti omuntu yenna okumukkirizisa nti Oulanyah yafudde butwa alina okuleeta obujulizi obwesimba kuba akimanyi nti Abafirika gyebuva negyebukoma tebakkiriza nti omuntu asobola okwefiira. Bweyabadde ku leediyo ya Capital FM ey’ebyobufuzi ku Lwomukaaga, amyuka ssentebe w’ekibiina ki National Resistance Movement (NRM) mu Buganda, Godfrey Kiwanda yakakasizza nti Oulanyah yamugamba nti yali yaweebwa obutwa nasaba ensonga eno ereme kubuusibwa maaso. “Siyawukana nandowooza ya taata w’Oulanyah eyategeezezza nti mutabani we yaweebwa obutwa kuba nange omugenzi Oulanyah yang’amba nti yaweebwa obutwa,” Kiwanda bwe yagambye. Wabula Minisita w’ebyamawulire, Chris Baryomunsi yayambalidde Kiwanda nategeeza namubuuza kyeyakolawo era lwaki ayogera kati nga Oulanyah amaze okufa. Kinajjukirwa nti bweyali mukuziika Oulanyah, kitaawe Nathan Okori, yakiddamu nakakasa nti mutabani we yali aweereddwa obutwa.

headline: Palamenti ejaguza emyaka 100, emirimu gy’ababaka bannansi bagitankana
text: Kampala Olwaleero giweze emyaka 100 bukya Palamenti ya Uganda etondebwawo mu 1921 era omumyuka akulira eby’amawulire n’empuliziganya mu Palamenti, Hellen Kaweesa, agamba nti mukakafu ku kya Palamenti okunyweza enfuga eya demokulaasiya emyaka 100 egiyise.  Ebikujjuko bino bikwatiddwa mu ngeri ya kimpowooze olw’ekirwadde kya Ssennyiga Corona ekikyalemesezza abantu okukung’aana.  Oluvannyuma ababaka bayisizza ekiteeso ekijjukira emyaka 100 bukyanga Palamenti entondebwawo. Ku ngeri Palamenti gy’ezze ekolamu, Kaweesa agamba nti wadde wakyaliwo ebisoomooza naye Palamenti ekyuse, omuwendo gw’ababaka gweyongedde era n’abantu kati babeera bagoberera ensonga eziri mu Palamenti okusinga bwekyali. “Palamenti eno nnene emirundi etaano okusinga eyasooka, ekisenge ekyasookerwamu kyali kya babaka 100 bokka naye kati mu Palamenti ey’e 11 bajja kusoba mu 500. Noolwekyo tukyasoomoozebwa ekifo kuba tulina okukigaziya.” Kaweesa bw’annyonnyodde. Kaweesa agasseeko nti enfuga ya demokulaasiya, ababaka ba Palamenti bagyettanidde nnyo ekireeseewo obwerufu. Ono agamba nti kati basoomoozebwa omuwendo gw’ababaka abato ogweyongedde ate nga n’ebitundu bye balina okukiikirira bikyali bingi, ekitegeeza nti ababaka bakyeyongera. Kaweesa alaze okutya olw’omutindo gw’ababaka oguserebye yo nga Palamenti n’ategeeza nti balina eddimu okubabangula ate nga n’abamu ku bantu tebategeera buvunaanyizibwa bwa babaka nga bababanja ebintu bingi ebitali buvunaanyizibwa bwabwe “Obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe tebunnategeerebwa, abamu basaba ababaka ebintu bingi okuli; amasomero, amalwaliro wadde nga kino kiva ku babaka okusuubiza ensi n’e Ggulu nga banoonya akalulu. Noolwekyo tulina okubasomesa bamanye obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe.” Kaweesa bw’ategeezezza.

headline: Owek.  Nsibirwa asiimiddwa ekkanisa olw’okugiyamba okulaakulana
text: Abakulembeze b’ekkanisa ya Uganda mu bulabirizi bwe Namirembe basiimye omumyuka ow’okubiri owa KatikkiroOwek. Robert Waggwa Nsibirwa olw’okugiyambako mu nteekateeka z’okutumbula eby’obulimi awamu n’okutumbula ekirime ky’ Emmwanyi. Bano okusiima basinzidde ku mukolo gwa Rev. Can. Henry Ssegawa ne mukyala weChristine Ssegawa gwebategese okwebalizaako Katonda olw’okuweza emyaka32 ngabali mu buwereza. Kinajjukirwa ntiRev. Can. Henry Segawa ye muwandiisi w’obulabirizi owenkalakkalira era akwasiddwa ennyumba ey’enkalakkalira ey’omuwandiisi w’obulabirizi buno okusobola okutambuza obulungi emirimu. Omulabirizi we Namirembe Rt. Rev. Bp. Wilberforce Kityo Luwaliraabadde omubuulizi w’olunaku asinzidde wano nasiima Owek. Robert Waggwa Nsibirwa olwokuvujirira enteekateeka zekkanisa nokubayamba okubafunira endokwa zemmwanyi nga ayita mu kitongole kya BUCADEF. Mu kwogera kwe,Owek.Robert Waggwa ategeezezza nti obukulembeze eri abantu ba Ssaabasajja Kabaka buli ku mitendera egy’enjawulo era Omulabirizi Kityo Luwalira ne Canon Ssegawa beetaba butereevu mu nteekateeka y’ Emmwanyi Terimba okusobola okutumbula enkulaakulana n’abantu okubalabirako.  “Tukoze ebintu bingi nnyo mu Bwakabaka okulaba nti abantu baffe bagezaako okubeera mu mbeera esaanidde era tulabawo enjawulo. Enteekateeka eno Katikkiro gyeyawomamu omutwe eya Emmwanyi Terimba wamu nokusimba ebitooke etambulidde ddala bulungi era tukirabye nti mu myaka 5 obungi bw’emmwanyi n’amatooke mu Buganda wamu n’enfuna byeyongeddeko,” Owek. Waggwa bw’ategeezezza. Ono agumizza abantu mu Buganda ne Uganda nti akatale k’emmwanyi wekali era nabasaba okwongera amaanyi mu kuzirima basobole okufuna ensimbi bakyuuse embeera yabwe. Owek Nsibirwa ayagaliza Canon Ssegawa n’omukyala Christine obulamu obulungi basobole okwongera okuweereza Omukama awamu n’Obwakabaka. Omujaguza w’olunaku Rev. Can. Henry Segawayebaziiza Katonda olw’okumusobozesa okuwereza ekkanisa emyaka 32 era naasiima ennyumba emuweereddwa kyokka nalaga obwetaavu okufunira abaweereza abalala webasula. Omukolo gunogwetabiddwako abalabirizi okuli omubeezi wa Ssaabalabirizi Dr. Rt. Rev. Hannighton Mutebi, Bp. Jackson Matovu, Bp. George Ssenabulya ne Jackson Matovu abasatu abaawummula, bassaabadinkoni mu bulabirizi buno obwe Namirembe, abasumba nababuulizi abalala.

headline: Emmwanyi Terimba : Uganda ekwata kyamusanvu mu nsi ezirima emmwanyi
text: Uganda erinnyerinye mu nsi ezisinga okulima emmwanyi nga kati ekwata kifo kyamusanvu ku nsi ekumi ezisinga okulima emmwanyi mu nsi yonna. Ekyama kino kyabikuddwa Ssenkulu wa Uganda Coffee Development Authority, Dr. Emmanuel Iyamulemye, nga ayita ku mukutu gwe ogwa Twitter. Iyamulemye bino yabiggye mu kitongole ky’ensi yonna ekivunaanyizibwa ku mmwanyi ekya ‘International Coffee Organization’ mu bibalo byekyafulumizza mu 2020/2021 era Uganda yasobodde okuva mu kifo kya nnamba 8 nedda mu ky’omusanvu. “Olugero lwa Uganda okulima emmwanyi lutandise okunyuma,” Iyamulemye bwe yannyonnyodde. Ono agasseeko nti olw’okuba waliwo etteeka ly’ emmwanyi basuubira obungi okweyongerako. Era nasuubiza okukolagana n’ebitongole ebirala byonna okuyimusa omutindo gw’emmwanyi awamu nokuyambako abalimi. Obungi bw’emmwanyi Uganda bwetunze mu myezi 12 egy’omwaka 2020/2021 buli kiro 6,078,638 60 nga zino zibalirirwamu obukadde bwa ddoola 559.26 nga buno bwalinnya bwogerageranya n’emmwanyi eziwera obukadde 5 (5,105,881) ez’omwaka oguwedde nga zaabalirirwamu obukadde 496.28 mu mwaka 2019/20.

headline: Abavubuka e Kkooki batendereza Obwakabaka ku kulwanyisa Mukenenya
text: Rakai – Kooki Abavubuka abawangaalira mu ssaza lya Ssaabasajja Kabaka e Kkooki batenderezza Omutanda olwa kaweefube gw’aliko okulaba ng’akawuka ka Mukenenya kafuuka lufumo mu ggwanga ng’ayita mu nkola y’ebyoto eyategekeddwa ku magombolola okubangula abavubuka ku ngeri gye bayinza okulwanyisa ssaako n’okwewala obulwadde buno. Okwogera bino baasinzidde ku kyalo Luteebe  mu muluka gw’e Kanoni mu ggombolola ya Mumyuka Lwanda mu distulikiti y’e Rakai mu ssaza lya Ssaabasajja Kabaka ery’e Kkooki ku mukolo gw’ekyoto ekyalangiriddwa Obwakabaka bwa Buganda okukolebwa mu masaza 18 agakola Obwakabaka n’ekigendererwa eky’okulwanyisa Siriimu. Bano nga bakulembeddwamu Matovu Francis Munnyolo atwala abavubuka mu ggombolola ya Mumyuka Lwanda ne Bwemi Julius akulembera abavubuka mu ssaza ly’ekkooki   n’abalala, bagamba nti baaganyuddwa nnyo mu nteekateeka eno era nga baayize bingi  bye babadde tebamanyi mu nteekateeka y’ekyoto. Ye musawo Robert Ssennyondo okuva mu ddwaliro  ly’e Rakai eyakulembeddemu ttiimu y’abakugu abaabangudde abavubuka ku ngeri gye bayinza okwekuuma n’okubatangira okufuna obulwadde buno, yakubirizza abavubuka okubeera abeesimbu eri bannaabwe. Omumyuka w’omukwanaganya w’emirimu gya Ssaabasajja Kabaka e Kkooki, Omulangira Nelson Lubambula yakuutidde abavubuka okukendeeza ku misinde gye bakozesa mu bikolwa  by’okwegadanga ssaako n’okusaba abawala, abakissa ku bavubuka abalenzi ababasaba omukwano, okukomya okutwalira ebitundu byabwe eby’omubiri wabweru. Owek. Betty Mugenyi Mayanja Namata akiikirira essaza ly’e Kkooki ku lukiiko lwa Buganda,  yasabye  abakooki okukulembeze obumu mu buli Kintu kye bakola,  era n’akuutira abakooki okuyigiriza abaana abato okubeera aboomugaso. Mu kwogera kwe omukwanaganya w’emirimu gya Ssaabasajja Kabaka e Kkooki, Gertrude Ssebuggwaawo Nakalanzi, yategeezezza abantu b’e Kkooki nti Ssaabasajja Kabaka abaagala nnyo wakati mu kumwagaliza amazaalibwa amalungi ssaako n’okumwebaza olw’enteekateeka eno kubanga etuukidde ddala ku muntu wa wansi. Mu ngeri y’emu  yawabudde abavubuka okuteeka mu nkola ekiragiro kya  Ssaabasajja Kabaka okulwanyisa Mukenenya nga b’olesa obwesimbu eri bannaabwe wamu n’obutapapira bintu bya mukwano.

headline: Mao wakuddamu okuzimba DP
text: Balintuma Ssenkaggale w’ekibiina ki ‘Democratic Party (DP)’ Nobert Mao, ategeezezza nga ekibiina bwekyakosebwa olw’ ababaka 11 kwabo 15 bekirina okusala eddiiro nebadda mu kibiina ki ‘National unity Platform (NUP)’ wabula bakola buli kimu bano okubazzaawo. Mao nga alayiza abamu ku bakulembeze abaggya Bwabadde ku kitebe ky’ekibiina e Balintuma – Mmengo mu Kampala ku Lwokubiri, Mao agambye nti agenda kukozesa amaanyi gonna galina okuddamu okuzimba DP. “Nze ndi mukuumi wa kibiina sinze nanyini kyo, bagambye omusota bwegubeera nga gweyubula gubeera mukambwe era bwe bukambwe bwemulaba ensangi zino,” Mao bwanyonyodde. Mao bwabadde ku mukolo gw’okulayiza abakulembeze b’ekibiina mu Wakiso ne Kampala agasseeko nti, bangi bakyaggya abantu mu DP kubanga nnyanja ate nga NUP yo eringa ekidiba. Bino byabadde bikyagenda mu maaso newabaawo ekibinja ky’abavubuka abateeberezebwa okubeera aba NUP abasazeeko ekifo kyonna nga bwebayimba ennyimba eziwaana Bobi Wine. Ate ye pulezidenti wa Uganda Young Democrats. Christopher Okidi asekeredde aba NUP abajaganya okufuna ababaka okuva mu DP nti tebalina kyebagasseeko kubanga bano era babadde mu Opozisoni nga tewali kyebagatta ku lutalo lwa kuwangula Pulezidenti Museveni. Eyali omubaka wa Kawempe North Ssebuliba Mutumba agumizza bannakibiina okunywera kubanga kino si bino DP ezze ebiyitamu.

headline: Abakozi ba disitulikiti 4 e Masaka bakwatiddwa Ssennyiga Corona
text: Masaka Abakozi ba disitulikiti ye Masaka bana bazuuliddwamu ekirwadde ki COVID-19. Kino kyabikuddwa akulira eddwaliro lya Masaka Regional Referral Hospital Nathan Onyachi nategeeza nti abana bano batandise dda okujjanjabibwa. Omulwadde wa  ssennyiga Corona nga afuna obujjanjabi, Ekif. File        “Abakozi ba disitulikiti ye Masaka bana basangiddwa ne ssennyiga corona era twatandise dda okunoonya abantu abaliko nabo n’okukebera abakozi abalala ku disitulikiti eno era n’okubasaba okwetwala mu Kalantiini,” Onyachi bweyategeezezza. Onyachi yagambye nti ekisinze okwongera okusaasaana kw’ ekirwadde kino be bantu obutafaayo kugondera biragiro ebyabaweebwa okutangira ekirwadde kino ekya Ssennyiga Corona. Yasabye bannayuganda okufaayo okwekuuma ekirwadde kino ku mirimu ne mu maka gaabwe. Ate yye omubaka wa Pulezidenti e Masaka Herman Ssentongo, era nga yakulira akakiiko akalwanyisa ekirwadde kino yalambuludde nga bwebagenda okulinda ebinava mu kukebera abakozi abalala naabaliko n’abalwadde okusalawo oba ekitebe kino bakiggalwa. “Mukiseera kino abakugu baffe bafuna Sampolo ku bakozi bonna aba disitulikiti era kino kye kigenda okutuwa kyetuzzaako,” Ssentongo bweyagambye nalabula abatuuze okukomya okujeemera ebiragiro bino bwebaba bakyayagala obulamu. Ssentongo yagambye nti mu kitundu kye Masaka bakaziikamu abantu bana abafudde kirwadde kino wadde bano bagyibwa Kampala. Mu kiseera kino eggwanga lyakafiirwa abantu 46 okuva mu mwezi gwa March ekirwadde kino lwekyabalukawo. Masaka yafuna abalwadde ba ssennyiga Corona 84 nga ku bano abalwadde 74 bawona nebasiibulwa era nga kati eddwaliro lirina abalwadde 10 bokka. Bino webigidde nga ku Lwokusatu Minisitule y’ebyobulamu yakakasizza nga abakafuna ekirwadde kino bwebaweze 4,101 ku bano 1,876 basiibulwa.

headline: Bapulezidenti 21 be bagenda okubaawo nga M7 alayira
text: Kampala Abakulembeze b’amawanga abawerera ddala 21 be bakakasizza okwetaba ku mukolo gw’okulayiza Pulezidenti Yoweri Kaguta Museveni ku kisanja kye ekyomukaaga. Okusinziira ku Minisita w’ensonga z’obwapulezidenti, Esther Mbayo, baakwetaba ku mukolo guno ogugenda okubaawo wiiki ejja ku kisaawe e Kololo.  Bino Minisita Mbayo abitegeezezza bannamawulire ku ssengejjero ly’amawulire ga gavumenti mu Kampala, olwaleero ku Lwokubiri n’agattako nti naye basuubira omuwendo guno okweyongerako. “Pulezidenti yayise abakulembeze  42 okuva mu Afirika n’eggwanga lyonna era ku bano 21 baamaze dda okukakasa nti baakubaawo,” Mbayo bw’agambye. Kisuubirwa nti mu bano kuliko; Uhuru Kenyatta (Kenya), Samia Suluhu Hassan(Tanzania) Cyril Ramaphosa(South Africa), Salva Kiir(South Sudan), Paul Kagame(Rwanda), Felix Tshisekedi(DRC), Teodoro Obiang Nguema(Equatorial Guinea), Emmerson Mnangagwa(Zimbabwe), Edgar Lungu(Zambia) n’abalala. Omugenzi Pulezidenti wa Chad Idriss Déby,  naye yali omu ku baali bayitiddwa wabula eby’embi n’afiira mu kulwanagana n’abayeekera. Mbayo agamba nti olwa Ssennyiga Corona, omuwendo gw’abagenyi gusaliddwako ne gudda ku bantu 4042, kisobozese okukwata ebiragiro by’okutangira Corona obulungi.  Okusinziira ku Mbayo buli disitulikiti ejja kuweereza abantu 17  bokka era mu bano mulina okubaamu ababaka abalonde aba Palamenti, bammemba ba CEC ya NRM, Ababaka ba EALA wamu n’abasuubuzi, bannaddiini wamu n’abakulembeze b’ensikirano. Bino we bijjidde ng’omwogezi wa poliisi mu ggwanga, Fred Enanga, yaakamala okutegeeza ng’abooludda oluvuganya bwe bategese okutabangula omukolo guno nga beekalakaasa, okuggala enguudo awamu n’okukasuka bbomu enkolerere, ky’agamba nti tebajja kikkiriza era nga babeetegekedde. Ate ye omwogezi w’eggye lya UPDF abadde yaakamala okutegeeza nga bwe waliwo obubinja obwagala okutabula omukolo gw’okulayira, wabula n’alaga nti beetegese ekimala.

headline: Abamenye ekkanisa mu Ndeeba  mutukoze bubi -Omulabirizi Luwalira
text: Ekkanisa ya St. Peter’s mu Ndeeba Ndeeba Omulabirizi we Namirembe . Rt. Rev. Wilberforce Kityo Luwalira alaze okunnyolwa olw’okumenyebwa kw’ekkanisa ya St. Peter’s mu Ndeeba. Ekkanisa eno ebadde emazeewo emyaka egiwera 40 yamenyeddwa mukiro ekyakeesezza olwaleero, nga erudde nga ekayanirwa omugagga amanyiddwako erya Dobovico era nga ebadde ekuumibwa poliisi. “Leero tukeeredde mukunyolwa olw’ekkanisa eyamenyeddwa mu Ndeeba, kyenyamiza okulaba nga ensonga eno ebadde egobererwa okuva mu 1981 bweti byebasazeewo ogikomekerezza. Ffenna tuli mu bulumi naye okusingira ddala abakulisitaayo b’ ekkanisa ya St. Peter’s”, Omulabirizi Luwalira bweyategezezza. Luwalira yagasseeko nti endabika y’ekkanisa eno ebadde eraga bulungi amaanyi abakulisitaayo b’omukitundu kino gebassaamu okugizimba kyokka nga gonna gasanyiziddwawo mu ddakiika entono. Yasabye abakulisitaayo okunywerera ku Katonda naye era beegendereze akaseera kano abantu mwebasaliddewo okukola ebya Sitaani. Luwalira yasabye abantu bonna abeetabye mu kubba ettaka wonna mu ggwanga okweddamu era nategeeza nga ebikoleddwa mu Ndeeba bwebitasobola kuziyiza kusaasaana kwa njiri. Ate ye omwogezi wa poliisi mu Kampala n’emirilaano Patrick Onyango yategezezza nga abadduumizi bapoliisi mukitundu kino 3, bwebamaze okukwatibwa olw’okulagajalira emirimu gyabwe Abakwate kuliko; akulira poliisi y’e Katwe David Epedu, akulira poliisi ya Ndeeba Yeko Kato ne Isabirye Kaloli nga naye muddumizi mu poliisi mu Kampala n’emirilaano. URN

headline: Ssaabalabirizi asabye  abantu okukuuma emirembe
text: Kampala Ssaabalabirizi w’ekkanisa ya Uganda, Dr. Stephen Kazimba Mugalu, asabye abantu mu ggwanga okukuuma emirembe naddala mu kaseera kano ak’okunoonya akalulu.  Bino Kazimba abitegeeezezza bannamawulire leero e Namirembe nga beetegekera olukung’aana lw’ Obulabirizi obw’enjawulo olwokubaawo ku Mmande ya Ssaabbiiti ejja. “Abapoliisi twayogedde nabo baleme okukozesa amaanyi agasusse ate ne bannayuganda tubakubiriza bakomye ebintu eby’empisa embi ng’okwekalakaasa n’okubba abantu.” Ssaabalabirizi Kazimba bw’annyonnyodde. Dr. Kazimba asabye wabeewo obwenkanya eri abeesimbyewo bonna mu ngeri gye basobola okutuuka ku bantu babawe endowooza zaabwe mu kifo ky’okuggyirako abamu leediyo ne ttiivi okubalemesa okutuuka ku bantu. Kazimba agambye nti ng’eggwanga bannayuganda basobola bulungi okukuuma emirembe wakati mu kusoomoozebwa. Ono asabye abakkiriza okuwaayo akaseera ka wiiki ennamba olukung’aana lwekagenda okumala okusabira eggwanga lisobole okuyita obulungi mu kkampeyini zino. “Olukung’aana luno lugenda kumala wiiki nnamba era nsaba ebeere wiiki ya kusaba n’okusiiba eri abantu ba Katonda olwa kkampeyini ennungi n’okulwanyisa obusambattuko.” Dr. Kazimba bw’agambye. Kino kiddiridde aba Inter-Religious Council of Uganda (IRCU) okusisinkana abakulu mu poliisi okutema empenda ku ngeri y’okunoonya akalulu kano gye kusobola okubeera okw’emirembe. Ssaabalabirizi akunze bannayuganda okukuuma emirembe era bateeka ekitiibwa mu biragiro ebyateekebwawo okutangira ekirwadde kya Ssennyiga Corona. Poliisi evuddeyo efunda eziwera n’eremesa omubaka Robert Kyagulanyi Ssentamu, Patrick Oboi Amuriat ne Gen. Henry Tumukunde ku bigambibwa nti bano babadde bamenya ebiragiro bya Ssennyiga Corona.

headline: Katikkiro ayanjudde olukiiko olunabbulula emipiira gy’Ebika
text: Katikkiro wa Buganda Owek. Charles Peter Mayiga, ayanjulidde Obuganda olukiiko olugenda okuzza endasi mu mipiira gy’Ebika. Katikkiro Mayiga n’Olukiiko olutongozeddwa Owek. Mayiga asinzidde wano n’ategeeza nti nga tuyita mu kusamba omupiira nga omuzannyo gusobola bulungi okugatta abantu ba Kabaka n’okunyweza obumu kiyambe okuzza Buganda ku ntikko. “Ffe wano mu Buganda ekituyunga ku Kabaka by’Ebika kubanga ayitibwa Ssaabataka era yakulembera abataka ab’obusolya. N’olwekyo mu kusamba omupiira kiba kyangu nnyo okugatta Abaganda, okubaagazisa Ennono n’obuwangwa bwabwe,” bwatyo Mayiga bw’alambuludde. Owek. Mayiga era agasseeko nti kino kijja kubayamba okwenyigiramu butereevu ku nsonga z’Eggwanga lyabwe. Ono agambye nti amaanyi gabadde gakendedde mu mipiira gy’Ebika wadde nga obuwagizi bw’emipiira gyebuli era nti akizudde nga abantu baagala okuwagira emipiira egitegekeddwa obulungi. Owek. Mayiga agasseeko nti bafunye abakugu bano basobole okwekenneenya ensonga eno naddala ku ngeri gyegutegekebwamu, obukugu, ensonga z’ensimbi n’ abawagizi era akakasa nti bano omulimu bajja kugukola bulungi ddala. Okusinziira ku Katikkiro Mayiga, olukiiko era lugenda kutunuulira n’omuzannyo gw’abawala ogw’okubaka kubanga nagwo gwalina abawagizi bangi naye gugenze guggwamu amaanyi. Katikkiro Mayiga alaze nti ttiimu z’Ebika zisobola bulungi okuliikiriza ttiimu ya She Cranes ssinga gubeera gutereezeddwa bulungi. Ono asabye abantu bonna abanatuukirirwa olukiiko oluno okuluwa obuwagizi kuba kyeluliko tekiyamba mizannyo mu Buganda mwokka naye ne Uganda nga batumbula ebitone buli omu afunemu. Olukiiko luno lukulemberwa Mw. Raymond Kabugo namyukibwa Sam Mpima. Abalala kuliko; Sulaiman Ssejjengo, David Katabira, Sam Mpoza, Omutaka Robert Mujabi, Hassan Badru Zziwa n’omukyala Rose Kaala.

headline: Abakozi ba Palamenti 5 basangiddwamu Corona
text: Abakozi bataano mu lukiiko lw’eggwanga olukulu bataano basangiddwamu ekirwadde ki Ssennyiga Corona.  Okusinziira ku amyuka akulira eby’amawulire ku Palamenti Hellen Kaweesa, kino bakizudde oluvanyuma lw’okusalawo okukebera abakozi mu kizimbe kino. Ekiwandiiko Kaweesa kyeyafulumizza kinyonyola nga abasangiddwa n’ekirwadde bwebamaze edda okubategeeza ebyavudde mukukeberwa era nebasindikibwa mu malwaliro agajjanjaba ekirwadde kino okusobola okufuna obujjanjabi. Kaweesa yalambuludde nti bakufuuyira ekizimbe kino kyonna enkya ku Lwomukaaga kiyambeko okukendeeza ku misinde ekirwadde kino gyekisaasaanirako.  “Omuwendo gw’abakozi tugenda gukendeeza mbagirawo, abakozi abaaliko nabasangiddwamu ekirwadde kino balagiddwa okusigala awaka mu Kalantiini nga bwebalinda okulaba oba balina obubonero bwabalina ssennyiga Corona,” Kaweesa bweyalambudde. Bino webigidde nga Minisitule y’ebyobulamu leero ekakasizza nga abantu 65 bwebazuuliddwamu ekirwadde kino ate nga babiri bo entamu ezabwe zivuunikiddwa.

headline: Abayiseemu mu Bukomansimbi basabiddwa okwewala entalo
text: Ssentebe wa distulikiti y’e Bukomansimbi, Muhammad Kateregga, akalaatidde abakulembeze abayiseemu mu kitundu kino okwewala entalo naye beegatte bakolere abantu ababalonze awatali kusosola. Ssentebe Kateregga nga alambuza abakulembeze abaggya  Kateregga okwogera bino abadde asisinkanye abakulembeze abaggya ku kitebe kya disitulikiti y’e Bukomansimbi okubalambika mu ebyo bye boolekedde mu bukulembeze bwabwe ssaako okubalaga ebituukiddwako. Ssentebe omulonde owa National Unity Platform, Fred Nyenje n’abakiise abaggya ku disitulikiti eno, balambuzibwa pulojekiti ezikoleddwa okuli essomero lya Bukango Seed Secondary School eryazimbiddwa gavumenti. Okusinziira ku bakulu, essomero lino lyamazeewo ssente ezikunukkiriza obuwumbi 2. Ssentebe Kateregga yasabye bano okufuba okulaba nti essomero lino baliteekako bbugwe era bakuume n’ebyo ebikoleddwa. Bano era beeyongeddeyo mu ggombolola y’e Butenga okulambula pulojekiti y’amazzi aga Solar, gavumenti ge yateekayo ku buwumbi 10. Akulira ekifo kino, Ezel Kaggwa, yagambye nti mu kiseera kino abantu abasoba mu mitwalo mukaaga (60,000) be bakozesa amazzi gano wadde wakyaliwo ebisoomooza. Beeyongeddeyo ku ddwaliro lya Butenga Health Centre IV era Ssentebe Kateregga n’agamba nti balina ekirowoozo ky’okufuula eddwaliro lino eddene. Mu kwogera kwe, ssentebe omulonde, Fred Nyenje, yeebazizza olukiiko lwa disitulikiti olukadde olw’enkulaakulana gye bakoze mu Bukomansimbi. Bo bakkansala abalonde beebazizza enteekateeka Ssentebe Kateregga gy’akoze ey’okubalambuza pulojekiti ezikoleddwa era ne basuuubiza okwongera okugitwala mu maaso.

headline: Muwada Mawejje agenze mu Police F.C
text: Oluvanyuma  lwa Ttiimu ya Police F.C okuwonera ku kaguwa okusalwako mu Uganda Premier League mu sizoni ya 2019/2020, kati ekola buli kimu okulaba nga yenywezza. Ttiimu eno efunye omusambi omuggya Muwada Mawejje agiyambeko okunyweza amakati gaayo. Mawejje yayanjuddwa ku Lwokutaano era naweebwa endagaano ya myaka 2 okusambira Police F.C. Ono Police F.C agyegattideko ku bwerere era nga kinajjukirwa nti ekitundu kya sizoni ewedde akisambidde mu Bright Stars FC gyeyasindikibwa aba Wakiso Giants ku bbanja. Mawejje okugenda mu Wakiso Giants yava mu KCCA, Muwada yasambirako ne ttiimu ya SC Villa wamu ne Victoria University etakyaliwo.

headline: Bobi Wine ne Dr Besigye bakkaanyiza okukolera awamu,  bagamba akalulu kamala budde
text: Abanene ku ludda oluvuganya gavumenti okuli Dr. Kizza Besigye, Asuman Basaalirwa, Robert Kyagulanyi Ssentamu n’abalala bakkaanyiza okukolera awamu balwanyise ebikolwa by’okubba akalulu ebyeyambisibwa gavumenti okwenywereza mu buyinza. Bano okutabukira gavumenti basisinkanye ku Hotel Africana ku Mmande era batadde omukono ku kiwandiiko ekivumirira okubba obululu buli kulonda lwekubaayo. Akulira ekibiina ki National Unity Platform, Robert Kyagulanyi Ssentamu agamba nti buli lwebayingira akalulu bamaliriza beesonze akalala ekiwa ekifananyi ekikyamu eri bannansi era nebamaliriza nga bagudde mu katego ka Pulezidenti Museveni. “Tetusobola kwefuula batakimanyi nti Pulezidenti Museveni ategeka akalulu nga alinga agenda mu lutalo nga alina buli kyakulwanyisa nga bwekyali mu kalulu ka 2021, Kayunga, Omoro, Soroti awamu n’awalala. Ekiseera kituuse tukyuuse obukodyo n’enjiri abantu tubasabe berwaneko ku mitendera gyonna,” Kyagulanyi bw’agambye. Kyagulanyi asinzidde wano nasaba bakulembeze banne mu bibiina by’obufuzi okukyuusa enjiri gyebawa bannayuganda nga wonna ku mitendera balina kubanja kwenunula beegobeko Pulezidenti Museveni nga bakozesa buli mukisa ogubeeyoleka. Ono agasseeko nti akalulu konna kebayingiramu balina kunoonya muwaatwa kugoba Pulezidenti Museveni era beegatte okutuukira ddala ku muntu asembayo kuba buli lwebavaayo okwelwanyisa banguyiza Pulezidenti Museveni omulimu gw’okusigala nga abakulembera. Ye akulira ekisinde, Peoples’ Front for Transition (PFT), Dr Kizza Besigye agamba nti ekimu ku bizibu bannayuganda byebasinga okubeera nabyo kwekuba nti tebalina ddoboozi lyonna ku ngeri eggwanga lyabwe gyeritambuzibwamu nga n’abakulembeze abali mu bifo ebikulu mu gavumenti tebalina buyinza bwonna. Dr. Besigye agamba nti embeera tejja kukyuuka okutuusa nga obuyinza buvudde mu ngalo zabo ababuwamba kuba kizuuse nti akalulu tekasobola kukyuusa buyinza oba bakwate ekkubo lya Mao bateese ne gavumenti naye nakino takirabamu ssuubi. “Ffe tulowooza nti akalulu tetugenda kukkiriza kagende mu maaso bwekati nga balimba bannansi nab’ebweru, bwetuba tugenda mukalulu kati kubuulira bantu abaliyo ku ngeri gyebasobola okununulamu obuyinza bwabwe.  “Bwetuba twegasse netusalawo nga eggwanga nti tetukyatambula nakino, Mwami Museveni wakoma, bwobba akalulu tobba bantu basigalayo singa tugamba abantu bemwalaba e Soroti nti tutambule, bajja kusituka,” Dr. Besigye bw’annyonnyodde. Besigye agamba nti ebintu gavumenti ya Museveni byeyasangawo nga akutte obuyinza yabigabana ne banne nebabitwala nga kati akatono kasolooza mu misolo nako akakozesa nga bw’ayagala nga kino kirina okusalirwa eddagala. Ono asabye beegatte nga abakulembeze wamu ne bannayuganda okusobola okuleetawo enkyukakyuka bannansi gyebayaayaanira. Amyuka Pulezidenti w’ekibiina ki FDC, Erias Lukwago ategeezezza nti ekyabadde e Soroti tekyogerekeka kuba abantu babwe bakwatibwa nebaggalirwa awatali musango era tewali musango gwebaggulwako kyokka embeera eno yasukka ku lunaku lw’akalulu era akalulu kabbibwa. Pulezidenti wa JEEMA, Asuman Basaalirwa ategeezezza nti gavumenti ya NRM kati kyekola kwekusosonkereza bannayuganda buli lwewabaayo akalulu nga kino kyekyali e Kayunga, Omoro ne Soroti. Kati ekirindiriddwa kwekulaba oba bannabyabufuzi n’ebibiina by’obufuzi binasobola okukolera awamu nga bwebisuubizza kuba emikago gino gizze gibaawo.

headline: Oweek. Nsibirwa aweereddwa engule olw’okuwagira okulima emmwanyi
text: Omumyuka wa Katikkiro ow’okubiri, Oweek. Robert Waggwa Nsibirwa asiimiddwa era n’aweebwa engule olw’emirimu gyakoze mukutumbula ekirime ky’emmwanyi mu ggwanga n’okwetooloola ensi yonna.  Engule eno emanyiddwa nga ‘Coffee Lifetime Achievement Award,’ Nsibirwa emuweereddwa bwabadde yeetaabye mu kuggulawo olukiiko olw’e 18 olukwata ku mmwanyi olumanyiddwa nga African Fine Coffees Conference & Exhibition oluyindira ku Sarova Whitesands Beach resort e Mombasa mu Kenya.  Engule nga bwefaanana Engule eno Nsibirwa emukwasiddwa Dorothy Tembi, akulira ekitongole kya International Trade Center ekituula e Geneva mu Switzerland. Nsibirwa ye ssentebe era ssenkulu wa Africa Coffee Academy era nga ye pulezidenti w’ekitongole kigatta abalimi b’emmwanyi ekimanyiddwa nga Uganda Coffee Federation.  Akoze emirmu mingi mu kaweefube w’okutumbula emmwanyi era nga akuliddemu ebitongole bingi ebikola ku mmwanyi mu Uganda n’ensi yonna.

headline: Janet alumirizza abavuganya gavumenti okuba emabega w’okwekalakasa e Makerere
text: Janet Museveni, muk’omukulembeze w’eggwanga era minisita w’ebyenjigiriza n’ebyemizannyo, alumirizza abavuganya gavumenti okubeera emabega w’akeegugungo mu ssetendekero e Makerere kati akanyingidde olunaku lw’omukaaga. Mubbaluwa gyawandiise nga esoose kufulumira mu lupapula lwa gavumenti olwa New Vision, Janet Museveni yagambye nti balina amawulire agalaga anti abo abekalakaasa sibayizi be Makerere oba ssetendekero endala yonna wabula bantu abasasulwa bannabyabufuzi okuleetawo obujagalalo muggwanga. “Abantu abeekalakaasa beebo abagufudde omulimu okwetaba mubuli kwekalakaasa muggwanga yonna gyekubeera. Abo abavuganya gavumenti abateekebwamu omusimbi omungi abantu abatannamanyika, bagufudde muze okukozesa abaana abatalina mirimu buli webakizuula nti kibagasa,” Mukyala Museveni bweyagambye. Yayongeddeko nti abo abakole ebikolwa bino barina okukizuula nti buno buli bwanguzi kakuuse eggwanga bulijjo bwelyogerako. “Bwowulira obuli bwenguzi sokeera kuggwe wennyini oyinza okuba ggwe asinga abo boolumiriza. Osasula abaana okwenyigira mubioklwa ebimenya amateeka? Osasula abantu abatali bayizi mu massetendekero okwekalakaasa? Osasula bannamawulire abagwira okujja wano okuwandiika ebintu byebatalinaako kumanya kubanga oyagala okukakasa ensi nti byoyogera byebituufu? Okozesa okwekalakasa kwe bisale bya ssetendekero ng’olina byeweeyagaliza? Bwoba okola ebyo waggulu omulundi omulala tosonganga olunwe mumuntu mulala nti mukenuzi, wetandikireko,” bwatyo Janet bweyagambye.

headline: Amerika erabudde ab’ebyokwerinda abaatyobodde eddembe ly’abantu mu kalulu ka 2021
text: Omwogezi w’ekitongole kya Amerika ekivunaanyizibwa ku nsonga ez’ebweru ekya ‘Department of State’ Ned Price,’ ategeezezza nti bagenda kufuna engeri gye bakola ku bantu bonna abeenyigidde mu kutyoboola eddembe ly’obuntu mu kalulu akaakubwa nga January 14. Museveni ne Kyagulanyi bakyattunka Bino Price yabyogedde ayogerako ne bannamawulire ng’abuuzibwa ku nsonga ya Pulezidenti wa National Unity Platform (NUP), Robert Kyagulanyi, okuggyayo omusango ng’alumiriza abalamuzi okubeera ne kyekubiira. “Tutunuulidde engeri ez’enjawulo gye tugenda okukola ku bantu bonna naddala ab’ebyokwerinda abalinnyiridde eddembe lya bannayuganda,” Price bwe yagambye. Price yakiggumizza nti akalulu akaakubwa nga January 14 kalimu ebirumira bingi era ebitongole by’ebyokwerinda byatulugunya ab’oludda oluvuganya wamu ne bannakyewa, n’asaba wabeewo okunoonyereza ku kituufu ekyaliwo. “Tusaba wabeewo okunoonyereza ku ebyo byonna ebyaliwo mu kalulu.” Price bwe yagasseeko. Price yagambye nti wadde Pulezidenti Museveni ne Uganda bayambako okutuukiriza ebigendererwa bya Amerika mu kitundu kino okuli okulwanyisa abatujju e Somalia, naye ate tebajja kusirika busirisi ng’eddembe ly’abantu lityoboolwa. “Tusobola okutuukiriza ebigendererwa byaffe wamu n’ebyo bye tukkiririzaamu. Nga bwe ng’ambye, tutunuulidde engeri ez’enjawulo gye tusobola okuyitamu okubonereza abaakola ebyo bye twalaba mu kulonda kwa Uganda nga bwe twongera okukolagana ne Uganda okutuukiriza ebigendererwa byaffe ffenna.” Price bwe yannyonnyodde. Bino we bijjidde nga bannabyabufuzi ab’enjawulo bavuddeyo ne basaba amawanga g’abazungu obutakoma ku bigambo naye babeeko kye bakola ku bakungu ba gavumenti abagufudde omuze okutyoboola eddembe lya bannayuganda.

headline: Omuliro gusaanyizzaawo bya bukadde e Katabi
text: Omuliro nga gutuuntumuka URN Omuliro gukutte negusaanyaawo ebbajjiro mu kabuge ke Katabi ku luguudo lwe Entebbe ebintu ebibalirwamu obukadde 150 nebisirikka. Ebbajjiro lino libaddemu entebe, ebitanda, emeeza n’ebintu ebirala.  Edward Miiro, omu kabaafiriddwa ebintu byabwe yagambye nti amafuta gayinza okuba gegaavuddeko omuliro guno ogwatandise ku ssaawa nga mukaaga ez’emisana. Ekitongole kya poliisi ekizikiriza omuliro kyatuuse oluvanyuma lw’eddakiika nga 40, ng’omuliro gwamaze dda okusaasaanira ekifo kyonna. Poliisi weyatuukidde ng’abatuuze bagezaako okukoza buli kimu kyebasobola okuzikiza omuliro wabula nga ggo gugenda bugenzi mumaaso.  Vianney Tensumulule, nannyina bajjiro lino yategeezezza nti essuubi lye okuddamu okukola liri mu kampuni ya nsuwa mweyali yawandiisa ebajjiro lye. Godfrey Mugerwa, ssentebe wa Kitala cell yasabye abatuuze okwegendereza biki byebateeka mumaduuka gaabwe.

headline: Minisita Nabakooba anokoddwayo mwabo abaalyazaamanya poliisi
text: Tumwebaze ng’akwasa Nabakooba woofiisi  Minisita omuggya mu gavumenti eyawakati akola ku nsonga za tekinologiya era omubaka omukyala akiikirira disitulikiti y’e Mityana mu palamenti Judith Nabakooba anokoddwayo ng’omu kubantu abalamereddwa okusasula ssente zeyeewola okuva mukittavvu kya Poliisi.  Nabakooba yali mwogezi wa poliisi eyawummulira ku ddaala lya kamisona era nga yeesimbawo mu 2016 okuvuganya ku kifo kya palamenti kyeyawangula. Omwaka oguwedde nga gugwako, omukulembeze w’eggwanga Yoweri Kaguta Museveni yamulonda nga minisita okuddira Frank Tumwebaze mu bigere ng’ono yatwalibwa mu minisitule ekola ku kikula ky’abantu. Alipoota eyakoleddwa abakulira ekittavvu kya poliisi enokolayo Nabakooba ng’omu ku boofiisa abakulu abaawummula emirimu gya poliisi wabula nga baalemererwa okusasula amabanja agababangibwa. Nabakooba abangibwa akakadde kamu n’emitwalo nsanvu. Abalala ababangibwa naye nga nabo banyukka emirimu gya poliisi kuliko, Ocan Ben, Mutabazi Juliet, Wanitho Marcellino nga bano babangibwa obukadde obuli wakati w’obuna n’omukaaga.  Omumyuka wa ssenkaggale wa poliisi EdwardOchom yategeezezza nti kati bagenda kuteeka ekkomo ku ssente ze bawola boofiisa abanaatera okuwummula. Yayongeddeko nti munamateeka wabwe agenda kuwandiikira abo bonna ababangibwa okulaba nga basasula naye singa balemererwa, bandi badda embuga.  Ekittavu kya poliisi era kyafiirwa obukadde 16, oluvanyuma lw’okufa kw’aba ofiisa abaali babangibwa.

headline: Ab’e Bukomansimbi balabuddwa ku ssente z’emyoga, tujja kubasiba
text: Bukomansimbi – Buddu Abantu ba Kabaka abawangaalira mu disitulikiti y’e Bukomansimbi balabuddwa ku nsimbi z’emyoga singa banaazikozesa obubi nti abamu baakufundikira nga bali mu makomera kuba ensimbi zino si zaakulya wabula okwekulaakulanya. Okulabula kuno kukoleddwa akulira ekitongole  kya Micro-Finance Support Centre mu bbendobendo ly’e Masaka,  Katobe Wilfreds,  bw’abadde abangula abatuuze ba Bukomansimbi North ne South ku nteekateeka eno ku kitebe kya disitulikiti. Katobe agambye nti waliwo abantu abategese SACCO ez’ebicupuli basobole okuganyulwa mu nsimbi zino naye balina okukimanya nti babeetegekedde. Enteekateeka eno mu kitundu kya Bukomansimbi North ne South ezingiramu SACCO 36 era nga bano babanguddwa ku nkozesa y’ensimbi zino era ne baweebwa amabaluwa. Bano oluvannyuma lw’okutendekebwa bati balinze kuganyulwa mu nsimbi ezisoba mu kawumbi akalamba  (1.12billon) ezaatuuse edda ku akawunta zaabwe basobole okwekulaakulanya. Ye omukwanaganya w’enteekateeka y’emyoga mu mu bitundu by’e Masaka, Gonzaga Muteesaasira,  yeebazizza Pulezidenti Museveni olw’enteekateeka eno  ng’agamba nti abantu bangi basula ng’emitima gibeewanise (ku bunkenke)  nga Bbanka n’abawola embaata babatwalako ebintu byabwe,  naye kati omuntu wa wansi ajja kusobola okweggya mu bwavu. Mu ngeri y’emu omubaka wa Pulezidenti e Bukomansimbi, Teopisita Lule Ssenkungu,  ategeezezza nti bakoze okunoonyereza era ne bazuula nti  SACCO eziweereddwa amabaluwa z’entuufu n’asaba abantu okwebuuza  ku bantu ababasingako, okwewala  okukola ensobi. Bo abantu ab’enjawulo  ababanguddwa basiimye gavumenti ku nteekateeka eno ne basuubiza okugikozesa obulungi.

headline: WORLD CUP | Senegal  yeesoose okuva mukibinja mu z’Afirika
text: Ttiimu y’eggwanga lya Senegal emanyiddwa nga ‘The Lions of Teranga’ bakoze ebyafaayo bwebafuuse ttiimu y’ Africa esoose okuva mu kibinja mu mpaka z’omupiira eza World Cup 2022 eziyindira e Qatar. Senegal mu kibinja evuddemu nga ttiimu ekutte eky’okubiri mu kibinja A ekikulembeddwa Netherlands, eno yakubye omutegesi Qatar ne Equador mu mupiira ogubaddeko n’obugombe. Ggoolo za Senegal ezisoose ziteebeddwa omusambi Ismaila Sarr ate nga eya Equador eteebeddwa Moises Caicedo. Equador eyongedde okutaama nga eyita mu muzannyi Felix Torres olwo negubeera ggoolo 2-2 wakati ku njuyi zombi okunyigiriza ebitagambika. Senegal bwetyo esobodde okufuna ggoolo ey’okusatu nga eyita mu muzannyi Kalidou Koulibaly era omukwasi wa ggoolo Galindez tasobodde kulaba mupiira weguyise. Wadde Equador ekoze buli kimu naye emikisa omuva ggoolo gyonna gigaanye bwetyo Senegal neyitawo okugenda ku luzannya lwa ttiimu 16 ezibeera zivudde mu bibinja era nga guno gwe mulundi ogusookedde ddala bukya batandika kwetaba mu World Cup mu 2002.

headline: Masaza Cup 2021 : Butambala ekubye Buweekula 1-0, Busujju ne Mawogola bagudde maliri 1-1
text: Empaka z’amasaza ga Buganda zizzeemu okutojjera ku kisaawe kya FUFA Technical Centre e Njeru nga Butambala ebadde ezannya ne Buweekula ate Mawogola ng’etunka ne Busujju okutangaaza emikisa gyabwe egy’okuva mu kibinja kya Muganzirwazza.  Ogusoosewo gubadde wakati wa Mawogola ne Busujju era nga gugweredde mu maliri ga ggoolo 1-1.  Ttiimu ya Mawogola yesoose okuteeba ng’eyita mu muzannyi Umar Luswabi mu ddaakiika ey’omunaana (8) ng’ ate ggoolo ya Busujju eteebeddwa Akram Kasaga mu ddaakiika ya 47.  Omutendesi wa Mawogola Jamad Magasi agamba omupiira guno tegubadde mwangu wabula wakuzimbira ku kabonero kano kafunye okuwangula omupiira oguddako.  Ate  owa Busujju,  Timothy Onyango ategeezezza nti  ekibalemeseza okuwangula omupiira guno basubiddwa emikisa mingi.  Mu mupiira ogw’okubiri oguzannyiddwa gubadde wakati wa  Butambala ne Buweekula era gugenze okuggwa nga Butambala eguwangudde ggoolo 1-0.
