Dr. Kabanda agamba nti abantu 56 be baakafa obulwadde bw’Ebola. Omukolo gwetabiddwako, Omukubiriza w’olukiiko lw’Abataka, Omutaka Namwama Augustine Kizito Mutumba, Ssenkulu wa BBS Terefayina Omuk. Patrick Ssembajjo, Ssenkulu wa KCCA, Dorothy Kisaka ne Mufti Ramadhan Mubajje.

headline: Abaddukanya ekisaawe ky’ Entebbe aba CAA balina bebakutte ku by’enguzi eggyibwa ku Bankubakyeyo
text: Ab’obuyinza ku kisaawe ki Entebbe International Airport baliko abakozi babwe bebakutte ku bigambibwa nti babadde balya enguzi ku batambuze ekikontana n’amateeka agabafuga. Kino kiddiridde abantu ab’enjawulo okuvaayo nebemulugunya ku bakozi ku kisaawe kino okubasaba enguzi etuukira ddala ku lukumi lwa ddoola ($ 1000) okusobola okufuluma era atakikola bamulemesa okulinnya ennyonyi. Bw’abadde ayogerako ne bannamawulire ku Lwokutaano, amyuuka Senkulu w’ekitongole ki Uganda Civil Aviation Authority(UCAA), Olive Birungi Lumonya akkirizza nti waliwo abantu abaggyibwako enguzi era baliko n’abakozi babwe bebakutte ku nsonga eno. “Ali mu katambi mukozi wa UCAA lwakuba ssente bazimuweera bweru wa kisaawe. Naye akwatiddwa era tulina emitendera egigenda okugobererwa asobola okubonerezebwa,” Birungi bw’ategeezezza. Ku nsonga eno, avunaanyizibwa ku bantu abayingira n’okufuluma eggwanga, Maj Gen Apollo Kasiita Gowa naye akkirizza nti omuze guno mweguli naye nawera okugumalawo kuba balina kukolera mu bwerufu. Birungi Lumonya agamba nti beekenenyeza obutambi obuli ku mutimbagano nebazuula nti obumu bulimu abakozi babwe ate era waliwo n;obujingirire. Abakulu ku kisaawe kino bategeezezza nti okuva mu mwaka 2020, baweza abakozi 26 abakwatibwa era abamu bagobeddwa, abalala bawummuziddwa ate abalala nebabonerezebwa mu ngeri ezitali zimu. Birungi yeetondedde abantu bonna abakoseddwa olw’ebikolwa bino naye nasuubiza okubaako ekikyukamu. Aba CAA era baweze abakozi okukozesa essimu nga bali ku mulimu era okutandika leero abasaabaze bokka be bakkirizibwa okubeera n’ essimu okusobola okukendeeza ku bikolwa by’enguzi. Kati abakozi bonna balina okwambala kkaadi zabwe ez’emirimu mu bulago abantu basobole okufuna ebibakwatako.

headline: Abatwala abantu ebweru bakkiriziddwa okuddamu okukola
text: Kampala Gavumenti ekkiriza kkampuni ezitwala abantu mu mawanga ag’enjawulo okuddamu okukola oluvannyuma lw’okusitula ku muggalo n’amateeka agaali gaaziteekebwako mu kaweefube w’okukendeeza ku nsaasaana y’ekirwadde kya Ssennyiga Corona.  Okusinziira ku Minisita avunaanyizibwa ku kikula ky’abantu n’abakozi, Frank Tumwebaze, Minisitule ye egenda kufulumyawo ebiragiro ebirina okugobererwa amakampuni agatwala abantu ebweru, kiyambe obutatambuza kirwadde kino. “Tutegeeza kkampuni zonna ezirina layisinsi okutwala abantu ebweru n’okubafunira emirimu nti oluvannyuma lw’okusitula ku muggalo n’okukendeeza ku biragiro n’amateeka ga Minisitule y’ebyobulamu wamu n’okukkiriza ennyonyi okuddamu okukola. Minisitule y’abakozi n’ekikula kya bantu eggyeewo ekkoligo ku kkampuni ezitwala abantu ebweru,” Tumwebaze bw’agambye. Minisita Tumwebaze alambise nti kkampuni zino zisuubirwa okutambulira wansi w’ebiragiro ebiggya ebyafulumizibwa eri abantu abafuluma n’okuyingira eggwanga mu mbeera ya Ssennyiga Corona. Ono agasseeko nga Omuwandiisi w’enkalakkalira mu Minisitule eno bw’agenda okufulumyawo ekiwandiiko ekyenjawulo ku birina okugoberera. Mu mwezi gwa March, gavumenti yayimiriza okutwala abantu mu mawanga g’ebweru okuli; Ekyombo kya Buwarabu, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Jordan, Somalia, Kuwait, Bahrain, Afghanistan, ne Iraq, okuziyiza ekirwadde kye kimu. Era nga gyebuvuddeko ekibiina ekigatta amakampuni agatwala abantu ebweru ekya Uganda Association of External Recruitment Agencies (UAERA), nga bakulembeddwamu ssentebe waabwe, Baker Akantabira, baavaayo ne basaba gavumenti eggulewo kkampuni zino kubanga buli kaseera omulimu gwabwe gubadde gwongera okusaanawo. Uganda erina kkampuni 187 ezikkirizibwa mu mateeka okutwala abantu ebweru n’okubafunira emirimu.

headline: Obwakabaka buzzeemu okugema abantu COVID-19
text: Obwakabaka buzzeemu okugema abantu ekirwadde kya  Ssennyiga Corona okusobola okukuuma abantu ba Ssaabasajja Kabaka Ronald Muwenda Mutebi II nga balamu ng’enteekateeka eno eyindidde mu bimuli bya Bulange e Mmengo ku Lwokutaano nga yaakumala ennaku bbiri nnamba.  Enteekateeka eno etongezeddwa Katikkiro Charles Peter Mayiga agemeddwa akayiso ke akookusatu nga kano ke kongera obukuumi mu mubiri eri abo abagemebwa emirundi ebiri ate nga bali waggulu w’emyaka 50.  Mukuumaddamula Mayiga asinzidde wano n’akunga abantu  okusoosowazanga ebyobulamu nga bettanira buli nteekateeka ezireetebwa  basobole okwekuuma nga balamu olwo basobole okutumbula embeera zaabwe era bakulaakulane.  “Tulina  enjawulo nnene nnyo wakati w’omuntu n’ekisolo. Ekisolo ky’okutale kiri ku bwakatonda ffe abantu tulina okutegeera ekituufu ekituyamba okutereeza obulamu bwaffe. Era nze ndowooza omuntu bwalagajjala nafa Katonda ajja kumubuuza. Lwaki mugendera ku bibooziboozi nga Ssaabasajja asise omukono gw’ekkanzu ne bamukuba empiso nga mulaba, Nnaabagereka ne Katikkiro ne bakola kye kimu ggwe n’olowooza nti b’onywa nabo amalwa be basinga okutegeera!” Katikkiro Mayiga bw’abuuzizza.  Katikkiro era awadde bannayuganda amagezi okukomya okutwalibwa amawulire amafu ku by’obulamu wabula beebuuze abasawo abakugu okunnyonnyoka.  Minisita w’ebyobulamu mu Buganda, Owek. Dr. Prosperous Nankindu Kavuma ategeezezza nti abantu ba Kabaka bazze mu bungi nga tewali abawaliriza era ne yeebaza Obwakabaka olw’enteekateeka eno.  Ye akulira emirimu ku ddwaliro e Mmengo Godfrey Ssemanda  akkaatirizza obukulu bw’okwegemesa era n’alambika ku ddoozi ya ‘Booster’ egemebwa eri abantu abakuze mu myaka era n’akakasa nti eddagala lino teririna bulabe nga bwe byogerwa.  Ate ye akulira ebyobulamu mu kitongole KCCA mu divizoni, Dr. Dennis Buluma  yeebazizza Obwakabaka olw’amaanyi n’etoffaali bwe liteeka mu kutumbula ebyobulamu by’abantu era n’asaba abantu okwenyigira mu nteekateeka zino kubanga zaakubayamba.  Abamu ku bagemeddwa beebazizza Ssaabasajja okufaayo ku bantu ba bulijjo era ne bakubiriza n’abantu abalala okukozesa omukisa oguleeteddwa bakuume obulamu.  Okugema Ssennyiga corona wano mu bulange  kwakumala ennaku bbiri nga kutandise leero olwo kukomekkerezebwe enkya ku Lwomukaaga.

headline: Poliisi Ekoze Ebikwekweto Mu Kampala Mweyooledde Boda Boda 200
text: Ezimu ku boda boda ezikwatiddwa  Olwaleero Poliisi ekoze ebikwekweto mu Kampala n’emirirwano mweboyedde boda boda ezisukka mu 200. Okusinziira ku Patrick Oyango ayogerere Poliisi y’ekitundu kino, kino kikoleddwa olw’abavuzi ba boda boda abeeyongedde okujeemera ebiragiro bya gavumenti ku kuziyiza ekirwadde kya coronavirus. Okuzinziira ku, Onyango Poliisi teyakomye kukwata boda boda zokka, wabula yaggalidde n’abavuzi wamu n’abasaabaze abaabadde bazitambuliriko. Omukulembeze w’eggwanga mu mwezi gw’okusatu omwaka guno yawera boda boda okutambuza abasaabaze ssaako n’okuziragira okukoma okutambula ssaawa kkumi nemu ez’olweggulo. “Abantu abe’njawulo bakwatiddwa era baakuvunaanibwa mu kkooti olw’okujeemera ebiragiro ebiri mu mateeka ng’era kino kiyinza okuvaako okusaasaana kw’ekirwadde kya coronavirus mu ggwanga,” Onyango bweyagambye. Poliisi ekubirizza abantu okulekeraawo okujeemera ebirgiro bino. Bagambye bano bebakutte baakukola ng’ekyokulabirako eri abalala.

headline: Gavumenti efulumizza olukalala lw’abaawambibwa, baasangibwa n’ebintu by’amagye
text: Kampala Kyaddaaki gavumenti efulumizza olukalala lw’abantu 177 abagambibwa okuwambibwa ab’ebyokwerinda wadde ng’abeebyobuyinza bagamba nti bano baakwatibwa oluvannyuma lw’okusangibwa n’ebintu by’amagye era bano baasooka kusimbibwa mu kkooti y’amagye oluvannyuma ne basindikibwa ku alimanda. Aba NUP balumiriza amajje ne poliisi okuwamba abantu baabwe  Bw’abadde awaayo olukalala luno eri Palamenti leero ku Lwokuna, Minisita w’ensonga ez’omunda, Gen. Jeje Odongo, agambye nti ku bantu bano 177, 155 ku bo baabasanga n’ebintu by’amagye, ekintu ekimenya amateeka. Okusinziira ku Minisita Odongo, 156 baasimbibwa mu kkooti ne bavunaanibwa okusangibwa n’ebyokulwanyisa era ne basindikibwa ku alimanda mu kkomera ly’e Makindye nga bwe balinda okuwozesebwa.Olukalala luno luliko abantu abalala 53 abaakwatibwa olw’okwenyigira mu kwekalakaasa era bangi ku bano nabo baasindikibwa mu kkomera e Makindye. Akawayiro nnamba 161 ak’etteeka lya UPDF kagamba nti omuntu yenna asangibwa n’ebyokulwanyisa ajja kuvunaanibwa era bwe gumusinga asibwe emyaka 14 oba okuwa engassi oba byombi. Omwezi oguwedde, Pulezidenti Museveni yawakanya ebyali byogerwa nti abamu ku bantu baali bawambiddwa n’ategeeza nti aboogerwako baali bakwatiddwa ku misango egy’enjawulo. Wabula omuwendo ogufulumiziddwa Minisitule y’ensonga z’omunda tegukwatagana na muwendo Pulezidenti Museveni gwe yayogerako kuba yagamba nti abakwate bali 200 ate olukalala olufulumiziddwa lulaga abantu 177. Olukalala olufulumiziddwa luleeseewo akalembereza mu bantu b’abamu ku bakwate ababadde beebuuza abantu baabwe gye bali kuba abamu ku bano bamaze omwezi mulamba nga tebamanyiseeko wa gye bali. Kinajjukirwa nti ebitongole by’ebyokwerinda bibadde bikubagana empawa ku ani alina obuvunaanyizibwa okufulumya olukalala luno ng’okusooka amyuka Ssaabaduumizi wa poliisi, Maj. Gen. Paul Lokech, yayita olukung’aana lwa bannamawulire okubawa amawulire wabula n’alusazaamu awatali kuwa nsonga yonna.

headline: Katikkiro Mayiga alambudde ku Mutiibwa Kalidinaali Wamala
text: Katikkiro wa Buganda, Charles Peter Mayiga alambudde ku Kalidinaali Emmanuel Wamalaera n’abaako n’obubaka bwa Ssaabasajja Kabaka bw’atuusa olw’okufiirwa muto we, Msgr. Henry Kyabukasa. Ensisinkano eno ebaddewo leero ku Mmande mu maka ga Kalidinaali e Nsambya mu Kampala. “Ssebo Omutiibwa Kalidinaali, nsanyuse nnyo okujjako wano mu maka go era Ssaabasajja Kabaka atumye nnyo okukulaba era akusaasidde olw’okufiirwa muto wo Msgr. Henry Kyabukasa era n’antuma okutegeeza nti asiima nnyo essaala z’omuweereza era akakasiza ddala nti zimuyambye.” Katikkiro Mayiga bw’ategeezezza Ku lulwe Katikkiro Mayiga ategeezezza nti muto wa Kalidinaali Byabukasa yali amumanyi okuva mu buto kuba yakola ne kitaawe Fr. John Musoke nga batendeka abaseminariyo e Bukalasa ate ng’abamu ku abo batendese abadde nabo emyaka mingi. Katikkiro Mayiga agamba nti Msgr. Kyabukasa yali mwetowaze olw’okuba yali mugezi era ng’akimanyi ntimuto wa Kalidinaali. Okusinziira ku Katikkiro Mayiga, kyamukisa okuba nti Katonda abawadde ekirabo eky’okulaba Kalidinaali ebbanga lino lyonna naddala abo abamulabako ng’akyali Ffaaza era kibeera kyasanyu buli lwe bamusisinkana. Mu ngeri y’Obuwangwa, Katikkiro Mayiga mu kukubagiza kuno agenze n’ekita ky’omwenge okwongera okulaga okunyolwa. Ye Omutiibwa Kalidinaali Emmanuel Wamala asiimye Katikkiro Mayiga olw’okumulambula era n’amusiima olw’emirimu gy’akola okusitula embeera z’abantu mu Buganda. “Onsanyudde kubanga obugenyi bwo buno buziguliddewo ebijjukizo ebyo. Ssebo Kamalabyonna wa Buganda n’obuwombeefu bunginkusaba onamusize Bbaffe Ssaabasajja Kabaka ne maama Nnaabagereka, abaana beng’oma, Abalangira n’Abambejja n’Obuganda bwonna.” Ssaabasumba omuwummuze ow’essaza ekkulu ery’e Kampala bw’ategeezezezza.

headline: Poliisi egobaganye ne boda boda lwakujjeemera ekiragiro kya Museveni
text: Paaka ya  takisi  nga njereere Ebitongole by’ebyokwerinda nga bikulembeddwamu poliisi n’amajje olwaleero basiibye bagobagana na bavuzi ba boda boda abaganye okugondera ekiragiro ky’omukulembeze w’eggwanga ekiwera okutambulira mu bidduka eby’olukale.  Eggulo, President Yoweri Kaguta Museveni yayimirizza boda boda, takisi ne baasi zonna ezitambuza abantu ez’olukale mu kaweefube wa gavumenti okutangira okusaasaana kw’ekirwadde kya COVID-19 mu ggwanga.  Yagambye nti boda boda zikkirizibwa kutambuza migugu gyokka.  Kyokka mu bitundu bya Kampala eby’enjawulo, aba boda boda balabiddwako nga batambuuza abantu okwawukana ku kiragiro.  Abaserikale ababadd ebayiiribbwa ku nguudo ez’enjawulo babakubye emiggo bombi, omuvuzi n’omusaabaza.  Mu bitundu ebimu abasirikale babadde bawamba ne zi bodaboda. “Mwagala tulyeki bannange, mutuleke ffe tukole,” owa boda boda ataategeerekeseeko linnya bweyawuliddwa nga agamba abasirikale wakati mu mbooko.  Ekirwadde kya COVID-19 ekyabalukawo munsi yonna nga kitandikira e China kyakatta abantu abasoba mu 21,000 n’abalala 468,644 kyabaayoola nga abamu bali ku ndiri.

headline: Katikkiro mu bifananyi ng’ali e Gomba
text: Katikkiro Charles Peter Mayiga yeetabye ku mukolo gw’okuggulawo Kelezia empya ey’ekisomesa kye Mawuuki e Gomba, wamu n’okujaguza emyaka 10 egya St. Joan of Ark. Omusumba w’essaza lye Kiyinda Mityana, Anthony Joseph Zziwa, yakulembeddemu okusaba.

headline: Kabaka asaasidde abakoseddwa ekirwadde kya Coronavirus
text: Kabaka ng’ayogerako eri Obuganda mu Lubiri e Mmengo Ssaabasajja Kabaka Ronald Muwenda Mutebi II asaasidde nnyo abantube abakoseddwa ekirwadde kya coronavirus mu Uganda ne mu mawnaga amalala. Bwabadde ayogerako eri Obuganda olwaleero mu Lubiri lw’e Mmengo, Kabaka agambye nti singa abantu bawuliriza obubaka obubaweebwa eb’ebyobulamu obulwadde bwa coronavirus bwewalika.  “Tusaasira nnyo eb’engganda z’abantu baffe Bannayuganda abafudde obulwadde buno mu mawanga ag’ebweru.  Tuteeka mu ssaala naabo abakyali mumbeera embi mu mawanga ago bassuuke.  Twebaza nnyo abasawo abali ku mwanjo gw’okulwanyisa obulwadde buno obugoyezza ennyo ensi yonna,” Kabaka bweagambye.  Omutanda yasabye gavumenti eyongere okussa essira mu by’obulamu mu ggwanga lyonna okusobola okwenganga okusoomoozebwa kwendwadde enkambwe nga coronavirus.  Yasabye abantu nti obulwadde nebwebuba bukomye, bagende mumaaso n’okukuuma obuyonjo ng’agamba nti endwadde ezisinga okuluma abantu zewalikwa singa abantu baba bayonjo.  Kabaka era yasiimye abantu bonna abalina kyebawaddeyo okuyamba abo bakoseddwa ekirwadde kino.  Kabaka wiiki eno yawaayo obukadde 100 okusobola okudduukirira Bannayuganda abakoseddwa ebiragiro ebyateekebwawo gavumenti okusobola okutangira okusaasaana kwa COVID-19.  Yasabye n’abasuubuzi okukomya okuduumuula emiwendo gy’ebintu ebikozesebwa mu bulamu obwabulijjo n’agamba nti abantu tebajja kusobola kubyetuusaako ku miwendo eminene.  Woosomera bino nga coronavirus yakakwata abantu 1,715589 ng’ate abalala 103,841 bamaze okulugulamu obulamu.

headline: Temutya kubagema Ssennyiga Corona – Katikkiro Mayiga
text: Katikkiro wa Buganda, Owek. Charles Peter Mayiga, asabye bannayuganda obuteewala kubagema Ssennyiga kolona nga beesigama ku bulimba obusaasaanyizibwa ku mikutu gimugattabantu. “Amawanga agaakula tegasobola kututta nga gakozesa ddagala lya Ssennyiga ate nga nabo balikozesa, era akugamba nti abazungu basobola okutta bakaddugala okuyita mu ddagala lino aba mulimba kkungwa.” Katikkiro bw’agambye.  Okwogera bino Katikkiro asinzidde ku mbuga y’Obwakabaka enkulu e Mmengo, mu bimuli bya Bulange bw’abadde agenze okukubibwa empiso esooka mu kugema ekirwadde kya kolona. Mukuumaddamula ajunguludde ebigambibwa nti eddagala erigema Ssennyiga kolona erya Astra Zeneca bamagulumeeru baalikola kulemesa baddugavu  kuzaala. Agambye nti singa balina ekigendererwa kino baali basobola okuyita mu bika by’eddagala ebirala nga Panadol.  Mu kwongera okuzibula abantu amaaso, Owek. Mayiga agambye nti abazungu beetaaga nnyo abaddugavu kubanga be babakolera emirimu gye beenyinyala n’egyo egyetaagisa amaanyi ng’okulima n’okusima zaabu so ate ng’abaddugavu katale k’amaanyi eri ebyo ebikolebwa mu nsi ezakula. Katikkiro asinzidde wano n’akunga abantu okwettanira okugemebwa ekirwadde kya kolona era n’abajjukiza okugenda mu maaso n’okugoberera ebiragiro ebyateekebwawo okutangira ekirwadde kino kinnamuzisa. Bw’abadde ayaniriza Katikkiro, Minisita wa Buganda ow’ebyobulamu, Owek. Prosperous Nankindu Kavuma, yeebazizza Katikkiro okukkiriza okumugemera mu lujjudde n’ategeeza nti kano kabonero akalaga nti eddagala erigemesebwa teririna buzibu ate kiraga nti Obuganda bukkiririza mu nteekateeka eno. Okugema ekirwadde kya kolona kugenda mu maaso ku Bulange e Mmengo nga kwabwereere era abantu bakubirizibwa okwogera okujjumbira. Buli muntu akubibwa empiso bbiri mu kugema Ssennyiga kolona wabula ey’ookubiri omuntu emukubibwa oluvannyuma lwa Ssabbiiti 8 okuva ku mpiso eyasooka. Ate ye Minisita Noah Kiyimba asiimye Katikkiro Mayiga olw’okujjukiza abantu bulijjo okwetangira ekirwadde kya Ssennyiga Corona.

headline: Minisita Kasaija agamba embeera ebayinze,  gavumenti terina ssente zitambuza ggwanga
text: Minisita w’ebyensimbi Matia Kasaija ategeezezza akakiiko ka Palamenti akalondoola ebyenfuna by’ eggwanga nti embeera ebayinze obuto nga batandise okulemererwa kuba ne ssente ezirina okutambuza eggwanga tebalaba webaziggya. Kasaija annyonnyodde nti eno y’ensonga lwaki ssente ezaweerezebwa mu bitongole bya gavumenti mu kitundu ky’omwaka gw’ebyensimbi ekya 2022/2023 zaali ntono ezitalina kyamanyi kyezisobola kukola. Ono alaze okutya ku nsimbi ezikung’aanyizibwa ekitongole ki Uganda Revenue Authority zagamba nti ntono nnyo mukiseera kino olw’ebyenfuna ebiserebye neyesanga nga talina ssente zakuweereza bitongole okutambuza emirimu. Minisita Kasaija agamba balowoozezza okwewala mu bbanka enkulu ey’ eggwanga naye batyaayo amagoba amangi agagenda okubasabibwa nga kati basobeddwa eka nemu kibira. Kasaija yeeyamye eri ababaka bano okubatwalira omuteesiteesi omukulu owa Minisitule y’ebyensimbi Ramathan Ggoobi abannyonnyole ku kituufu ekigenda mu maaso. Kinajjukirwa nti gyebuvuddeko Minisitule y’ebyensimbi yategeeza eggwanga nti ensimbi entono ezasindikibwa eri ebitongole zaali zigendereddwamu okulwanyisa okunaabuuka kwa ssente ya Uganda kuba buli lwezibeera ennyingi mu bantu namaanyi gaazo gakendeera. Omubaka omukyala owa Namayingo, Margret Makhoha yeebazizza Minisita olw’okwogera ekituufu naye namusaba addeyo n’enteekateeka erina okugobererwa okutaasa embeera eno.

headline: Bannaddiini 6 be bafudde mu myezi 6 gyokka
text: Enjega eyagwiridde Eklezia w’Omukama, ettukizza ebiwundu bya bannayuganda abazze bafa  ebirwadde ebitali bimu okuva mu nzikiriza ez’enjawulo. Ssaabasumba Dr. Cyprian Kizito Lwanga ng’ono y’abadde akulira essaza ekkulu erya Kampala era yasangiddwa ku Lwomukaaga ng’afiiridde mu kisenge kye, ekintu ekyatiisizza buli omu. Bino okubaawo Lwanga yabadde yaakamala okusaba gavumenti ekomye ebikolwa eby’okutulugunya bannansi era eyimbule n’abo abaakwatibwa. Dr. Lwanga yasembye okulabikako mu lujjudde ku Lwokutaano nga yeetabye n’abakkiriza mu Kristo nga batambuza ekkubo ly’omusaalaba era okufa kwe kwalangiriddwa Msgr. John Baptist Kauta. Mgr. Kauta yannyonnyodde nti okufa kwa Ssaabasumba kwabakubye entiisa kuba abadde teyeemulugunyaangako nti tawulira bulungi wabula okumusanga obusanzi ng’afiiridde mu kisenge kye.  Abasawo ba Ssaabasumba wamu n’abakugu okuva e Mulago bategeezezza nti yafudde kizibu kya mutima era afiiridde ku myaka 68. Bisoopu John Baptist Kaggwa Olunaku lwali lwa  January 20, 2021, omusumba w’essaza eyali yakawummula John Baptist Kaggwa yafa oluvannyuma lw’okutawanyizibwa ekirwadde kya COVID-19 okumala emyezi ebiri. Okufaananako ne Dr. Lwanga, Bisoopu Kaggwa yali amanyiddwa olw’okulwanirira obwenkanya wamu n’okufuba okukulaakulanya abantu. Ku myaka 78 gye yalina buli omu yali amumanyi ng’omulwanirizi w’eddembe kayingo atatya kubuulira gavumenti kituufu nga waliwo ekisobye. Owoobusobozi Bisaka  Bisaka yali yeeyita Katonda era ng’alina abagoberezi abawereko. Ono yafa January 18, 2021 era ye mutandisi w’enzikiriza ya ‘Faith Unity’ nga we yafiira ng’aweza egy’obukulu 90. Okufa kwa Owoobusobozi Bisaka kwalangirirwa ayogerera enzikiriza eno Omukwenda Mitooro era kyakuba wala abagoberezi be era n’okutuusa kati abamu ku bano baagaana okukkiriza nti ono yafa nga bagamba nti awummuddemu.  Sheikh Nuhu Muzaata Batte Oluvannyuma  lw’ekittabasiraamu okusirikamu mu 2015, Obusiraamu bubadde tebunnaba kuddamu kufiirwa mukulembeze alinga Muzaata. Ono yafa omwaka oguwedde nga guggwaako nga December 4, 2020. Muzaata yamanyika nnyo olw’okwogera ku nsonga naddala ezinyigiriza abasiraamu mu ggwanga. Shiekh Muzaata teyakoma okwo wabula yayambalira ne bannabyabufuzi abaali bakozesa obubi ebifo byabwe era ono obutambi bwe ng’ayogera, abasuubuzi mu Kampala batandika okubukolamu ssente. Muzaata yafiira mu ddwaliro lya International Hospital Kampala, oluvannyuma lw’okumala akaseera nga mulwadde era munywanyi we Hajji Latif Ssebaggala ye kakasa amawulire g’okufa kwe. Sheikh Dr. Abdu Anas Kaliisa Dr. Anas Kaliisa yali mumanyi era munnabyafaayo era okufa kwe nga November 4, 2020 kwasannyalaza eggwanga. Ono ajjukirwa nnyo olw’ekibiina kye ekya Salam Charity mwe yali ayambira abantu abeetaavu era yayambako okutandikawo Kaliisa Foundation, eyamba okuweerera abaana abeetaavu. Ono yayatikirira nnyo olwa pulogulaamu gye yakolanga ku ttivvi ya NBS eya  Ensi n’Ebyayo era yagenze okufa ng’azimbye emizikiti egy’enjawulo okwetooloola eggwanga. Paasita Augustine Yiga Paasita Augustine Yiga abasinga baasooka kuwakanya mawulire ga kufa kwe, oluvannyuma lw’amawulire okusaasaana nga October 20, 2020. Yiga eyali amanyiddwa nga “Abizzaayo”  olw’engeri gye yali akolamu ebyamagero wamu n’okuzzaayo eddogo eri eyalisindika era amakanda yali yagasimba  Kawaala ku kkanisa ya Revival Church. Ono baali bamubise enfunda eziwera wabuli buli mulundi yavangayo n’ayambalira ababadde bamubika ku ttivvi ye eya ABS. Ng’asinziira ku mukutu gwe ogwa ABS, Yiga yeesanganga mu buzibu n’ekitongole kya UCC ekivunaanyizibwa ku kulung’amya ebyempuliziganya olw’okumenya agamu ku mateeka gaakyo. We yafiira yali yaakamala okuyimbulwa okuva mu kkomera gye yatwalibwa olw’okuwubisa abantu ng’abagamba nti mu Africa tewali Corona wabula Ssennyiga owabulijjo. Ono we yafiira ng’alina emyaka 44 era kigambibwa nti yafa bulwadde bwa kibumba.

headline: Jacob Oulanyah bamututte mu kkooti ku by’okuwangula ekifo kya Sipiika
text: Kampala Munnamateeka Hassan Male Mabirizi addukidde mu kkooti ya East Africa elafubanira obwenkanya nawakanya okulondebwa kwa Jacob Oulanyah nga Sipiika omuggya owa Palamenti y’e 11 gwagamba nti yalondeddwa mu bukyamu. Okusinziira ku biwandiiko Mabirizi byatutte mu woofiisi za kkooti eno e Kololo, Mabirizi agamba nti obululu obwalangiriddwa bwabadde bungi okusinga ku muwendo gw’ababaka ababaddewo ku lunaku lw’okulonda ekintu ekimenya amateeka. Mu musango guno, Mabirizi era awakanya ekya Ssaabalamuzi Alfonse Owiny Dollo okukulemberamu okulondesa kuno ate nga Oulanyah mukwano gwe era nga yamuteeka ku biwandiiko bye ebimwogerako nga abamu ku bantu abasobola okumuweera obujulizi ku bimukwatako. Kati Mabirizi ayagala kkooti ya ‘East African Court of Justice’ erangirire nti okulondebwa kwa Oulanyah kwali kukyamu era eragire wategekebwewo okulonda okuggya okusobola okulonda Sipiika omutuufu. Ono ayagala n’okulonda kwa Sipiika kw’omumyuka wa Sipiika nakwo kuddibwemu kubanga Oulanyah eyali akukubiriza yali mukyamu kuba naye okulondebwa kwe nakwo kwali kukyamu era kulina okuddibwamu. Ekirindiriddwa kwe kulaba oba kkooti eno enagenda mu maaso n’okuwulira omusango guno era oba kinaasoboka okulondebwa kuno okuddamu okutegekebwa. Kinajjukirwa nti wiiki ewedde ababaka bakungaanira e Kololo okulonda Sipiika n’omumyuka we era nga olwokaano lwalimu bannakibiina kya NRM babiri okuli Rebecca Kadaga ne Jacob Oulanyah awamu ne Ssemujju Nganda owa FDC. Gyebyagweredde nga Oulanyah awangudde obwa Sipiika ate ekifo ky’omumyuka wa Sipiika nekiwangulwa Anita Among eyawangudde Muhammad Nsereko ne Yusufu Nsibambi.

headline: Poliisi erabudde okukwata bakanyama ba beesimbyewo
text: Kampala Poliisi y’eggwanga egamba nti tegenda kusibamu kukwata bakanyama ba beesimbyewo singa tebakoma kubakozesa kukunga bantu n’okujeemera ebiragiro bya kakiiko k’ebyokulonda ne Minisitule y’ebyobulamu, ebirung’amya okunoonya akalulu ka 2021. Omwogezi wa Poliisi mu ggwanga, Fred Ennanga “Ebiragiro bino byonna bisoboka bulungi singa ffenna tweyisa mu ngeri ey’obuvunaanyizbwa. Abeesimbyewo n’ebibiina by’ebyobufuzi ebikunga ababoodabooda n’obukundi bwa bakanyama okuyisa ebivvulu n’okukuba enkung’aana, tugenda kubwakwata bavunaanibwa mu mateeka.” omwogezi wa Poliisi Fred Ennanga bwe yagambye. Ennanga era alabudde abantu abalemedde ku by’okutimbula ebipande bya bannaabwe n’ategeeza nga kino bwe kivudde ku kujeemera ebiragiro ebyabaweebwa ku wa awatuufu awalina okutimbibwa ebipande. “Bw’otambula, olaba ebipande ebiteekeddwa ku bupande bw’oku nguudo, mpagi za kkamera n’ebizimbe by’abantu. Singa Nannyini kizimbe atandika okutimbululayo ebipande okuva ku bisenge, tewali musango gw’ajja kuba ng’akoze kubanga byateekebwawo awatali kufuna lukkusa.” Ennanga bwe yagasseeko. Ennanga yagambye nti batadde amaaso ku bannabyabufuzi abakozesa olulimi olukuma mu bantu omuliro n’okusiga obukyayi mu bantu gye bali mu kunoonya obululu. Ono yannyonnyodde nti bakwataganye n’ekitongole kya Uganda Communications Commission (UCC), okugoberera abatambuza obubaka obw’obulimba wamu n’okusiga obukyayi nga bayitira mu mawulire ne ku mutimbagano.

headline: Ab’Emmamba abaawangula basisinkanye omutaka Gabunga
text: Bazukkulu ba Gabunga abaawangula ebifo ebyenjawulo mu kalulu akaawedde aka 2021, eggulo baakedde kusisinkana Omutaka omukulu Owaakasolya k’Emmamba, Jjajja Gabunga Mubiru Zziikwa, okuwoza olutabaalo. Mu bano mulimu abaawangula obwakkansala, bammeeya, n’ababaka ba Palamenti awamu n’abalala. Abamu ku bayitamu nga bawa Jjajja Gabunga ettu Mu bakulembeze abazze kwe kwabadde Mmeeya wa munisipaali y’e Kira Julius Mutebi, omubaka w’ekibuga Lugazi omulonde, Stephen Sserubula n’abalala nga bano balombojjedde jjajja bwe embeera gye bayitamu. Omubaka omulonde owa Munisipaali y’e Lugazi, Stephen Sserubula, yategeezezza nti baakutunuulira obusobozi obwa buli Mutuba mu kika ky’Emmamba, okulaba ogusinga okukola obulungi. Ate ye mmeeya wa Kira, Julius Mutebi yagambye nti, “Jjajja twagala okukwebaza weebale kukuuma kika kyaffe ne bonna abakukwatirako era tujja kusanyuka nnyo nga tuyitibwa okuwa ebirowoozo byaffe ku ebyo bye tulowooza ebisobola okutumbula ekika kyaffe.” Omubaka Sserubula bwe yagambye. Jjajja w’ekika ky’mmamba, Omutaka Mubiru Zziikwa ng’aliwamu ne bakulembeze banne, b’ozaayozezza bazukkulu baabwe olwokutuuka ku kkula ly’obululembeze kyokka ne babasaba obuteerabira kika kyabwe. “Nga bwe mwalidde obwami temuddeyo kudigida budigizi ate mu kung’aanye abazzukulu era mweweeyo okukikulaakulanya,” Omutaka Mubiru Zziikwa bwe yategeezezza. Ate Ssaabawandiisi w’ekika ky’Emmamba, Andrew Benon Kibuuka, yabasabye mu buli kye bakola bakulembeze ekika kyabwe era bafube okukiweereza awamu n’okukiyiyiza, kisobole okukulaakulana.

headline: Abayindi balaajanidde gavumenti ku kusosolwa olwa Ssennyiga Corona
text: Kampala Abamu ku bayindi abawangaalira mu Uganda bawandiikidde gavumenti nga beemulugunya ku ngeri gye basosolwamu naddala nga bava e Buyindi okudda e Uganda olw’ekirwadde kya Ssennyiga Corona. Ebbaluwa eno eriko omukono gwaRajesh Chaplot, nga mubalirizi wa bitabo alaajanidde gavumenti ekkirize eggye eggwanga lya India ku mutendera gw’amawanga agakoseddwa nnyo ekirwadde kino, balizze ku mangu agali yadde yadde. Kinajjukirwa nti mu mwezi gwa May,gavumenti yawera entambula zonna ez’e Buyindi olw’ekika ky’akawuka kaCOVID-19akapya akaali kazuuliddwayo. “Ennyonyi ezisaabaza abantu wakati wa Uganda neBuyindi zongezeddwayo. Tewali muntu ava Buyindi ajja kukkirizibwamu Uganda.” Minisita Jane Ruth Aceng bwe yagamba. Wabula ku kino, Rajesh agamba kikyamu okugaana abayindi okuyingira mu Uganda ate ng’abantu abalala okuva e Bungereza nayo ekirwadde gye kiri ekyamaanyi, bakkirizibwa. Rajesh annyonnyola nti mu kiseera kino Bungereza erina abantu bangi abakwatibwa ekirwadde buli lunaku okusinga Buyindi. Okusinziira ku Rajesh, Bungereza efuna abalwadde402 buli lunaku ku buli kakadde k’abantu ate Buyindi erinako 29 bokka. Omuyindi ono Rajeshagasseeko nti omuwendo gw’abakwatibwa e Buyindi gwali mungi mu kusooka naye kati embeera yatereera era tewali nsonga lwaki gavumenti egenda mu maaso n’okubateekako obukwakkulizo. Ono alaze okunyolwa olwa bannayuganda okutambula kyere mu Buyindi naye ate eno mu Uganda bakyagenda mu maaso n’okubasosola. Asabye abo abagemeddwa emirundi ebiri bakkirizibwe okudda mu Uganda basobole okutambuza emirimu gyabwe. “Abayindi ababeera kuno bagatta ebitundu 60 ku buli 100 ku by’enfuna by’eggwanga. Mu mutima guno mwe tusabira gavumenti ekkirize abayindi abakyali mu Buyindi abafuna obutuuze nabo abakolera kuno okuddamu okutambuza emirimu gyabw.” Rajesh bw’agasseeko. Rajesh agamba nti amakampuni agawerako agakozesa abayindi mu Uganda gakalubizibwa okutambuza obulungi emirimu gyago, ekintu ekireesewo okufiirizibwa.

headline: Katikkiro Mayiga asabye bannabyamizannyo okunyweza empisa
text: Katikkiro Charles Peter Mayiga akubiriza bannabyamizannyo okunyweza empisa bweba baagala okutwala ebitone byabwe mu maaso. Owek. Mayiga bino abyogeredde mu Bulange e Mmengo bw’abadde asisinkanye Omukulembeze wa FUFA, Omw. Eng. Moses Magogo, ng’ono abadde azze okwanjulira Katikkiro tiimu z’omupiira eziva mu kitundu kya Buganda, ezigenda okwetaba mu mpaka za FUFA DRUM. Katikkiro Mayiga annyonnyodde nti awatali mpisa kijja kubeera kizibu okuganyulwa mu muzanyo gwo mupiira nabasaba bulijjo okukola obutaweera nga batumbula omupiira wano n’ebweru.  Owek. Mayiga abajjukizza nti omuzanyo gw’omupiira ssi muzanyo buzannyo wabula kintu ekisobola okubayamba okwongera okutumbula ebitone byabwe n’okubayimirizaawo mu bulamu obwa bulijjo. Ono asabye abaddukanya omupiira okuggya eby’obufuzi mu mupiira bweba baagala okugutwala mu maaso n’okwongera okugwagazisa abalala. Minisita w’Abavubuka n’Emizannyo mu Bwakabaka Oweek. Henry Ssekabembe Kiberu, atenderezza eby’emizannyo by’agambye nti bitumbula empisa ate binyweza n’obumu. Owek. Ssekabembe agambye nti Buganda egenda kusindikayo abantu 90 basome ebikwata ku muzannyo gw’omupiira bafune obumanyirivu mu kuddukanya empaka z’Amasaza.  Akulira ekibiina ekitwala omupiira mu ggwanga, Eng Moses Magogo ategezezza katikkiro nti ekikopo kya Drum kyali kirooto bulooto nga kati musanyufu okulaba nga kyamala nekituukirira. Magogo yeebazizza Obwakabaka okubawa ettaka e Lugazi okugenda okuzimbibwako ekisaawe. Ensisinkano eno yeetabiddwako Minisita Ssekabembe Kiberu, akulira FUFA, Moses Magogo, omumyuka we Rogers Byamukama, omubaka wa Palamenti Patrick Nsanja, Andeleya Kaweesa, Diriisa Kasalirwe n’abalala.

headline: Katikkiro Mayiga  asisinkanye Kapiteeni wa Cranes Emma Okwi
text: Katikkiro Charles aliko akaama kakubye bannabitone naddala abazannyi b’omupiira okutwala eky’okulabirako kya Emmanuel Okwi nga beeyisa bulungi bwebaba baagala okulaakulanya ebitone byabwe. Bino Katikkiro Mayiga abyogeredde mu nsisinkano gyabaddemu ne Emmanuel Okwi e Bulange Mmengo ku Lwokuna nebateesa ku nsonga z’omupiira. Owek. Mayiga agamba nti singa abazannyi balabira ku Okwi nebafuna byebamukopako bajja kwanguyirwa okwerula emikisa gyabwe. Ye Okwi agambye nti yeenyumirizza nnyo mu mpaka z’Amasaza kuba gye yatandikira olugendo lwe olumutuusizza wano waali. Ono asabye abantu wonna mu ggwanga okuwagira enteekateeka y’omupiira gw’Amasaza awamu n’enteekateeka endala eza Buganda kuba ziganyula abantu bonna awatali kusosolamu. Emma Okwi y’omu ku bazannyi b’omupiira abaagunjulwa empaka z’Amasaza, era yali muzannyi wa Mawokota. Okwi ajjukirwa okubeera mu ttiimu ya Mawokota eyasamba fayinolo kweyakubira Gomba ggoolo 2:0 okusobola okusitukira mu kikopo ky’omwaka gwa 2007.

headline: AKAMYUFU: Ab’e Ssembabule bazize ak’omubaka omukyala
text: Bannakibiina kya National Resistance Movement, abaakedde okulonda ababaka okuli owa Mawogola North ne Mawogola South, tebajjumbidde kulonda anaakwata kkaadi ku kifo ky’omubaka omukyala. Abamu ku balonzi nga basimbye enyiriri Wadde ng’okusooka abalonzi bazze mu bungi wabula obwedda buli amala okulonda ababaka ba kositityuwensi nga badduka bajaganya era tebalinze kulonda mubaka mukyala. Akakiiko k’ekibiina ak’ebyokulonda kaalagira abalonzi basooke balonde ababaka ba Kositityuwensi n’oluvannyuma balonde Omubaka omukyala, wabula kino kumpi tekisobose. Ekifo ky’omubaka omukyala kibadde kyesimbyeko Mary Begumisa, Jovanice Twongyeirwe ne Phoebe Arinaitwe era ng’okulonda kubadde mu bifo musanvu byokka ku ebyo 17 ebironderwamu mu kitundu kino. Ebibadde byakafunibwawo ku kifo ky’omubaka omukyala biraze nti Mary Begumisa abadde akyakulembedde banne. Eyakuliddemu okulondesa mu ggombolola y’e Mijwala, John Byansi ategeezezza nti, obwedda abantu abayita okudda balonde Omubaka omukyala naye nga tebamufaako. Byansi agamba nti kati agenda kukola alipoota agiwe akulira eby’okulonda mu NRM alabe eky’okukola kubanga abadde tasobola kukaka bantu kusimba nnyiriri. Omu ku balonzi b’e Byesika, George Muheirwe, mu Mawogola North ategeezezza omukutu gwa URN nga abalonzi bwe babadde beesunze akalulu ka konsitityuwensi okusinga ku k’omubaka omukyala kubanga babadde bakooye obuvuyo mu kulonda kw’ekitundu kino era nga babadde balina gwe baweereza obubaka. “Akabakyala tetukeetabyemu lwa nsonga tubadde n’obulumi obwa MP nga bwe businze okutunuluma era bano abalala tebabadde mu birowoozo byaffe.” Muheirwe bw’ategeezezza. Ono yagasseeko nga bwe bamaze ebbanga nga balonda naye Omubaka waabwe ow’ekitundu naye nga balangiriramu mulala nga leero babadde baliko omuntu gwe baagala okuweereza obubaka era nga bakakasa nti abufunye. Akamyufu ka Mawogala South ne North awamu n’okulonda omubaka omukyala bwayongezebwayo okutuuka olunaku lwaleero olw’obuvuyo n’okulwanagana wakati w’abawagizi ku njuyi ez’enjawulo mu kunoonya obululu. Ku bifo ebironderwako okuli; Byesika, Kyabelesa, Kashongi A ne B, nga byonna bisangibwa mu ggombolola y’e Kiwanda, abalondesa bakkaanyizza kwegayirira abantu balindeko okugenda nga tebabawuliriza. Obwedda buli lwe balangirira nti Godfrey Aine Kaguta Sodo akulembedde Shartsi Musherure Kuteesa ne Salim Kisekka olwo ng’abantu babuuka wakati mu ssanyu era nebelema okulonda Omubaka omukyala. Ku nsonga eno omulonzi w’e Kashongi Grace Kashendwa, agambye nti ababadde beesimbyewo ku kifo ky’omubaka omukyala tebabamanyi ate era baalemwa n’okutuuka ku bantu nga banoonya akalulu.

headline: Wuuno ow’emyaka 28 eyawangudde Mutuluuzo mu Mpigi
text: Kampala Omuvubuka Ssejjemba Martin ayingidde mu byafaayo bwafuuse ssentebe wa disitulikiti ye Mpigi owa LC5 ku myaka 28 gyokka oluvannyuma lw’okuwangula banne abasatu ababadde mu lwokaano. Martin Ssejjemba eyakoze ebyafaayo Sejjemba nga yabadde ne bbendera ya National Unity Platform (NUP) yawangudde munnabyabufuzi era eyaliko omubaka wa Mawogola North, Peter Claver Mutuluuza eyabadde ku kkaadi ya National Resistance Movement (NRM) era nga yabadde ssentebe wa Mpigi. Ebyalangiriddwa akulira eby’okulonda mu disitulikiti ye Mpigi, Flavia Namujulizi byalaze nti Ssejjemba yafunye obululu 29711 ate Mutuluuza nafuna obululu 8174 ate munnakibiina kya Democratic Party (DP) nafuna 4176 so nga Ssematimba Godfrey Kasas atalina kibiina nafuna obululu 3,850. Nga bwekyabadde mu disitulikiti ez’enjawulo okwetoloola Buganda, ku mutendera gwa bakiise ku nkiiko za disitulikiti ebifo ebisinga bwawanguddwa bannakibiina kya National Unity Platform.

headline: Obwakabaka bwagala abavubuka bongerwe obukugu okulwanyisa ebbula ly’emirimu
text: Obwakabaka bwa Buganda butegeezezza nti bwetegefu okulagana ne gavumenti awamu ne bannamikago abalala okusobola okuteekawo enteekateeka okusobola okuwa abavubuka emirimu. Akulira bboodi y’ebyenjigiriza mu Buganda, Deborah Zawedde ategeezezza nti waliwo obwetaavu okuwa abavubuka obukugu obutuukana n’embeera. Bino Omuk. Zawedde abyogeredde ku mukolo gw’okutikkira abavubuka 43 abakuguse mu by’okuyunga amasanyalaze g’ enjuba (Solar) mu nteekateeka eyakoleddwa aba Don Bosco Technical Institute e Luweero ng’eno yawagiddwa aba Sendea Academy. Zawedde agamba nti nga Buganda balina abavubuka bangi abatalina mirimu nga weetaaga okubaawo ekikolebwa mu bwangu okusobola okutaasa ebiseera byabwe eby’omu maaso. “Singa tugenda mu maaso n’okumala gatendeka bavubuka nga tetwekenenyeza bwetaavu buli ku katale ka mirimu, tugenda kuba tetulina kyetukola mukufunira abavubuka bano emirimu. Ebbula ly’emirimu kyekimu ku bizibu ebinene mu ggwanga essaawa eno,” Zawedde bwe yannyonnyodde. Ye Ssenkulu wa Sendea Academy, Loy Kyozaire mu nteekateeka eno bakaganyula abantu 400 okuli abavubuka n’abantu abakulu nga babatendeka ku masanyalaze ga Solar omuli okuganyunga awamu n’okugaddaabiriza. Ono asabye ebitongole ne kampuni okuvaayo bakwatagane ne Buganda okusobola okumalawo ekizibu ky’abavubuka abatalina mirimu kuba ebya Kabaka tebisosola mu mawanga. Akulira ettendekero lya Don Bosco Technical Institute agamba nti enkolagana gyebalina ne Sendea Academy egenda kuyambako okuwa obukugu abaana b’eggwanga era kikendeeze ku kizibu ky’ ebbula ly’emirimu era kiyambe okuleetawo omutindo mu kisaaw kya amasanyalaze g’enjuba. Ye akulira ekibiina ekitaba abayunga abantu ku masanyalaze g’enjuba, Douglas Baguma ategeezezza nti ebitundu ebiri wansi wa 30 ku buli 100 bebakozesa amasanyalaze g’enjuba mu ggwanga ekiraga nti akatale kakyali kagazi n’abalala okuyingira omulimu guno.

headline: Omuloodi Lukwago ne Kasozi be basongeddwako okusikira Owek. Ssebuggwawo
text: Kampala Ekibiina kya Forum for Democratic Change (FDC) kimaliridde okusikiza abo bonna abaajeemera ekibiina ne babaako obuvunaanyizibwa bwe batwala awatali kufuna lukkusa awamu n’abo abeesimbawo ku bwannamunigina. Ensonda mu FDC zigamba nti abakulu amaaso bagatadde ku Muloodi wa Kampala, Erias Lukwago n’eyali omubaka wa Makindye East mu Palamenti, Ibrahim Kasozi, okudda mu kifo ky’omumyuka wa Pulezidenti w’ekibiina mu kitundu kya Buganda. Kino kiddiridde munnakibiina ekyali mu kifo kino era eyali Mmeeya wa Lubaga, Owek. Joyce Nabbosa Ssebuggwawo okulondebwa nga Minisita omubeezi ow’ebyamawulire ne Tekinologiya mu gavumenti ya Pulezidenti Museveni. Okusinziira ku nsonda, ekibiina kya FDC tekinnasalawo ku babiri banokuba abamu bagamba nti Ibrahim Kasozi ekibiina akiruddemu era amanyi ebintu by’omunda bwe bitambula ate ng’abalala bagamba nti Lukwago amusinza obuganzi mu Buganda. Pulezidenti w’ekibiina kino, Patrick Amuriat, bw’atuukiriddwa tawakkaanyizza Ku kya bantu bano kubeera bamu ku balowoozebwako wabula agasseeko ng’ekibiina bwe kijja okutegeeza eggwanga mu bwangu ku kinaaba kituukiddwako. Ono agamba nti nga Ssabbiiti ejja tennayita, ekibiina kijja kuba kimalirizza okulondako omuntu omu okudda mu bigere by’Owek. Nabbosa. Okusinziira ku Amuriat,akakiiko k’ekibiina k’akulira kagenda kutuula ku Lwokutaano lwa wiiki eno, okulondako erinnya limu erinaaweerezebwa eri olukiiko lwa National Executive Committee (NEC)okukakasibwa.

headline: Ebya Ingrid Bibi: Aba FDC bamwegaanye
text: Kampala Ekibiina kya Forum for Democratic Party kivuddeyo ne kyongera okwegaana okubeera n’akakwate konna ne Turinawe Ingrid Kamateneti, omu ku bantu abakola ennyo okuginoonyeza akalulu mu kitundu kya Kigezi. Ono avuganya ku kifo ky’omubaka wa Munisipaali y’e Rukungiri. Amuriat nga anoonya akalulu mu bitundu bye Rukungiri Turinawe ng’ono yaliko mu bifo ebinene mu kibiina n’okutuusa essaawa ya leero alabibwa nga munywanyi wa Dr. Kizza Besigye, wabula nga yasalawo okwesimbawo ku lulwe oluvannyuma lw’okugobwa mu kibiina olw’obutakkaanya n’ebyo ebyava mu kamyufu k’ekibiina. Mu kamyufu k’ekibiina akaliwo mu August 2020, Dr. Warren Tumwiine yawangula kkaadi y’ekibiina n’obululu 130, Ingrid n’afuna 65 ate Ronald Kaginda n’afuna obululu 62. Turinawe yagaana okukkiriza ebyali bivudde mu kulonda ng’agamba nti mwalimu vvulugu era n’ajeemera ekibiina. Wano Ssaabawandiisi w’ekibiina, Nandala Mafabi, we yamugobera mu kibiina mu Decemba wa 2020. Bwe yabadde mu lukung’aana mu kibuga ky’e Rukungiri eggulo ku Mmande, alina kkaadi y’ekibiina ku bwapulezidenti Patrick Oboi Amuriat yeegaanye Turinawe mu lujjudde n’asaba abaayo okulonda Dr. Warren Tumwiine. “Njagala okubasaba okulonda abantu abali wano omuli ne Warren ku lw’ebifo by’obukulembeze mu kibuga. Twalina akamyufu wano era kaali k’amazima n’olwekyo omuntu bw’aba yasalawo okwesimbawo ku lulwe aba yava mu kibiina.” Amuriat bwe yagambye. FDC era ekyali mu kusoberwa oluvannyuma olwa Winnie Babihuga naye okusalawo avuganye ku kifo ky’omubaka omukyala ku lulwe oluvannyuma lw’okuwangulwa Betty Muzanira mu kamyufu k’ekibiina. Amuriat ali mu kunoonya akalulu, yatandikidde ku mwalo gwe Rwenshama mu Rujumbura mu disitulikiti y’e Rukungiri n’avumirira eky’abajaasi abatulugunya bannansi ku myalo era n’asuubizza okubaggyako singa akwata obuyinza. Ono bwe yavudde wano n’ayolekera ekitundu kya Nyakishenyi wabula n’alemererwa okutuukayo oluvannyuma lw’amazzi okusalako ekkubo ku kyalo kya Nyabikuuku.

headline: Owek. Waggwa Nsibirwa asabye bannabizineensi okwettanira emyoleso
text: Omumyuka ow’okubiri owa Katikiro Ow’ekitiibwa Wagwa Nsibirwa asabye bannamakolero awamu ne bannanyini bizineensi ku mitendera egy’enjawulo okwettanira emyoleso egy’enjawulo kibayambe okugaziya ku katale kabwe. Minisita Waggwa Nsibirwa bino abyogeredde ku mukolo kwatongoleza omwoleso gwa Buganda ogugenda okubaawo omwezi ogujja mu lubiri e Mmengo nga 19-28 ogutuumiddwa, “Coronation Vintage Show” ng’omukolo gubadde mu Bulange e Mmengo ku Lwokusatu. Owek. Nsibirwa agamba nti okwolesa kiyamba kinene nnyo okutumbula bizinensi y’omuntu ate n’oyo akwetabamu kimuyamba kwongera okuyiga ebipya awamu nokumanyisa abantu kwebyo byakola. Ono asabye abatandisi b’amasomero wamu n’abakulembeze okuleeta abayizi mu mwoleso gw’Obwakabaka guno okusobola okumanya bizineensi ez’enjawulo zebasobola okutandika n’okumanya ebyaliwo mu nsi yabwe. Ye Minisita w’ebyobulambuzi, obuwangwa n’ennono Owek. David Kyewalabye Male, akowodde abantu okweyiwa mu Lubiri lwa Beene okuva nga 19 – 28 okusobola okwenyumiriza mu mwoleso ogugenda okubaletera enjawulo mu bulamu bwabwe. Ono era ategezezza bannabizinensi okwongera okwetanira okuyiga olulimi oluganda kuba lukozesebwa nnyo abantu nga terukoma ku baganda bokka naye n’abantu b’ebitundu ebirala. Omwoleso guno gutegekeddwa ekitongole ky’Obwakabaka ki Buganda Heritage and Tourism Board wamu n’e Kampuni ya Luba Events era bonna baweze okugwongeramu ebinonogo . Ssenkulu w’olukiiko olukulembera ekitongole ki Buganda Heritage Tourism Board (BHTB), Omuk. Benon Ntambi asabye abantu okujja mu bungi kuba enteekateeka y’omulundi guno ebadde tenalabwako wantu wonna.

headline: AKAMYUFU KA NRM : Museveni alabudde  abawagizi n’abeesimbyewo ku kubba akalulu
text: Kampala Ssentebe w’ekibiina ki NRM, Pulezidenti Yoweri Museveni alabudde abeesimbyewo, abawagizi babwe wamu n’abantu abeetegese okubba akalulu mu kamyufu k’ekibiina ku Lwokutaano luno nti tagenda kubaganya. Pulezidenti Yoweri Museveni Kino kiddiridde poliisi okunokolayo ebifo 15 omusuubirwa okubeera obuvuyo n’efujjo mu kalulu, mubino kuliko; Ssembabule, Kassanda, Kazo, Bundibugyo, Sironko, Sheema, Mbale, Hoima, Koboko, Adjumani, Kashongi, Kampala, Wakiso ne Hoima mu kalulu akagenda okukubwa enkya ku Lwokutaano. Bino Museveni yabitadde mukiwandiiko kye yafulumizza ku Lwokuna nategeeza nti obutabanguko wamu n’obuvuyo tekirina gwekiyamba. Museveni yagambye nti, “NRM bweyatwala obuyinza mu 1986, twakomya okuyingirira eddembe ly’abantu okwesalirawo ku ggwe baagala okubakiikirira. Twakomya enguzi, obuvuyo, obusososoze mu mawanga, okukozesa olulimi olukyamu wamu n’okukyusa ebiva mu kalulu, ekimu ku bino kiba kiraga nga akalulu akatali ka bwenkanya.” Olw’ebikolwa bino Museveni agamba abantu bagyibwako eddembe ly’okufuna abakulembeze be baagala kubanga baweebwe bebatalonze era nga emirundi egisinga abafunye obuyinza mu ngeri eno bakola ku bigendererwa byabwe so ssi bizibu bya bantu. “Abantu abaagala okufuna wofiisi zino nga bayitira mu makubo gemenye waggulu, balabe ba Uganda era beetaaga kuwangula,” Museveni bweyanyonyodde. Museveni yagasseeko nti ye yagaana eby’okukozesa okutiisatiisa n’obuvuyo ku bannayuganda kubanga ssi baddu. Museveni agamba nti tasobola kukwata mitwalo 30 nagiwa mulonzi kubanga tekirina wekimuyambira okujjako okumukuumira mu bwavu. Ono yalagidde ab’ebyokwerinda okukwata abo bonna abagulirira abantu wamu n’okuleetawo obutabanguko. Awadde amagezi abeesimbye mu kamyufu okukomya mbagirawo obuvuyo era nalagira ababaka ba Pulezidenti mubitundu byonna (RDC) awamu nabakulira ebyokwerinda okuyingira mu nsonga eno mu bwangu. Bano nabo Museveni yabalabudde nti singa embeera ebaleremerera ajja kwefunira amawulire okuva wansi mu bantu era nabo abeekolereko olw’okulemwa okukola omulimu gwabwe.

headline: Akakiiko akanonyereza ku vvulugu ku ttaka kamalirizza emirimu
text: Omulamuzi Catherine Bamugemereire   Akakiiko akaateekebwawo omukulembeze w’eggwanga Yoweri Kaguta Museveni, kamalirizza emirimu egyakakwasibwa egy’okunonyereza ku vvulugu ali mu kitongole ky’ettaka. Akakiiko kano akabadde kakulirwa omulamuzi wa kkooti ejulirwamu, Catherine Bamugemereire kamaze emyezi 30 mukunonyereza kuno. Mubyekakoze mubbanga lyekamaze mubaddemu, okutaasa ssente z’eggwanga eziwera akatabalika kamu [trillion] okuva mukwemulugunya 7767, obubbi bw’ettaka, obuli bwenguzi oba obukuluppya obwenjawulo. Akakiiko era kategezezza nti kasobodde okutaasa ssente nyingi ddala oluvanyuma lw’okusazaamu ebyapa 160. Akakiiko kano alipoota yaako yakwasibwa Museveni era ekirindiddwa kwekulaba kiki kyagenda okugikolera.

headline: Katikkiro atongozza Ebitabo
text: Katikkiro nga akutte Ekitabo Omuzadde n’Omwana ekimu ku bitabo ebyattongozeddwa. Katikkiro atongozza ebitabo “Omuzadde n’Omwana, ne “Raising Great Children”, ebyawandiikibwa Afande Emiliano Kayima era nga ono yaliko Omwogezi wa Police ya Uganda. Katikkiro asabye abazadde okulambika abaana byebasaanye okukola awamu n’ebyo byebatasaanye kukola, bwebasobya babonerezebwe ate bwebakola obulungi babayozeyoze. Era wano Katikkiro asabye abazadde okukuza abaana n’obuntubulamu kibasobozese okufuuka aboomugaso eri eggwanga.  Omusumba Jjumba ow’e Masaka naye abaddako ku mukolo. Ebitabo bino bitongozeddwa wali ku woteri ya Africana mu Kampala.

headline: Bannayuganda bakuutiddwa okwetegeka bwebaba baakuwangula mu by’emizannyo
text: Minisita wa Ssaabasajja Kabaka avunanyizibwa ku by’emizannyo, abavubuka n’okwewummuza, Oweek. Henry Sekabembe Kiberu agambye singa Uganda yeteekateeka bulungi, esobola okuwangula engule nnyingi nnyo mu by’emizannyo. Okwogera bino Sekabembe abadde mu Bulange e Mmengo mu kuggalawo omusomo gw’ebyemizannyo ogumanyiddwa nga sports administration and management training, ogumaze ennkau ssatu nga guyinda.  “Uganda nga tweteeseteese bulungi, netukola byetuteekeddwa okukola nga bwetuteekeddwa okubikola, mu butonde bwetulina, mu mmere gyetulya, ne mubaamu obuntu bulamu, ku ddaala lyonna mu nsi yonna tuteekeddwa okusobola okuvuganya n’okuwangula. Omukisa gusanga yeeteeseteese,” Sekabembe bwagambye. Omusomo guno ogwaggulwawo nga Gattonnya 11, gwawagiddwa ekibiina ekikola ku by’emizannyo mu ggwanga ekya Uganda Olympics Committee. Abamu ku beetabye mu musomo  Okusinziira ku Oweek. Hassan Kiyemba, omusomo guno gugendereddwamu okuwa obukugu obw’enjawulo munzirirukanya y’ebyemizannyo  “Tujja kufuba nnyo okulaba nga abantu abaddukanya eby’emizannyo balina obukugu obw’enjawulo tusobola okutunda n’okusikiriza abantu bangi mu masaza gonna okulaba nga bawagira eby’emizannyo,” Kiyemba bwagambye.  Omusomo gwetabiddwamu abatendesi b’omupiira mu masaza, mu bika, mu masomero, obukiiko obukulembera eby’emizannyo mu Bwakabaka nga kwekuli akakiiko akakulembera omupiira gw’amasaza, akakulembera omupiira gw’ebika, omupiira gw’okubaka ogwe’bika, akakiiko akakulembera omupiira gw’amasomero n’ekikopo kya Nnaabagereka n’abamu ku bategesi b’emisinde. Omusomo guno gwagulwawo Oweek. Ssekabembe ng’ali wamu ne pulezidenti wa Uganda Olympics Committee William Blick. Gwetabiddwamu abantu abawera 150.

headline: Kiwanda atutte ekya Buganda, Kadaga nawangula Namuganza
text: Kampala Minisita Namuganza ne Rebecca Kadaga ababadde ku mbiranye Sipiika wa Palamenti Rebecca Kadaga awangudde Persis Namuganza, minisita w’eby’ettaka neyeddiza ekifo ky’Omumyuka wa ssentebe ow’okubiri owa bakyala ow’ekibiina ki National Resisitance Movement (NRM) ate ne Minisita Godfrey Kiwanda nawangula ekya Buganda. Ssentebe w’akakiiko k’ebyokulonda Dr. Tanga Odoi, amakya ga leero alangiridde nga Kadaga bwafunye obululu 6,776 nawangula Namuganza eyafunye obululu 3,882. Ababiri bano nga bonna basibuka mu kitundu ky’e Busoga babadde ku mbiranye, nga Namuganza alumiriza Kadaga obutassa kitibwa pulezidenti Museveni era Ssentebbe w’ekibiina. Namuganza yategeezza nga Kadaga bwakwatagana ne Opozisoni mu palamenti okuleeta ebiteeso ebisiiga ekibiina ki NRM enziro ate nga Kadaga alumirizza nga Namuganza bwaleeteddwa abamulwanyisa munda mu kibiina ki NRM abawakkanya engeri gyatambuzzaamu palamenti. Ekifo kya Ssentebbe w’ekibiina mu Buganda ekibaddemu Hajji Abdul Nadduli, kyatwaliddwa Godfrey Kiwanda Ssuubi eyafunye obululu 4,749 nawangula Moses Karangwa Kalisa eyafunye obululu 3,701. Abalala ababadde mu lwokaano Kiganda Twaha Ssonko yafunye obululu 1,048, Mayengo Moses nafuna 127 ate Magaro John nafuna 675. Omumyuka wa Sipiika Jacob Oulanyah yawangudde Col. Sam Engola okufuuka Ssentebe mu mambuka. Oulanyah yafunye obululu 7,473 ate Engola nafuna 1,665, ku kifo kyekimu Timothy Okee Jokene yafunye obululu 895, Dr Odongo Oledo nakungaanya obululu 277. Mu Ankole, Dr. Chris Baryomunsi yalondeddwa Ssentebe bwafunye obululu 5,947 ate Munnamajje Maj. Gen Matayo Kyaligonza nafuna obululu 2,550, kifo kino Florence Kintu Tumwine yafunye 1,875, naddirirwa Muhangi Wilberforce n’obululu 1,255, Boaz Kafuda yakutte kya kutaano n’obululu 602 ate Dr Diini Kisembo nasembayo n’obululu 224. Ssentebe w’ekibiina mu Kampala kati ye Katongole Singh Marwaha bwawangudde Amooti Godfrey Nyakana. Singh yafunye obululu 4,503 nga Nyakana nafuna 2,466. E Karamoja Simon Peter Aleper yasigazza ekifo kino ku bululu 8,143 ate abadde amuvuganya Lokor Jimmy nafuna 2,220. Captain Mike Mukula naye yawangudde Sanjay Tana okufuuka ssentebe w’ekibiina mukitundu ky’e Buvanjuba.

headline: Abantu 16 be bafudde Corona mu Masaka, abakugu balabudde
text: Masaka Buddu Abatuuze b’e Masaka n’ebitundu ebiriraanyeewo batandise okusattira olw’ekirwadde kya Ssennyiga Corona okweyongera mu kitundu kino. We butuukidde olwaleero ng’abantu 16 be baakafa okuva Pulezidenti Museveni lwe yalangirira omuggalo ogwokubiri ate nga n’ennamba y’abakwatibwa obulwadde buno yeeyongera buli lukya. “Enamba y’abantu abazuulibwamu ekirwadde kya Covid- 19 yeeyongedde nnyo era nga tusuubira okuba nga kino kivudde ku bayizi abaakava ku ssomero nga kati basiiga bazadde baabwe. Kyamukisa mubi kuba kati tufuna abaana abato n’abakulu abazuulibwamu ekirwadde kino.” Dr Edwin Okello omu ku basawo abakulira okujjanjaba Covid-19 mu ddwaliro e Masaka bw’ategeezezza. Ono agamba nti okukendeeza ku nnamba, basazewo abatali bubi babawandiikire eddagala badde ewaka ebifo ebitono bye balina bikozesebweabali mu mbeera embi kuba kati balinawo abalwadde 10 abassiza ku byuma. Dr. Okello asinzidde wano n’asaba abantu okwewala ekirwadde kino kuba embeera bwesukkako wano eyinza okubalemerera olw’ebikozesebwa ebitono. Alabudde abantu abatandise okwejjanjaba bokka ewaka nti bayinza okweleetera obuzibu bw’atyo n’abasaba okusooka mu ddwaliro abasawo bazuule ekituufu ekibaluma n’eddagala lye beetaaga okukozesa. Ye akulira akakiiko akalwanyisa COVID-19 era nga ye mubaka wa Pulezidenti e Masaka, Fred Bamwine, agamba nti batandisewo enkola erondoola abalwadde abajjanjabirwa ewaka era baakuwandiikira bassentebe b’ebyalo n’abasawo ku byalo amannya g’abantu bano, basobole okubalondoola n’okulaba nga tebatambula kubunyisa kirwadde kino. Ate omusumba w’essaza ly’e Masaka, Bishop Serverous Jjumba asabye abantu beegayirireKatonda aggyewo ekirwadde kino nga bwe banywerera ku biragiro bya gavumenti.

headline: Akalulu Kazitoye: Kabuleeta alemereddwa okukuba enkung’aana e Kyotera, Rakai ne Lwengo
text: Avuganya ku bwapulezidenti, Joseph Kabuleta, ng’ono talina kibiina kw’ajjidde, olunaku lw’eggulo yalemereddwa okunoonya akalulu mu disitulikiti y’e Kyotera, Rakai ne Lwengo nga bwe yabadde ategese. Avuganya ku bwapulezidenti  Joseph Kabuleta Bannamawulire mu kitundu kino bakedde naye z’agenze okuwera essaawa kkumi (10) ez’olweggulo nga tewali kabonero kalaga nti Kabuleta waakulabikako. Woofiisi ya Kabuleta ekwasaganya kkampeyini ze, yategeezezza nti waabaddewo ensonga ezaabadde tezinnamalirizibwa mu Kampala nga Kabuleeta ze yabadde asoose okukolako. Ate ye omukwanaganya wa kkampeyini ze, Godwin Matsiko, ategeezezezza nti baaluddewo okutegeeza abawagizi baabwe mu kitundu kino naye Kabuleeta yabadde alina leediyo z’alina okubeerako mu Kampala nga kyabadde tekisoboka kukwata budde. Kabuleta si ye yekka eyaakasazaamu enteekateeka z’okukuba kkampeyini mu disitulikiti zino ng’eyasooka yali Willy Mayambala eyalemesebwa olw’obuzibu bw’ebyenfuna wadde ng’ono yaddamu okusaba akakiiko k’ebyokulonda okumukkiriza addemu anoonye akalulu mu kitundu kino. Bino we bijjidde ng’abeesimbyewo naddala ku mutendera gw’Obwapulezidenti bali mu kutalaaga ebitundu by’eggwanga ebyenjawulo nga banoonya akalulu akayinza okubatuusa ku ntebe ennene.

headline: Ng’enda kuzza amaanyi mu kabondo ka Buganda- Muwanga Kivumbi
text: Ssentebe w’akabondo k’ababaka abakiikirira ebintu bya Buganda mu lukiiko lw’eggwanga olukulu, Mohammad Muwanga Kivumbi, yeeyamye okukola n’amaanyi okulaba ng’akabondo k’akulembera kaddamu okwolesa amaanyi nga ge kaalina. “Amazima gaali nti obubondo bw’ababaka mu ggwanga lyonna bwanafuwa dda, naye nze ng’enda kukola kyonna kye nsobola mu nsi okulaba ng’akabondo ka Buganda kaddamu endasi.” Muwanga Kivumbi eyakalondebwa ku bukulu buno bw’agambye. Ono asinzidde ku mukutu gw’empuliziganya ogumu era n’agamba nti sibeetegefu kukola nsobi yonna nga ng’enderere mu kaweefube waabwe era nti ensobi gye banaakola ejja kuba ekoleddwa mu bwerufu. Okusinziira ku Muwanga, akabondo kano kaludde ebbanga nga kaava dda ku mulamwa ogwakateekesaawo ne kafuuka ng’ekibiina kya munnomukabi nga kalabikira mu kuziika era n’agamba mbu singa abadde talabawo kisobola kukyusibwa teyandyenyigidde mu bukulembeze bw’akabondo kano. Omubaka w’essaza ly’e Mawokota ono asinzidde wano n’akolokota gavumenti ku ngeri gy’ewanyisaamu ekirwadde kya ssennyiga kolona gy’agamba nti ya kibogwe. Ono agambye nti singa gavumenti ebadde ekakasa nti eyagala kugoba kolona, singa embalirira y’eggwanga eddibwamu ne basala ssente ku bintu ebimu olwo ne ziteekebwa mu by’obulamu. “Okusinziira ku kye nnabaze, singa tusala ssente ku bintu ebimu, tusobola okufissa obuse 7 (7 trillion) olyo ne zigenda mu by’obulamu. Emmotoka z’ababaka tebasobola kuzongerayo nezigulwa omwaka ogujja? Jjuuzi nawulira ssaabaminisita Nabbanja, ayagala mmotoka mpya mbu tayagala Dr. Rugunda z’abadde ekozesa, gwe ani agaana emmotoka enkadde?” Muwanga bw’abuuzizza. Kivumbi era asekeredde Pulezidenti Museveni oly’okwemulugunya nti baamulayiriza mu motoka ezaali ziwedde kumpagala n’agamba nti kyennyiza omukulembeze w’eggwanga okuyombera emmotoka ng’ensi erumbiddwa nawookeera w’ekirwadde. Ono gavumenti agiwadde gaabuwa nti yeddize amalwaliro g’obwannannyini okutaasa okupaaza ssente z’obujjanjabi ate n’ebizimbe by’amasomero bikozesebwe okujjanjabirayo abantu engeri gye gaggalwa mu kaseera kano. Agambye nti gavumenti bw’ebyeddiza okumala akaseera n’eriyiridde bannannyini byo, olwo nabo bajja kuganyulwa. Asabye ebintu ebitwala ssente ng’okuzimba engundo birindeko okutuusa nga kolona alinnyiddwa ku nfeete kubanga okusinziira ku Muwanga, tewali kitasobola kulinda bwe kituuka ku kuziimba eggwanga.

headline: Ssingo efunye  omutendesi omuggya  okwetegekera Sizoni empya
text: Ttiimu y’essaza lya Ssingo erangiridde Simon Ddungu ng’omutendesi omuggya owa ttiimu eno, ng’ono emuggye mu Busiro gyebadde atendeka mu mpaka eziwedde. Okusinziira ku bakungu ba ttiimu eno, kino kikoleddwa okwetegekera sizoni empya etandika omwezi ogujja ogwa June 2022. Omutendesi ono amanyiddwa nga Ddunga, yatendekako ku ttiimu ya Mbale Heroes awamu ne ttiimu endala ezamanyi mu ggwanga. Ddungu asikidde Emmy Kisakye eyatendeka Ssingo omwaka oguwedde, nga kati azze ku kya bumyuka, ne Regan Lule ye mutendesi wa bakwasi ba ggoolo. Ono alina obumanyirivu mu mupiira gw’Amasaza nga yawangulira ttiimu ya Gomba ekikopo mu 2017, Mawokota mu 2013 gyeyali omumyuka w’omutendesi. Ddunga weyeegatidde ku Ssingo nga yakawangula ebikopo by’ Amasaza bibiri okuli ekya 2015 ne 2018 kyokka ezze esereba mu mutindo nga omwaka oguwedde yalemererwa okuva mu kibinja.

headline: Bobi Wine addayo e Kalangala okunoonya akalulu
text: Kampala Akwatidde ekibiina kya National Unity Platform bbendera, Robert Kyagulanyi Ssentamu (Bobi Wine), alangiridde nti waakuddayo mu bitundu by’e Kalangala ku Lwokutaano okunoonya akalulu. Omubaka Kyagulanyi mu lukiiko lwa bannamawulire “Baatulemesa okunoonya akalulu mu bitundu by’e Kalangala nga Decemba 30 naye njagala okukakasa abantu b’e Kalangala nti, tugenda kubeera nammwe ku Lwokutaano luno.” Kyagulanyi bw’annyonnyodde. Kino kiddiridde Kyagulanyi okukwatibwa bwe yali e Kalangala n’ateekebwa ku nnyonyi ppaka mu makaage ate ttiimu ye emunoonyeza akalulu n’eggalirwa e Masaka. Bobi Wine addamu okunoonya akalulu olunaku lw’enkya ng’atandikira Namisindwa oluvannyuma agende e Namayingo ku Lwokuna. Kyagulanyi era asinzidde n’awera okwongera okwanika ebikolwa bya Pulezidenti Museveni ne Ssentebe w’akakiiko k’ebyokulonda omulamuzi, Simon Byabakama. Kyagulanyi yennyamidde ku bikolwa by’okumutulugunya ne ttiimu ye ebibakolebwako ab’ebyokwerinda abalina okubakuuma mu mateeka. “Akakiiko k’ebyokulonda kalabikira ddala nti tekali mu mitambo gya byakulonda kuno era twongedde okukakasa nti kalina kyekubiira. Akakiiko tekalina kye kaavaayo kwogera nga ttiimu yange yonna ekwatiddwa, era tewali kye kaakola nga mpambiddwa okuva e Kalangala.” Kyagulanyi bw’agambye. Kyagulanyi annyonnyodde nti akakiiko k’ebyokulonda kelemeddwa okulaga obusobozi bw’okutegeka akalulu ak’amazima n’obwenkanya kuba emirundi gyonna poliisi gy’etyobodde amateeka ng’ebakuba n’okubalemesa okukuba enkung’aana, akakiiko kasigadde kasirise. Ono agamba nti mu ngeri y’okubakugira ng’oludda oluvuganya, akakiiko kaawera kkampeyini mu disitulikiti 13 kyokka eno, Pulezidenti Museveni yasigalayo nga yeegazaanya.

headline: Okunyweza omukago gwa Airtel ne K2 Ejjudde.
text: Ssenkulu wa Airtel Uganda, Somasekhar Ganapathy asisinkanye Katikkiro wamu n’abakungu b’obwakabaka okwongera okunyweza omukago gwa Airtel ne K2 telecom (K2 Ejjudde). Katikkiro ngali n’Omulangira Jjunju, Minisita Wanggwa Nsibirwa wamu n’aba Airtel ne K2 Ejjudde. Ensisinkano eno yetabiddwamu, Omulangira Cryspin Jjunju Kiwewa ku lw’obwakabaka, Minisita wa Buganda  o’webyensimbi Oweek. Robert Waggwa Nsibirwa, Ssenkulu wa CBS FM Michael Kawoya Mwebe, ne Ssenkulu wa K2 ejjudde, Omulangira Arthur Mawanda. Ate kulwa Airtel Uganda, Amit Kapur Chief Commercial officer, Ali Balunywa Director Sales and distribution, Faridah Namutebi Head Strategic sales, ne Hajji Gava Musa, project manager Airtel-K2. Ensisinkano ebadde ku Bulange- Mengo. Kinajjukirwa nti Obwakabaka bwakola omukago ne Airtel Uganda okusosobola okwongera amaanyi mu kampuni y’obwakabaka eya K2 Telecome era nga kati eyitibwa K2 Ejjudde.

headline: Katikkiro Mayiga avumiridde abayiwayiwa ssente mu kalulu
text: Katikkiro wa Buganda Charles Peter Mayiga, avumiridde abantu abayiwayiwa ssente mu kalulu nti kino kifeebya obuweereza kuba bano bwebatuuka mu bifo balowooza ku kimu kyakununula ssente zabwe. Katikkiro Mayiga nga abangula abakiise. “Ababbi, abalyake, abaluvu, abamenyi b’amateeka nabalinga bwebatyo besanga betusinza. Bwebatuuka mu bifo ebyo nabo bongera obulyake, banunule ssente ezo zebagenda basowerera mu bitundu gyebatalina kakwate,” Owek. Mayiga bw’agambye. Ono bino abyogedde aggalawo omusomo gw’abakiise b’olukiiko lwa Buganda oguyindidde ku ttendekero lya Buganda Royal Institute e Mmengo – Kakeeka ku Mmande. Katikkiro Mayiga abadde ayogera ku bisomoozo by’omulembe Omutebi, akonye ku by’obufuzi obw’ennono obutondebwawo n’ekigendererwa ky’okunafuya Buganda nategeeza nti kino kigyongera maanyi. Owek. Mayiga era yenyamidde olw’obwavu obususse mu bantu ba Kabaka nebatuuka n’okulemwa okulwanirira ebitwala eggwanga n’ebitundu byabwe mu maaso. Ono ategeezezza nti olw’okuba obwavu buyitiridde abantu betunzeeko buli kimu era nga kati balinda abawa ssente nebalyoka bamuwagira wadde nga tabalumirirwa. Okusinziira ku Katikkiro Mayiga, ekizibu ekirala kiri mu by’obufuzi ebifuuse ebyakirwanire nga abantu batuuka n’okweggwa mu malaka nagamba nti bino tebisobola kuzimba ggwanga. Katikkiro Mayiga agambye nti omulembe Omutebi okufanana n’emirala gulina ebisomooza naye Buganda n’abantu baayo balina kubeera bagezi okulaba nga babivunuka. Abamu ku beetabye mu musomo Alaze nti bagenda kukola kaweefube w’okunyweza n’okutaaasa Nnamulondo era bakole ne kaweefube w’ebyenfuna basobole okuyamba abantu okuva mu bwavu. Mayiga anyonyodde nti okuva ku bafuzi b’amatwale, wabaddewo enkola ezigendererwa okunafuya Buganda naye mu mirembe gyonna egy’enjawulo abantu mu Buganda bazze banywerera ku Kabaka waabwe. Ono abawadde amagezi bekuumire ku Kabaka basobole okuwangula ebisomooza. Owek. Mayiga abakiise abasabye bamanyise abantu ebigenda mu maaso era bakimanye nti ekimu ku bintu byebalina okusoosowaza be bantu era bafube okulaba engeri gyebawuliziganyamu nabo. Yye Owek. Daudi Mpanga alaze abakiise obukulu bwa Federo era nategeeza nti yegenda okuyamba abantu ba Buganda okwesitula mu by’enfuna era bakulaakulane. Omu ku boogezi, Ronnie Kiwumulo Mbabaali, alambise abakiise ku mugaso gw’okubeera eky’okulabirako eri bebakulembera kibayambe okukwatagana. Katikkiro Mayiga nga abuuza ku omu ku bakiise Omusomo guno gwetabiddwako ba minisita ab’enjawulo okuva mu Bwakabaka okuli Owek. Noah Kiyimba, Owek. Patrick Luwaga Mugumbule, Owek. Hajji Ahmed Lwasa wamu n’abakungu okuva mu bitongole by’Obwakabaka.

headline: Pulezidenti Museveni asuubizza okuyamba ku bannayuganda abali mu UAE
text: Pulezidenti Yoweri Kaguta Museveni asuubizza okuwaayo obuyambi bw’ensimbi eri bannayuganda abakolera wamu n’okubeera mu United Arab Emirates, kibayambe okwongera okwekulaakulanya. Bino Museveni yabyogeredde mu nsisinkano gye yabaddemu n’abakulembeze abeegattira mu kibiina kya The Association of Ugandans living in United Arab Emirates (AUU) ku wiikendi, nga yawerekeddwako omumyuka owookusatu owa Ssaabaminisita, Lukia Nakadama ku St. Regis Hotel e Abu Dhabi mu United Arab Emirates. Museveni yabasuubizza okuteeka ssente mu SACCO yaabwe basobole okwewola ku magoba amatono. “Tugenda kubawa ssente. Ng’enda kuteeka emitwalo gya ddoola 10 mu SACCO yammwe musobole okwewola n’okutandika bbizineesi wano. Ate kyo ekibiina kyammwe ng’enda kukiteekamu emitwalo 5.” Pulezidenti Museveni bwe yagambye. Museveni era yasuubizza nga bw’agenda okukola ku kizibu kya bannayuganda abakukusibwa okuleetebwa mu kitundu kino, n’ategeeza nti kabineeti yasazeewo okuteekawo ekifo we bayinza okusooka okukuumira abaana bano ababeera babonyaabonyezebwa n’okununulwa. Ono era abasabye okusikiriza bannaabwe okwegatta ku kibiina kino kuba UAE erimu bannayuganda abawerera ddala emitwalo 6 era bano baweereza mu Uganda ssente ezisoba mu bukadde bwa ddoola 200 e Uganda buli mwaka. Ssentebe w’ekibiina kino, Nsubuga Abdulbasit yasabye Pulezidenti Museveni okusitukiramu ku nsonga y’abaana abawala abali ku nguudo za Dubai kuba wadde babadde babayambako naye oluusi balemererwa. Nsubuga yannyonnyodde nti wadde emabegako omuwendo gwa bannayuganda ababadde beetuga gwali gulinnya, naye kati gubadde gukendedde. Ensisinkano eno yeetabiddwamu ne Ambasada wa Uganda mu United Arab Emirates, Zaake Kibedi.

headline: Temulonda babaka bekweka ku nsonga za Buganda – Katikkiro Mayiga
text: Kamalabyonna wa Buganda Charles Peter Mayiga, asabye abantu obutalonda babaka batiiririra nsonga za Buganda mu palamenti. Okwogera bino Katikkiro abadde mukuziika kitaawe w’omubaka Joseph Sekabiito, Omulangira Kitayimbwa e Ndaiga mu Mawogola ku Lwokuna. Katikkiro Mayiga yagambye nti, “Saagala munnabyabufuzi yekokoota, Saagala munnabyabufuzi yekweka Kabaka. Mumiransanafu yali alegeddwamu mmundu abalala baba balegeddwamu bikoola bya miti nebadduka. Temutuleetera babaka ba palamenti abekweka nga ensonga za Buganda ziri mu ddiiro” Omulangira Wasajja ne Katikkiro Mayiga mukuziika Kamalabyonna yanyonyodde nga bwewaliwo ebisomooza omulembe Omutebi naye abantu bulijjo okunoonya ekituufu era bakinywerereko. Mayiga yatendereza obuvumu obwayolesebwa Omulangira Kitayimbwa ne banne bwebakweka n’okutolosa Ssekabaka Muteesa II mu kaseera Obote weyamunoonyeza nga ayagala okumutta, asabye abantu bulijjo okumutwala nga eky’okulabirako. Ate yye omukubiriza w’olukiiko lwa Buganda Patrick Luwagga Mugumbule, omugenzi yamwogeddeko nga omusajja omuvumu era nasaba Buganda ekkirize erinnya Mumiransanafu lifuuke kitibwa asobole okwongera okujjukirwa. Ku lw’abaana b’omugenzi omubaka Joseph Ssekabiito yasiimye Ssaabasajja olw’okubasaasira era nasiima abantu abesombye okuva mubuli kanyomerero okujja okubaziikirako. Sipiika wa Palamenti Rebecca Kadaga mu bubaka bwe bweyatisse omubaka wa Nakasongola Mutebi Noah Wanzala, yasaasidde nnyo ab’enju eno era nategeeza nti ebyo byeyakola bwebirina okugumya ab’enju eno era bafube okutwala omukululo gwalese. Ekitambiro ky’emmisa ekyawerekedde omugenzi kyakulembeddwamu Omusumba we Masaka Serverus Jjumba eyasabye abakungubazi okuyigira ku mugenzi. Omukolo gwetabiddwako Minisita Noah Kiyimba, Pookino, omukiise wa Kooki mu Lukiiko lwa Buganda Owek Gertrude Ssebugwawo n’ Omwami w’essaza Mawogola, Hajji Nohamood Sserwadda. Abalala kwabaddeko; Kaggo eyawummula Tofiri Malokweza, Abaami ba Kabaka ku mitendera gyonna, bannabyabufuzi, bannaddiini n’abantu abalala bangi.

headline: Abakungubazi  babunyiziddwa emiwabo lwa Coronavirus
text: Ab’amajje nga bafulumya abakungubazi   Ab’ebyokwerinda olwaleero batutte entyagi abakungubazi ababadde bakungaanye okuziika omusuubuzi w’e Kabale Amon Paddy Amanya.   Amanya yatiddwa ku lw’okubiri era omulambo ggwe n’egusuulibwa okuliraana ekkolero ly’amajani erya Highland tea factory mu muluka gw’e Kitumba.  Ono yasembayo okulabwa ku Bbalaza bweyali ava ku mirimu gye.  Ng’ebikumi n’ebikumi by’abantu bikungaanidde ku kisaawe ky’essomero lya Emmaus Bile mu divizoni ya Bugongi, ab’ebyokwerinda nga bakulembeddwamu Darius Nadinda, omubaka wa pulezidenti e Kabale ne Patrick Besigye Keihwa, ssentebe wa disitulikit y’e Kabale balumbye ekifo kino nebabuuza lwaki abantu baabadde bajeemedde ekiragiro kya pulezidenti eyaweze enkungaana nga n’okuziika mw’okutwalidde.  Bano baabadde bakulembeddwamu omusumba wa balokole Johnson Bakashaba, akulira ekkanisa ya Revival Outreach Ministries.  Ono olwalabye ab’ebyokwerinda n’amalamu omusulo.  Bano era beewunyizza nti poliisi y’ekitundu yabadde ewadde abantu bano obukuumi.  Omusirikale Kenneth Asiimwe, eyasangiddwa mu kifo kino yagambye nti mukama waabwe Dan Byaruhanga, amyuka atwala poliisi y’e Kigezi Region yeyabadde abasindise.

headline: Omumyuka Wa Pulezidenti Wa South Sudan Ne Mukyalawe Coronavirus Abayodde
text: Dr Riek Machar Teny omukyuka wa pulezidenti asooka owa South Sudan wamu ne mukyalawe era minisita avunaanyizibwa ku by’okwerinda, Angelina Teny bakebereddwa nebasangibwamu ekirwadde kya coronavirus. Bano sibeebokka ku bakulembeze ba South Sudan abamaze okuyoolebwa. Baminisita abalala musanvu okuli ow’ensonga za kabineeti Martin Eria Lomuro, ow’ebyobulamu Elizabeth Acuei Yol, ow’ensonga z’omunda muggwanga Paul Mayom Akec, ow’ensonga z’obutebenkevu bw’eggwanga Obote Mamur Mete, ow’ebyensimbi Salvatore Garang Mabiordit, wamu n’oweby’obusuubuzi Kuol Athian nabo bayooleddwa nawookeera. Bonna bonna babadde ku kakiiko akaateekebwawo okulwanyisa ekirwadde kino. South Sudan yemu ku mawanga agaasembayo okuzuulibwamu obulwadde bwa coronavirus kyokka nga wetwogerera bino, abalwadde banaatera okutuuka mu 500.

headline: Busiro North:  Ab’omubaka  Nsubuga bawakanyizza obujulizi obuleeteddwa ku kujingirira empapula
text: Bannamateeka abakiikirira omubaka wa Busiro North bawakkanyizza eky’oludda oluwaabi okuleeta obujulizi obupya obulumirizza omuntu waabwe okujingirira ebiwandiiko bye yasinziirako okwesimbawo. Edgar Lubadde eyasemba mu kalulu nga yafuna obululu 199 bwokka yaddukira mu kkooti ng’agamba nti Nsubuga teyalina buyigirize bumusobozesa kubeera mubaka wa Palamenti mu kalulu akakubwa nga January 14. Leero ku Mmande, wakati ng’omusango guno guwulirwa, bannamateeka ba Lubadde nga bakulembeddwa Ezra Nyalwa ne Christopher Kajwar, bataddeyo okusaba mu kkooti nga baagala okuleeta obujulizi obupya omuli ne alipoota ya poliisi ekakasa nti Nsubuga yajingirira ebiwandiiko kwe baamuwandiisiza. Okusinziira ku alipoota ya poliisi, omubaka wa Busiro North eyalondebwa ye Peter Mukalazi era yakozesa mpapula za Nsubuga Paul okwewandiisa. “Twazudde mu biwandiiko bya Eklezia nti Nsubuga Paul omutuufu, mutabani waJoseph Musoke ne Specioza Lunkuse, abatuuze b’e Kakooge mu disitulikiti y’e Wakiso era yazaalibwa January,19, 1985 n’abatizibwa mu Klezia yeemu nga October, 1, 1986.” Alipoota ya poliisi bw’esomye. Obujulizi buno era bwalaze nti Nsubuga yajingirira emikono gy’abantu abaamusemba nga yeesimbawo okubeera omubaka wa Busiro North mu kalulu akaawedde. “Omukugu mu by’empandiika yakizudde nti Nsubuga yajingirira emikono gy’abantu abaamusemba. Emikono egiri ku mannya agaamusemba gifaanaganamu, ekikakasa nti mijingirire.” Munnamateeka Christopher Kajwarabw’ategeezezza kkooti. Wabula kino bannamateeka ba Nsubuga nga bakulembeddwa Chrysostom Katumba bakiwakanyizza obujulizi obupya kuba bwabadde buleetawo ensonga empya mu musango guno ezitakkiriganyizibwako. “Obujulizi obuggya buleetawo ensonga empya ey’okujingirira ebiwandiiko okwewandiisizibwa era kireetawo ensonga endala eya poliisi okunoonyereza ku biwandiiko ebyajingirirwa era bino tubiwakanya.” Katumba bw’annyonnyodde kkooti. Katumba agamba nti omusango ogwawaabwa gwa Nsubuga butabeera nabuyigirize obulagirwa kyokka ate obujulizi obuleeteddwa bwa kujingirira mpapula za buyigirize, ekintu kye batasobola kukkiriza. Ono agasseeko nti obujulizi buno bwalina okuleetebwa nga April 19,2021 so si kati. Ku nsonga eno n’akakiiko k’ebyokulonda nga nako baakawaabira kawakanyizza obujulizi obupya nga kagamba nti obudde bwaggwaako dda. Wabula bannamateeka ba Lubadde bagamba nti tewali kipya kye baleese kuba ensonga zino zaayogerwako mu musango ng’ekipya kyokka ekirimu y’ebbaluwa ya poliisi ekakasa nti waaliwo okujingirira ebiwandiiko. Omulamuzi ali mu mitambo gy’omusango guno, Winfred Nabisinde agwongezzaayo okutuuka ngaOctober 26 lw’anaawa ensala ye ku nsonga eno.

headline: Salim Uhuru yawonyewo, ebirala NUP ebitutte
text: Kampala Munnakibiina kya National Resisitance Movement, Salim Uhuru, yeyasobodde okuwangulira ekibiina kye ekifo ky’obwammeeya wakati nga omuyaga gwa National Unity Platform (NUP) gugenda mu maaso nokukunta mubitundu by’eggwanga eby’enjawulo. Salim Uhuru eyawangudde Mu kalulu akakubiddwa ku Mmande, Uhuru yeyawangudde obwammeeya bwa Kampala Central ate divizoni endala nezitwalibwa aba NUP. Ebifo 56 ebilonderwamu byebyalonze abakulembeze ba Munisipaali ne divizoni omuli bammeeya ne bakkansala. E Kampala Salim Uhuru owa NRM yafunye obululu 13114 nawangula owa NUP Hamudan Kigozi Ssemugoma eyakungaanyiza obululu 10654. Charles Sserunjogi owa DP yakutte kyakusatu n’obululu 5318. Bweyabadde ayogerako ne bannamawulire oluvannyuma lw’obuwanguzi buno, Uhuru yagambye nti buno buwanguzi bwamaanyi eri ekibiina kya NRM naddala mukaseera kano nga kumpi ebifo ku mitendera gyonna bitwaliddwa aba NUP. “Kino kirabo eri ekibiina kya NRM, nze nga Uhuru ngenda kukolera wamu n’abantu bonna awatali kusosola ngatte ettofaali ku nkulaakulana y’ekibuga Kampala,” Uhuru bwe yasuubizza. Mu divizoni za Kampala endala esatu aba NUP baziwangudde. Mu divizoni ye Lubaga, Munnakibiina kya FDC Owek. Joyce Nabbosa Ssebugwawo yawanguddwa Zacchy Mberaze Mawula, ate e Makindye Ali Mulyanyama owa NUP neyeddiza entebe y’obwammeeya. E Nakawa munnakibiina kya NUP Paul Mugambe yawangudde Bruhan Byaruhanga owa NRM ku bululu 32754 bwetyo NUP netwala ebifo ebyasinze.

headline: Ssennyiga Corona : Ekitebe kya poliisi e Naguru kiggaddwa
text: Kampala Ekitebe kya poliisi mu ggwanga ne ‘ National Security Command Centre’ e Naguru biggaddwa olw’ekirwadde ki COVID-19. Ekitebe kya Poliisi e Naguru ekiggaddwa olwa COVID-19 Omwogezi wa Poliisi mu Ggwanga Fred Ennanga, yategeezezza nti wofiisi zino zonna ziggadwa olw’okweyongera kw’ekirwadde ki COVID-19 mu Kampala n’emirilaano nga n’omuwendo gw’ abaakafa gweyongedde. “Ekitebe tukiggaddewo okumala ennaku ssatu. Tukikoze okusobozesa okufuuyira ekifo kino, okusala ku muwendo gw’abantu wamu n’okukebera abakozi bonna,” Ennanga bweyagambye. Ennanga yanyonyodde nga kaweefube ono bwatandise ku Mmande era nti bakukebera abapoliisi bonna ku kitebe n’abakugu abakola ku kkamera za CCTV. Ku ky’okukebera abapoliisi bonna mu Ggwanga, Enanga yagambye nti bakolaganira wamu ne Minisitule y’ebyobulamu okugenda maaso n’okukebera abamu ku bapoliiisi bano. Ennanga yakakasizza nga abapoliisi abasinga naddala abakolera mu kitundu kya Kampala n’emirilaano wamu naabo abali e Isingiro, Jinja ne Masindi. Kitegeerekese nti waliwo enteekateeka y’okufuuyira poliisi zonna 1600 eziri mu Ggwanga n’eddagala eritta akawuka . Kino Ennanga agamba nti bakyakyetegereza kubanga kyetaaga ssente nnyingi.

headline: Ssaabasajja Kabaka ayozaayozezza Ssaabasumba Ssemogerere
text: Ssaabasajja Kabaka Ronald Muwenda Mutebi II ayozaayozezza musajja we, Paul Ssemogerere olw’okutuuzibwa nga Ssaabasumba bw’essaza ekkulu ery’e Kampala. Obubaka buno Beene abutisse Omulangira David Kintu Wasajja abusomeddeSsaabasumba n’abakkiriza mu Lutikko e Lubaga leero ku Lwokubiri. “Ssaabasumba Paul Ssemogerere e Lubaga, tukulamusizza n’essanyu ku mukolo ogwekitiibwa ogw’okutuuzibwako nga Ssaabasumba w’essaza ekkulu ery’e Kampala. Tukuyozaayoza nnyo nnyini okulondebwa ku bukulu obwo. Twebaza Omukama eyakuwa ebitone ebyenjawulo omuli obwetoowaze, obukozi n’obumalirivu obwakusobozesa okubeera munnaddiini omulungi. Mu ngeri yeemu twebaza, bazadde bo abagenzi omuli Aipiyo Mivule ne Angelina Namutebi abaakukuza obulungi n’okugunjula. Tukimanyi bulungi nti amaka amalungi n’entendeka ennungi mwe muva obukulembeze obulungi. Ng’otandika omulimu omunene ogw’okulembera essaza ekkulu nga Ssaabasumba, tujja kwongera okukusabira, tetulina kubuusabuusa nti ojja kutuukiriza bulungi obutume olw’amaanyi g’Omukama n’ekisinde ekyateekebwateekebwa bassabasumaba abaakusooka. Tusaba Mukama akwongere omukisa gwe bulijjo.” Obubaka bwa Kabaka bwe busomye. Ate Ku lwa Gavumenti ya Ssaabasajja Kabaka, Katikkiro Charles Peter Mayiga ategeezezza nti enkolagana Buganda gy’ebabadde ne Ssaabasumba w’abeeredde mu Busumba bwa Kasana- Luweero, yaakugenda mu maaso. Asabye Obwakabaka okunyweza enkolagana ne Ekereziya, kiyambe okutumbula ebyenjigiriza, okutumbula ebyobulamu, obulimi n’obulunzi, okufunira abavubuka emirimu awamu n’okuzza obuntubulamu mu bantu, kiyambe okuzza Buganda ku ntikko kuba singa bakwatira wamu zijja kutuukirira. “Ssebo Ssaabasumba nkusuubiza okukwasizaako mu ngeri Mukama gy’anaaba atusobozesezza ng’okola omulimu guno ye yennyini Katonda gw’akugwanyizza.” Okusinziira ku Katikkiro Mayiga, enteekateeka zonna ez’okuzza Buganda ku ntikko, Ssaabasumba Ssemogerere azimanyi bulungi era balina esuubi nti baakuzitwala mu maaso nga batambulira wamu naye embeera y’abantu ba Kabaka esobole okukyuka. Katikkiro Mayiga era yeeyamye okwongera okusabira Ssaabasumba omuggya, Omukama amuwe omukisa era amukulembere mu bukulembeze bwe buno.

headline: Akakiiko k’eddembe ly’obuntu kalabudde abeesimbyewo ku Corona
text: Akakiiko akalwanirira eddembe ly’obuntu mu ggwanga aka Uganda Human Rights Commission- UHRC, kalabudde abeesimbyewo okukomya okujeemera ebiragiro bya Ssennyiga Corona. Ssentebe w’akakiiko Katebalirwe Amooti Wa Irumba Akola nga ssentebe w’akakiiko kano mu kiseera kino, Katebalirwe Amooti Wa Irumba agamba nti obuvuyo n’obukuubagano bw’abakuumaddembe n’abeesimbyewo kiva ku bannabyabufuzi kujeemera biragiro bya Ssennyiga Corona. “Tubeegayiridde mugoberere ebiragiro bya minisitule y’ebyobulamu n’akakiiko k’ebyokulonda, tukendeeze ku bizibu bye tulina. Kivudde ku kujeemera biragiro bino kye kitabudde embeera ng’abamu ku bannabyabufuzi boogera lwatu nti tebagenda kugondera biragiro bya Ssennyiga Corona.” Katebalirwe bw’agambye. Okusinziira ku biragiro by’akakiiko k’ebyokulonda, abeesimbyewo n’abawagizi baabwe balina okwambala Masiki, okwewa amabanga era nga tebalina kukuba nkung’aana zisussa bantu 200. Akakiiko k’ebyokulonda era kaawera okuyisa ebivvulu mu kaweefube w’okugezaako okutangira ekirwadde kya Ssennyiga Corona okusaasaana. Kinajjukirwa nti omwezi oguwedde akwatidde ekibiina kya National Unity Platfor, Robert Kyagulanyi, yakwatibwa e Luuka bwe yali anoonya akalulu olw’okujeemera ebiragiro bya Ssennyiga Corona. Abalala abaakwatibwa poliisi olw’okujeemera ebiragiro bya Ssennyiga Corona kuliko n’alina kkaadi ya FDC, Patrick Oboi Amuriat. Katebalirwe agamba nti kampeyini bwe ziba zaakutambula bulungi, bannabyabufuzi balina okugondera ebiragiro bino, kikendeeze ku kutyoboola eddembe ly’obuntu. Ono asabye bannabyabufuzi okumanya nti ekirwadde kya Ssennyiga Corona kikyaliyo era bakole buli kimu okutaasa abawagizi baabwe. Katebalirwe akoowodde abakuumaddembe nabo okukomya okukozesa amaanyi agasukkiridde nga bagumbulula abantu. Ate ye Omukungu w’ekitongole kino, Aida Nakiganda, ategeezezza nti baakafuna emisango 15 egyemulugunya ku kutyoboola eddembe lyabwe okuva mu kwekalakaasa okwaliwo omwezi oguwedde era nga 13 ku gino gibatwaliddwa ab’enganda z’abagenzi abattibwa mu kwekalakaasa. Emirala gikwata ku bantu abaakwatiddwa ab’ebyokwerinda ne babalemesa ab’enganda zaabwe okubalabako n’okwogera nabo.

headline: Gavumenti etondewo emirimu okutaasa obutonde –  Owek. Nkalubo
text: Minisita w’ebyettaka n’obutonde bw’ensi mu Buganda, Owek. Hajjati MariamNkalubo Mayanja asabye gavumenti emalewo ekizibu ky’ebbula ly’emirimu kiyambeko okukendeeza ku misinde abantu gye basaanyizaawo obutonde nga beekwasa obwavu. Okusaba kunoOwek. Nkalubo akukoledde mu nsisinkano gy’abaddemu n’ekitongole ky’ebibira ne Minisitule y’amazzi mu Gavumenti eyaawakati nga babadde ku mbuga enkulu e Bulange -Mmengo nga bateesa ku nnongoosereza ezigenda okukolebwa mu tteeka ly’ebibira erya 2001 (Uganda Forest Policy 2001). Kinajjukirwa nti mu mwaka oguwedde Gavumenti ya Kabaka yatta omukago ne Minisitule y’amazzi n’obutonde mu gavumenti eyaawakati okulaba engeri gye basobola okutaasaamu obutonde. Owek.Nkaluboeraasabye Gavumenti okwongera okumyumyula ku mateekaku kutyoboola obutonde bw’ensiky’agambye ntimpagi n nenemu lutalo lw’okukuuma obutondeeggwanga ligende mu maaso. Ate Minisita omubeezi ow’ebyobulimi, Owek. Martin Kaseekende asabye Gavumenti ekulembeze abakulembeze b’ennono n’obuwangwakubanga bano bawulirwa nnyo abantu baabwe. Amyuka Kamisonamu Minisitule y’amazzi n’obutonde bw’ensi, Isa Katwesige agamba nti kino kye kiseera okukola ennongosereza essibwemu obuwaayiro obw’okutaasa obutonde okusinziira ku nsi nga bw’etambula . Katwesige ategeezeza ntikaweefubew’okutaasa obutonde baakumutandika na kusimba miti n’okubangula bannayuganda ku bukulu bwabwo. Ensisinkano eno yeetabiddwamu ababaka mu Lukiiko lwa Buganda, bammeeya mu bitundu ebyenjawulo, abaami b’eggombolola ez’enjawulon’abakungu abalala.

headline: Dan Magic n’omupoliisi wa Kyagulanyi babakubyemu ttiyaggaasi, bali bubi
text: Kayunga Abantu abawerako bafunye ebisago ebyamaanyi oluvannyuma lwa poliisi okukuba amasasi ne ttiyaggaasi ng’egezaako okugumbulula abawagizi ba Munnakibiina kya NUP, Robert Kyagulanyi Ssentamu, ababadde bazze okumuwubirako. Kyagulanyi nga ayamba ku Dan Magic okufuna obujjanjabi Kyagulanyi ategeezezza nti abantu abakubiddwa tebalina kikyamu kye bakoze naye yeewuunya lwaki poliisi egenda mu maaso n’okukozesa obukambwe obususse ku bantu abatalina bulabe. “Mukwano gwange Dan Magic bamukubye mu ffeesi! Omupoliisi ASP Kato gwe bampa naye akubiddwa bubi nnyo, bangi ku bannaffe bafunye ebisago. Musabire eggwanga lyaffe naye kino tujja kuyitamu.” Kyagulanyi bw’ategeezezza.
