Uwurongoye urwego CNC, Madame Vestine  Nahimana, yabimenyesheje mu kiganiro n'abamenyeshamakuru inyuma y'inama y'abagize urwo rwego. BBC yari imaze neza na neza imyaka itatu yafatiwe ingingo yo guhagarikwa mu Burundi. Ingingo yari yafashwe itariki 29 ukwezi kwa gatatu mu 2019. Madame Nahimana yavuze ko mu rwego CNC baronse ikete rya BBC isaba gusubira gukorera mu Burundi  baca basanga "nta kindi gisigaye atari ukuyakira kugira ngo isubire gushira ahabona ibiganiro vyayo". CNC yari yatse BBC uruhusha rwo gukorera mu Burundi iyagiriza kurenga amategeko agenga umwuga  wo kumenyesha amakuru muri ico gihugu  hamwe n'inyafato itajanye n'umwuga. Nta biganiro yari irekuriwe gushikiriza mu Burundi, nta n'umunyamakuru yari yemerewe kuyikorera canke kuyiha inkuru mu buryo ubwaribwo bwose muri ico gihugu kuva ico gihe. BBC yari yatswe uruhusha rwo gukorera mu Burundi yagirizwa  gutosekaza izina rya reta yari irongowe ico gihe na prezida Pierre Nkurunziza. Na cane cane inyanduruko yavuye ku matohoza ku vyavugwa ko ari ibibanza abantu bapfungirwamwo mu kinyegero  kandi bakaborezwamwo igufa mu ntumbero yo gucecekesha abatavuga rumwe na reta, ivyo reta yiyamirije nk'"inkuru z'ibinyoma". Ico gihe BBC yumvirizwa n'abantu bangana na miriyoni 1.3 mu Burundi. Hemerewe ibinyamakuru bishasha vyinshi Ibinyamakuru bitari bike birimwo n'Ijwi rya Amerika (VOA),  Iwacu, radiyo Bonesha FM, Ikiriho n'ibindi vyarafatiwe ibihano mu bihe n'imvo bitandukanye vy'inyuma y'intureka za poritike zo mu 2015. Ivyo bihano vyari vyiyamirijwe n'amashirahamwe haranira uburenganzira bwa zina muntu nka Amnesty International yavuze ko vyari ingingo "zeruye z'abategetsi b'Uburundi mu gucecekesha ibimenyeshamakuru". Kuva presida Evariste Ndaishimiye ashitse ku butegetsi inyuma y'amatora yo mu 2020,  imwe mu ntumbero yashize imbere n'ukunagura imigendeneranire myiza n'ibihugu canke amashirahamwe atarabana ryiza na reta y'Uburundi kuva mu 2015. Reta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n'ishirahamwe rya  Buraya biherutse gufuta ingingo z'ibihano  vyari vyarafatiye Uburundi. Bimwe bimwe nka Iwacu, Ikiriho na Bonesha FM  haheze igihe vyarahawe uruhusha rwo gusubira gukora. Madame Nahimana yavuze ko CNC yumviye akamo k'umukuru w'igihugu yasavye urwo rwego kuvugana n'ibinyamakuru vyari vyarafatiwe ibihano kugirango bisubire guhabwa impusha zo gukora. Muri iyo nama yemereye BBC gusubira gukorera mu Burundi, CNC yemereye kandi ama radiyo n'ama television mashasha: Dosiye y'iyindi radiyo, Radio Voix de Developpement Communautaire de Bubanza yasubijwe inyuma  kugira ije guhinyanyura ivyo  CNC yayisavye. Atangaza ko BBC yemerewe gusubira gukorera mu Burundi, umukuru wa CNC yagize ati:  "Twizeye ko tugiye kubandanya dukorana n'iyo radiyo mu ntumbero yo kubandanya twubahiriza umwuga w'abamenyeshamakuru n'ibimenyeshamakuru."

headline: Coronavirus - Burundi: Leta imenyesha ko hari abandi 20 banduye
text: Ubushikiranganji bw'amagara y'abantu n'ukurwanya SIDA mu Burundi bumenyesha ko hari abantu 20 babonywe ko banduye umugera coronavirus. Mw'itangazo bwaraye busohoye, ubwo bushikiranganji bumenyesha ko abo 20 bari mu bantu 98 bapimwe uwo mugera kuva ku wa 01 gushika ku wa 04 z'uku kwa gatandatu. Ibi biharuro bishasha bitangajwe inyuma y'aho ishirahamwe OLUCOME rimenyeshereje amakenga yaryo ku bijanye n'amakuru ashikirizwa na leta y'u Burundi kuri mugera uriko urakora ibara kw'isi yose. Nk'uko vyama, ubushikiranganji bw'amagara y'abantu ntibutanga umwidondoro w'abo bantu bashasha banduye iyi ndwara ya Covid-19. Iryo tangazo rimenyesha ko mu bari basanzwe bakirwaye iyo ndwara bashika 29, 12 muri bo bapimwe bagasanga barakize, kandi ko baronkejwe uruhusha rwo gusubira mu miryango yabo. Gushika ubu, ibiharuro vyerekana ko abantu 83 aribo bamaze kwandura uwo mugera; muri abo 45 bakaba bamaze gukira, nayo 37 bakaba ari bo bakirwaye, umwe akaba yaritavye Imana. Gushika ubu, nta ngingo zirafatwa na leta y'u Burundi mu ntumbero yo kuzibira ikwirakwira ry'uwo mugera nk'uko vyagenze mu bindi bihugu vyo mu karere. Hari bamwe babona ko amakuru atangwa na leta ku vyerekeye iyo ndwara yoba atajanye n'ukuri ku kungene yifashe mu gihugu. Ishirahamwe ryigenga OLUCOME ryiyemeje kurwanya igiturire n'isesagurwa ry'ubutunzi bwa leta, riherutse gusohora itangazo aho rinegura leta ko ititayeho uko bikwiye ikiza ca Covid-19. Olucome yibaza ko amakuru atangazwa ashobora kuba ari kure y'ukuri kw'ivyo Abarundi bibaza, ikanasaba leta y'u Burundi kureka kwizimagiza imbere y'iki kiza kiriko kiriha inkumbi kw'isi. Mu minsi iheze hari amakuru yakwiriye ku mbuga ntangamakuru ko hari bamwe mu bategetsi muri leta y'u Burundi boba baranduye iyi ndwara, ibihakanwa n'umuvugizi wa leta. Ayo makuru akaba yakwiragiye inyuma y'aho umutambukanyi w'umukuru w'igihugu, Denise Nkurunziza agiriye muri Kenya kuvurwa indwara itaramenyekana gushika ubu. Vyaravuzwe cane ko yagiye i Nairobi kwivuza uwu mugera, ariko ayo makuru akaba yarahakanywe n'umwe mu bakozi bo mu biro vy'umukuru w'igihugu BBC yabajije ariko atashatse ko izina ryiwe rimenyekana . Umugera wa coronavirus watanguye kumenyekana mu mpera z'umwaka uheze mu gisagara ca Wuhan mu Bushinwa, ubu ukaba ubarizwa kw'isi yose. Ku wa 31 z'ukwezi kwa gatatu niho leta y'u Burundi yatangaza umuntu wa mbere yanduye uwo mugera.

headline: US: Imigumiko inyuma y'aho umuporisi yiciye umwirabure Daunte Wright hafi ya Minneapolis
text: Igiporisi cakoresheje ivyuka bikoroza amosozi gihagarika uruja n'uruza mw'ijoro kugira gicureshe  imigumuko yadutse inyuma y'aho umuporisi arasiye umwirabure mu gisagara ca Brooklyn Center, hafi ya Minneapolis muri Reta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Umuryango w'uyu musore yagandaguwe uvuga ko azwi kw'izina rya Daunte Wright, akaba afise imyaka 20. Umukuru w'igisagara ca Brooklyn Center yaciye afata ingingo yo kubuza uruja n'uruza mu gisagara cose mu masaha y'ijoro gushika isaha cumi na zibiri z'agatondo mu masaha yo muri ako karere, asaba abanyagihugu "gutaha muhira ku mutekano wabo". Hari icuka kibi cane muri Minneapolis mu gihe urubanza rw'uwahoze ari umupolisi yagirizwa kwica George Floyd rubandanya. Buramatari wa Minnesota, Tim Walz avuga ko ariko arakurikiranira hafi ingene ibintu bimeze, yongera asengera umuryango wa Wright. Ejo ku wa Mungu, abantu baharurwa mu majana bagenda baririmba izina rya  Daunte Wright baciye biyegeranya hanze y'ibiro vy'igiporisi mu gisagara ca Brooklyn Center, ku birometero bike uvuye hagati mu gisagara ca Minneapolis uja mu buraruko. Icuka kibi cadutse igihe igiporisi cashirako umwambaro wo mu gihe co kurwanya imigumuko n'igihe  imodoka zibiri zashika zigaca ziterwa amabuye, nk'uko bivugwa n'itororokanirizo ry'amakuru Reuters. Abari muri iyo myiyerekano banditse ivyandiko hasi n'ingwa bongera batsa n'amabuji, ariko igiporisi mu nyuma kikaba cabategetse kuvaho, ireresi ikerekana abo baporisi bariko batera vya vyuka bikoroza amosozi  n'ama grenades yo gushwiragiza abari mu myiyerekano. Ibinyamakuru bikorera muri ako karere bivuga ko habaye n'ibikorwa vyo gusahura mu turere tutari duke, Mike Elliott arongoye igisagara ca Brooklyn Center agaca atangaza ingingo yo kubuza uruja n'uruza aciye ku rubuga rwa Twitter. Yanditse ati: "Dushaka ko umutekano w'abantu bose wubahirizwa. Ndasavye ko mwese muba mu mutekano kandi ndasavye ko mutaha muhira". Bamwe mu basirikare b'igihugu ba (Minnesota National Guard) bari basanzwe bararungitswe gucungera urubanza rwa Derek Chauvin yagirizwa urupfu rwa George Floyd, barungitswe mu gisagara ca Brooklyn Center. Brooklyn Center yugaye inyubakwa z'amashure yose ihagarika n'ivyigwa hamwe n'ibindi bikorwa kuri ayo mashure kuri uno wa mbere, nk'uko bivugwa n'ibinyamakuru bikorera muri ako karere. None ni ibiki vyashikiye Daunte Wright neza na neza? Mw'itangazo casohoye, igiporisi ca Brooklyn Center kivuga ko cahagaritse umugabo yari yarenze amategeko y'ibarabara ku muhingamo w'ejo ku wa Mungu, kandi ko yari asanzwe afise umutahe wo kumuhagarika. Igiporisi kivuga ko abaporisi bagerageje kumuhagarika yaciye asibimra mu modoka. Niho umwe mu baporisi yaca amurasa, ariko abandanya anyonga imodokari yiwe agenda aca ku zindi, imbere y'uko ayita ku yindi modoka. Mu nyuma niho yatangazwa ko yapfuye. Umugore yari muri iyo modoka yakomeretse buke buke. Igiporisi kivuga ko abo baporisi bari bambaye bafise camera  zabo kandi ko na kamera y'imodoka nayo nyene yariko irakora. Nyina wiwe Katie avuga kpo umuhungu wiwe yamuhagamaye igihe imodoka yiwe yahagarikwa akamubwira ko yahagaritswe kubera "ibimotesho vyari kuri retroviseur". Avuga ko mu nyuma yumvise uruhagarara terefone ica iracika. "Haciye umunota, nahamagaye hanyuma umukunzi wiwe bari kumwe muri iyo modoka aca avuga ko yarashwe....umuhungu wanje yari aryamye hasi yapfuye". Avuga ko abo baporisi basize ikiziga c'umuhungu wiwe kiryamye hasi, yongerako ati: "Nta n'umwe azotubwira na kimwe. Nta n'umwe azotuvugisha...navuze nti ndabasavye mukure ikiziga c'umuhungu wanje hasi". Umukuru w'igisagara Elliott yavuze ko ivyabaye ari "agahomerabunwa", buramatari  Walz  nawe ati : "Reta yacu iragandariye uwundi  mwirabure yishwe n'abajejwe kwubahiriza umutekano". Igisagara ca Minneapolis gisanzwe kirangwamwo icuka kibi inyuma y'urupfu rwa wa mwirabure George Floyd rwatumye haduka imyiyerekano mu gihugu,, ahanini yakozwe mu mahoro n'aho hari ahandi yabayemwo imigumuko, inyubakwa zimwe zimwe zirononekara.

headline: USA itangaza ko abasirikare bayo 34 bagize ibibazo vyo mu bwonko mu gitero ca Irani
text: Ubunyamabanga bwo kwivuna abansi bwa Amerika, Pentagone, bumenyesha ko abasirikare 34 b'ico gihugu bagize ibibazo vyo mu bwonko (TBI)  bivuye kuri ca gitero ca Irani ku kirindiro cazo muri Irak. Umuvugizi w'ubwo bunyamabanga avuga ko gushika ubu, abashika 17 aribo bakiriko baravurwa. Perezida Donald Trump wa Amerika yari yatangaje ko ata musirikare wa Amerika n'umwe yigeze agira ingorane muri ico gitero ca Irani co ku wa 08 z'uku kwa mbere, mu kwihora igandagurwa ry'umusirikare mukuru wa Irani. Bwana Trump akaba yavuze ivyo ashaka gusigura ingingo yafashe yo kudasubiza ico gitero. Hagati aho mu ndwi iheze, Pentagon yari yamenyesheje ko abasirikare 11 bariko bavurwa kubera ibibazo vyo mu mutwe bagize bivuye kuri ico gitero. Abajijwe uko kuvuguruzanya mu gihe yari mu nama yerekeye ubutunzi kw'isi mu Buswisi, Bwana Trump yishuye ati: "Narumvise ko hari abari bamenetse umutwe, n'ibintu ataco bivuze, ariko mvuga nti, kandi ndavyemeza, si ibintu bikomeye". "Si mfata ko ari ububabare bukomeye nk'ubwo nabonye". Pentagone ivuga ko ata musirikare n'umwe yapfuye muri ico gitero ca Irani c'igisasu ca misire ku kirindiro ca Ain al-Asad, kuko hafi bose bari mu buraro bwo mu kuzimu igihe ivyo bisasu vyaterwa. Ejo ku wa gatanu, umuvugizi w'ubunyamabanga bujejwe kwivuna abansi, Jonathan Hoffman, yabwiye abamenyeshamakuru ko abasirikare umunani mu bagize ibibazo batahukanywe muri Amerika kugira ngo babandanye bavurwa, mu gihe abandi icenda nabo batwawe mu Budagi. 16 bavuriwe muri Irak uwundi umwe nawe muri Koweit imbere y'uko abo bose 17 basubira ku bikorwa vyabo, k'uko abategetsi babivuga. Bwana Hoffman avuga ko umunyamabanga ajejwe kwivuna abansi, Mark Esper atashotse aronka amakuru y'uko hoba hari abasirikare bari bagize ibibazo mu minsi yakurikiye ico gitero. Ishirahamwe ry'abakukuruke bahoze barwana mu ntambara za Irak na Afghanistani, riranegura ubutegetsi bwa Trump kubona butashotse bumenyesha ko hari abasirikare bagize ibibazo. Paul Rieckhoff, uwatanguje iryo shirahamwe avuga ati: "ico ni ikintu gikomeye. Leta ya Amerika yategerezwa guha Abanyamerika amakuru ku vyerekeye ubuzima bw'abana babo. Nta kindi kintu gisumba ico". Igisirikare ca Amerika kimenyesha ko izo ngorane zikunda gushika mu burere bw'intambara. Ejo ku wa gatanu, abanyagihugu ba Irak ibihumbi n'ibihumbi barihaye amabarabara ku mugwa mukuru Baghdad biyamiriza abasirikare mvamakungu baharurwa mu 5000. Inama nshingamateka ya Irak iherutse gusaba abarwanyi mvamakungu bose - harimwo n'abanyamerika - kuva muri ico gihugu.

headline: Imvo n'imvano ku mishamirano hagati ya Russia na Ukraine
text: Mu kiganiro c’uyu musi, tuganira ku nkuru imaze iminsi ivugwa kw'isi y'igihugu ca Ukraine aho amakuru avuga ko gishobora guterwa umwanya uwo ari wo wose n’igihugu kibanyi c’Uburusiya. Ukraine cahoze ari kimwe mu bihugu bigize Reta Zunze Ubumwe z’ Abasoviete (URSS/USSR) imbere y’uko ivyo bihugu vyiyonkora mu 1991 bica birikukira. Intara ya Crimée/Crimea ibamwo abarusiya benshi yaciye yegukira Ukraine, ariko umugwa mukuru wayo, Sebastopol, ugumamwo ibirindiro vya gisirikare vy’Uburusiya. Mu 2014, Uburusiya bwarigaruriye iyo ntara bukoresheje inguvu, bugirako buratangaza ko ibaye iyabwo bwite, inyuma y’imyiyerekano yatumye prezida yari yatowe Viktor Ianoukovich, yagirizwa kuba mu kwaha k’Uburusiya, ata agahungira muri ico ihugu. Ivyo bihugu vyagumye birabana ribi, ibintu bikaba vyagiye kwunyuka aho Ukraine isabiye kwinjira mw’ishirahamwe ryo kugwaniriza umwansi hamwe ry’abanyaburaya, OTAN/NATO, ivyo Uburusiya buterekwa na gato. Inyuma y’amatora yo 2019 muri Ukraine yashikanye ku butegetsi prezida Volodymyr Zelensky, hari icizere ko hashobora kuba agahengwe, mbere n’umukuru w’Uburusiya Vladimir Putin aravuga ko yiteguye gusubira kugirana imigenderanire myiza n’ico gihugu. Ibintu vyasubiye kuba ndanse mu mpera z’umwaka uheze, aho Uburusiya bwarunze ingabo zirenga 100.000 ku rubibe bihana na Ukraine. Ukraine na yo yaciye ihamagaza igitigiri nk’ico c’abasirikare bama bagavye mu kwitegurira ibitero vy’Uburusiya bishobora kuba umwanya uwo ari wo wose. Ku ruhande rumwe hari Uburusiya, ku rundi ruhande Ukraine n’ibihugu vya Buraya hamwe na Amerika bihurikiye mw’ishirahamwe Otan, ubu biguma bishigikira mu majambo no mu bikoresho vya gisirikare biguma birungika muri Ukraine no mu bihugu vy’incuti vyegereye Uburusiya. Hagiye haba ibiganiro bihuza impande zose ariko gushika ubu nta co birashikako. Uburusiya buguma buhakana ko ata mu gambi bufise wo gutera Ukraine, ariko ibihugu vyo bishigikiye Ukraine bivuga ko ari umwanya n’umwanya ibitero bigatangura, mbere bimwe bimwe bikaba bimaze gutahukana ababiserukira bahora muri ico gihugu, bikanasaba abanyagihugu bavyo kuva muri Ukraine. Inyuma y’imyimenyerezo Uburusiya bwari bumazemwo imisi ku rubibe buhana na Ukraine, inkuru zivuga ko zimwe mu ngabo zabwo zitanguye kuva muri ako karere mugabo umukuru wa Ukraine n'ishirahamwe rya OTAN bakavuga ko Ata bimenyetso bifatika barabona vyemeza ko izo ngabo z'Uburusiya zatanguye kuvayo. None mu vyo ukuri Uburusiya na Ukraine bipfa iki? Uburaya na Amerika bufise izihe nyungu murI Ukraine? Kubera iki Uburusiya butipfuza ko Ukraine ija muri Otan? Mu gihe iyo ntambara yokwaduka, yogira izihe nkurikizi mu karere ivyo bihugu birimwo no hirya no hirya no hino kw’isi, dore ko hari n'abamaze kuvuga ko yaba intambara ya gatatu y'isi ? Ivyo ni bimwe mu bibazo tugiye guca hirya no hino muri kino kiganiro c’imvo n’imvano mwateguriwe na Cyriaque Muhawenayo.

headline: Ethiopia: Inyeshamba za Tigray ziti 'emera ubutegetsi bwacu canke tubandanya intambara'
text: Inyeshamba z'intara ya Tigray muri Ethiopia zivuga ko ubutegetsi bwazo butegerezwa kubanza kwemerwa imbere y'uko zemera guhagarika intambara. Mu bindi vyinshi zisaba, zivuga kandi ko ingabo za Eritrea zitegerezwa kubanza kuva mu gihugu. Ubutegetsi bwa Addis Abeba buherutse gutangaza ko buhagaritse intambara ku ruhande rwabwo, inyuma y'aho izi nyeshamba zifatiye igice kinini c'iyi ntara, ingabo z'igihugu nazo zikayanyaga. Iyi ntambara imaze amezi umunani hagati y'izi nyeshamba n'ingabo za reta imaze guhitana ibihumbi n'ibihumbi vy'abanyagihugu. Ishirahamwe ONU rimenyesha ko abarenga imiriyoni zibiri bataye izabo, nayo abantu 400.000 bakaba bahanzwe na kigoyi gishobora gutera abarenga imiriyoni 1.8. Inyeshamba z'umuhari Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) zabanje kuvuga ko ivyo guhagarika intambara vyatangajwe na reta ya Ethiopia ari "ukujajura" zica ziyemeza kwirukana "abansi" bazo muri iyo ntara. Muri bo harimwo ingabo za Eritrea hamwe n'ingabo za Ethiopia ziva mu ntara ya Amhara iri mu bumanuko bwa Tigray. Ariko basohoye urutonde rw'ibindi vyinshi bisabwa kugira ngo bemere guhagarika intambara, harimwo gukora amatohoza ku vyaha vyo mu ntambara bivugwa, gutanga imfashanyo z'ubutabazi hamwe no gusanura ibintu shingiro vyo mu buzima bwa misi yose, harimwo umuyagankuba. Ejo ku wa Mungu, "reta ya Tigray" yasohoye itangazo rivuga riti: "Mu gihe tuzoba twijejwe neza ko umutekano w'abanyagihugu utazohungabanywa n'igitero ca kabiri, twemeye guhagarika intambara". Umunyamakuru wa BBC World Service Africa Will Ross avuga ko mu gihe reta ya Addis Ababa yoramuka yemeye ibi bisabwa n'inyeshamba ko ubutegetsi bwazo bubanza kwemerwa, yoba yerekanye neza ko yatsinzwe intambara kandi ko yananiwe no kwikurako umwansi wayo. Avuga ko amakungu abandanya atera akamo ko intambara zihagarara kugira ngo imiriyoni z'abantu basinzikajwe n'intambara bashobore kuronswa imfashanyo, ariko ko bisabwa ko impande zompi zibanza kwumvikana neza kugira ngo amahoro agaruke. Iyi ntambara yatanguye ku wa 04 z'ukwa cumi na rimwe umwaka uheze, igihe umushikiranganji wa mbere wa Ethiopia Abiy Ahmed agomorera ingabo za reta ku ngabo z'intara ya Tigray. Ico gihe yatangaje ko yafashe iyo ngingo inyuma y'igitero cakozwe ku kirindiro c'igisirikare ca reta muri iyo ntara. Ibintu vyagiye kuyangara haciye amezi atari make hari icuka kibi hagati ya reta ya Abiy n'abategetsi ba TPLF. Inyuma y'intsinzi zitari nke cagiye kigira harimwo ugufata umugwa mukuru wa Tigray Mekelle, ibintu vyagiye biba nabi ku gisirikare ca Ethiopia gifashwe mu mugongo n'ingabo za Eritrea n'iz'intara ya Amhara mu ntambara n'inyeshamba za TPLF . Mu ndwi iheze, ingabo za Tigray zasubiye kwigarurira umugwa mukuru Mekelle. Impande zompi muri iyo ntambara ziragirizwa ko zagandaguye abantu zinahonyanga uburenganzira bwa kiremwa muntu. Ku wa gatanu, ingabo ziharurwa mu bihumbi za Ethiopia zafashwe mpiri zarazungurukanywe mu mabarabara ya Mekelle. Gushika ubu, reta ya Abiy i Addis Abeba yaranse kuganira n'abategetsi ba TPLF, mbere akaba yavuze ko uwu ari umuhari w'iterabwoba.

headline: Intambara ya Ukraine: Ingene Russia yarushirije mu kwunga imigenderanire na Africa
text: Uburusiya muri iyi myaka ya vuba buguma  bwongereza uruhara rwabwo muri Afrika none kuva buteye Ukraine, bwiteze ivyo bihugu bishasha bicuditse kubushigikira, canke nibura kutagira uruhande vyegamira mu nzego mpuzamakungu nka ONU. Kuva muri Libya ukaja muri Mali, Centrafrique, Mozamibque n'ahandi, Uburusiya bwagumye bwongereza uruhara -rimwe na rimwe mu buryo bwa gisirikare mu gufasha kurwanya imigwi yitwaje ibigwanisho canke intagondwa z'aba Djihadists. Mu nama ijejwe umutekano ya ONU, igihugu ca Kenya kiyirimwo mu buryo butari  ntayegayezwa, cariyamirije mu majambo atomoye igitero c'Uburusiya kuri Ukraine. Ariko gushika ubu ibindi bihugu ntivyitabiriye cane mu gushigikira aho Kenya ihagaze. Ishirahamwe ry'ibihugu vya Afrika, AU/UA ryashikirije "impungenge zikomeye" ku biriko biraba, ariko ntaco cashikirije mu kunegura Uburusiya". Afrika y'Epfo, isanzwe icuditse n'Uburusiya bisangiye ishirahamwe rya Brics, yasavye ico gihugu kuvana ingabo zaco muri Ukraine, ariko ico gihugu kimenyesha ko kiguma cizeye ko hoboneka inyishu iciye mu mahoro. Hagati aho, umukuru wa Centrafrique, Faustin-Archange Touadéra bivugwa ko yashigikiye ingingo y'Uburusiya yo kwemera intara za Ukraine za Donetsk na Luhansk nk'intara zigenga. Ku wa gatatu, umukuru w'abasirikare bigaruriye ubutegetsi muri Sudan  Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo, yagize urugendo i Moscou mu kimenyetso c'imigenderanire irushirije gukomera hagati y'ivyo bihugu vyompi. Kamwe mu turorero tugaragara neza tw'ingene ubucuti bwahindutse muri Afrika kabaye indwi imwe imbere y'uko Uburusiya butera Ukraine mu kurangiza uruhara rw'Ubufaransa mu gukorwa co kurwanya intagondwa muri Mali. Umushikiranganji wa mbere wa Mali  Choguel Maiga yemeje, mu kiganiro na France24, ko igihugu ciwe cagiraniye amasezerano yo gufashanya mu vya gisirikare n'Uburusiya. Ariko yarahakanye ibivugwa ko kompanyi ya gisirikare yo mu Rusiya iteje impari, Groupe Wagner, irimwo muri ayo masezerano. Ubwo bufasha bw'Uburusiya muri Mali, n'ubwo Uburusiya nyene bwoba bwemereye abasirikare bafashe ubutegetsi muri Burkina Faso, biri mu ngendo imaze imyaka itanu iheze aho Uburusiya bwakomeje inzira yo kwongereza uruhara rwabwo muri Afrika, mu buryo butandukanye. Mu gihe ugufashanya hagati y'Uburusiya na Afrika kwariko kuratera imbere, inama kaminuza yo mu 2019 yabereye mu gisagara ca Sochi co mu bumanuko bw'Uburusiya yitabwe n'intumwa zivuye mu bihugu vya Afrika birenga 50, harimwo abakuru b'ibihugu 43. Prezida  Vladimir Putin yarashikirije ijambo abategetsi, yibutsa kahise ko gushigikira imihari yo guhabuza intahe yo kwikukira anemera kwongereza urudandazwa hamwe n'imitahe. Ariko hari n'urundi ruhara: gucungera mu buryo butagaragara umutekano w'ama reta mu bihugu bimwe bimwe vya Afrika, biciye mu kwigisha, mw'iperereza no mu bikoresho, hamwe rero n'ikoreshwa ry'abacangero b'abarusiya mu ntambara zo muri Afrika. Nk'uko Putin yabivuze, hari imigenderanire ya kera kuva ku gihe ca URSS, igihe Afrika kari akarere ko kunyinyaniramwo na Reta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ariko kuva URSS isenyutse mu 1991 gushika mu ntango z'imyaka 10 iheze, igihe Uburusiya bukiri ku nzira yo gusubira gufata umurongo, imigenderanire na Afrika nticari icihutirwa. Ico gihe, gusubira kuba igihugu c'igihangange vyaciye biba intego nyamukuru ya poritike yo hanze y'umukuru w'Uburusiya. Mu 2014, Uburusiya bumaze kwigarurira agace ka Ukraine ka Crimee, hamwe n'ibihano mpuzamakungu vyaciye bikurikira, haciye haba itituka rikomeye ry'imigenderanire na Amerika hamwe n'Ishirahamwe rya Buraya. Bubonye ko bushobora kugeramirwa no gukumirwa n'amakugu, Ubususiya bwaciye butangura kuronderera incuti nshasha ahandi. "Kubera ingaruka z'ibihano, Uburusiya bwategerezwa kurondera amasoko mashasha ku bihingurwa vyabwo" nk'uko bivugwa na  Irina Abramova, umuyobozi w'igisata ca Afrika mu kigo Russian National  Academy of Sciences. Ariko Uburusiya bwarondera ibirenze amasoko - bwari bukeneye kwongereza ijambo ryabwo kw'isi. Mu 2014 bwaragiye mu ntambara yo muri Syria, bushigikira Prezida Bashar al-Assad, imwe mu mvo kukaba kwari ukugira bwerekane akajagari Ibihugu vya Buraya vyariko biratera kandi bwerekane ingene Uburusiya bushobora kugakosora. Mu nyuma ya Syria bwaciye bugana umugabane wa Afrika. Irina Filatova, umwigisha w'iteka kuri kaminuza ya Kwa-Zulu Natal  muri Afrika y'Epfo, avuga ko igikorwa ca mbere gikomeye c'Uburusiya muri Afrika kwari ugutesha agaciro uruhara rw'ibihugu vyo mu Burengero, nk'uko vyagenze muri Syria. Bwashaka kwerekana ko abanaya-Buraya, nk'akarorero, bananiwe no gutuza aba-djihadist muri Sahel. Ivyo bwabikora mu nzira zibiri muri Afrika, bufatanya kurungika abigisha ba gisirikare b'igihugu  gufasha mu bihugu bimwe bimwe, hamwe n'amakompanyi yigenga, nka Groupe Wagner, agwana mu bindi. Centrafrique cabaye igihugu ca mbere co muri Afrika aho abacangero b'abarusiya bo muri Wagner bagaragaye mu 2017. Mu nyuma bakurikiwe n'umugwi w'abasirikare urungitswe na reta kuja  gukarihiriza ubwenge abo muri Centrafrique. Intego yabo kwari ugufasha prezida  Touadéra kuguma ku butegetsi. Vyagumye bivugwa cane ko abo bacangero bakora amarorerwa, ariko Uburusiya bwagumye buhakana ko ata muntu n'umwe wabwo yagize uruhara mu vyaha canke intureka ku banyagihugu basanzwe. Abacangero b'abarusiya barakora kandi muri Libya, Sudan, Mozambique na Mali, ku ngero zitandukanye z'ivyo bashikako. Ikindi kimenyetso c'akamaro ka Afrika ku Burusiya, ni uko uwo mugabane wabaye isoko rikomeye ry'ibigwanisho vy'Uburusiya. Hafi ica kabiri c'ibigwanisho vyose vyinjira muri Afrika biva mu Burusiya, nk'uko bivugwa n'ikigo c'igihugu kiraba ivyo gushohora hanze. Abagura cane ibigwanisho ni Algeria na Misiri (Egypt), ariko hari n'amasoko mashasha muri Nigeria, Tanzania na Cameroun. Ariko hari akandi kunguko k'ubucuti bukomeye mu vy'imigenderanire. Afrika muri rusangi ifise ikirenga ica kane c'amajwi mu nama ya bose ya ONU, kandi rishobora kuba ijwi rya rusangi rikomeye mu zindi nzego mpuzamakungu. Mu 2021 icegeranyo ku migenderanire ya Africa n'Uburusiya, casohowe n'ishure rya kaminuza Higher School of Economics rya Moscou, kivuga ko ibihugu vya Afrika akenshi muri kahise vyakunze kutagira uruhande vyegamira iyo hageze ku bikorwa vy'Uburusiya. "Nta gihugu na kimwe cigeze gifatira ibihano Uburusiya (inyuma ya 2014). Mu gutora muri ONU ku bibazo vyerekeye Ukraine, vyinshi mu bihugu vyo kuri uwo mugabane bifata ingingo yo kutagira aho vyegamiye," nk'uko icegeranyo kibivuga. Ubu habaye igitero kuri Ukraine, hamwe uko kutagira aho vyegamiye kwobandanya, canke bikerura mu gushigikira, aho utwigoro tw'Uburusiya muri iyi myaka iheze vyoboneka ko twavuyemwo umusaruro.

headline: Habonetse uwundi muntu yanduye coronavirus mu Burundi, 22 bandi bapimwe ntayo bafise
text: Ubushikiranganji bujejwe amagara mu Burundi bumenyesha ko uwundi muntu yatowemwo umugera corona ubu abanduye bakaba babaye batatu muri ico gihugu. Umushikiranganji w'amagara y'abantu n'ukurwanya ikiza SIDA mu Burundi, niwe yabitangaje kuri uno wa kane. Mu kiganiro yahaye abamenyeshamakuru i Bujumbura kuri uyu mugoroba, umushikiranganji Thaddée Ndikumana  amenyesha ko uyo muntu mushasha ari umurundikazi w'imyaka 26. Abandi 22 bapimwe basanze batanduye uwo mugera, umushikiranganji Ndikumana agasaba abanyagihugu kubandanya bakurikiza ingingo zafashwe zo kurwanya no gukinga ico kiza. Amakuru y'uko hoba hari abanduye coronavirus mu Burundi yavugwa, hakaba mbere n'abagiriza leta kubinyegeza. Umuvugizi w'umukuru w'igihugu c'u Burundi yaheruka kubwira BBC ko u Burundi burinzwe n'Imana, ari yo mpamvu ico kiza kitari bwahashike. Ivyo vyatumye hari amashirahamwe yiyamiriza ingene u Burundi bufata ikibazo ca coronavirus, akavuga ko bugifata minenerwe. Gushika ubu mu Burundi nta mategeko abuza abantu gusohoka yari bwafatwe nk'uko biri mu bihugu bibanyi, kiretse gusa kubaha impanuro zo kugira isuku. Ingendo z'indege zarabujijwe ikiringo c'iminsi cumi n'ine, imbibe nazo zikaba zugaye ku ruja n'uruza rusanzwe. Gushika ubu Afrika niyo irangwamwo abanduye coronavirus bake ugereranije n'iyindi migabane, ariko abajejwe ivy'amagara ku rwego mpuzamakungu bavuga ko abandura n'abapfa kuri uwo mugabane bagenda bariyongera.

headline: Iminsi 100 intambara itanguye: Ingene ibinyamakuru biyivuga muri Ukraine no mu Burusiya
text: Gushika ku mutaga hagati imboneshakure (television) y’Uburusiya ntaco yari bwavuge ku c’uko iminsi 100 irumanye kuva Uburusiya buteye Ukraine. Nyinshi mu mboneshakure zikurikirwa cane mu Burusiya zataganguye amakuru yazo yo um gitondo zagiriza Ukraine gutera ata gutoronya  ibisasu ku turere tutagenzurwa na reta. Imboneshakure igenzurwa na Kremlin (ibiro vy’umukuru w’igihugu), Rossiya1, yavuze ko aba-nationalists bateye Mariupol na Donetsk’’ um gihe Channel One nayo, nayo nyene igenzurwa na reta, itanga uburorero bushasha bw’ubunyamwuga n’ukwitanga   vyerekanwa n’igisirikare c’Uburusiya um kugwanira Donbas’’. Nta n’imwe ivuga ko ‘igikorwa ca gisirikare  kidasanzwe’ c’Uburusiya muri UKraine  conjiye um munsi waco ugira 100. Imbere y’uko intambara itangura, abasigura uko ibintu biriko biragenda bari babwiye ababakurikira ko vyashoboka ko  bitwara  Uburusiya iminsi mike gusa kugira bwifatire Ukraine. Ku wa kane, urubuga rwigenga Meduza rwanditse ko hari abarubwiye ko reta yari yategegetse ibinyamakuru kudacisha um kanwa ivy’uko  ivy’iminsi 100. Rimwe mu masoko ya Meduza muri Kremlin ryayibwiye riti: ‘’ Guhagarara cane ku matariki ajanye bn’intambara bishobora gutuma abarusiya bibaza ivyari bigamijwe n’ico gitero n’ingene coba kimaze gushobora canke kunanirwa kubishikako.’’ Ibi bihushanye cane n’ibivugwa n’ibinyamakuru muri Ukraine aho imboneshakure iriko ikravuga ibiba uyu munsi ku civugo ‘Iminsi 100 yo kurya umutima amenyo’’. Uwushikiriza amakuru ku mboneshakure yigenga Prymy TV yavuze ati: ‘’Uyu si umunsi wo kwigina kandi twizeye ko ata minsi 200 tuzokwibuka kuva intambara itanguye. Amezi arenga atatu araheze kuva intambara itanguye. Iyi ni amwe mu matariki akomeye muri iyo ntambara:

headline: OMS/WHO ivuga ko intambara yo kurwanya malaria itava aho iri
text: Ishami rya ONU rijejwe amagara y'abantu kw'isi WHO/OMS riragabisha ko ata ntambwe iraterwa mu ntambara yo kurwanya malaria. Mu cegeranyo c'umwaka kuri iyo ndwara, iryo shirahamwe rivuga ko ibitigiri vy'abayirwaye n'abamaze gupfa atacahindutse muri iyi myaka ibiri iheze, bikaba bitandukanye n'ingene vyari vyakorotse bitangaje twinjira muri iki kinjana. Malaria yica abantu 400.000 buri mwaka, benshi muri bo bakaba ari abo musi y'ubugaragwa bwa Sahara muri Afrika. Hari ubwoba ko imfashanyo mu migambi yo kurwanya malaria zizogabanuka kubera amarorerwa ikiza ca coronavirus kiriko kirakora. Utwigoro two kurwanya iyo ndwara iterwa n'imibu kandi tugenda tuburizwamwo  n'ingene iyo ndwara itakivurwa n'imiti imwe imwe. Icegeranyo c'igisata ca ONU kijejwe ubutabazi, OCHA co mu 2019, kivuga ko abantu imiliyoni zitanu n'ibice indwi banduye malariya muri uwo mwaka mu Burundi, igitigiri kingana hafi igice c'abanyagihugu bose bo muri ico gihugu. Muri abo bantu bose, abangana 1801 barahitanywe n'iyo ndwara iterwa n'umubu kuva mu kwezi kwa mbere gushika ku wa 21 ukwezi kw'indwi mu 2019.

headline: Russia - Ukraine: Hatanguye ibiganiro ku ntambara iri hagati y'ivyo bihugu
text: Amafoto yatanguye guhererekanywa mu gihe abategetsi b'Uburusiya na Ukraine bari mu biganiro ku ntambara iriko irabahuza, ivyo biganiro bikaba biriko birabera  ku rubibe igihugu ca Ukraine gihana na Belarus. Imbere y'uko iyo nama itangura, prezida wa Ukraine yavuze ko igihugu ciwe cipfuza ko intambara zica zihagarara ubwo nyene n'ingabo z'Uburusiya zikava muri ico gihugu. Hagati aho, Uburusiya bwo buvuga ko hoshikwako amasezerano impande zose zifisemwo inyungu. Ku musi ugira gatanu inyuma y'aho ingabo z'Uburusiya zinjiriye muri Ukraine, intumwa z'ivyo bihugu bibiri zatanguye ibiganiro bigamije kurangiza iyo ntambara. Ibiro vya prezida wa Ukraine bivuga ko bishaka ihagarikwa ry'intambara ubwo nyene hamwe n'ivanwa ry'ingabo z'Uburusiya muri ico gihugu. Hagati aho, Vladimir Medinsky arongoye intumwa z'Uburusiya mu biganiro avuga ko bashaka amasezerano afitiye inyungu impande zose. Imbere y'uko iyo nama itangura, prezida Volodymyr Zelensky yahamagariye ingabo z'Uburusiya gushira hasi ibigwanisho, aca atera akamo ishirahamwe ry'ubumwe bwa Buraya kwemerera Ukraine kwinjira muri iryo shirahamwe ubwo nyene.

headline: Ayavugwa mu mupira w'amaguru: Lukaku, Pogba, Doku, Abraham, Lingard, Sterling
text: Sergio Aguero aherutse kugurwa na Barcelona yahinyagaye, ibizomutuma adakina mu kiringo c'indwi cumi (amezi arenga atatu). Mw'itangazo uwo murwi wo muri La Liga wasohoye, Barcelona ivuga ko yahinyagaye mu kuguru kw'iburyo. Aguero w'imyaka 33 yinjiye muri  Barcelona ku masezerano y'imyaka ibiri yateyeko igikumu mu kwa gatandatu, avuye muri Manchester City aho yari amaze imyaka cumi, aho yaciye umuhigo mu bakinyi bamaze kwinjiriza ibitsindo vyinshi uwu murwi, akaba yatsinze ibitsindo 260 mu nkino 390. Kugira ngo PSG ishobore kwigarurira iki gihangange co muri Argentina, iriteguye kugurisha abakinyi cumi bose harimwo uwahoze akina hagati muri  Everton umunya Senegal Idrissa Gueye w'imyaka 31. (Athletic) Uwu murwi wo mu Bufaransa kandi wahagaritse ivyo kurondera umukinyi wo hagati wa Manchester United umufaransa Paul Pogba w'imyaka 28. (Le Parisien - in French) Inyuma yo gufatwa ibipimo vya mbere vyo kwa muganga muri Chelsea, umusatirizi wa Inter Milan,  umubirigi Romelu Lukaku w'imyaka 28 ashobora gukinira uwo murwi urukino rwayo rwo kwugurura Premier League aho uzohura na Crystal Palace ku wa gatandatu. (Daily Star) Lyon yamaze kwemerera umushahara wa musatirizi wa  Liverpool umuswisi  Xherdan Shaqiri w'imyaka 29. (L'Equipe - via Get French Football News) Manchester United iriteguye kwemeza ko yamaze kugura umukinyi w'inyuma wa  Real Madrid umufaransa Raphael Varane w'imyaka 28 kuri uwu wa gatatu  - bikazomuha akaryo ko kuzokina urukino rwa mbere muri Premier League ku wa gatandatu, aho uwo murwi uzotana mu mitwe na Leeds. (Daily Star) Liverpool ihanze amaso umukinyi wo ku ruhande wa Rennes umubirigi Jeremy Doku w'imyaka 19. (Voetbal 24 - in Dutch) Umusatirizi wa Chelsea umwongereza Tammy Abraham w'imyaka 23 ariko araronderwa na Arsenal, Roma hamwe na Atalanta. (Goal) Roma iriko iregereza igiciro c'imiriyoni zababa 47 z'amadorari y'abanyamerika gisabwa kuri Abraham, ni mu gihe Chelsea iriko irarondera ingene yotanga nk'intizo uyu musatirizi ata kibanza kinini agifise, harimwo n'igice cemeza ko uwomutwara afise n'amahirwe yo kuzomugura burundu.  (Mail) Umumenyereza wa Roma Jose Mourinho aripfuza umusatirizi wa  Arsenal umufaransa  Alexander Lacazette w'imyaka 30. (Gazzetta dello Sport - via Boot Room) Leicester iripfuza umukinyi wo hagati wa Manchester United umwongereza Jesse Lingard w'imyaka 28 mu gihe uwundi mwongereza mugenzi we James Maddison w'imyaka 24 yova muri uwo murwi. (Football London) Aba Foxes (ni ukuvuga Leicester) baravugwa kandi ko bashaka umukinyi w'inyuma wa  Schalke umunya Turukiya Ozan Kabak w'imyaka 21 - yamaze igice ca nyuma c'umwaka w'inkino uheze muri Liverpool aho yari yaratijijwe - hamwe n'umufaransa na we nyene akina inyuma muri West Ham  Issa Diop w'imyaka 24. (Leicester Mercury) Everton iripfuza umukinyi wo hagati wa Newcastle United umwongereza Sean Longstaff w'imyaka 23. (Athletic) Bayern Munich iriko irihweza nimba yogarukana umukinyi wo ku ruhande, umufaransa Franck Ribery w'imyaka 38 amaze igihe yimenyereza hamwe n'uwu murwi kuva avuye muri  Fiorentina. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian) Umukinyi wo ku ruhande wa Manchester City umwongereza Raheem Sterling w'imyaka 26 ariteguye kugiriranira ibiganiro n'uwu murwi wiwe kugira ngo ashobore gutera igikumu ku yandi masezerano yo kubandanya ayikinira. (Sun) Umukinyi wo hagati wa Tottenham umufaransa Tanguy Ndombele w'imyaka 24 ariko arihweza kazoza kiwe muri uwu murwi.  (Athletic)

headline: DRC: Van Damme atera akamo ba rurangiranwa gutemberera ico gihugu
text: Umukinyi rurangiranwa wa filime w'Umubiligi Jean Claude va Damme, batazira 'Mitsi ya Bruxelles' avuga ko anejerejwe no kuba yahawe igitabo c'inzira ca Congo - avuga kandi ko afise intumbero yo guhamagarira abandi bantu bamenyekana cane gutemberera Republika ya Demokrasi ya Congo. Ari i Kinshasa ku mugwa mukuru w'ico gihugu, igihe yariko arashikirizwa ico gitabo c'inzira n'akazi ko guserukira ico gihugu mu karanga, urwaruka n'ibidukikije, uwo mugabo w'imyaka 61 yagize ati: "Ngiye kugondoza abandi bantu rurangiranwa kw'isi nka Stallone, Schwarzenegger, Jacky Chan hamwe n'abandi benshi." "Hari kandi n'abaririmvyi nka Jennifer Lopez  hamwe n'abakinyi b'umupira nka Messi, Ronaldinho, Cristiano Ronaldo. Bategerezwa kuza muri iki gihugu kwerekana ko kigendwa, kwerekana ko Congo ishobora gukingira umutekano abantu bari muvyo kuremesha ibiro vyinjiza amahera (Showbiz). Igihugu ca RD Congo kimaze imyaka irenga 30 kiri mu ntambara, aho imigwi myinsi yitwaje ibigwanisho ibica bigacika mu buseruko bw'ico gihugu hagwiriye ubutare, aho yica, ifata ku nguvu ikanasahura. Uwo yigeze kuba rurangiranwa mu buhinga bwo kwivuna umwansi ata kigwanisho (arts martiaux), Van Damme yarakinye mu mafilime y'ingwano i Hollywood y'amafaranga menshi nka Cyborg, Kickboxer na Universal Soldier - ubu vuba na ho akaba aherutse gusubiramwo Master Croc mu mafilime ya Kung Fu Panda. Azwi nk'umuntu akaze cane. Yatangaje abantu mu kiganiro n'abamenyeshamakuru aho yavuga ko yavukiye muri RD Congo, avuga ko "avuka i Likasi", igisagara kiri mu bumanuko bushira ubuseruko bw'ico gihugu. Aho hashobora hari mu mwaka ico gihugu ciganzura intwaro y'Ububiligi. Yanashimitse cane ku kamaro ko kuzana abashora imitahe mu gihugu ca RD Congo. "RD Congo ifise ubutare buciye imiriyaridi ibihumbi 36...akazi kanje n'ukurondera abazana imitahe, bazi neza ko ari ukubanza gutanga imbere yo kuronka, hanyuma no guha icizere prezida Felix Antoine Tshisekedi." Ariko benshi bibajije ikibazo kuri ico gitabo c'inzira gishasha c'uwo mukinyi wa Filime mu gihe ibwirizwa shingiro rya RD Congo  ribuza kugira ubwenegihugu bubiri.

headline: Manchester City hanze: uko umwaka utashe amagorwa ni ya yandi– Kevin de Bruyne
text: Umukiyi wo hagati wa Manchester City Kevin de Bruyne avuga ait "dukeneye gusubira kwiga neza", inyuma y'aho bakuriwe mw'ihiganwa ku ncuro ya gatatu yose bageze mu gice ca kane gishira ica nyuma muri Champions League. Mu rukino rwaraye rubaye mu gice ca kane gishira ica nyuma, Lyon yaraye imaramaje Man City mu kuyitsinda ibitsindo bitatu kuri kimwe. Moussa Dembele niwe yabakoreye ibara, mu kwinjiza ibitsindo bibiri vyose mu minota ya nyuma, kuwa 79 hanyuma ku wa 87, mw'ihiganwa rihuza imirwi yabaye iya mbere i Bulaya. Uyu murwi Lyon wo mu Bufaransa witeze guhura na Bayern Munich wo mu Budagi mu gice ca kabiri gishira ica nyuma, uyu nawo weretse Barcelona ico imbwa yaboneye ku mugezi mu rukino rwo ku wa gatanu. Lyon niyo yabanje kubona igori ku gitsindo catsinzwe na Maxwel Cornet, mu nyuma De Bruyne aragikurayo, ariko ibintu bikaba vyaciye bibabana urudubi. Avugana na BT Sport De Bruyne yagize ati: "Amagorwa ni ya yandi, imyaka yose". Mw'ihiganwa ryaraye rirangiye mu Bwongereza, City yahejeje ari iya kabiri inyuma ya Liverpool yatahukanye iryo higanwa, Pep Guardiola n'abakinyi biwe bavuvudikira igikombe c'ihiganwa ryu Bwongereza (EFL Cup). Kuva uyu murwi utanguye kumenyerezwa na Guardiola, City yari imaze  gutsindwa na Monaco igeze mu gice c'umunani gishira ica nyuma, hanyuma mu myaka iheze ibiri ikurikirana naho ikurwamwo na Liverpool na Tottenham igeze mu gice ca kane gishira ica nyuma. De Bruyne ati: "Igice ca mbere nticatugendeye neza. Ariko mu gice ca kabiri twakinye urukino rwiza cane turabasatira bikomeye. Tuvugishije ukuri Lyon nta bintu bihambaye bakoze kuko twarabarushije umupira, ariko dukeneye gusubira kwiga neza". Man city yararonse amahirwe menshi yo gushobora kwinjiza ariko biranka. Inkokora zagiye gucika igihe Raheem Sterling, bamaze gutsindwa ica kabiri, ahushirije igitsindo imbere y'igori wenyene, igitsindo cari gutuma iyo mirwi inganya 2-2. Ariko rero Moussa Dembele amaze gutsinda ica gatatu. Ibintu vyari birangiye muri city. Pep ati: "Sintahura neza. Ndaza kumuvugisha ni twashika mw'ihoteri. N'ukuri abakinyi barashavuye, ariko ni kimwe mu bigize urukino". Umumenyereza wa Manchester City yamye yagirizwa ko yama atsindwa muri Champions League kubera yama ahindagura imikenyuro, ugasanga bitumye abakinyi bata umutwe. Umuhinga muvyo inkino Pat Nevin yigeze gukinira Chelsea n'umurwi nserukiragihugu wa Ecosse (Scotland) yabwiye iradiyo BBC Radio 5 Live ko uravye City yitaye mu ngorane yo nyene. Ati: "Iminota 22 ya mbere yabaye akaga. Pep Guardiola yagiye kwikangura haciye iminota 60. Urumva ko iyo minota yose uba wayipfishije ubusa kandi wari kuyikoresha". "Uno munsi vyari vyamwankiye. Wewe yipfuza abantu biwe ko bafata urukino mu minwe, ariko uravye urukino rusa n'urwari rwabananiye". "Nta nguvu bari bafise nk'uko dusanzwe tubamenyereye". Umumenyeshamakuru w'inkino w'umufaransa Julien Laurens, wewe, abona ko Lyon yaronkeye akoyoko ku "mikenyuro y'uburofa" ya Pep. Ati: "Niwe yananiwe. Yavyifashemwo nabi kuva mu ntango mbere no mu gice ca kabiri". "Yama ahindagura cane imikenyuro iyo ageze muri Champions League. Nivyo rimwe na rimwe birashobora kumuzanira akarusho, twarabibonye nk'igihe ahura na Real Madrid. Koko vyaragize akamaro. Ariko akenshi vyama vyanka". "Yarahinduye umukenyuro ariko biranka igihe yahura na Tottenham umwaka uheze, co kimwe n'igihe ahura na Monaco imyaka itatu iheze". "Kubera iki utokoresha umukenyuro abakinyi bawe bawe basanzwe bamenyereye mu gihe uzi neza ko uwo mugiye guhura umusumba kure? Kubera iki urondera kwisunga uwo muhiganwa?". "Uko siko bigenda. Amakosa ni rwiwe. Bimaze kuba kenshi". "Nibaza ko yotera intambwe akemera agasaba imbabazi. Yarishe umukino".

headline: 'Gwanya amacakubiri y'urukoba nka Logan' - Reta ya Afrika y'Epfo
text: Reta ya Afrika y'Epfo yateye akamo abantu ko bategerezwa gukurikiza akarorero k'umugabo w'umuzungu yafashwe video yakwiragiye henshi, ariko ariyamiriza amacakubiri ashingiye ku rukoba. Iyo video imwerekana ahanganye na ba nyene akabare b'abazungu mu gisagara ca Cape Town, ababaza impamvu babujije mugenzi we w'umwirabire kukinjiramwo. Itangazo rya reta ryasohotse ku musi wa kabiri, ririyamiriza ryivuye inyuma "iyo nyifato y'amacakubiri ashingiye ku rukoba yabaye igihe Thabiso Danca w'imyaka 25 yabuzwa kwinjira mu bunywero w'aba Irlandais, Hank's Olde, mu gisagara ca Cape Town, kubera gusa ari umwirabure, kandi akaba adaherekejwe n'umuzungu". Iyo video ubu imaze kurabwa n'abantu ibihumbi amajana, yatanguye gukwiragizwa ku musi wa gatanu. Yerekana umugenzi wa Danca, Christopher Logan, aja muri ubwo bunywero guhangana n'umwe muri banyene akabare kuri ivyo vyavugwa ko ari amacakubiri ashingiye ku rukoba. Yabwiye nyene akabare ko uwucungera umutekano yabwiye umugenzi wiwe: "Ntushobora kwinjira ngaha, atawuguherekeje, ata muzungu muri kumwe." Nyene ubunywero yishuye ko ivyo ata kibazo vyari bwatere mu myaka 18 amaze adandaza. Ubwo bunywero bwaciye busohora itangazo buhakana kugira inyifato y'amacakubiri ashingiye ku rukoba, bashira n'ikimenyetso hanze  cerekana ko ata macakubiri n'amwe aharangwa. Ico kimenyetso canditseko: "Dushaka kwemeza  ko mu myaka 30 iheze dukorera urudandaza aha muri Cap Town, twebwe nka banyene aka kabare, tutarigera, canke ngo dutegeke abakozi bacu, kwinuba umuntu hitwaje ikintu ico ari co cose, haba igitsina, kamere k'uburyo umuntu ahuza igitsina n'uwundi,  canke urukoba." Reta yasavye ko haba "amatohoza yihuta kuri ivyo vyabaye, kandi n'ubutungane bukore." Reta "yahamagariye abanye Afrika y'epfo bose gukurikiza akarorero ka Logan no kwiyamiriza amacakubiri afatiye ku rukoba".

headline: Swiss bemeje kubuza kwamamaza itabi inyuma cane y'ibihugu bibanyi
text: Aba-Swisse batoye bemeza kubuza kwamamaza itabi ahantu hose abakiri bato bashobora kubibona. Mu vy'ukuri, kuba Ego ariyo yiganje muri ayo matora ya kamarampaka mu gihugu cose bizotuma kwamamaza itabi bicibwa burundu. Ivyo bizotuma Swisse ija ku murongo w'ibindi bihugu bibanyi vy'i Buraya, vyinshi vyashitse ku ngingo zikomeye zibuza canke zigabanya kwamamaza itabi haraheze imyaka itari mike. N'ubwo ari igihugu gisanzwe kizwi neza ku bijanye n'amagara meza n'ugukingira ibidukikije, Swisse yari igifise amwe mu mategeko yerekeye itabi  yoroshe cane i Buraya. Mu gihe haheze imyaka myinshi kunywera itabi mu nzu z'uburiro n'ubunywero vyari vyaraciwe mu Bwongereza, mu Bufaransa, canke mu Budagi, muri Swisse bari bakihanywera itabi. Mu masoko ya kijambere (supermarches/supermartkets), abariko barasuma hari igihe bakirwa n'abagore bakiri bato babamwenyurira mu gihe babaha imponjo za gusa z'itabi riba riherutse gusohoka. Mu gihe ivyo haheze imyaka bibujijwe, kwamamaza itabi vyari bikibandanya. Ashima ivyavuye mu matora yo ku wa mungu, umushingamateka w'umu-social democrat  Flavia Wasserfallen yakeje igikorwa c'amashirahamwe y'abaganga n'abigisha bakoze isekeza ryo guca ivyo kwamamaza itabi. Yabwiye television ya Swisse ati: "Abantu barakoze cane kugira haboneke  poritike yo gushira imbere ineza y'abakiri bato". Ingingo z'ishami rya ONU riraba amagara kw'isi OMS zijanye n'itabi  - Framework Convention on Tobacco Control- zimaze imyaka hafi 20 zishitsweko mu gisagara ca Geneve. Swisse yarazishizeko umukono, ariko ntiyari bwazemeze mu mategeko -kikaba arico gihugu ca Buraya co nyene cari gisigaye - kuko gushika habe amatora yo ku wa mungu, amategeko y'ico gihugu yerekeye kwamamaza, ntiyisunga izo ngingo. Ugereranije no mu bindi bihugu vy'i Buraya, itabi muri Swisse rirazimbutse kandi 27% y'abantu bakuze muri ico gihugu baranywa itabi - urugero ruri hejuru y'urw'i Buraya muri rusangi. Ni kenshi amategeko agamije kugabanya canke guca kwamamaza itabi yari amaze kunanirwa kurengana mu nama nshingamateka. N'igihe abagira isekeza baba baronse imikono ikwiye yo gusaba ko haba amatora kamarampaka yo guca kwamamaza, reta yaca ibwira abanyagihugu gutora Oya. Abashigikiye ko kwamamaza bicibwa, bavugako ivyo biterwa n'uko muri ico gihugu hariyo amwe mu ma kompanyi akomeye cane kw'isi mu rudandazwa rw'itabi. Philip Morris, British American Tobacco na Japan Tobacco yose afise ivyicaro vyayo bikuru muri Swisse. Urudandazwa rw'itabi bigereranywa ko rwinjiriza ubutunzi bwa Swisse amafaranga arenga miriyaridi 6 z'amadorari ku mwaka, rugakoresha abantu 11.000 muri ico gihugu. Imbere y'uko amatora aba vyaragaragaye ko -nk'uko benshi bavyikeka - ko ama kompanyi y'itabi yahora asuka amafaranga mw'isekeza ryo gutora Oya. Abagwanya ko hacibwa kwamamaza, bavuga ko kubuza kwamamaza ikintu cemewe n'amategeko bidakwiye kwemerwa, kandi ko ivyo vyokwugururira imyango  ingingo ku bindi bicuruzwa, nk'isukari n'inzoga, navyo bibonwa nk'ibibangamira amagara y'abantu. Ivyapa biriko  zimwe mu mfungurwa aba-Swisse bakunda cane - vyerekanywe vyandiseko amajambo y'igabisha rikomeye ngo "ibi ni vyo bizoca bikurikira". Ariko abitavye amatora ivyo ntaco vyababwiye. Muri Swisse haharurwa abantu bashika 9.000 bapfa buri mwaka bahitanywe n'indwara zifatiye kw'itabi kandi  igisata c'amagara y'abantu gisohora amafaranga menshi yo kuvura bene izo ndwara. Biduza kandi amafaranga y'ubwishingizi, uwariwe wese ategerezwa gutanga, yaba anywa canke atanywa itabi. Imbere y'uko amatora aba, ibiharuro vyo kugereranya amajwi vyerekana ko 60% bari gushigikira  guca kwamamaza. Amaherezo babaye 56%, ariko n'ubundi bagumanye ubwiganze buhagije. Stefanie de Borba wo nw'ishirahamwe rya Swisse ryo kurwanya cancer yabwiye AFP ati: "Abantu baratahuye ko amagara ahambaye kuruta inyungu z'ubutunzi." Ubundi muri Swisse iyo abatora badatahura neza ico bahamagariwe gutora, baca bakurikiza impanuro ya reta. Ku yandi mategeko abiri bari bahamagariwe kwerekana aho bahagaze co kimwe no kuri iryo ryo guca kwamamaza itabi, reta yari yabahanuye gutora Oya, yamara yaratsinzwe. Ubu  abagize reta bakeneye akanya ko kwisuzuma niba bakiri ku murongo umwe n'abatora. Nk'uko umwe mu bandika uko babona ibintu aho muri Swisse yabivuze ku wa mungu: "Hageze guhitamwo hagati y'ubwigenge bw'ubutunzi n'amagara, abatora benshi bahisemwo ico ca nyuma…Haba uguca ukwamamaza, guca kunywa itabi canke itabi rizimvye, kunywa itabi ubu ntibigifise uruvugiro mu banyagihugu -bitandukanye no mu banyeporitike."

headline: Samuel Eto'o yahoze akinira Barcelona yemeye ko yanyereje ikori ry’imiriyoni 3.2 z’ama pawundi
text: Samuel Eto'o  yahoze ari umusatirizi wa Kameruni yemeye icaha co kunyereza umusoro ungana n’imiriyoni 3,2 z’amapawundi yakuye mw’igurisha ry’isanamu yiwe (droit à l'image /image rights) igihe yakinira Barcelona. Uyu yabaye umukinyi wa mbere wa Afrika w’umwaka incuro zine yaciriwe umunyororo urindirijwe (suspended prison/sursis) w’amezi 22 igihe yarengutswa imbere ya sentare muri Espagne ejo ku wa mbere. Ategerezwa kuriha aya mafaranga yose aheranye, hamwe n’ihadabu ry’imiriyoni 1.55 z’amapawundi. Abashingwamanza bagiriza Eto'o ko yananiwe no kumenyesha amatungo yiwe yavuye mw’igurishwa ry’isanamu yiwe hagati ya 2006 na 2009. Eto'o ni we mukinyi wundi aherutse gushirwa ku rutonde rurerure rw’abakinyi mvamahanga bakurikiranwa ku caha co kunyereza amakori muri Espagne muri ino myaka, harimwo Cristiano Ronaldo, Lionel Messi, Jose Mourinho na Neymar. Uyu munya-Kameruni w’imyaka 41, ubu akaba ari we arongoye ishirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru rya Kameruni, yinjiye muri Barcelona mu 2004 afise imyaka 23. Yarakiniye kandi Real Madrid, Inter Milan, Chelsea na Everton mu kiringo ciwe cose yamaze akina umupira w’amaguru, imbere y’uko akukuruka mu 2019. Yarengukishijwe muri sentare Ciudad de la Justicia i Barcelona ari kumwe n’uwahoze ari umuhagarikizi wiwe, Jose Maria Mesalles, nawe akaba yahawe umunyororo urindirijwe w’amezi 12 hamwe n’ihadabu. Sentare yabwiwe ko Eto'o yagurishije isanamu yiwe mw’ikompanyi ifise icicaro muri Hongrie/Hungary ariko yoyo ikaba yaramenyesheje amatungo yayo muri ico gihugu gifise amakori ari hasi. Eto'o yabwiye sentare ati: "Ndemera ivyo nagirizwa kandi nzoriha ivyo nishuzwa, ariko reka menyeshe ko nari nkiri umwana kandi ko nakurikiza ivyo uwahoze ari umuhagarikizi wanje Jose Maria Mesalles, nafata nka dawe, yansaba gukora ico gihe”.

headline: Colombia: kajugujugu y'umukuru w'igihugu Iván Duque yatewe amasasu
text: Kajugujugu yari ireruye umukuru w'igihugu ca Colombia yatewe amasasu igihe yariko izunguruka hafi y'urubibe ico gihugu gihana na Venezuela. Perezida Iván Duque yariko azunguruka mu karere ka  Cúcuta kari mu ntara ya Norte de Santander, ari kumwe n'umushikiranganji wo kwivuna abansi, uw'intwaro yo hagati, hamwe na buramatari w'iyo ntara. Umuvugizi w'ibiro vy'umukuru w'igihugu avuga ko ata n'umwe yahasize ubuzima canke yakomeretse. Perezida Duque ariyamiriza ico yita "igitero c'ubuhemu", anavuga ko ata bwoba atewe "n'ibi bikorwa bibi vy'iterabwoba". Mw'ireresi yacishije ku rubuga rwa Twitter, yavuze ati: "Igihugu cacu kirakomeye kandi Colombia irafise inguvu zihagije zo guhangana n'iterabwoba nk'iri". Yongerako y'uko inzego z'umutekano zahawe itegeko ryo guhiga abakoze iki gitero. Ikinyamakuru co muri ico gihugu Semana, candika ko abari muri iyo ndege bumvise ikintu gikubita imoteri y'iyo kajugujugu igihe yariko irururuka. Umuhari Armée de libération nationale/National Liberation Army (ELN) uzwi ko ari wo usanzwe urwanira mu karere ka Catatumbo kari ku rubibe Colombia ihana na Venezuela. Uyu muhari ELN washinzwe mu 1964 mu ntumbero yo kurwanya ubusumbane buri mw'isaranganya ry'ubutaka n'ubutunzi bw'ico gihugu umutungo, niho muhari w'inyeshamba ukomeye muri ico gihugu. Colombia, Reta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika hamwe n'Ubumwe bw'ibihugu vya Buraya bifata ELN  nk'umuhari w'iterabwoba. Mu ntango z'uku kwezi, ELN yariyamirije amakuru yavuga ko ari yo yakoze igitero c'ubwiyahuzi hakoreshejwe ibibombe bitezwe mu modoka kw'ikambi ya gisirikare iri ahitwa Cúcuta. Ico gitero cakomerekeyemwo abantu 36, harimwo n'abahanuzi ba gisirikare b'abanyamerika.

headline: Marie-Louise Sibazuri: "Amasezerano y'ubumwe bw'Abarundi yaragize ico amara"
text: Uno munsi mu Burundi wari umunsi w'akaruhuko hibukwa imyaka 30 iheze hemejwe amasezerano y'ubumwe bw'Abarundi yari afise intumbero yo kurangiza indyane zishingiye ku bwoko, intara na politike. Ayo masezerano yashitsweko hamaze kuba ubwicanyi i Ntega na Marangara mu 1988. Ayo maseserano yemejwe itariki 05/02/1991, ni kimwe mu nkingi zigize ibwirizwa shingiro ry'u Burundi. Ariko kuva ico gihe ayo masezerano ntiyabujije ko izo ndyane ziguma zigaruka mu gihugu mu myaka yayakurikiye. Umwe mu bari mu mugwi wateguye ayo masezerano ni Madame Marie-Louise Sibazuri, azwi cane nk'umuhinga mu kwandika ivyese, ubu aba muri Australia. headline: Igura n'igurishwa ry'abakinyi ku mugabane wa buraya 29.07.2022
text: Everton iriko iravugana na Paris St-Germain kugira igure umukinyi wo hagati wo muri Senegal Idrissa Gueye w'imyaka 32, bikaba vyitezwe ko ivyo biganiro bibandanya mu misi mike iri imbere. (Fabrizio Romano). Marseille kandi yaratanguye ibiganiro vyo kuzana muri uwo mugwi umunye Chili Alexis Sanchez w'imyaka 33 ava muri Inter Milan. (L'Equipe) West Ham irabandanya ibiganiro na Eintracht Frankfurt ku mukinyi wabo w'umunye Serbia Filip Kostic, 29, ashobora gukina inyuma mu bubamfu. headline: ‘Tagadzirira’ . . . bhora ngaritambwe.
text: KUCHANGE kusingadanwe anonzwa svondo rino kunhandare dzinosanganisira National Sports Stadium muHarare, Mandava Stadium (Zvishavane) neBabourfields (Bulawayo) uko zvikwata zvemuPremier Soccer League zvichatatsurana mumutambo weChibuku Super Cup.   Iyi ichave mitambo yekutanga yezvikwata izvi kubva pakamiswa mitambo yose munaKurume gore rapera nechinangwa chekudzivirira kupararira kwechirwere cheCovid-19.   Svondo rino, Kwayedza yakaita hurukuro nevarairidzi vezvikwata zvakasiyana avo vakarakidza mufaro mukuru nekudzoka kwenhabvu.   Murairidzi weFC Platimun, shasha dzePSL, Norman Mapeza anoti nguva yanga yareba vatambi vakangogara.    Mapeza   “Isu semakore ese tinotambira kuti tihwine uye iye zvino tiri kushanda nesimba kuti tigohwina. Asi tiri kutanga patsva nekuti takashandura zvakawanda kuchikwata chedu, vamwe vatambi vakaenda kukauya vamwe. Saka tichafamba nebhora nekuti tinoziva kuti zvimwe zvikwata zvinoda kusvika patiri,” anodaro Mapedza. FC Platinum kana kuti Pure Platinum Play iri muboka reGroup 4 rine zvikwata zvinoti Ngezi Platinum, Triangle neWhahwa. Murairidzi weDynamos FC – Tonderai “Stanza” Ndiraya – anoti nhabvu yadzoka panguva yakanaka chose. Anoti DeMbare yagara inozivikanwa sechikwata chikuru saka mwaka uno vanoda kurakidza nyika yose kuburikidza nekuhwina mikombe yakawanda.   “Zita rekungoti Dynamos chete ihombe uye zvakawanda zvinotarisirwa kubva kwatiri. Saka isu sechikwata tinovimbisa kuti tichashanda nesimba kuti mwaka uno vatsigiri vedu vagofara tahwina mikombe yakasiyana.   “Asi sezvo tange tave nenguva ndefu takangogara, tinokumbira kuvatsigiri vedu kuti ngavatipe nguva kana tikakundikana tinenge takundikana sezvo vakomana vachiri nengura. Asi ndinofara hangu nekuti tiri kutangirana zvikwata zvose sezvo tose tange takagara nguva ndefu,” anodaro Ndiraya.   DeMbare yakaiswa muboka rine zvikwata zvinoti CAPS United, Henrentals, Harare City neZPC Kariba. Iri ndiro rega boka rine zvikwata zvitanhatu sezvo mamwe ese ane zvikwata zvina.   Kuchiti kuBulawayo, murairidzi weChicken Inn — Joey “Mafero” Antipas — anoti chikwata chake hachisati chambohwina Chibuku Super Cup saka vacharwa semvumba gore rino kuti vatore mukombe uyu. Mafero akatungamira maGamecocks mugore ra2015 kuhwina mukombe wePSL.   “Kudzoka kwenhabvu kunofadza uye tiri kutanga nemukombe weChibuku uyo tisati tambohwina sechikwata saka mwaka uno ticharwa semvumba kuti tiuhwine,” anodaro MaGamecocks ari muboka reGroup 2 rine zvikwata zvinoti Bulawayo City, Bulawayo Chiefs neHighlanders.   KuManicaland, murairidzi wechikwata chichangopinda muPSL cheCranborne Bullets — Nesbert “Yabo” Saruchera — anoti ino ndiyo nguva chikwata chavo yange yakamirira.   “Nguva yatange takamirira yazosvika manje, tange takamirira kwenguva ndefu saka tiri kufara uye takagadzirira kusangana nezvimwe zvikwata tigovarakidza kuti isu tauya tichipisa.   “Mumutambo weChibuku Super Cup, vamwe vari muboka redu ngavazive kuti isu tatobudirira kufambira mberi mumutambo uyu. Hatina kupinda kuzozadzikisa mazita kwete asi tinoda kutaridza nyika kuti nhabvu iyi tinotoiziva,” anodaro Saruchera. headline: Nhabvu yevechidiki yosimudzirwa
text: SHASHA dzakambonetsa munhabvu – Godfrey ‘Goda’ Moyo naBeavan Chikaka – vobatana mukusimudzira vatambi vechidiki izvo zviri kuvaona vachirairidza chikwata chePrime Rangers Soccer Academy.   Goda, sekuzivikanwa kwaanonyanya kuitwa munhabvu, akatambira zvikwata zvinoti Motor Action, Lengthens neShooting Stars kuchiti Chikaka akatambira CAPS United, Highlanders, Zimbabwe Saints, Black Rhinos neTafic yekuBotswana.   Vatambi vaviri ava vose pavange vave kunosendeka shangu dzavo dzenhabvu vakasangana kuPrime Rangers FC iyo yaikwikwidza muDivision One uko kunove kwavave kurairidza iye zvino vachibika vatambi vemangwana. Kuchikwata ichi, varairidzi vaviri ava vari kushanda nezvikwata zvemapoka anoti Under-11, 12 ne21.   Muhurukuro neKwayedza svondo radarika pamhemberero dzePrime Rangers Academy apo vaipa mibairo kuvatambi vavo vakadadisa mugore ra2021, Goda anoti akabatana naChikaka nechinangwa chekubika vatambi vechidiki kuti vagokwanisa kusimukira mumutambo uyu.   “Nhabvu yedu kuti ibudirire tisvike kure, tinofanira kubika vechidiki zvakasimba nekudaro ndiko saka ini naChikaka takabatana kuchikwata chePrime Rangers Academy. Ruzivo rwatakawana munhabvu tiri kurwupawo kune vechidiki kuti vagokwanisa kudarika padanho ratakasvika isu,” anodaro Goda.   Anoti nerutsigiro rwavari kuwana kubva kumutungamiri wePrime Rangers, Samuel Horonga, vari kuona chiyedza chikuru zvekuti vane vatambi vakawanda avo vanofunga kuti vanogona kuenda kunotambira kunyika dzakaita seSouth Africa nekuEurope mune remangwana.   “Chishuwo chemutambi wese wenhabvu wemazuva ano kunotambira padanho repamusoro kuEurope kana kuSouth Africa chaiko. Tine vatambi avo tinofunga kuti vanogona kusvika padanho iri zvekuti vakaramba vakangozvininipisa chete vanosvika kure mumutambo uyu,” anodaro.   Chikaka anotiwo chikwata chavo gore rino chichakwikwidza muligi reUnder-21 Challenge League izvo vanovimba kuti zvichabatsira vatambi vavo kuti vagoonekwa nezvikwata zvikuru zvemuno nezvekunze.   “Mwaka uno tiri kuzokwikwidza muUnder-21 Challenge League umo tinovimba kuti muchabatsira vatambi vedu vagoonekwa nezvikwata zvizhinji.   “Ligi iri rakakosha nekuti ndipo panovhurirwa mikana yevatambi vazhinji yekusimukira mumutambo uyu. Masvondo adarika, takakwikwidza kumutambo wekupedzisira wegore uyo takasvika mufainari, matambiro atakaita akafadza zvikuru zvekuti tiri kutarisira kutanga kweChallenge League,” anodaro Chikaka.   Mumutambo weUnder-21 Challenge League, Prime Rangers ichakwikwidza nezvikwata zvinosanganisira Friendly Academy neBN Academy kutanga munaKukadzi.

headline: Nyanzvi dzeHutano Dzofara neKusashaya kweVanhu neCovid-19 muMazuva Manomwe Adarika
text: Bazi rezvehutano rakazivisa nemusi weChina kuti huwandu hwevanhu vafa nechirwere cheCovid-19 hwaramba huri pamazana maviri nemakumi maviri nevana kana kuti 224, sezvo pasina munhu akafa nedenda iri. Izvi zvinoreva kuti kwemazuva manomwe, hapana munhu afa munyika neCovid-19, chiitiko chiri kutambirwa nenyanzvi mune zvehutano dzichiti ichi chiratidzo chekuti matanho ekurwisana nechirwere ichi ari kutorwa nenyika ari kushanda. Huwandu hwevanhu vabatwa nechirwere ichi munyika hwakakwira kusvika pazviuru zvinomwe nemazana matanhatu ane makumi matatu nevatatu, kana kuti 7 633 mushure mekunge vanhu makumi matatu nevashanu kana kuti 35, vawanikwa vaine chirwere ichi. Pavanhu ava vanhu makumi matatu nevaviri kana kuti 32 vagara vari munyika, vaviri vakadoka kubva kuSouth Africa kuchiti mumwe chete ari akadzoka munyika kubva kuNamibia. Vanhu vakanga vapona kubva kucovid-19 kusvika nemusi weChina vanonzi vakanga vasvika pazviuru zvishanu nemazana masere ane makumi mana nemumwe, kana kuti 5 841. Huwandu hwevanhu vachiri kurwara neCovid-19 hwakakwira kuenda pachiuru nemazana mashanu nemakumi matanhatu nevasere, kana kuti 1 568.

headline: Dambudziko Rekushaya Mari muMabhanga Roenderera Mberi muNyika
text: Nyazvi munyaya dzezvehupfumi uye vanhuwo zvavo munyika vari kushora zvikuru vemabhanga uye vemuzvitoro nekuvabhadharisa mari dzemitero kwavari kuita kuti vatore mari dzavo mumabhanga kana kuwana mari muzvitoro. Vanhu vanoti kunze kwekupedza nguva yakareba vari mumitsetse, vave kubhadhara mari inosvika madhora makumi maviri pakutora mari inosvika chiuru chemadhora yavanofanirwa kunge vachitora nemadhora matatu chete. Vanhu ava vanoti vave kumanikidzwa kutora mari inosvika chiuru chemadhora mukati memazuva gumi sezvo vari kukwanisa kutora zana remadhora chete pazuva kubva mumabhanga uye pose pavanotora mari iyi vanobhadhariswa mari. Vezvitoro vanonziwo vari kumanikidza vanhu kuti vatenge zvavanenge vasiri kuda kuti vakwanisewo kuwana mari. Mukuru weBankers Association of Zimbabwe Dr. Charity Jinya vanoti vemabhanga havana zvavangaite pamitero iyi nekuti vashandi vawo vanenge vawandirwawo nebasa. Asi vanhu vataura neStudio 7 vanoti vave kupedza nguva yakareba yavanofanirwa kunge vachishanda vakaforera mari. Kunyangwe zvazvo mukuru webhanga renyika VaJohn Mangudya vakati mabhanga ape vanhu mari inosvika chiuru chemadhora pazuva, Amai Esther Samson vati chino nyanyovashungurudza kutadza kupiwa mari yakatemerwa iyi. “Kubvira last week tichingotora mari tichipiwa ma$200. Ndasvika na 7am kuzopiwa $200 iyoyo kuma past 3 pm kuno apa unenge wanzwa nenzara. Izvozvi ndatozotenga nartjie apo ndiro randadya pano. Tiri kuswera pano nenzara. Mari iri kunetsa” Amai Samson vanodaro. Mumwe zvakare ange akaforera mari pabhanga reCABS ndaVaMagodo Bangwayo, avo vati vari kurasikirwa nenguva yekunge vachibata mabasa panguva iyo vanhu vazhinji vari kurarama nekubata mabasa emaoko nekuda kwekusawanikwa kwemabasa. “Cash iri kunetsa, unogona kumira panapa 3 hours uchinzi mari hapana. Ndasvika kuma 11am asi ndiri kutobva kuwana mari ikozvino. Queue yanga yakasvika ukoko, vachimbopinza six six, kusvika vaapa 15 kusvika tazonzi tese kuma past 3 pm,” VaBangwayo vadaro. VaJack Kavero vaudzawo Studio 7 kuti kumichina kana kuti maATM vanhu havasi kukwanisa kutora mari sezvo musina mari. Vatiwo mumabhanga vari kungoudzwa kuti hakuna mari. Vati zvinovashungurudza zvikuru kuti vanobuda ziya kushanda vobudazve ziya kutora mari yavo kubhanga. No media source currently available Zvichakadaro, sangano rinomirira varairidzi reZimbabwe Teachers Association, Zimta, rati dambudziko remari kumabhanga riri kukanganisawo zvikuru mashandiro evarairidzi, sezvo vari kuzomanikidzwa kupedza nguva vari mumitsetse vachiedza kutora mari. Mukuru weZimta, VaSifiso Ndlovu vati nemhaka yekuti mabhanga haasi kukwanisa kupa vanhu mari dzavanoda pazuva, varairidzi vazhinji vari kukundikana kubhadhara zvikwereti pamwe nemitero yepavanogara. “Varairidzi vari kutarisira kutambira mari dzavo dzemihoro mangwana, ndinoona vazhinji vavo vachi kundikana kudzokera kumabasa kwavo vatadza kuwana mari dzavo.” VaNdlovu vati vane hurongwa hwekumbogara pasi nevatungamiri vezvemari kuti vanzwe kuti dambudziko iri richapera riini. Vanoti nyika inofanirwawo kusimbisa kurudziro yekuti vanhu vashandise makadhi ekumabhanga sezviri kuitwa mune dzimwe nyika dzakapoteredza. “Tinofanirwa kusiyana netsika yekungoshandisa mari chete, toshandisawo zvimwe zvakaita sema credit card kana digital money,” VaNdlovu vadaro. headline: Kambani yeKwese TV Inopihwa Rezenisi Kuti Itepfenyure paDandemutande
text: Sangano reZimbabwe Institute of Southern Africa-Zimbabwe rinoti rinotambira nemufaro kupihwa kwemarezenisi matatu ekutepfenyura padandemutande kuKwese TV neBroadcasting Authority of Zimbabwe asi richiti chinodihwa kusunungura masaisai kuti vanhu vakwanise kutepfenyura mateverevhizheni pamwe nemaredhiyoemumatunhu. Kambani yeEconet, muridzi weKwese TV, yakazivisa neChina kuti yainge yapihwa marezenisi matatu ekutepfeunyura padandemutande. Nhengo yebhodhi remaTrustees eMISA Zimbabwe, VaChris Chinaka, vaudza Studio 7 kuti kunyange hazvo vachitambire zvose zvinovandzudza kufambiswa kwemashoko, BAZ haisati yatanga kuburitsa marezenisi avanonyanyoda. Mukuru weMISA Zimbabwe, VaTabani Moyo, vati marezenisi apihwa Kwese TV ndeemakambani anoita zvemabhizimisi uye ivo vanoda marezenisi eFrequency Modulation ayo anoita kuti veruzhinji vawane mashoko nemutengo uri pasi. Vatiwo ivo marezenisi apihwa Kwese TV anodhura zvakanyaya sezvo achiita madhora zviuru makumi mashanu pagore uye rezenesi racho rinoti zvikamu makumi maviri kubva muzana zvemari inenge yawanikwa nekambani yacho, zviendeswe kuBAZ pagore rega rega. VaMoyo vati chinodiwa kusunungura mitemo yezvekutepfenyura kuti pavhurwe mateverevhizheni nemaredhiyo akawanda munyika. VaChinaka vatiwo zvakakosha kuti hurumende ivandudzwe mabasa enhau nekutepfenyura vachiti izvi ndizvo zvisumudzira mabasa ebudiriro munyika. Vatiwo hurumende haifaniri kuona sekuti iri kuitira vatapi venhau dzvene vachiti ibasa rehurumende kuona kuti vanhu vawana mashoko nenhau dzavanoda. Hatina kukwanisa kunzwa divi reEconet panyaya iyi sezvo vange vasati vapindura mibvunzo yedu pataenda pamhepo. Hatinawo kunzwa kubva kune vBAZ kuti makambani mangani akanyorera kuti apihwe marezenisi akaita seakapihwa kuKwese TV. No media source currently available

headline: VaMangudya Vokurudzirwa Kuzadzikisa Zvavanotaura paKufambisa Mari
text: Gavhuna weReserve Bank of Zimbabwe, VaJohn Mangudy,a neChishanu vakaparura hurongwa hwavo hwepagore hwekushandiswa kwemari. Kunyange nyanzvi munyaya dzezvehupfumi dzakawanda dziri kutambira hurongwa uyu, vakawanda vanoti panoda garwa rakajeka kuitira kuti hupfumi hugadzirike. Chinangwa chaVaMangudya ndechekusimbaradza dhora remunyika range roramba richishaya simba. Kunyange hazvo vakawanda vachiti Zimbabwe ikazvipira inokwanisa kubuda mumadhaka mairi munyaya dzezvehupfumi, vamwe vanoti nyika inenge huku yemurombo inokandirira mazai mumuti. Nyanzvi munyaya dzezvehupfumi inodzidzisa paDurban University of Technology, Muzvinafundo Gift Mugano, vanoti pane zvakanaka nezvekaipa pane zvakaparurwa nmaVaMangudya. VaMugano vati hurongwa hwavo hwekusimbaradza musika wekutengeswa kwemari wakanaka sezvo uchiunza kugadzikana munyika. Asi vati havatenderane nehurongwa hwekuomesera makambani enharembozha anoitawo mamwe mabasa anoitwa nemabhanga akaita seEconent neNet One kuti asashande semabhanga achiwanisa vanhu mari. Vati kushomeka kwemari munyika uye kushaya simba kwedhora remunyika kunopa kuti zviomere veruzhinji. Vatiwo vari kumamisha vapinda panguva yakaoma Asi nyanzvi munyaya dzezvemabhanga, VaGilbert Muponda, vanoti vanotambira hurongwa hwekuomesera makambani enharembozha vachiti ange okurudzira kutengeswa kwemari pamukoto zvange zvokanganisa hupfumi hwenyika. Asi VaMuponda vatiwo zvakakosha kusimbaradza nyaya yekurima senzira yekusimbaradza hupfumi vachiti nyika iri kupedza mari yekunze yakawanda ichitenga zvinhu zvinogona kurimwa kana kugadzirwa munyika. Imwe nyanzvi munyaya dzezvepfumi, VaVictor Bhoroma, vanoti hurongwa hwakaparurwa naVaMangudya hwakanaka vachiti zvikashanda zvichapa kuti mitengo yezvinhu iderere asi ndokunge hurumende yasimbaradza nyaya yekugadzira zvinhu zvekutengesa kunze kwenyika. VaBhoroma vatiwo pane zvimwe zvinoda kuitwa kuti vanhu vave nechivimbo nehurongwa hweRBZ uhu vachiti chitsvambe chiri kbhanga iri kuti riratidze kuti rinoshandisa mari yekunze zvisina huori. Zimbabwe yakatarisana nematambudziko makukutu munyaya dzezvehupfumi kusanganisira kushaikwa kwemari, magetsi, mvura nezvimwe. Matambudziko aya awedzerwawo nenyaya yechirwere cheCovid-19 icho charura pasi rose. No media source currently available

headline: Zimbabwe Inovharwa kweMasvondo Matatu Kutanga neMuvhuro
text: Zimbabwe inoti ichange isingachabvumidze vanhu kubuda mudzimba dzavo kutanga nemusi weMuvhuro senzira yekuyedza kumisa kupararira kwaita chirwere cheCoronavirus pasi rose. Vachitaura neChishanu manheru pamusoro pematanho atorwa nehurumende yavo, mutungamiri wenyika, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, vati vanhu vachange vachigara kudzimba dzavo kwemasvondo matatu kutanga neMuvhuro senzira yekudzivirira chirwere chiri kuita chamurambamhuru chichibata vanhu pasi rose. Chirwere ichi chabata vanhu vanodarika mazana mashanu nemakumi matatu ezviuru kubva zvachaputika kuChina gore rapera, uye vanhu vanodarika makumi mana ezviuru, vafa pasi rose, kusanganisira Zororo Makamba, uyo akashaya neMuvhuro muZimbabwe. VaMnangagwa vati vashandi vemuzvipatara pamwe nevashandi vehurumende ndivo chete vachange vachibvumidzwa kuenda kumabasa avo. VaMnangagwa vati vose vanotengesa zvinhu mumigwagwa vachange vasingabvumirwe kuita izvi kwemazuva makumi maviri nerimwe, zvitoro zvichange zvichivhurwa kwemaawa mana pazuva; madutavanhu ose achange asingabvumidzwe kutakura vanhu kunze kweZupco chete. Zvitoro zvinobvumidzwa kuvhura ndezviya zvinotengesa chikafu, mishonga nemamwe mabhizinisi akakosha kuvanhu muhupenyu hwavo nguva dzose. VaMnangagwa vati mauto nemapurisa achange achifamba achiona kuti vanhu vagara kudzimba dzavo. Zimbabwe yakavhara miganhu yayo nemusi weMuvhuro, uye ikabhana kuungana kwevanhu vanodarika makumi mashanu. Vanhu vashanu vabatwa nechirwere cheCoronavirus, kusanganisira Zororo Makamba, uyo akavigwa nemusi weChipiri.

headline: Zim ine tarenda: Songani
text: MUTAMBI wemaWarriors neVestri yekuIceland — Silas Songani — anoti vatambi vemuZimbabwe vane tarenda rinonwisa mvura uye anoshuvira kuona vakawanda vachitambira kuEurope.   Songani pari zvino ari munyika akamirira kudzokera kuIceland uko mwaka mutsva wenhabvu uchazotanga munaChivabvu.   Nhabvu yekuIceland inotanga munaChivabvu, yakasiyana nekune dzimwe nyika dzekuEurope sezvo kunyika iyi panguva ino kunenge kuchitonhora zvikuru.   Muhurukuro neKwayedza svondo rino, Songani anoti munyika muno mune vatambi vakawanda vane tarenda rekutamba nhabvu.   “MuZimbabwe tine vatambi vakawanda vanotamba nhabvu zvinonwisa mvura zvekuti vanotokwana kuzvikwata zvakawanda zviri kuEurope. Asi nekuda kwezvirango zvatakatemerwa neFIFA pamwe neCAF, zviri kutidzorera kumashure, dai nyaya iyi yagadziriswa nekuchimbidza.   “Sevatambi venhabvu, tikanotambirawo kunze kwenyika ndipo patinowanawo mari yekuchengeta nemhuri dzedu.   Muno zvikwata zvishoma zvinobhadhara, ndiko saka mutambi wese wenhabvu achishuvira kuenda kunze kwenyika.   “Manje kana takavharirwa sezvatakaitwa izvi, vatambi vakawanda vanopedzisira vaora mwoyo nekuti vakomana vanenge vane nzara, vamwe vavo vozopedzisira vamedzwa nezvinodhaka.   “Ngatikoshesei hupenyu neremangwana revatambi venhabvu,” anodaro.   Songani ave makore anodarika manomwe achitambira nhabvu yake kuEurope uko akambotambira kuDenmark kwenguva refu ari kuzvikwata zvakaita seSønderjyskE, Sydvest 05 neElverum.   Anoti vamiriri vevatambi vemuno ngavave vanhu vakavimbika vanomirira kodzero dzavo vovatsvagira zvikwata chaizvo zvekutambira kwete kukoshesa mari.   Songani anoti vatambi vazhinji tarenda ravo rakakanganiswa nevamiriri vavo avo vaivavimbisa zvinhu zvakawanda zvisina kuzoitika.   “Vamiriri vevatambi venhabvu ngavasanyepere vapfana nekuvavimbisa zvinhu zvisipo nekuti vanokonzeresa kuti vasvike pakuramwa nhabvu nekuda kwenhema dzavo zhinji.   “Mutambi wenhabvu munhu anoda kuraramisa mhuri yake nekuchengeta vabereki vake, asi manje kana muchivanyepera munenge muchitouraya remangwana rake.   “Ini ndakaita rombo rakanaka rekuti ndakashanda naMore Moyo mumiriri wangu uyo aikoshesa remangwana rangu.   Kune vaimbouya kwandiri vachindivimbisa zvinhu zvakawanda, asi ndakaramba ndakamira panaMoyo nekuti ndinoziva kwandakabva naye,” anodaro.   Songani kunyangwe hake akatambira kuEurope kwemakore akawanda, mutambi uyu haana kunyatsowana mukana wakakura wekutambira chikwata chenyika chemaWarriors sezvo akangokwanisa kutamba ka11 chete.   “Mutambi wenhabvu ishuviro yake kutambira nyika yake mitambo yakawanda, ini ndakakomborerwa kuti ndakatambira nyika yangu ka11 asi ndaidawo chaizvo kuitambira kakawanda.   “Varairidzi vairairidza chikwata chenyika ndivo vanoziva kuti sei vasina kundishevedza kakawanda uyewo ini handina daka nazvo nekuti pakupedzisira sechizvarwa chemuno, ndinoda kuona nyika yangu ichibudirira mumutambo wenhabvu ichisvika kure,” anodaro.   Songani anoenderera achiti: “Kana tave kutenderwa kutamba nhabvu senyika, ndichashanda nesimba kuti ndishevedzwe ndizotambira nyika yangu zvekare.”   Mutambi uyu anorumbidza zvikuru Norman Mapeza uyo waakashanda naye kuFC Platinum panguva yaakambodzoka kuzotambira nhabvu yake muno achibva kuDenmark asati aenda kuIceland.   Anoti Mapeza akamubika patsva zvekuti akashamisika kunzwa kuti atengwa neVestri yekuIceland.   “Mapeza ndinomurumbidza zvikuru nekuti akandibika patsva izvo zvakazozarura mukana wekuti ndiende kuIceland. Iye Mapeza pachake akatoshamisika kuti ndave kudzokera kuEurope akandikurudzira kuti ndishandise mukana uyu nemazvo wandakawana apo ndakatengwa neVestri,” anodaro.   Songani, uyo akambotambira Harare City neFC Platinum, ave nemakore 33 ekuberekwa uye anoti ave kutanga kuita gadziriro dzekusendeka shangu dzake dzekutamba nhabvu.   Anoti kana akasiya kutamba nhabvu, anoda kuzoita zvesports management.   “Nekugara kwandaita kuEurope, ndave kuzivana nevanhu vakawanda ikoko saka ndinoda kuvhurira mikana vatambi vakawanda vagouya kuzotambirawo nhabvu yavo kuEurope.   “Mikana yandakawana, ndinoda kuti vamwe vaiwanewo zvibatsire kuti nhabvu yedu munyika isimukire,” anodaro.

headline: Vakawanda muNyika Voisa Tarisiro paHurumende Ichaumbwa naVaMnangagwa
text: Vanhu vakawanda vanoti vane tarisiro yekuti zvinhu zvichanaka nekukurumidza munyika zvichitevera kugadzwa kwakaitwa VaEmmerson Mnangagwa semutungamiri wenyika mutsva. Vakawanda vevanhu ava vanoti dambudziko guru ranga ratarisana nenyika hutongi hwevaimbove mutungamiri wenyika VaRobert Mugabe, hwavanoti veruzhinji kusanganisira dzimwe nyika, vainge vasisina chivimbo nahwo. Kunyange vashandi vemumakanzuru akawanda vainge vasisatambire mari dzemihoro, vanhu vachitadza kuwana mari dzavo kumabhangi ukuwo vashandi vehurumende vainge vasisazive zuva ravanotambira mari yavo zvairatidza kuti hurumende yakangaisina hurongwa hwekupedza matambudziko munyika nechimbichimbi. Mumwe mushandi wekanzuru yeKariba, VaFish Mucheza, avo vanoti vave negore nemwedzi mitatu vasingatambire, vane tarisiro yekuti vave kuzohora nekuda kwehutungamiri hutsva. Mumwe mugari wemuChinhoyi, VaPanashe Tsomondo, avo vane bhizinisi rekutengesa midziyo yekuvakisa, vanoti vari kutarisira kupera kwedambudziko rekushayikwa kwemari kumabhangi. Mumwe mugari wekuAlaska VaEdmore Mazarure vanotiwo vanhu vachanyatsoona kusiyana kwaVaMnangagwa naVaMugabe nekufambiswa kwesarudzo munyika. VaMazarure vanoti nyika ine nhorowondo yekusafambiswa zvakanaka kwesarudzo nekudaro vanhu vakawanda vakatarisira shanduko pamabatirwo esarudzo, kubvira mukutsvaga rutsigiro, kana kuti ku campaigner, kusvika mukuburitswa kwezvinenge zvabuda musarudzo, kana kuti ma results. Vanoona nezvematongerwo enyika muChinhoyi VaJohn Marava vanoti vanhu vave netariro yakakura munaVaMnangagwa nekuti ivo nemauto vakakwanisa kubvisa VaMugabe pachigaro izvo zvaidiwa neveruzhinji munyika zvinova zvakatadza kuitwa nemapato ezvematongerwo enyika akaita seMDC-T inotungamirwa naVaMorgan Tsvangirai. VaMarava vanoti kuperera kwaVaMnangagwa mubasa rekushandura hurumende kuchatanga kuonekwa pavachasarudza makurukota avo svondo rino. Nekuda kwekuparara kwezvinhu zvakawanda munyika zvinosanganisira hupfumi hwenyika, kushayikwa kwemabasa,kuparara kwezvivakwa nemigwagwa pamwe nenzara yanga yatekeshera munyika, vamwe vanoti VaMunangagwa vane mutoro wakakura nyika isati yaenda kusarudzo gore rinouya. Asi vamwe vanoti VaMnangagwa vanofanira kupihwa mukana sezvo vatanga basa ravo zvakanaka nekushamwaridzana nenyika dzaivengwa naVaMugabe dzakaita seBritain neAmerica uye vanozivikanwa kuti vakatungamira chirongwa chemaguta, che Command Agriculture, zvakanaka gore rapera, izvo zvakapa varimi vakawanda goho rakawanda. headline: Kanzuru yeChinhoyi Yotsamwisa Vatyairi veDzimotokari
text: Vazhinji vataura neStudio7 muChinhoyi vanoti nguva dzakawanda vanosungirwa kusapaka motokari zvakanaka vachiti panenge pasina mitsetse yakajeka pavanopaka motokari dzavo. Mumwe anetsana nemapurisa nhasi ndiMuzvare Agnes Chiwoko avo vanogara nekushanda kuSouth Africa. Muzvare Chiwoko vati pavamisa motokari yavo panga pasina mitsetse yanga yakajeka izvo zvaita kuti vabhadhariswe madhora makumi mashanu nematatu. Muzvare Chiwoko vati vashandi vekanzuru vari kuita huori vachiti vanoda kusunga motokari dzine manhamba ekune dzimwe nyika kuitira kuti vapihwe mari yechioko muhomwe. Mumwe mutyairi wemotokari inotakura veruzhinji, VaTom Mbire, vati kanzuru inofanirwa kugadzirisa pekumisa motokari vasati vaita shave rekutora mari. VaAndrew Chisi vatiwo nzvimbo dzekumisa motokari iduku zvakanyanya uye mutsetse yacho haiwoneke vachiti nguva yavanopihwa kuti vamise motokari dzavo ipfupi padhora rimwechete paawa. Mutauriri wekanzuru yeChinhoyi, VaTichaona Mlauzi, vati mapurisa ari kunzi ndeekanzuru haasi, vakati kanzuru yakapa basa iri kukambani yakazvimirira yeClina Investment. Asi VaMlauzi vati vachaongorora zvichemo zvevanhu sezvo kubata basa kwakaipa kwekambani iyi kuchisvibisa zita rekanzuru. Hatina kunzwa divi rekambani yeClina Investment sezvo mukuru wavo, VaBrian Michels, vanga vasinga davire nharembozha yavo. No media source currently available

headline: MDC Alliance neZanu PF Dzotatsurana paNyaya yeSarudzo neKuvandudzwa kweMitemo
text: Nyika yave kuziva kuti sarudzo dzekutsiva nhengo dzeparamende pamwe nemakanzuru dzakadzingwa kana kushaya, dzema by-election, dzave kuzoitwa muna Kurume wegore rinouya zvichitevera kuziviswa kwakaitwa nezuro nemutungamiri wenyika, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, vachitaura vari kumusangano wePolitiburo yebato ravo reZanu PF. Asi VaMnangagwa vakabuda pachena kuti hapanazve kuvandudzwa kuchaitwa mitemo ine chekuita nesarudzo, vachiti mudunhu reSADC rose Zimbabwe yakaisa kare mitemo yose ine chekuita nesarudzo mubumbiro remitemo yenyika. Ukuwo, mamwe mapato anopikisa anosanganisira reMDC Alliance rinotungamirwa naVaNelson Chamisa, anga achiti hurumende yakanga isingade kuita sarudzo dzema by-elections idzi ichihwanda nedenda reCOVID-19. Mutevedzeri wemunyori anoona nezvesarudzo muMDC-Alliance, Muzvare Ellen Shiriyedenga, vanoti sebato vagarawo vachiti mitemo yakawanda inobata sarudzo inofanirwa kuvandudzwa sezvakakurudzirwa nemasangano pamwe nemapoka akaongorora sarudzo dza2018 munyika. Muzvare Shiriyedenga vanotiwo zvakare komisheni inoona nezvesarudzo munyika yeZimbabwe Electoral Commission, ZEC, inofanirwa kunge yakazvimirira pasina kupindira kwehurumende kana bato reZanu PF sezvavanoti zviri kuitika pari zvino. Asi mumwe wevechidiki veZanu PF mudunhu reHarare, VaAlex Gakanje, vanoti zvese zviri kutaurwa nemapato anopikisa kusanganisira MDC Alliance izvi kutungana kwembudzi sezvo zviri kubva kumapato ari kutya kupinda musarudzo nekuziva kuti anokundwa neZanu PF. VaGakanje vanoti hapana asingazive kuti sarudzo dzema by-election dzakamanikidzwa kusendekwa parutivi nekuda kwedenda reCovid-19, vachiti Zimbabwe haifanirwe kumanikidzwa kuita sarudzo ichiisa hupenyu hwevanhu panjodzi sezviri kuonekwa kune dzimwe nyika dzakaita masarudzo, uko denda reCovid-19 rakakwira.
