headline: Varairidzi, VanaChiremba, naVanaMukoti Voramwa Mabasa
text: Sangano rinomirira vadzidzisi vekumaruwa reAmalgamated Rural Teachers Union of Zimbabwe kana kuti ARTUZ rinoti nhengo dzaro zhinji hadzina kuenda kumabasa nhasi zvichitevera kurudziro yesangano iri yekuti varairidzi vasaende kumabasa vachitsutsumwa kuhurumende nemari dzemihoro. ARTUZ inoti nhengo dzayo dzakawanda nhasi dzaswera dzichidziya mushana kudzimba dzisiri pabasa zvichitevera kurudziro yesangano iri yekuti nhengo dzaro dziramwe mabasa kubva nhasi kusvika neChishanu nepamusana pekushomeka kwemari dzemihoro dzavari kutambiriswa nehurumende. Sachigaro weARTUZ mudunhu reHarare, VaMunyaradzi Masiyiwa vaudza Studio 7 kuti vadzidzisi vasina kuenda kumabasa nhasi vanodarika zvikamu makumi mana kubva muzana. Mutungamiri weARTUZ, VaObert Masaraure vatiwo vachatora matanho akasimbarara kana hurumende ikaramba yakaisa zvimiti munzeve isiri kuda kuvabhadhara nemadhora ekuAmerica. Zvichakadai, mumwe mubereki ane mwana anodzidza pane chimwe chikoro chiri kuGoromonzi mudunhu reMashonaland East, Amai Tinotenda Kahari, vaudza Studio 7 kuti hurumende inofanira kugadzirisa nhuna dzevarairidzi nekukasika kuitira kuti vana vasarasikirwe nedzidzo. Zvichakadai, mutungamiri werimwe sangano revadzidzisi reProgressive Teachers Union of Zimbabwe, VaTakavafira Zhou, vati nhengo dzesangano ravo dzichatangawo kuramwa mabasa svondo rinouya. VaZhou vati sePTUZ vachataurawo nevemamwe masangano anomirira vashandi vose vehurumende kuti vaite muonerapamwe sechuma chemuzukuru. Mutungamiri weZIMTA VaRichard Gundani vanotiwo havasi kufara nemari dzavari kutambiriswa. Zvichakadai, gurukota rezvedzidzo, VaPaul Mavhima vaudza Studio 7 parunhare kuti homwe yehurumende yakabooka zvekuti hurumende haikwanise kubhadhara varairidzi nemari yekunze kana kuvawedzera maRTGS parizvino. Vati zvakawanda zvine chekuita nekuwedzerwa kwemari dzemihoro yevashandi vehurumende tibvunze kugurukota rezvemari VaMthuli Ncube avo vatisina kukwanisa kubata panharembozha yavo. Mutauriri weHealth Apex Council VaPanganai Chivese vanoti vanachiremba, vanamukoti nevamwe vashandi vehurumende vatotanga kuramwa mabasa nezuro. Vati vashandi vakawirirana kuenda kumabasa kaviri pazuva asi vachiita zvekuchinjana. Vayambira kuti hurumende ikasagadzirisa zvichemo zvavo havasi kuenda kubasa vose svondo rinouya. Vati health Services Board iyo tisina kubata yati hurumende yakanzwa chichemo chavo uye iri kuyedza kuchigadzirisa. Sangano rinomirira vashandi munyika reZimbabwe Congress of Trade Unions kana kuti ZCTU rinoti mushandi anotambira mari iri pasipasi anofanira kutambiriswa mazana matanhatu emadhora ekuAmerica sezvo zvinhu zviri kuramba zvichiwedzerwa mutengo muyika. headline: VaTrump Voraswa neMamwe Maseneta eBato Ravo
text: Zvinhu hazvina kumirira zvakanaka kumutungamiri weAmerica, VaDonald Trump, zvichitevera mashoko nezviri kuitwa nevanhu vebato ravo, reRepublican Party, muparamende yeAmerica. Bepanhau reNew York Times rinoti mutungamiri wenhengo dzedare reSenate, dze Republican Party, VaMitch Mcconnell, vaudza bepanhau iri kuti VaTrump vakapara mhosva dzinofanirwa kutongwa. Svondo rapera, vatsigiri vaVaTrump vakapinda zvechisimba mudare reCongress yeAmerica vakapwanya misuwo, mahwindo, matafura nemacheya vachitsvaka mutevedzeri waVaTrump, VaMike Pence, pamwe chete nenhengo dzeparamende idzo dzakazvivharira mune dzimwe dzimba dzikavanda pasi pamatafura. Vamamwe vatsigiri vaVaTrump vanoti zvinotaurwa nemukuru wavo zvekuti sarudzo dzakabirwa ndezvechokwadi. Imwe nhengo yedare reSenate, Amai Liz Cheney, vakati nhasi Chitatu, vachavhota kuti VaTrump vatongwe neparamende pamusoro pemhosva dzavanonzi vakapara mukukurudzira vatsigiri vavo kuti vakonzere mhirizhonga paCapital Hill nemusi weChitatu pakafa vanhu vashanu. VaTrump vari kuramba vachiti vakabirwa musarudzo yemutungamiri wenyika kunyange hazvo matare edzimhosva makumi matanhatu akarasa zvichemo zvaVaTrump achiti hapana humbowo hunoratidza kuti sarudzo yakabirwa. Nyanzvi mune zvematongerwo enyika vari mugari wemu Washington D.C. Doctor Frenk Guni, vanoti zvinhu hazvina kumira zvakanaka mubato raVaTrump sezvo makambani mazhinji abuda pachena achiti haachapi mari kunhengo dzebato iri dzakakwikwidza kuti VaJoe Biden vakasarudzwa nevanhu pasina kubirirwa kwakaitwa. Makambani eSocial Media mazhinji, anosanganisa Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, Google nemamwe akavhara kuti VaTrump vasashandisa madandemutande awo. Doctor Guni vanoti mapurisa ari kushanda zvine simba kuitira kuti pakugadzwa nemusi weChitatu kwaVa Biden, pasave nebongozozo serakaonekwa svondo rapera. No media source currently available

headline: Vanhu Vofarira Hurongwa Hunokweretesa Mari Midziyo Ichiitwa Chibatiso
text: Vemabhizinesi madiki nemamwe achiri kusimukira vanoti vari kufara nechirongwa chebhanga guru renyika chekuti vakwanise kukwereta mari vachishandisa midziyo yavo sechibatiso. Izvi zvabuda pamusangano wezuva rimwe chete wapindwa nevamabhizinesi madiki uyo waitirwa kwaMutare. Vachitaura mushure memusangano uyu, mumwe muzvinabhizinesi, VaSondon Mugaradzoko, vati danho riri kutorwa nebhanga guru renyika richishanda nesangano reZimbabwe Association of Micro Finance Institutions, Zamfi, richabatsira zvikuru, sezvo mabhanga mazhinji achiomesera mabhizinesi madiki kana achida kukwereta mari kumabhanga aya. Mumwe apindawo mumusangano uyu, VaPeter Mavhiri, vatiwo kushandiswa kwezvipfuyo kunopa kuti vekumaruwa vakwanise kukwereta sezvo vasina maTitle Deeds pazvivakwa zvavo. Mukuru we Zamfi, Va Godfrey Chitambo, vanoti sangano ravo, iro rine nhengo zana neshanu, rakatanga hurongwa uhu mushure mekunge raona matambudziko ari kusangana nevemabhizinesi madiki ekuti vawane mari yekusimudzira mabasa avo apo vanenge vasina zvibatiso zvinodikanwa. Mumiriri webhanga guru renyika pamusangano uyu, Amai Grace Chiromo, vati kurerutsa kuwanikwa kwezvikwereti kuchapa budiriro munyika. Vatiwo vari mushishi kuti pave nemutemo wekutambira zvibatiso zvitsva izvi kuitira kuti zvicherechedzwe pazvibvumirano zvekukweretesana. Vanhu vangangosvika makumi manomwe vapinda mumusangano uyu, uye mumwe musangano wakadai uchaitwa kuMasvingo neBulawayo svondo rinouya. No media source currently available

headline: Take Money orongera Munoz
text: SHASHA yetsiva yeWorld Boxing Council (WBC) Female Super-bantamweight – Kudakwashe ‘Take Money’ Chiwandire – oenda kuSouth Africa kunosimbaradza gadziriro dzemutambo waakatarisana nawo naZulina Munoz wekuMexico.   Svondo radarika, Take Money akapihwa rutsigiro nekambani yeKGK Logistics iyo iri kumubhadharira mari yendege kuenda kuSouth Africa nepekugara panguva yaanenge achiita gadziriro dzake kunyika iyi.   Take Money naMunoz vari kutarisirwa kurwa nemusi wa27 Nyamavhuvhu kuHarare International Conference Centre (HICC).   Chiwandire anoti rubatsiro rwaakapihwa rwekuti aende kuSouth Africa kunoita gadziriro dzake ruchabatsira zvikuru uye ndokupa chivimbiso chekuti achashanda nesimba kuti agochengetedza bhande rake.   “Handina neremuromo, asi kungotenda chete masangano ese ari kuuya achindibatsira mugadziriro dzangu ndakatarisana nemutambo wangu mukuru uri kutevera naZulina Munoz.   “Zvakandikoshera zvikuru kuona ndichirangarirwa uye ndinofara chaizvo nekuti kusimudzirwa kwemwanasikana.   Saka ndinopa kutenda kukuru nerutsigiro urwu, dai zvikaramba zvakadaro.   “Ndinovimbisa kuti ndichashanda nesimba kuti bhande rangu randinaro rirambe riri muno risabude, mureza wenyika yedu yeZimbabwe urambe uchisimudzirwa,” anodaro Take Money.   Murairidzi pamwe namaneja wake – Clyde Musonda – anoti vakaronga mitambo yehushamwari yakawanda iyo Chiwandire achanotamba kuSouth Africa nevatambi veko izvo zvichamubatsira zvikuru mugadziriro dzake.   Anoti kuenda naChiwandire kunze kwenyika kunoita gadziriro kunopa mutambi uyu nguva yekuti angofunge zvegadziriro dzake pasina zvimwe zvinomukanganisa.   “Tangosarirwa nemwedzi mumwe chete kuti mutambo uchisvika. Saka zvakakosha kuti nguva yatiri ino Take Money anyatsoita gadziriro dzake munzvimbo yakasununguka isina chinomukanganisa.   “Naizvozvo tinotenda hama dzedu dzatibatsira kuti tigoenda kuSouth Africa uko tichanoita gadziriro dzedu kusvika tidzoke kuzosangana naMunoz. Takaronga mitambo yakawanda ichaona Take Money achisangana nevatambi vetsiva vekuSouth Africa vakasiyana izvo zvichibatsira gadziriro dzake.   “Munoz tinomuziva kuti ishasha asi isu tichamurakidzawo kuti Chiwandire ishashawo zvekare uye bhande redu harisi kuzobva muno, richasara muno,” anodaro Musonda.   Chiwandire akahwina bhande reWBC Female Interim Super-bantamweight mushure mekukunda Cathrine Phiri wekuZambia mwedzi yadarika.   Izvi zvakabva zvaona vatambi vakawanda vekunyika dzakasiyana vachida kusangana naye kusvika iye nechikwata chake vazosarudza Munoz.   Akakunda Munoz, anenge ave kukwanisa kuenderera mberi mumutambo uyu opihwa mukana wekurwira bhande reWBC Super Bantamweight Gold iro rina Yamileth Mercado wekuMexico zvakare.

headline: Vane Vana Matsi Vonetsekena neZvikwanisiro
text: Vabereki vane vana vane hurema hwekusanzwa kana kuti matsi vari kukurudzira bazi rezvehutano kuti rivabatsire nezvikwanisiro, kana kuti hearing aids, kuitira kuti vana vavo vakwanisewo kudzidza sevamwe vana muzvikoro pasina dambudziko. Vabereki vakawanda vanoti kuongororwa kwevanhu vane hurema hwekusanzwa kunodhura zvokuti vazhinji vavo havakwanise kuendesa vana vavo kunaana chiremba kuti vanorapwa hurwere uhwu husati hwakomba. Amai Tsitsi Nlabati vekuMasvingo vanoti mwana wavo, uyo anemakore mapfumbamwe, anonzwira kure mazwi anotaurwa zvokuti vakashaya mari yokutenga ma hearing aids izvo zviri kudzosera kumashure budiriro yehupenyu hwemwana wavo. Amai Nlabati vanoti vakavimbiswa nenyanzvi munyaya dzezvehutano kuti mwana wavo aisafanira kuenda kuzvikoro zvinodzidza vana vanorarama nehurema nokuti vainge vaine chivimbo chekuti mwana aizokwanisa kuita zvakanaka kana akatengerwa ma hearing aids. Baba Kizito Chirenje vekuMurombedzi, kwaZvimba vanoti vane dambudziko zvakare remwana wavo uyo akambotengerwa ma hearing aids neimwe hama yavo yakambogara mhiri yemakungwa asi akadimburwa dimburwa kaviri kose nevamwe vana vaida kuziva kuti chii chaaipfekera munzeve. Baba Chirenje vanoti hama yavo yakadzoka kumusha nokudaro havachakwanisa kuwana mamwe ma hearing aid nokuti anonzi anotengwa nemari yekuAmerica iyo vasingakwanisi kuwana. Sachigaro wekomiti inoona nezvehutano muparamende, Dr Ruth Labode, vanoti bazi rehutano harina mari yokutengera mwana wese mahearing aids nokudaro vabereki ava vanofanira kubatsirwa nemadhona ayo anopemha mari kunze kwenyika. Dr Labode vanoti hurumende yakaomerwa panguva ino zvokuti iri kutoshayawo mari yokutenga mishonga ine mitengo iri pasi pasi inofanira kubatsira varwere muzvipatara. Nyanzvi munyaya dzemutauro wemaoko mubazi rezvehutano, Amai Cecilia Nleya, vanoti pane chirongwa chokuti mwana wese anozvarwa atange kuongororwa kana paine hurema waanenge ainahwo kuitira kuti vazokwanisa kubatsira vana ava pavanenge vachikura zvinoenderana nekuremara kwavo. Asi Dr Labode vanoti kunyangwe hazvo vana ivava kana vawanikwa vaine hurema hwakadaro, hapana zvakanyanya zvinokwanisika kuitwa kuvana ava nokuti mamiriro ehupfumi hwenyika haana kumira zvakanaka. Tsvagurudzo yakaitwa nebazi rehutano inoratidza kuti pavanhu miriyoni imwe chete yevanhu vanorarama nehurema hwakasiyana siyana, pakaonekwa kuti vanhu zviuri zana nemakumi maviri, vanhu vasinganzwe kana kutaura. Zimbabwe yakasaina chibvumirano cheUnited Nations Conventions on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities mugore 2013, asi nyanzvi munyaya dzemitemo pamwe nehutano dzinoti zviga zveUnited Nations izvi hazvisati zvaiswa mumitemo yenyika. headline: Zec Inovhara Mahofisi Ayo kweMasvondo Maviri Zvichitevera Kubatwa neCovid-19 kweVanhu Vakawanda Kusanganisira Vashandi Vayo
text: Zimbabwe Electoral Commission, Zec, inoti iri kuvhara mahofisi ayo kwemasvondo maviri kutanga nemusi weMuvhuro unouya zvichitevera kukwira kuri kuita huwandu hwevanhu vari kubatwa neCovid-19, kusanganisirawo vamwe vashandi veZec. Muchiziviso chayo kune veruzhinji sachigaro weZec, Justice Priscilla Chigumba, vati mahofisi avo ese munyika achavharwa senzira yekudzivirira kupararira kweCovid-19. Amai Chigumba vati danho ravatora rakanangana nekudzivirira kupararira kwedenda iri. Mukuru anoona nezvesarudzo muZec, VaUtoile Silaigwana, vaudza Studio7 kuti danho iri rakanangana nekuchengetedza vashandi vekomisheni pamwe nevavhoti. Vati komisheni haisi kuvhara mahofisi zvachose uye paichavhura mwedzi unouya, munhu wese anokodzera kuvhota anofanira kunyoresa. Vati vashandi vekomisheni yavo vachange vachishanda vari kumba vachiita basa ravo semazuva ose. Asi mutungamiriri weDemocratic Party, Dr Wurayayi Zembe, vaudza Studio 7 kuti Zec inofanira kushandisa michina yechizvinozvino kuitira kuti vanhu varambe vachinyoresa kuvhota kunyange kuine denda reCovid-19. Asi VaSilaigwana vati Zec ine tarisiro yekushandisawo michina yechizvino zvino pakunyoresa vanhu kuti vavhote, asi pari zvino mutemo hauvabvumidze kuita izvi. Mukuru anoona nezvekufambiswa kwebasa musangano reResource Centre, VaSolomon Bobosibhunu, vaudza Studio 7 kuti danho ratorwa neZec rakanaka, asi vakati Zec inofanirawo kutaura nevamwe isati yatora matanho akadai. Mutevedzeri wemutauriri weMDC Alliance, VaClifford Hlatywayo, vati nyaya dzesarudzo dzinoda kuti vanhu vashande pamwe kunyange kuine Covid-19. Hatina kukwanisa kunzwa kubva kubato reZanu PF sezvo mushandi mukuru muchikamu chekuburitswa kwemashoko mubato iri, VaTafadzwa Mugwadi, vange vasiri kudaira nharembozha yavo. Zec iri kushorwa nenyaya yekutadza kuita sarudzo dzema by-elections panguva iyo dzimwe nyika dziri kuita sarudzo asi pachitevedzwa mitemo inobata chirwere cheCovid-19. Zec pachayo inoti inokwanisa kuita sarudzo idzi nguva ipi zvayo asi yakabatwa nemutemo wehurumende wekudzivirira Covid-19. No media source currently available

headline: Vatori veNhau Vocherechedza Zuva reKuremekedzwa kweKodzero Dzavo Vachiti muZimbabwe Vari Kushungurudzwa
text: Vatori venhau neMuvhuro vakacherechedza zuva rekuremekedzwa kwekodzero dzavo kana kuti World Press Freedom Day vachichema chema kuti makore makumi matatu mushure mechibvumirano chekuWindoek Declaration vachiri kushanda vakamanikidzika munyika. Mumwe mutori wenhau, VaEliah Ntali vaudza Studio 7 kuti chibvumirano chakaitwa kunyika yeNamibia muWindhoek, chinozivikanwa nekuti Windhoek Declaration chinokurudzira kufambiswa kwemashoko zvakasununguka hachisati chazadzikiswa munyika vachipa muenzaniso wekusungwa nekumbunyikidzwa kwevatori venhau. Mumwe mutori wenhau John Cassim atsinhirawo mashoko aya vachiti pakapidigurwa hurumende yamushakabvu Robert Mugabe nemauto muna 2017, zvinhu zvakamboita nani pakapinda VaEmmerson Mnangagwa panyanga asi iko zvino hazvichisina kumira zvakanaka. Mukuru we Media Institute of Southern Africa- Zimbabwe kana kuti Misa-Zimbabwe VaTabani Moyo vatiwo basa rekutapwa kwenhau harisi kufamba zvakanaka vachitiwo vatapi venhau vari kushungurudzwa, kusungwa uye kune dzimwe nyika dziri kuchamhembe kweAfrica vari kuurayiwa. VaMoyo vatiwo panguva ino yedenda reCovid-19 vatapi venhau vanofanirwa kupiwa zvinovadzivirira pavanenge varikubasa vakarumbidza hurumende yeZimbabwe nekutenda kuisa vatori venhau pavanhu vakatanga kubaiwa nhomba. VaMoyo vatiwo hurumende inofanirwa kuisa mitemo inokurudzira kufambiswa kwemashoko kwakasununguka vakatiwo mitemo irikuda kuiswa yakadai seCybersecurity and data protection Bill inodzorera shure kufambiswa kwemashoko zvakasununguka Mukuru weZimbabwe Association of Community Radio Stations (ZACRAS), Muzvare Vivenne Marara vakurudzirawo hurumende nevatori venhau kuti vawanise veruzhinji ruzivo rwakakwana kuti vatore matanho akakosha muhupenyu vaine ruzivo rwakakwana. Vatori venhau vemuZimbabwe vanotiwo chirwere cheCovid-19 chasiya vazhinji vavo vave parumananzombe sezvo mamwe makambani enhau onetsekana kubhadhara vashandi. Mugwaro ravo rekucherechedza WPFD, Amnesty International yatiwo kumabudazuva nekuchamhembe kweAfrica vatori venhau vari kumbunyikidzwa izvo zvosanganawo nedenda reCovid-19 . Amnesty International yati Zimbabwe irikushungurudzawo vatori venhau kuburikidza nekusungwa pamwe nekukanganiswa pakushanda. Mumwe mutori wenhau wekuManicaland, Sydney Saize akasungwa mugovera achiita basa rake. Asi hurumende iri kuramba mashoko ekuti iri kushungurudza vatori venhau ichiti iri kutoisa mitemo yekurerutsira vatori venhau. Mutevedzeri wegurukota rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko VaKindness Paradza vaudza Studio 7 kuti pane mitemo yakawanda yadzikwa kurerutsira vatori venhau. Asi mumashoko kuvatori venhau, rimwe sangano rinorwira kodzero dzevanhu reZimbabwe Lawyers for Human Rights rinoti hurumende inofanira kumisa tsika yekumbunyikidza kodzero dzevatori venhau sezvo zvichikanganisa nyaya yehutongo hwejekerere. Zuva reWorld Press Freedom Day rinocherechedzwa musi wa 3 Chivabvu gore rega rega uye gore rino ririkucherechedzwa pasi pedingindira rakanangana nekukosha kwekuburitswa kwemashoko kuruzhinji kana kuti “information as a public good." headline: Vanorwira Kodzero dzeVanhu Voratidzira neKurara neKuswera muAfrica Unity Square
text: Nhengo dzemasangano anorwira kodzero dzevanhu anoti reZimbabwe Activists Alliance, Occupy Africa Unity Square Movement neZimbabwe Women in Politics Alliance, dzakabatana nevamwe vana veZimbabwe, dziri kurara pamwe nekuswera muAfrica Unity Square dzichiratidzira kwemazuva gumi nematanhatu. Vanoona nezvekufambiswa kwemabasa musangano reZimbabwe Activists Alliance, Muzvare Tendayi Lynnette Mudehwe vanoti vari kurara pamwe nekuswera munzvimbo iyi senzira yekuratidzira kusafara kwevana veZimbabwe nezvavanoti zviri kuitwa nehurumende zvekusateerera vanhu. “Tiri kuda kutaura nyaya dzatinoti hurumende yeZimbabwe igadzirise nekukurumidza, zvakaita senyaya dzeupfumi, matongerwo enyika pamwe nekurarama kwevanhu,” Muzvare Mudehwe vanodaro. Vanoti vakaona kuti nyaya yekuratidzira zvezuva rimwe chete hainyatsoburitsi zvinyunyuto zvavo, saka vakafunga zvekuti vangogarira panzvimbo kwemazuva aya. “Takasarudza mazuva gumi nematanhatu kuitira kuti zvinangane nezuva rakakosha munhoroondo yeSouth Africa neAfrica yose, reDay of the African Child, apo tinocherechedza mwana weAfrica,” vanowedzera Muzvare Mudehwe. Vanoti vakatanga kurara munzvimbo iyi usiku hwemusi weChipiri uye havasati vasangana nematambudziko kubva kumapurisa, asi vanoti vanotarisira kuti vanogona kuzokanganiswa. headline: Huwandu hweVari Kufa neCovid-19 Hwoderara Asi Nyanzvi Dzinoti Haisi Nguva yeKupemberera
text: Apo huwandu hwevanhu vari kubatwa nekufa nechirwere cheCovid-19 huri kuramba huchiderera, nyanzvi munyaya dzezvehutano dziri kukurudzira vanhu kuti vasarivare nekuti chirwere ichi chinogona kudzoka zvakare zvine hukasha. Nemusi weChina mukuru anoona nezvezvirwere zvekutapuriranwa mubazi rezvehutano Dr Portia Manangazira, vanoti vanhu vanofanira kuramba vachitevedzera kurudziro iri kupihwa yekuzvidzivirira nekupfeka mamamasiki, kugeza maoko, kusaita magungano nezvimwe. Mukuru musangano reCommunity Working Group on Heath, VaItai Rusike, vatsinhirawo mashoko aya vachiti vanhu vanofanira kuramba vakangwarira kuti vasatapurirwe chirwere. Zvichakadaro, mashoko atumirwa Studio 7 neAfrican Union achibva kuAfrica Centers for Disease Control and Prevention anoratidza kuti vanhu vanodarika mamiriyoni matatu nezviuru mazana manomwe kana kuti 3,7million vabatwa nechirwere cheCovid-19 muAfrica. Vanhu vafa vasvika zviuru makumi mapfumbamwe nezvitanhatu zvine mazana manomwe nemakumi matatu nevaviri kana kuti 96, 732. Vapora muAfrica vadarika mamiriyoni matatu nezviuru mazana maviri kana kuti 3, 2 million. South Africa ndiyo ine vanhu vakawandisa vabatwa nekufa nechirwere ichi muAfrica. Dunhu reSADC ndirozve rine vanhu vakawandisa vabatwa nechirwere ichi vadarika miriyoni imwe chete nezviuru mazana manomwe kana kuti 1,7 million. North Africa ine vanhu vabatwa nechirwere ichi vadarika miriyoni imwe chete. Huwandu hwevanhu vabatwa nechirwere cheCovid-19 pasi rose hwadarika zana remamiriyoni nemanomwe kana kuti 107 million. Johns Hopkins University yemuAmerica iyo iri kuongorora kupararira kwechirwere ichi pasi rose inoti muAmerica ndimo mune vanhu vakawandisa vabatwa nekufa nechirwere ichi. Vafa muAmerica vanodarika zviuru mazana nemakumi manomwe nechimwe kana kuti 471 000, vabatwa nechirwere ichi vachidarika mamiriyoni makumi maviri nemanomwe kana kuti 27 miillion. Pasi rose, vanhu vafa nechirwere ichi vanodarika mamiriyoni maviri nezviuru mazana matatu kana kuti 2,3 million. Vapora pasi rose vadarika mamiriyoni makumi matanhatu ana kuti 60 million. headline: Vanhu Voshushikana neKuwanda kweVanhu Vari Kubatwa neCovid-19 Munyika
text:
Vanhu vakawanda munyika vari kushushikana zvikuru nekukwira kuri kuita huwandu hwevanhu vari kubatwa nechirwere cheCovid-19. Vanhu vakawanda vataura neStuduio7 kuChiredzi vanoti huwandu huri kubudiswa hwevanhu vari kubatwa neCovid-19 kwemazuva mana apfuura huri kuvatyisa sezvo guta iri raramba riri roga rine vanhu vakawanda vari kubatwa nechirwere ichi zvichienzaniswa nemamwe maguta mudunhu rose reMasvingo. Dzimwe nzvimbo mudunhu reMasvingo dziri kubuda dzisina kana munhu
mumwe chete anobatwa nechirwere ichi panoongororwa vanhu zuva nezuva. Musi wechipiri 8 Chikumi pavanhu gumi nemumwe vakawanikwa vaine
chirwere ichi mudunhu rose reMasvingo, vapfumbamwe vaiva vekuChiredzi
vaviri vari vemudhorobha reMasvingo. Musi weChitatu 9 Chikumi, pavanhu gumi nevapfumbamwe vakabatwa neCovid-19 mudunhu rose, vese vaiva vekuChiredzi uye nezuro musi wa 10 Chikumi, vanhu vapfumbamwe vakabatwa nechirwere ichi vose ndeve kuChiredzi.

Mumwe mugari wemumusha weTsvovani, VaMalcom Mugodzwa, vanoti vave kutyira hupenyu hwavo.

Mumwewo mugari wemumusha wekwa Zava, VaTiyani Chauke, vanofunga kuti guta ravo riri pedyo nemazambuko ekuenda kunyika dze South Africa neMozambique uko vagari vanobira zvisiri pamutemo nekudaro vanogona
kuuya nechirwere ichi.

Izvi zvatsigirwawo naMuzvare Nyasha Sigauke vachiti ivo hurumende
inofanira kuona kuti vanochengetedza mitemo vapinda mumisha
yemudhorobah iri kuitirakuti vanhu vatevedzere zvisungo zvekuti chirwere
ichi chaisapararire.

Hurumende yati iri kushushikanawo nekukwira kuri kuita chirwere ichi
muChiredzi kunyange hazvo kusati kwave nemunhu arasikirwa nehupenyu.

Mukuru webasa mubazi rezvehutano muMasvingo, Dr Amedus Shamu, vanoti hurumende iri kuita tsvakurudzo yekuti ione kuti chi chiri kukonzera kukwira kwechirwere ichi muChiredzi. Asi mutauriri wekomiti yeCovid-19 Task Force muMasvingo, VaRodgers Irimayi, vati kukwira uku kuri kukonzerwa nevanhu vari kubva kwakasiyana siyana vachinotsvaga mabasa ekukohwa nzimbe muminda yeTongaart Hullert nevamwe varimi. Hurumende yakazivisa nezuro kuti vanhu vana vakafa nechirwere cheCovid-19 munyika yese, uye vanhu makumi matanhatu nevana vakabatwa nechirwere ichi munyika. Vanhu vabatwa nechirwere munyika yose vave zviuru makumi matatu
nezvipfumbamwe nemazana mana ane makumi mapfumbamwe nevatanhatu, 39 496. Vanhu vafa nechirwere ichi vava chiuru chimwe chete nemazana matanhatu nemakumi maviri nevatanhatu, 1 626. Vanhu mazana mashanu nemakumi matatu nevaviri vakaibawa nhomba
yekutanga nezuro izvo zvakasvitsa huwandu hwevabaiwa nhomba yekutanga pamazana matanhatu nemakumi mapfumbamwe ezviuru nemazana mana nemakumi mashanu nevavviri 690 452. Vanhu zviuru zvina nemazana mapfumbamwe nemamkumi mapfumbamwe nemumwe chete 4 991 vakabaiwa homba yepiri nezuro, izvo zvakasvitsa
vanhu vabaiwa nhomba yepiiri pa zviuru mazana matatu nemakumi mapfumambawe nezvipfumamwe nemakumi mashanu nevana, 399 054. Zimbabwe inoti ine hurongwa hwekubaya vanhu vanosvika mamiriyoni gumi, kana kuti zvikamu makumi matanhatu kubva muzana, 60%,
zvevanhu vari munyika senzira yekudzivirira kupararira kwechirwere
cheCovid-19. Kunyange hazvo Zimbabwe iine chirongwa ichi, nyanzvi munyaya dzehutano dzinoti kubaya vanhu mamiriyoni gumi kuchanetsa sezvo vanhu vakawanda vari kutadza kubayiwa nhomba yekutanga munzvimbo dzakawanda, sezvo nhomba idzi dziri kushaikwa mumatunhu akawanda munyika. Zvichakadaro, hurumende yeAmerica yazivisa kuti ichabatsira Zimbabwe nemari yekurwisa denda reCovid-19 inotangira pamamiriyoni makumi manomwe nemashanu emadhora kusvika pazana nemakumi
mashanu emamiriyoni emadhora ekuAmerica. No media source currently available

headline: Kusapa Bazi rezveHutano Mari KweMakore Akawanda Kunonzi Kwopa Kuti Kurwisa Coronavirus Kunetse.
text: Vanhu vakawanda munyika vanoti kunyangwe hazvo Zimbabwe yasvitsa makore makumi mana yawana kuzvitonga kuzere, zvinhu munyaya dzezvehutano hazvina kumira zvakanaka zvaburitswa pachena nenyaya yechirwere checoronavirus. Vanhu vakawanda vataura neStudio 7 kusanganisira nyanzvi munezvehutano vanoti Zimbabwe inofanirwa kusunga dzisimbe kugadzirisa matambudziko munyaya dzezvehutano. Amai Pepukai Shava vanoti kunyangwe haazvo nyika yakakwanisa kuvaka zvipatara mushure mekuwana kuzvitonga kuzere, zvipatara izvi zvangove midhuri isisina zvinhu zvakakosha zvekushandisa. Mutungamiri webato reLabour Economists African Democrats, Muzvare Linda Masarira, vanoti hurumende haisi kuita zvakakwana kusimudzira nyaya dzezvehutano munyika zvopa kuti kana kurwisa chirwere checoronavirus kunetsa nekuti zvipatara hazvina zvikwanisiro zvakaita semichina yekubatsira vanhu kufema kana varwarisa. Vatiwo zvingabatsire kana nyika ikaisa mutemo unosungira kuti vatungamiriri vehurumende varapwe munyika vakati izvi zvinogona kubatsira kusimudzirwa kwezvipatara munyika. Izvi zvatsigirwawo naVaKudzai Kwangwari avo vatiwo kunyangwe hazvo zviripowo zvakagonekwa nenyika mushure mekuwana kuzvitonga kuzere vati kune zvizhinjiwo zvichiri kuda kuzadzikiswa vakati izvi zvinosanganisirawo nyaya yehutano. Munyori musangano ravanachiremba vanorwira kodzero dzevanhu reZimbabwe Association of Doctors for Human Rights, Doctor Norman Matara, vanoti kunyangwe hazvo mumakore ekutanga Zimbabwe ichangosungunuka, hurumende yakamboedza kusimudzira zvinhu munyaya dzezvehutano kusanganisira kuvaka makirinika. Asi vanoti makore makumi maviri apfuura, Zimbabwe yatadza kuvandudza zvinhu munyaya yezvehutano kuburikidza nekusapiwa mari yakawanda kubazi rezvehutano. VaMatara vati kunyangwe hazvo nyika dzemuAfrica dzakanyorerana pasi chibvumirano cheAbuja Declaration icho chinosungira hurumende kuti iise zvikamu gumi nezvishanu kubva muzana zvemari yebhajeti yenyika kune zvehutano, Zimbabwe haina gore rayakambozadzikisa zvinotarisirwa izvi. VaMatara vanotiwo kusaisa mari yakakwana kubazi rezvehutano zvinobudawo kunyangwe panguva ino nyika iri kurwisa chirwere cheCOVID-19 vachiti bazi rezvehutano rakatora nguva kuwana mari chirwere chapinda munyika izvo zvakaita kuti zvizhinji zvaidiwa kushandiswa zvibve kune masangano ekunze kwete kuhurumende. Vanomirira Chinhoyi mudare reparamende vari nhengo yeMDC Doctor Peter Matarutse vanoti kunyangwe hazvo nyika yakakwanisa kudzivirira zvirwere zvakaita se Kwashiorkor, T.B nezvimwewo kuondomoka kwehupfumi munyika kwasiya zvinhu zvakaita manyama amire nerongo munyaya dzezvehutano. Studio 7 haina kukwanisa kubata gurukota rezvehutano Dr Obadiah Moyo kuti tinzwe divi ravo sezvo vange vasiri kudaira nharembozha yavo. Asi mutevedzeri wegurukota rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko VaEnergy Mutodi vati hurumende iri kuyedza napose painogona kugadzirisa zvinhu munyaya dzezvehutano. Nyaya yechirwere checoronavirus iri kuburitsa pachena kuti zvinhu munyanya dzezvehutano zvaderera uye zvipatara zvizhinji hazvina zvikwanisiro uye midhuri yacho yave kuondomoka. headline: Dai nhabvu yachidzoka: Mugadza
text: MURAIRIDZI weHarare City Queens neMighty Warriors Under-20, Rosemary Mugadza, anoti asuwa zvikuru kurairidza mutambo wenhabvu yevanhukadzi zvichitevera kumiswa kwakaitwa mitambo yose senzira yekudzivirira kupararira kwechirwere cheCovid-19.   Muhurukuro neKwayedza, Mugadza anoti chishuwo chake ndechekuti kudai mariro ezvinhu adzikama maringe nechirwere ichi kuitira kuti mitambo ichitanga kuitwa zvakare.   “Zvinhu zvese zvakamira panguva ino uye isu tiri mune zvemitambo tiri kuchema kunyanya nekuti mutambo uyu ndiwo unotiraramisa hupenyu hwedu.   “Zvese takungozvisiira mumaoko aMwari nekuti ndivo vane mhinduro yezvinhu zvese uye vachatitungamira muhupenyu hwedu kusvika takunda chirwere ichi.  Tave kuda kudzokera kuhupenyu hwedu hwekare hwatange tajaira,” anodaro Mugadza.   Mugadza, uyo anozivikanwa nekumbotambira zvikwata zvakaita seZimbabwe Saints Ladies neHighlanders Royals, anoti ari kupota achitarisa vatambi vezvikwata zvake zviviri — Mighty Warriors U20 neHarare City Queens — achida kuziva kuti vari kugara sei uye kuti vari kumboitawo here gadziriro vega kudzimba dzavo.   Anoti vatambi vechidiki vechisikana venhabvu vakasiyana nevakomana nekuti kana vari kudzimba kuita gadziriro kunonetsa sezvo vanenge vave kumboita mabasa epamba.   “Vasikana kana vave kudzimba kuita gadziriro kwacho kunonetsa nekuti vanenge vakumboita mabasa epamba vachinzi zvenhabvu izvo imbosiyana nazvo tozozviona kana yatanga.  Manje mutambi wenhabvu haadi izvozvo anofanirwa kugara achigadzirira nguva nenguva.   “Saka tinenge tichikurukura navo paWhatsApp tichivaudza zvekuti vaite vari kudzimba kwavo kana vapedza havo kuita mabasa epamba,” anodaro.   Chikwata chemaMighty Warriors U20 change chichifanirwa kurwira tikiti rekuenda kumakwikwi eWorld Cup kuCosta Rica gore rinotevera asi mitambo iyi yakambomiswa nesangano reCAF nekuda kwechirwere cheCovid-19.

headline: Zimbabwe Yoramba Kuti Yakatumira Mauto kuMozambique Kunorwisa Vanotsigira ISIS
text: Munyori mukuru mubazi rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko vanick mangwana vari kuramba runyerekupe rwekuti Zimbabwe yakatumira mauto kuMozambique kunorwisa vanopfurikidza mwero vachitsigira chikwata cheIslamic State kana kuti ISIS. Vanopfurikidza mwero ava vari mudunhu reCao Delgado pedyo nemuganhu wenyika yeTanzania. Vanhu vanodarika churu chimwe chete vafa muMozambique nekuda kwehondo iyi. Nemusi weChishanu, mutungamiri wenyika VaEmmerson Mnangagwa vanova sachigaro webazi rezvekudzivirirwa kwenyika dzemuSADC kana kuti SADC Organ on Politics and Defense vakaenda kunoita hurukuro nemutungamiri weMozambique VaFilipe Nyusi nezvekusagadzikana kwenyika iyi. Asi VaMangwana vari kuramba mashoko ekuti Zimbabwe yakatotumira mauto. ​Vanoti kana Zimbabwe ichida kuita izvi mune remangwana inotoita pasi peSADC. No media source currently available Munyori anoona nezvemutemo mubato rinopikisa reMDC VaInnocent Gonese vanova gweta vaudzawo Studio 7 kuti VaMnangagwa havakwanise kuita zano ndega vachitumira mauto kune imwe nyika vasina kusuma dare reparamende uye kana vakaita fungira mumoyo rwendo rwembwa vanofanira kusuma dare iri nechimbichimbi. headline: Tinogona kutora ‘coach’ wekunze: ZIFA
text: SANGANO rinotungamirira nhabvu yemuno reZimbabwe Football Association (ZIFA) rinoti rinogona kugadza mumwezve murairidzi wechikwata chenyika chemaWarriors wekunze kana wemuno kuti agotsiva Zdrvako “Loga” Logarusic uyo akadzingwa basa kutanga kwesvondo rino.   Zvichitevera kudzinga kwavakaita Loga basa, ZIFA iri pakati pekutsvaga murairidzi wekutsiva chizvarwa chekunyika yeCroatia ichi, icho chakakwanisa kurairidza mitambo 14 chete yemaWarriors ndokuhwinha mumwe chete.   Pari zvino ZIFA ichambogadza murairidzi anongofanobata chigaro ichi kwekanguva kadiki uyo vachapa basa rekutungamira maWarriors mumitambo yemwedzi unotevera apo achange achirwirira tikiti rekuenda kuQatar World Cup. Mutungamiriri weZifa – Felton Kamambo – anoti ZIFA yatanga basa rekutsvaga murairidzi anotsiva Loga.   “Zvichitevera kupesana kwatakaita naLoga, veruzhinji vangade kuziva kuti tinogona kugadza mumwe murairidzi wemaWarriors anove chizvarwa chekunze kwenyika asi hunge kana ane magwaro akakwana uye akatifadza patinoita hurukuro naye.   “Iye zvino tave kushambadza basa iri tichitsvaga murairidzi mutsva anouya kuzotungamira chikwata chedu. “Saka basa iri tinogona kungopa chero murairidzi, angave wemuno kana wekunze anenge atifadza ane zvatiri kutsvaga ndiye achapinda panyanga,” anodaro Kamambo.   ZIFA yainge yambovimbisa kuzivisa murairidzi achafanobata chigaro ichi musi weChipiri svondo rino usati wadarika asi haina kuzoita saizvozvo.   Mumitambo 14 iyo Loga akarairidza maWarriors, akangokwanisa kuhwina mumwe chete, ndokuita mangange mishanu uye ndokukundwa misere.   Zvisinei, asiya maWarriors abudirira kuenda kumitambo yeAfrica Cup of Nations iyo ichatambwa gore rinotevera kuCameroon. Asi, asiyawo chikwata chenyika ichi chiri pasi muGroup G murwendo rwekurwira kuenda ku2022 Qatar World Cup apo chiine chibodzwa chimwe chete kubva mumitambo miviri yachatamba kusvika pari zvino.   Mwedzi unotevera, maWarriors achasangana neGhana mumitambo miviri yakatevedzena yekurwira kuenda kuQatar iyo vanofanirwa kuhwina kuti varambe vaine mukana.

headline: ‘Joshua, Wilder votyanana’
text: akapa chikwata chaDeontay Wilder kusvika pakupera kwevhiki rino kuti mutambi wavo agorwa naAnthony Joshua kana kuti osiyana nazvo voronga zvavo mumwe mutambo naAlexander Povetkin muna Gunyana. Hurukuro dziri kuitwa dzekuronga mutambo uyu pakati pevatambi vaviri ava – Joshua naWilder – avo vasati vambokundwa muboka reheavyweight.   Baba vaHearn, Barry, akatombosangana nevamiriri vaWilder Shelly Finkel kuNew York masvondo adarika kuti vapedzise hurukuro dzekuronga mutambo uyu waJoshua uyo ane mabhande eIBF, WBA neWBO kuti asangane naWilder uyo ane bhande reWBC.   Asi iye zvino Hearn (Jnr) anoti mukana wekuti mutambo uyu uitwe gore rino mudiki sezvo vave kutarisira kuti Joshua arwe naPovetkin muna Gunyana.   Izvi zvinoreva kuti mutambo waJoshua naWilder, uyo uchaburitsa mutambi mumwe achazobata mabhande mana makuru mutsiva, uchambomirwa kuitwa kusvika muna Kukadzi 2019.   Hearn anoti, “Baba vangu vakasangana naShelly uye vave kugara vachikurukura. Vakasangana svondo radarika musi weChishanu, uye vakatitumira mashoko padandemutande musi weMuvhuro mangwanani saka tiri kuvapindura. “Ndinofunga kuti tichazvigadzirisa asi WBA iri kugara ichitibvunza zuva nezuva kuti tave papi uye isu tiri kugara tichiwedzera mazuva ehurukuro acho.” – Sportmail Boxing

headline: Sikandar odzoka kuzc
text: MUTAMBI wecricket, Sikandar Raza, akasarudzwa kuti agove muchikwata cheZimbabwe Cricket icho chichaenda kunokwikwidza neBangladesh mumitambo mitatu yeone day international uye nemiviri yetest match.   Asi achange asiri muchikwata chemaChevrons icho chiri kuSouth Africa kunokwikwidza mumitambo yakasiyana iri kutanga svondo rino musi weSvondo.   Shasha iyi yange isina kusarudzwa kuti iende kunomirira maChevrons zvichitevera nyaya dzake dzekondirakiti dzainetsa, asi zvakazogadziriswa apo pakaitwa hurukuro pakati pake neZimbabwe Cricket contracts committee svondo rino.   Raza akatsanangura mamiriro aive akaita nyaya yake uye akakumbira ruregerero ndokuzvipira kumirira Zimbabwe mumitambo inotevera.   Apo maChevrons akasimuka kuenda kuSouth Africa kare kunokwikwidza mumitambo mitatu yeODI iyo ichange ichitambirwa kuKimberley uye neyeTwenty20, vanosarudza chikwata ichi vakaronga kuti vamusiye asi vachizomusarudza pakuenda kuBangladesh.    “Ndine mufaro mukuru nezvakaitika izvi uye ndinopa kutenda kuZC iyo yakwanisa kugadzirisa nyaya dzangu.   “Ndinoda kusiyana nenyaya iyi ndotanga kuita zvekuti nditambe cricket yangu kwete kufunga zvakawanda,” anodaro Raza.   Akafanobata chigaro chamanaging director weZC –  Givemore Makoni – anoti anotambira nemaoko maviri kudzoka kwaRaza muchikwata ichi.   “Tine mufaro mukuru kuti takakwanisa kuwirirana naSikandar uyo anove mumwe wevatambi vedu vepamusoro. Tinomutambira nemaoko maviri kudzoka muchikwata chedu uye tinovimba kuti patichaenda naye kuBangladesh nemimwe mitambo achatibatsira zvikuru,” anodaro.   Masvondo adarika, Raza akabuda pachena kuti akange asiri kuzotambira maChevrons kumitambo yeSouth Africa neBangladesh zvichitevera kusapihwa kondirakiti itsva neZC izvo akatumira pandemutande rake retwitter.

headline: pe yakahwapura mukombe
text: CHIKORO chePrince Edward ndicho chakahwapura mukombe wemakwikwi eDairyboard Rugby Schools Festival ayo akaitirwa muHarare svondo rapera.   Prince Edward yakakunda Churchill Boys 16-10 mufainari yainakidza kukunda ngoma kurira.   Tawanda Jimu – uyo anove Dairyboard Rugby Schools Festival Tournament director – anoti makwikwi aya akakosha sezvo vachiashandisa kutsvaga nyanzvi dzemangwana dzichazomirira nyika pamwe nezvikwata zvikuru zvemutambo uyu.   Anoti makwishu egore rino akarakidza kuti mutambo werugby wakura zvikuru uye uri kutambwa muzvikoro, vachitarisa zvikwata zvakawanda zvakauya kuzokwikwidza zvevakomana nevasikana.   “Tichiongorora zvikwata zvese zvakauya, takazviona kuti mutambo uyu uri kuramba uchikura uye uchisimudzira vatambi pamwe nezvikwata zvakawanda.   “Zvimwe zvikwata zvaizviona sezvikuru iye zvino zvave kuzviona zvega kuti hazvingohwine dambe nekuti zvimwe zvekumamisha chaizvo zvaitozvikunda zvichitamba rugby yepamusoro, inonwisa mvura,” anodaro Jimu.   Anoenderera mberi achiti mutambo uyu uripo pakupa mukana kuvatambi verugby kubva kuzvikoro zvakasiyana kuti vagosimukire kusvika padanho rave naTendai “The Beast” Mtawarira uyo anotambira maSpringboks eSouth Africa.   “Chishuvo chedu kuti titsvage mumwe Beast kuburikidza nemutambo uyu ndiko saka uchiitwa gore negore kuti vatambi ava vawane mukana wekusvika kure.   “Tinoziva kuti kuburikidza nemutambo uyu ndipo vamwe vatambi vanoonekwa nezvikwata zvakasiyana izvo zvinozovapa mukana wekuzvitambira,” anodaro.

headline: Korera Inonzi Yauraya Vanhu Makumi Maviri neVasere muHarare Chete
text: Vanhu makumi maviri nevasere vanonzi vafa nechirwere chekorera kusvika pari zvino muguta reHarare chete, sekutaura kwevakafanobata chigaro chemukuru anoona nezvehutano mukanzuru yeHarare, Doctor Clemence Duri. Ukuwo bazi rezvehutano rinoti huwandu hwevanhu vabatwa nechirwere ichi hwava kudarika zviuru zvina munyika yose. “Tiri kugutsikana nemafambiro ari kuita zvinhu nekuti vanhu vese vari kuisa misoro pamwe chete. Tiri kuedza kubata pamwe chete neshamwari dzedu nesuwo veHarare City Council tiri kuedza kuita zvatinogona,” Dr Duri vaudza Studio7. “Hongu, hatingagoni kuzviita zvese asi unonyatsona kuti vanhu vane chido chekuti chirwere ichi chipedzwe zvachose.” Dr Duri vanoti kunyange hazvo vachigutsikana nebasa riri kuitwa mukurwisana nechirwere ichi, vari kukumbira vanhu nemasangano ekunze kuti vabatsire mukurwisa chirwere ichi. Gurukota rezvemari, VaMthuli Ncube, vakati veruzhinji vanofanirwawo kubatsira nemari yekurwisa chirwere ichi. Korera yagara ichinetsa muZimbabwe. Muna 1993 ku muna 2003, korera yakabatwa nevanhu vanodarika zviuru makumo manomwe. Muna 2008 vanhu vanodarika zviuru zvina vakafa nechirwere ichi. Nyanzvi munyaya dzehutano dzinoti Zimbabwe ndiyo chete nyika yawirwa nedambudziko rekorera rakaipisisa kudarika dzimwe nyika dzemuAfrica. No media source currently available

headline: Madzimai eWomen of Dominion International Osendeka Musangano wePagore Nekuda kweCoronavirus
text: Sangano reWomen of Dominion International rinoti harisi kuita musangano waro wepagore gore rino nekuda kwechirwere che coronavirus. Mutungamiri wesangano iri, Pastor Marvelous Ndhlovu, vanoti madzimai anobva munyika dzakasiyanasiyana anga achitarisirwa kusangana ku Los Angeles mudunhu reCalifornia muna Chikumi asi nekuda kwekurudziro yekuti vanhu vasaungana senzira yekudzivirira kupararira kwe coronavirus, vaona zvakakosha ] kuti musangano wavo usaitwa. Pastor Ndhlovu vanoti sezvo mamwe madzimai achibva kunze kweAmerica, miganhu yenyika dzakawanda yakavharwa pari zvino zvekuti kana dai zvinhu zvakazogadzikana panenge pasisina nguva yekuti madzimai aya agadzirire. "Ndinoda kutenda Mwari nekuwana mukana wekutsanangura kuti gore rino takaona zvakakodzera kuti tisaita musangano wedu weWomen of Dominion watanga tichifanirwa kuita muna June, June 25 kusvika 28 tiri kuLos Angeles, California. "Saka takazogara sedare takakanzura musangano iwoyo. Gore rino tanga tichi celebrator nine years dzekunge tiri Women of Dominion, kubva patakatanga tichitanga kusangana gore ra2012." Pastor Ndhlovu vanoti chakanyanyoita kuti vakanzure musangano wegore rino zvikonzero zvakati wandeyi, chekutanga chiri chechirwere che coronavirus. "Patakatarisa nekunyatsoongorora, uyezve nekunyanyonzwisisa nezvatiri kunzwa nema forecast takaona kuti izvo musangano iwoyo uchanetsa kuti ubudirire, uye zvinogona kuti strainer isusu vanotungamirira Women of Dominion nevano attender as well. "Dambudzo rekutanga tichiziva kuti tose coronavirus yaka affecter even kubva vanhu kumabasa. Even kuLos Angeles kwatiri kuenda it's one of the cities iri kunzi ichaita ma cases akawanda, saka kuti June tifokasite kuti zvinhu zvinenge zvave nani panguva iyoyo in that city nemaonero edu uye nekunzwa pamweya, hatina kuona kunge zviri zvinhu zvakanga zvakanakira musangano wedu," vanodaro Pastor Ndhlovu. Women of Dominion International yave nemakore mapfumbamwe yaumbwa uye inobatanidza madzimai anobva kuZimbabwe ari munyika dzakasiyanasiyana mukurarama mushoko raMwari. headline: Dzidziso Pamusoro peCOVID-19 Kune Vachadzidzisa Veruzhinji Yotambirwa neMufaro
text: Bazi rezvehutano neMuvhuro rakazivisa kuti huwandu hwevanhu vafa nechirwere cheCovid-19 hwakanga hwasvika pazana nemakumi matatu nevashanu kana kuti 135, kuchitiwo vabatwa nechirwere ichi munyika yose vasvika pazviuru zvishanu nemazana matatu ane vasere kana kuti 5 308. Bazi iri rakati vanhu vakanga vapora kubva kuchirwere ichi kusvika neMuvhuro vakanga vasvika pazviuru zvitatu nemazana masere ane makumi mana nevasere kana kuti 3 848, izvo zvakasiya vanhu chiuru nemazana matatu nemakumi maviri nevashanu kana kuti 1 325 vari ivo vachine chirwere ichi munyika yose. Mukuedza kudzivirira kupararira kwechirwere ichi munyika, bazi rezvehutano rakabatana nesangano reUnited Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) riri kupa zvidzidzo kuvanhu vachazonodzidzisawo vamwe pamusoro pemabatirwo anofanirwa kuitwa Covid-19 uye kuti chirwere ichi chingadzivirirwa sei kuti chisapararira. Zvidzidzo izvi zviri kuitirwa kuDomboshawa, uye vari kupinda muzvidzidzo izvi vanozotarisirwa kunodzidzisawo vamwe vari mune zvehutano mumapoka avo, avo vanozodzidzisawo vamwe munharaunda dzavagere. Bazi iri razivisa kuburikidza neTiwtter kuti vapinda muzvidzidzo izvi vanhu vabva kubazi rezvehutano, kumapurisa nemauto, uyewo vamwe vabva kumasangano akazvimirira. Mukuru wesangano reCommunity Working Group on Health, VaItai Rusike, vanoti hurongwa hwekudzidzisa vadzidzisi uhwu hwakakosha zvikuru sezvo huchizobatsira kuti dzidziso pamusoro pechirwere ichi izokwanisa kupararira nenyika yose. VaRusike vakurudzirawo kuti dzidziso pamusoro pechirwere cheCovid-19 iwandire pamwe nekupararira kunzvimbo dzinogara veruzhinji pamwe nekumaruwa, uko vanoti veruzhinji vanenge vari kuratidza kuti havasi kuteerera kurudziro dzebazi rezvehutano pamwe neWorld Health Organisation dzekuti vazvivhare miromo nemhino, kugeza maoko, pamwe nekusiya mukaha pakati pavo nevamwe. No media source currently available Zvichakadaro, Johns Hopkins University Hospital yemuno muAmerica, iyo iri kuongorora chirwere ichi inoti pasi rose vanhu vanodarika mamiriyoni makumi maviri neimwe nezviuru mazana mapfumbamwe negumi nezvisere, kana kuti 21 918 000 vabatwa nechirwere ichi, icho chaurayawo vanhu vanodarika zviuru mazana manomwe nemakumi manomwe nezvina nemazana manomwe, kana kuti 774, 700. America ndiyo ichiri pamusoro pahuwandu hwevanhu vabatwa neCovid-19, avo vadarika mamiriyoni mashanu nezviuru mazana mana nemakumi mana nezvina, kana kuti 5, 444, 000 Vanhu vafa muAmerica vadarika zviuru zana nemakumi manomwe, kana kuti 170, 000. MuAfrica vanhu vanodarika miriyoni nezviuru zana nemakumi maviri nezvisere, kana kuti 1,128 000, vabatwa nechirwere ichi, kuchitiwo vashaya vadarika zviuru makumi maviri nezvishanu nemazana masere, kana kuti 25, 800. Vanhu vapona kubva kuchirwere ichi vadarika zviuru mazana masere nemakumi mana nezvitanhatu, kana kuti 846, 000. South Africa ndiyo iri pamusoro muAfrica iine vanhu vanodarika mazana mashanu nemakumi mapfumbamwe ezviuru, kana kuti 590, 000 vabatwa nacho. Vanhu vafa nechiwere ichi muSoiuth Africa vadarika zviuru gumi nechimwe nemazana mapfumbamwe kana kuti 11, 900.

headline: Hurumende Inobhadhara Chikwereti Chayo kuZESA
text: Hurumende inoti yabhadhara chikwereti chayo chemagetsi kumbani yemagetsi yeZESA uyewo yabhadharwa chikwereti cheZESA kukambani yemagetsi yeESKOM yekuSouth Africa. Vachitaura mushure memusangano wedare remakurukota, gurukota rinoona nezvemamhando dzemoto, VaFortune Chasi, vati hurumende yabhadhara chikwereti chayo chemamiriyoni makumi maviri emadhora kuZESA uyewo yapa kambani iyi mamwe mamiriyoni makuma maviri emadhora ekuti kambani iyi ivandudze basa rekugaya magetsi. Vatiwo vabhadhara chikwereti cheZESA kuESKOM chemamiriyoni gumi emadhora ekuAmerica. Vati izvi zvichabatsira kuti nyika ideredze dambudziko rekushomeka kwemagetsi munyika iro raita kuti nyika igove magetsi kana kuti loadshedding. VaChasi vatiwo veruzhinji, makambani nemakanzuru vanofanira kubhadhara magetsi. Vatiwo nyaya yemagetsi inofanira kubatanidza vanhu munyika kuona kuti vogadzirisa sei dambudziko rekushomeka kwemagetsi. Vachitaurawo mushure medare remakurukota, gurukota rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko, Amai Monica Mutsvangwa, vati dare remakurukota ratambira danho rakatorwa nebazi rezvemari svondo rino rekudzora dhora remuno rikati danho iri richaunza kugadzikana munyika munyaya dzehupfumi. Pavabvunzwa nezvekuti vanhu vane maNostro Foreign Currency Account nevaya vanotumirwa mari nemakambani akaita Western Union nemamwe, vachawana mari yavo here kana kuti vachamanikidzwa kuitengesa kumabhanga, Amai Mutsvangwa vati vanhu ava vacharamba vachiwana mari dzavo ari madhora ekuAmerica, mapaunzi nedzimwe mari dzekunze. Asi kunyange hazvo Amai Mutsvangwa vati dare remakurukota ratambira gwaro reStatutory Instrument 142, masangano evashandi pamwe nevemabhizimisi audza hurumende kuti mutemo uyu unofanira kubviswa sezvo wakaitwa pasina kuwirirana sezvinodiwa pasi pemutemo weTNF. Masangano aya atuma gurukota rezvevashandi, Doctor Sekai Nzenza, kuti vaendese nyaya iyi kudare remakurukota svondo rinouya kuti mutemo uyu ubviswe. Zimbabwe Congress of Trade Unions inoti vashandi vacharamwa mabasa kana izvi zvikasaitika. Mutemo uyu, uyo wakaburitswa nemusi weMuvhuro wave pamberi pekomiti yeparamende yeParliamentary Legal Committee iyo inoongorora kuti mitemo haipikisane nebumbiro remutemo here kana kuti kwete. Rimwe gweta risina kuda kudomwa nezita raudza Studio7 kuti rinoona nesekuti mutemo uyo hauna kunyorwa zvakajeka uye zviri pachena kuti hurumende ine vanhu kana makambani ainoda kubata pachishandiswa mutemo uyu. Zvichakadai nhengo dzeparamende nhasi dzati nyaya yekuzvidza paramende kuri kuitwa nemakurukota ehurumende iri kuenderera mberi yave kunganganisa mashandiro eparamende. Sachigaro wekomiti yeparamende inoona nezvedzidzo, Amai Priscillar Misihairambwi Mushonga, vaudza mutauriri weNational Assembly, Advocate VaJacob Mudenda, kuti makomiti ave kutadza kuita basa rawo nekuti makurukota ehurumende pamwe nevanyori vemapazi ehurumende havawanike, sezvo vanenge vasipo nguva dzese. Amai Mushonga vati zviri pachena kuti zvose zvinotaurwa nemutungamiriri wenyika, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, hazvisi kuitwa nekuti makurukota avo nevanyori vawo havana basa ravari kuita. Vati nekuda kwazvovo vave kuda kuita musangano wemasachigaro emakomiti eparamende nemutungamiriri wenyika. Advocate Mudenda vatambira chikumbiro chaAmai Mushonga uye vaudza mukuru webasa rehurumende muparamende zvakare vari gurukota rezvemitemo neparamende, VaZiyambi Ziyambi, kuti varonge musangano nemutungamiri wenyika. Chitatu chega chega vatevedzeri vemutungamiriri wenyika, makurukota ehurumende nevatevedzeri vavo vanosungirwa kuenda kuparamende kunopindura mibvunzo kubva kunhengo dzeparamende asi vazhinji vavo havaendi. headline: Vatambi vaita ngura: Siyachitema
text: MURAIRIDZI wechikwata chenetball cheGlow Petroleum Queens – Perpetau Siyachitema – anoti kugara nguva refu vatambi vemutambo uyu vakangogara kwava kuona vazhinji vachiusiya, kuita ngura kana kutsvaga mamwe mabasa anovararamisa.   Kubva pakatanga kumiswa mitambo gore radarika nekuda kwechirwere cheCovid-19, mutambo wenetball hauna kuzombopihwa mvumo yekutambwa zvekare izvo sekutaura kwaSiyachitema, zvava kuita kuti vamwe vatambi vaore moyo vachifunga kuti mutambo uyu hauchdzoke uye vamwe vave kuita mamwe mabasa kana zvedzimba.   “Denda iri chokwadi rakanganisa zvakawanda chaizvo nekuti vatambi vazhinji havachina shungu nemutambo uyu nekuti havachazive kuti uchadzoka here kana kuti kwete.   “Kubva gore radarika taingoita gadziriro vamwe vari kudzimba dzavo, zvino munhu anosvika pakuneta nekungoita gadziriro dzake mutambo usingadzoke.   Kuburikidza nekugara ikoko, vamwe vave kusimba miviri yavo, vamwe vave kuita pamuviri zvekuti kuzotamba netball kunozonetsa pamberi apo. “Kudai denda iri rachipera kuitira kuti upenyu hwedu nevatambi huchiendekawo nekuti ndipo panoraramira vatambi vazhinji,” anodaro Siyachitema.   Shasha iyi inoti iri kuzvishingisa ndokuudza vatambi vake kuti vasaore moyo uye vagare vachiita gadziriro dzavo kuitira kuti miviri yavo igare yakasimba.   “Pakatanga Covid-19 gore radarika, vatambi vaiita gadziriro vari kudzimba dzavo uye mazuva ose ndaigadzira mavhidhiyo ndovatumira ezvandinenge ndichida kuti vadzidze ivo vozonditumira vachizviita, asi vamwe vakasvika pakuneta nekuti vanenge vave kubvunza kuti toramba tichifondokerei iwo mutambo wacho usiri kudzoka. Vanenge vachitoti zviri nani kuita zvimwe.   “Ini semurairidzi wavo, handikwanise kuvaudza izvozvo kuti zororai, ndinongovati garai muchingoita gadziriro kusvika pazvinenge zvakanaka, hapana anoziva kuti zvinonaka rinhi,” anodaro.   Siyachitema ndiye akatungamira chikwata chemaGems chekutanga kuenda kunokwikwidza kumitambo yeWorld Cup 2019 apo chakanokwikwidza kuEngland uye kubva kumutambo uyu, akasvika achisendeka shangu dzake dzekutamba ndokutanga kurairidza mutambo uyu.   Chikwata chemaGems gore rinotevera chinofanirwa kutanga kurwira kuenda kumutambo we2023 World Cup uyo unofanirwa kuzotambirwa kuSouth Africa.   Achitaura, Siyachitema anoti kana netball ikasapihwa mvumo yekuti ichitanga kutambwa, zvinogona kuremera chikwata chemaGems gore rinotevera kusarudza vatambi vanochimirira pakurwira tikiti rekuenda kuSouth Africa sezvo vatambi vazhinji vanenge vava nengura yekugara vasingatambe kwenguva refu.   “Zvino zvino takatarisana nekurwira kuenda kuWorld Cup, zvino kana tisiri kutamba zvinogona kuzoremera chikwata chenyika.   “Mitambo iri kutofanirwa kutanga kutambwa nekuchimbidza kuti vatambi vagare vakagwinya uye vanosarudza chikwata chenyika vatange kuongorora vatambi. Patakabva kuWorld Cup yekupedzisira, vatambi vakaita seni, Pauline Jani naJoice Takaidza takabva tasendeka kutambira maGems, saka pane gwanza guru rinofanira kuvharwa.   Kana mitambo isiri kutambwa hameno kuti vanotitsiva sei,” anodaro Siyachitema.

headline: ‘Hupenyu hwevatambi hwoendeka’
text: MURAIRIDZI weTriangle United kana kuti Sugar Sugar Boys, Taurai Mangwiro, anoti kudzoka kwenhabvu kuri kuona hupenyu hwevatambi vakawanda huchitanga kuendeka sezvo vazhinji vange vakakanganisika nekugara kudzimba senzira yekudzivirira kupararira kwechirwere cheCovid-19. Nekuda kweCovid-19, gore ra2020 nhabvu yePremier Soccer League (PSL) haina kumbotambwa sezvo mitambo yose yakambomiswa.   Izvi zvakaona vamwe vatambi venhabvu vachikwangwaya sezvo vachirarama nemutambo uyu. Asi zvichitevera kudzoka kwenhabvu mwedzi wadarika, zvikwata zvemuPSL zviri kutatsurana mumutambo weChibuku Super Cup.   “Kugara kumba kwange kwakaoma uye hupenyu hwevatambi vazhinji hwakambokanganisika nekungogara nekuti mari yange isisauye.   “Mutambi wenhabvu kana akangogara mari haiuye, kune mari yakaita seyemabhonasi iyo inouya kana chikwata chahwina. Mari iyi inobatsira vatambi saka yaisauya sezvo nhabvu yange isiri kutambwa. “Asi kudzoka kwaita nhabvu kwave kusunungura zvakawanda uye hupenyu hwevatambi hwave kusimukira manje,” anodaro Mangwiro.   Mangwiro mumwe wevarairidzi vashoma vakakwanisa kuhwina mukombe weChibuku Super Cup uyo akahwapura mugore ra2018 izvo zvakazoona chikwata chake chichikwikwidza mumutambo weCAF Confederations Cup muna2019.   Mwaka uno, chikwata chake hachina kutanga zvakanaka mumutambo weChibuku Super Cup zvichitevera kukundwa kwachakaitwa mitambo miviri yekutanga 3-1 neNgezi Platinum Stars uye 2-1 neFC Platinum.   Mangwiro anoti vakatanga zvakashata asi vari kushanda nesimba kuti vadzoke mumutambo uyu uye vagohwina zvekare.   “Kuti uhwine mikombe yenhabvu inotoda kushandirwa zvakasimba saka isu tiri kushanda nesimba kuti tigohwina.   “Ndinobvuma kuti hatina kutanga zvakanaka asi chandinoziva ndechekuti tichiri nemimwe mitambo iyo ticharwa semvumba kuti tisabude mumutambo uyu.   Mitambo yedu yekutanga yakatirakidz kuti tange tichiri nengura. Asi, tine mimwe yatichatamba ndinoziva tichahwina uye togadzirisa pange pachikanganisika. Saka tiri kufanirwa kutokunya dzisimbe kuti tihwine,” anodaro Mangwiro.

headline: Kunyoresa Kuvhota Kwokonzera Mutauro Munyika
text: Sachigaro wesangano rinotungamira nyaya dzesarudzo reZimbabwe Electoral Commission, ZEC, Amai Rita Makarau, vanoti vanhu vachatanga kunyoresa kuvhota kuti vave pagwaro idzva rinoshandisa michina yechizvino zvino, kana kuti Biometric Voter Registration, nemusi weMuvhuro. Asi musi uyu, dare repamusoro reHigh Court rinenge richizeyawo nyaya yekuti zviri kuitwa neZEC zviri pamutemo here kana kuti kwete. Bato reMDC-T rakaendesa mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, mutevedzeri wavo, vanove zvekare gurukota rezvemitemo, vaEmmerson Mnangagwa, uye ZEC, kumatare richiti zvavari kuita munyaya dzesarudzo, kusanganisira nyaya yekutanga kunyoresa vavhoti, hazvisi pamutemo. Mamwe masangano, akaita seZimbabwe Election Support Network, aburitsawo mashoko kuvatori venhau nhasi achikurudzira hurumende kuti ivandudze mitemo yesarudzo kuitira kuti nyika iite sarudzo dzakachena. Sangano iri rati nyaya dzekutyora kodzero dzevanhu munguva yesarudzo, kusanganisira kuvaita kafiramberi nekuvatyisidzira, dzinofanira kumira. Sangano remubatanidzwa wemasangano akawanda akazvimirira munyika, Crisis In Zimbabwe Coalition, yaburitsawo mashoko kuvatori venhau richiti harisi kufara kuti ZEC haisi kunyatsoshandawo nemasangano akazvimirira oga muzvirongwa zvayo. Sangano iri ratiwo nenyaya yekushaya dzidziso yakakwana yezvekunyoresa kuvhota, sarudzo idzi dzichangoita sedzimwe dzakaitwa kare dzisina kutambirwa nemapato anopikisa. Mashoko aya anotsinhirwawo nemunyori mukuru weMDC-T, VaDouglas Mwonzora, vakati nemasikati eMuvhuro dare rinenge rozeya kuti zviri kuitwa neZEC zviri pamutemo here. headline: VaGari vemuManicaland Vanoti Vanoda Chouviri paZvicherwa Zviri muDunhu Ravo
text: Sangano reSouthern Eastern Trade Information and Negotiations Institute, SEATINI rinoti vagari vemunharaunda dzinoshandira makambani ekunze anenge asainirana zvibvumirano nehurumende zvekuita mabasa muno vanofanirwa kunge vaine chekuita pazvibvumirano izvi. Mashoko aya abuda pamusangano waitwa nhasi maMutare apo zvabuda pachena kuti vagari vazhinji vanozosangana nematambudziko nekuda kwekuti zvibvumirano zvinenge zvaitwa hazvineyi nemagariro avo. Nyanzvi munyaya dzezvekuongorora mafambiro emabasa musangano reSEATINI VaAdmire Mutizwa vati ichokwadi kuti vagary havana chouviri chavari kuwana kubva kuzviwanikwa munharaudza mune zvicherwa vachipa muenzaniso mangoda ari maMarange ayo vagary vanoti haapna pundutso yaaunza munharaunda mavo. “Saka zvatiri kuita kunouku ndezvekuti tiri kukurudzira kuti vagari vaparticipate maringe nekutsvagwa kuri kuita makambani ekunze, takaona pahurumende yedu itsva kuti iri kuti Zimbabwe is Open for Business zvinoreveyi kumunhu, an ordinary person, sekwaChiadzwa pane makambani akamina madiamond mari ichibuda asi hapana chavakawana saka tiri kuti zvinorevei kwavari kana zvichinzi Zimbabwe is open for business.” VaMutizwa vanoti kurudziro yavari kuita kumatunhu ose munyika ndeyekuti inzwi revagari rinzwikwewo panyaya dzebudiriro. “Chechipiri tiri kuda kukurudzira voice revagari vemunzvimbo maeerano nedevelopment, transparence and accountability, macitizens vakaita participate pakutsvagwa kwemari tinovimba kuti macitizens edu anowana zvinovabatsira munzvimbo dzavanenge vari pamusoro pemabasa anenge oitwa nemakani ekunze aya.” Muzvare Mildred Muzanechita mugari wemaMutare uye ange ari pamusangano wanhasi anoti dzidziso iripo inobatsira kuvhura pfungwa kuvagari venharaunda dzakasiyana-siyana pamusoro pezvinosungirwa kuitwa kana makambani achinge apihwa basa rekuchera zvicherwa munharaunda mavo. “Musangano uyu wabatsira pakuti tinenge tave kuziva zvatinoda basa risati raitwa sekuti venharaunda tiwanirwe pekushanda, kumacommunities sevekuPenhalonga uye Bocha, infrastructure development vanofanirwa zvakare kubatsirika nazvo. Vanoenderera mberi vachiti, “Mainvestor aya kana achiuya muno muZimbabwe tinge tiine benefit ichasara nesu kana vachinge vazopedza mabasa avo mumacommunities matinogara.” Mumwe mugari wemaMutare VaAnndy Ziyera avo vapindawo mumusangano vanoti sekutaura kwakaita mutungamiriri wenyika VaEmmerson Mnangagwa mazuva mashoma apfuura kuti inzwi revanhu inzwi ramwari zvido zvavo zvinofanirwa kuremekedzwa zvimwechetewo nekuti pakuuya kwemabhizinesi muno vange vachipawo pfungwa dzavo. “Vanhu ndivo nyika saka inzwi revanhu ndiro inzwi raMwari vakadaro VaMnangagwa, naizvozvo panoitwa mainvestments ese vanhu vanofanirwa kunge nechekuitawo, FDI haifanirwi kuuraya local investment uye tinotarisira kuti itobatsira local investment yacho.” Vanotizve, “Tinoziva kuti tairima cotton muno but yakatourayiwa neizvozvo tave kuimporta cotton kana maSkipper muno anobva kuChina saka tinodawo equal treatment.” Musangano uyu wakapindwa nevagari vanobva kunzvimbo dzinocherwa zviwanikwa dzakaita sePenhalonga, Marange uye Chimanimani. headline: VaMnangagwa Vanoti Vanenge Vakundwa Ngavabvume Kukundwa
text: Mutungamiri wenyika, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, vanoti vanhu vanenge vakundwa musarudzo vanofanirwa kubvuma kukundwa voshanda nekupembera nevanenge vakakunda kuitira kuti munyika muve nerunyararo. Vachitaura nhasi muBanket apo vanga vachitsvaira marara mumusha unogara veruzhinji weKuwadzana, VaMnangagwa vati vanhu vanofanirwa kuwirirana munyika, uye kuti kana munhu akundwa musarudzo, haafanirwe kuita zvemhirizhonga asi kuti anofanirwa kupembera nevakakunda kuti munyika muve nerunyararo. VaMnangagwa vati kana munhu akundwa anofanirwa kusiya zvinenge zvamukundisa zvemhirizhonga, uyo anenge akunda sezvavakaita, oramba achiita zvinoita kuti arambe achikunda. VaMnangagwa vati bato ravo reZanu PF rinokunda nokudaro richaramba richiita zvinokundisa zvekuenda kunonzwa zvichemo zvevanhu nekuzvigadzirisa sezvavakaita zvekuunza mabhazi anobhadharwa mari shoma yekufambisa. Kunyange VaMnangagwa vasina kudoma bato nezita, vazhinji vanoti ibato rinopikisa reMDC inotungamirirwa naVaNelson Chamisa ranga richitaurwa. Asi mutevedzeri wemutauriri webato reMDC, VaLuke Tamborinyoka, vati bato ravo harisi kuzobva pachokwadi chekuti VaMnangagwa vakabirira sarudzo izvo vanoti Zimbabwe Electoral Commission yakabvuma nekuchinja zvakabuda musarudzo katatu. Panyaya yehutsanana VaMnangagwa vati hurumende ichaisa mutemo wekuti motokari dzose dzinotakura veruzhinji zvikuru mabhazi dzive nemabhini ekurasira marara sezvo zvakaonekwa kuti vanhu vanenge vari mudzimotokari vanorasa marara nepamahwindo. Asi mumwe mugari wemuBanket asina kuda kudomwa nezita anoti kuchenesa nzvimbo hakufanirwe kumirira zuva rinotsvaira mutungamiri wenyika sezviri kuitika muBanket umo makatsvairwa nezuro nekuti VaMnangagwa vari kuuya. VaMnangangwa, avo vasvika muBanket nguva dza 8 manganani dzavanga vachitarisirwa, vaudza vanhu kuti vakurumidza nekuti vari kuenda kuAdis Ababa, KuEthiopia nhasi kumusangano weAfrican Union. headline: Hurumende IYosimbaradza Kuti ZUPCO Ndiyo Yega Ine Mvumo Yekutakura Vanhu
text: Mutevedzeri wegurukota Amai Marian Chombo vanoti kambani yemabhazi, yeZimbabwe United Passenger Company (ZUPCO) ndiyo yega yakapihwa mvumo yekutakura vanhu mumaguta. Izvi zvinotevera kunyunyuta kwevanhu vakawanda munyika nerimwe sangano rinomirira vanotakura vanhu nezvinhu, reZimbabwe Union of Drivers and Conductors (ZUDCO) kuti kambani yeZUPCO yaremerwa nemutoro. Mutungamiri weZUDCO, VaFredrick Maguramhinga, vanoti hurumende haisi kuda kunzwa zvichemo zvevanhu vari kunetseka nekushaya zvinovatakura kuenda nekudzoka kumabasa. VaMaguramhinga vanoti sangano ravo ririkuramba richikumbira hurumende kuti iite musangano nevanotakura vanhu kuti zvinonetsa mativi ose zvikurukurwe uye kuti hurumende ikwanise kubatsira mukugadziriswa kwedambudziko iri sezvainofanirwa kuita. Vachipindura chikumbiro cheZUDCO ichi , Amai MaChombo, vanoti kana hurumende yatura gwara nemutemo hazvigoni kungozvisendeka parutivi.  No media source currently available

headline: Kanzuru yeHarareYoronga Kuwanisa Vanhu Mvura Munguva Dzakasiyana
text: Kanzuru yeHarare yazivisa kuti ichatanga kugovera mvura nguva dzakasiyana nekuda kwekuderera kwemvura pamwe nekuwanda kwetsvina munyanza yeLake Chivero. Kanzuru yeHarare inoti yatarisana nematambudziko akawanda munyanza iyi zvekuti ichatanga kugovera vanhu mvura mwedzi uno sezvo isisakwanise kuti mugari wese muguta awane mvura yakachena. Mukuru anoona nezvekufambiswa kwemabasa pachigayo chemvura cheMorton Jaffrey Water Works, VaPaul Chabata, vati mvura iri mudhamu yasviba zvakaipisisa nekuda kwetsvina inobva kuHarare nezvimbo dzakatenderedza guta iri izvo zvave kuita kuti kanzuru ishandise mari yakawanda pakuchenesa mvura iyi. Vatiwo tsvina iyi inokonzerwawo nevanhu vanoredza hove zvisina mvumo mudhamu yave kukanganisa kanzuru pakupomba mvura. Mabharani mukuru wekanzuru, Engineer Hosiah Chisangno, vati vari kukurudzira vagari kuchengetedza mvura uye kanzuru yavo ichatanga kugovera vanhu mvura kutanga mwedzi uno. Vatiwo kunzuru ichavhara chigayo cheMorton Jaffrey mukupera kwesvondo kuitira kuti vabvise tsvina irimo uye izvi zvichawedzera huwandu hwemvura kubva pa 360 mega litres kusvika pa 450 mega litres pazuva. Vagari vemuHarare vanoshandisa 800 mega litres muchando ne1200 mega litres panguva yezhizha pazuva rega rega. Vanoona nezvekufambiswa kwebasa musangano reCommunity Water Alliance, VaHardlife Mudzingwa, vaudza Studio7 kuti havabvumirani nematanho ari kuda kutorwa nekanzuru ekugovera mvura vachiti zvichaita kuti vagari vabatwe nezvirwere. VaMudzingwa vati kanzuru inofanira kutora mvura kubva kune mamwe madhamu akaita seDarwendale kuti mvura ikwanire munhu wese. Muzvina bhizimisi vashanda padhamu iri kwenguva yakareba, VaGarry Stafford, vaudza Studio7 kuti kuzara kwejecha mudhamu kuri kukonzerwa nekurimwa kuri kuitwa mumatoro nedzimwe nzvimbo muHarare nenzvimbo dzakatenderedza guta uye zvakakosha kuti zvisaitwe kuti dhamu reChivero risaparare. Vati dhamu iri range rakadzika mamita makumi maviri nemasere asi pari zvino rakadzika mamita gumi nemasere chete sezvo razara jecha. Nyanzvi munyaya dzemvura dzinoti tsvina yakawanda iri kupinda muLake Chivero iri kukonzerwa nekanzuru yeHarare iyo iri kutadza kugadzirisa mapombi anotakura tsvina. Nyanzvi idzi dzinoti kuendeswa kwetsvina isina kuiswa mishonga inodzora hukasha hwetsvina munzizi dzakaita seMukuvisi neManyame kuri kuwedzerawo kuipa kwemvura yemuLake Chivero. Muna Kurume 2015 kanzuru yeHarare yakawanikwa nematare edzimhosva iine mhosva yekudira siweji muna Mukuvisi isina kucheneswa sezvinodiwa nemutemo ikafaindiswa zviuru zana zvemadhora ekuAmerica. Kanzuru yeHarare yakabatwa nemhosva yekutyora mutemo weEnvironmental Management Act kuburikidza nekudira tsvina munzizi dzinoti Mukuvisi, Marimba, Ruwa neNyatsime, nzizi dzine mvura inopedzisira yapinda muLake Chivero. Nyanzvi mukuvakwa kwemaguta dzinoti guta reHarare rakavakirwa panzvimbo isina kunaka sezvo riri munzvimbo inofamba nemvura inopinda muLake Chivero, izvo zvinoita kuti mvura iyi isvibe zvakanyanya. Pari zvino guta reHarare rinoda mari inosvika mamiriyoni matatu emadhora semari yekutenga mishonga yekuchenesa mvura pamwedzi wega wega. No media source currently available

headline: Mitambo yePSL yamiswa
text: SANGANO rePremier Soccer League razivisa kuti mitambo yose yePSL ye”match day two” iyo yange ichitambwa svondo rino yambomiswa zvichitevera kusauya kwaita varidzi vepembe kuzoridza mune mimwe mitambo yange ichifanirwa kutambwa nhasi.   Pachinyorwa chabva kuPSL, chamangwiza wePSL, Kennedy Ndebele, anoti kusabatika kwaita varidzi vepembe mumitambo yanhasi kwavatuma kumisa mitambo yose ye”match day two” nechinangwa chekuedza kuita tsvakurudzo kuti zvafamba sei.   “Tinoziva kumiswa kwemitambo yose yematch day two izvo zvakonzerwa nekusauya kubasa kwaita varidzi vepembe kumitambo yakasiyana.   “Asi kune vamwe vaenda kunhandare vachida kunoridza asi havana kuzokwanisa kuenderera mberi sezvo vamwe vazongoregedza mitambo yave kuda kutanga.   “Tamboedza kuita hurukuro neZIFA Referees Committee kuti tinzwisise kuti zviri kufamba sei, asi hapana chabuda.   “Tinovimba kuti zvichagadzirika nekukasika,” anodaro Ndebele.   Kusabatika kwevaridzi vepembe kumitambo yanhasi vamwe vanoti zvakonzerwa nekumbomiswa kwaita basa bhodhi reZIFA nhasi neSports and Recreation Commission (SRC).

headline: VaMthuli Ncube Voendeswa kuMatare neNyaya yeKukwidza Mutero
text: Mumwe muzvinabhizimisi wemuHarare, VaArnold Mutsondi, vaendesa gurukota rezvemari, Muzvinafundo Muthuli Ncube, kumatare vachiti mutemo wavo wavakadzika wekuwedzera mutero hausi pamutemo uye hautarisirwe munyika ine hutongo hwejekerere. VaNcube vakati vanhu vatange kubhadhara masendi maviri padhora roga roga pavanoshandisa makadhi avo ekubhengi kubva pamasendi mashanu pachero mari yavanenge vachitumira kana kushandisa. VaMutsondi vanoti zviri pachena kuti hurumende iri kuda kuomesera vanhu vasina mhaka nekuti yakundikana kugadzirisa dambudziko remari. Gweta raVaMutsondi, VaAlex Majachani, vanoti zviri kuitwa naVaNcube kutyora bumbiro remutemo wenyika. Hatina kukwanisa kubata VaNcube kuti tinzwe divi ravo panyaya iyi. headline: Bato reNCA Rokwirira VaMugabe Dare
text: Bato rinopikisa reNational Constitutional Assembly, NCA, rinoti ratuma magweta aro kuti akwire kudare repamusoro soro reConstitutional Court, achimisa mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, kugadza vatevedzeri vavo vaviri richiti zviri kunze kwebumbiro remitemo yenyika. Mutauriri webato iri, VaMadock Chivasa, vanoti bumbiro remitemo idzva rinoti VaMugabe vaifanirwa kunge vakadoma vatevedzeri vavo vaviri sarudzo dzichangopera, kwete kuzozviita kwapera gore sarudzo dzaitwa. VaChivasa vanoti bato ravo riri kutevera Sixth Schedule paragraph 14 sub-paragraph iyo vanoti inoti VaMugabe vaifanirwa kudoma vatevedzeri vavo vaviri pasina kunonoka. Imwe nyaya inonzi naVaChivasa iri mugwaro ravo riri kuenda kudare ndeyekuti hutungamiri hwenyika hwaVaMugabe nevatevedzeri vavo vaviri hahunawo munhukadzi sezvinotarisirwa munyika ine vanhukadzi vakawanda kudarika vanhurume. VaChivasa vanoti magweta avo eMbidzo, Muchadehama and Makoni achaendesa mapepa aya chekutanga neChishanu mangwanani. VaMugabe vari kutarisirwa kutoresa mhiko VaEmmerson Mnangagwa pamwe naVaPelekezela Mphoko sevatevedzeri vavo vaviri. Imwe nyanzvi munyaya dzemitemo inodzidzisa paKent University kuBritain, Doctor Alex Magaisa, vanoti nyaya yeNCA inonakidza kutevera. Vanoti chikamu chemutemo chiri kushandiswa nebato iri nechinonzi chakashandiswawo naVaMugabe zvinonetsa kunyatsonzwisisa asi vanoti dare repamusorosoro iri rinogonawo kuramba kutambira nyaya iyi. Zvichakadaro, bato reMDC T rinotiwo riri kuronga kuroverera VaMugabe nemhosva yekutyora bumbiro remitemo nekudzinga kwavakaita mutevedzeri wavo, Amai Joice Mujuru, kubva pachigaro richishandisa nhengo dzaro mudare reparamende. Mutauriri webato iri, VaObert Gutu, vaudza bepanhau reNewsDay kuti VaMugabe vakazvidza bumbiro renyika nekudzinga kwavakaita Amai Mujuru, vachiti mutevedzeri wemutungamiri wenyika anofanirwa kudzingwa chete pachiteverwa bumbiro renyika. headline: Vatambi VeTeam Zimbabwe 2016 Paralympic Vodzokera Kumusha Vasina Menduru
text: Vatambi vemuZimbabwe vema2016 Paralympic Games vari kudzoka kumusha vari maoko chete. Mutori wedu wenhau dzemitambo. Vatambi vaviri vanga vasara kukwikwidza mumakundano aya ve Mixed Four, Margaret Bangajena, Michelle Garnet, Jesicca Davies na Previous Wiri nezuro vakapedza vari pachinhanho chekugumisira mugungano ravo. Vatambi ava vakatevera Laina Sithole uyo neMugovera akatadza kusvika mufainari ye 100 metres T35 ayo aive makundano ake ega aaikwikwidza. Sezvakaitawo chikwata cheZimbabwe kubva kumaOlympic Games chisina menduru, chikwata ichi chiri kudzokawo chisina kana menduru imwechete. Mumitambo yeCastle Lager Premier Soccer League chikwata cheHighlanders chiri mumafaro makuru mushure mekudzokorora kurova Dynamos 2-1mumutambo wanga wakaoma muBarbiurfields Stadium nezuro. Aka kave kechipiri Highlanders ichi kunda Dynamos mwaka uno wenhabvu mumitambo yeligi, kanove kechipiri zvekare mukati memakore gumi Bosso ichikwanisa kukunda Dembare. Kukunda uku kwasiya Bosso yasara nemapoinzi gumi pasi pechikwata chiri kutungamira cheFC Platinum icho chakarova How Mine 1-0 munhandare yeMandava. Mutsigiri weBosso VaDannboy Hamandishe vanoti vangadai vakakunda nezvibodzwa zvakawanda asi zvakangodaro varatidza kuti vanhu vakuru. Mumwe wavo VaTichaona Jecha vanoti murairidzi wawave naye ibanga chairo vachiti zvinhu zvasanduka. Kugona Kunenge Kudada yave nemapoinzi makumi mana nemasere kubva mumitambo makumi maviri nemitatu. Asi Bosso yave nemapoinzi matanhatu pamusoro peDynamos iyo nemamiriro akaita zvinhu yave kuratidza kuti yabuda mumakwikwi emukombe weligi. Asi Makepekepe aramba arimo muhondo yeligi mushure mekurova Chicken Inn 1-0. Kunyange hazvo chikwata ichi chaibaka moto hachina kukwanisa kunwisa zvibodzwa zvakawanda kunze kwechimwechete chakabva kuna Leonard Tsipa. Chikwata chemaGreen Machine chakatamba zvine mutsindo zvekuti mumwe muteveri wechikwata ichi Charles Muroyiwa anoti vanoisa mari muchikwata ichi vanotsvaga neshungu nematambiro aya. Asi maGreen Machine ari kuramba aiine poindi imwechete pasi peFC Platinum iyo yakarova How Mine. Musi mumwechete iwoyo, Hwange neZPC Kariba dzakaita mangange 1-1. Ngezi yakadambura Bulawayo City 1-0, Tsholotsholo ikakunda Border Strikers 1-0 asi Chapungu yakanwisa zviviri pakukunda Harare City 2-1. No media source currently available

headline: Mvura Yonetsa Vagari vekwaGutu kuMasvingo
text:
Vagari vakawanda kwaMpandawana kwaGutu vanoti vari kutyira kubatwa nezvirwere zvakaita seCholera sezvo vave nemasvondo anodarika matatu vasina mvura mudzimba dzavo zvichinzi mushina unopomba mvura wakafa. Vagari vanoti vakaudzwa nebazi reZinwa rinovapa mvura kuti kune mishina yakafa kudhamu rinopombwa mvura asi havafari nenguva yareba yatorwa dambudziko iri risina kugadziriswa. Vagari vemumisha yeve ruzhinji yakaita seku Hwiru nekuGona vanoti nekushomeka kwemvura vave kushandisa mvura yemumatsime asina kuvharwa pamwe nezvikova iyo iri kukanganisa hutano hwavo. Sachigaro wesangano rinomiririra vagari reGutu United Residents and Rate Payers Alliance, VaLloyd Mufudze, vanoti vagari vazhinji vave kugara vachinzwa midumbu nekushandisa mvura yakasviba yemumatsime.

Mumwe mugari wemumusha weGona, VaTafunga Mamombe, vanoti kushaikwa kwemvura kwenguva refu kwave kutyorwa kodzero dzavo. VaMamombe vati vakaudzwa kuti mushina uchagadziriswa nekukurumidza asi nanhasi chabuda hapana. Vamwe vagari vari kupomera kanzuru yeGutu, mhosva yekusaita hany’a nedambudziko ravo nekusunda bazi reZinwa kuti rigadzirise dambudziko iri. Asi mukuru webasa mukanzuru yekwaGutu, VaAlexender Mutembwa, vaudza Stduio 7 parunhare kuti dambudziko iri riri kuZinwa, ivo havana simba rekuvamhanyisa kuti vagadzirise. Kanzura veward 34 maMupandawana, VaBernard Chimwango, vanoti vakambozama kutaura ne Zinwa kuti igadzirise zviri kunetsa, asi bazi iri riri kuisa zvitanda munzeve.

Asi mutaururi weZinwa, VaTsungirai Shoriwa, vati vane hurombo nekutadza kugadzirisa dambudziko iri, asi vati riri kugadziriswa nechimbi chimbi. Vagari vanoti dambudziko remvura rinotyirwa kuti ringango wedzera kupararira kweChirwere cheCovid-19 icho chinokurudzirwa kushandiswa kwemvura yakakwanda uye yakachena. headline: Bato Rinopikisa reCCC Roparura Gwaro Raro Rine Zvarinoti Zvigadziriswe Sarudzo Dzisati Dzaitwa
text: Bato rinopikisa reCitizens Coalition for Change, CCC rinotungamirirwa naVaNelson Chamisa, nhasi riri kuparura gwaro raro rinonzi PRE-ELECTION PACT ON ELECTORAL REFORMS, kana kuti PREPARE, iro rine zvinhu zvinomwe zvarinoti zvinofanirwa kutanga zvavandudzwa sarudzo dza 2023 dzisati dzaitwa. s Mutauriri weCCC, Muzvare Fadzai Mahere, vanoti mutungamiri webato ravo, VaNelson Chamisa, vakatara gore rino ra 2022 segore rekuti mitemo inobata sarudzo ivandudzwe kuitira kuti sarudzo dza 2023 dzitambirike nemapoka ose achakwikwidza. Muzvare Mahere vanoti zviri mugwaro ravo zvinomwe zvavanoda kuona zvichivandudzwa zvinoti wese mwana weZimbabwe ari kunze kwenyika kana mujeri apiwe kodzero yake yekuvhota sezviri mubumbiro remitemo, gwaro revavhoti riongororwe, chetatu, zvabuda musarudzo zviziviswe paine nguva. Chechina vanoti Zimbabwe Electoral Commission, ZEC, ishandirwe nevanhu vasina kwavakarerekera, kwete kungozara mauto nenhengo dzeZanu PF chete. Chechishanu Muzvare Mahere vanoti bato ravo riri kuda kuti mashandiro emasangano enhau ari pasi pehurumende avandudzwe kuitira kupa mukana kumapato anopikisa. Chechitanhatu vanoti vanhu vanofanirwa kuvhota vakasununguka, uye chechinomwe vachiti vanoda kuti nhengo dzemapato anopikisa dzisangoshungurudzwa misangano yadzo ichivhiringidzwa nekurambidzwa nemapurisa kana nenhengo dzebato riri kutonga. Bato iri rinoti rakoka mapoka ose ane chekuita nesarudzo munyika anosanganisira masangano akazviomirira, venhau, vamiriri veparamende, makanzura, vamiriri vedzimwe nyika pamwe nemapazi ehurumende neZEC kuti vange varipo pakuparurwa kwegwaro ravo iri. headline: ZIMTA Inoti Nhengo Dzayo Hadzichakwanisa Kuramba Dzichienda Kumabasa
text: Rimwe sangano rinomirira varairidzi, re Zimbabwe Teachers Association (ZIMTA), rabatanawo nemamwe masangano evarairidzi pakuzivisa kuti nhengo dzaro hadzichakwanisa kuramba dzichienda kumabasa sezvo dzisisina mari dzekufambisa. Mutungamiri wesangano iri, VaRichard Gundani, vanoti nhengo dzavo dzichange dzichienda kumabasa kaviri chete pasvondo, Muvhuro neChishanu. VaGundani vanoti danho ratorwa nesangano ravo rinotsinhira danho rakaziviswa nesangano rinomirira vashandi vehurumende, re APEX Council, rekuti vashandi vehurumende vakanga vasisakwanise kuramba vachienda kumabasa mazuva ose. Asi mutevedzeri wegurukota rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko, VaEnergy Mutodi vakaudza Studio 7 neSvondo kuti hurumende yakasununguka kuramba ichiita hurukuro nevashandi vayo pamusoro pemihoro yavo. Masangano anomiririra varairidzi, e Propgressive Teachers Union of Zimbabwe neAmalgamated Rural Teachers Union of Zimbabwe, ndemamwe masangano evarairidzi akatozivisa kare kuti nhengo dzawo dzakanga dzisisakwanise kuramba dzichienda kumabasa. No media source currently available Zvichakadaro, sangano rinomiririra varairidzi vekumaruwa, re Amalgamated Rural Teachers Union of Zimbabwe, rinoti nhengo dzaro dzave kutangidza kuratidzira vhiki yega yega kusvika hurumende yagadzirisa zvichemo zvevarairidzi. Mutungamiriri wesangano iri, VaObert Masaraure, vaudza Studio 7 kuti sangano ravo richatangidza kudzidzisa nekubatsira vana vechikoro pa nzvimbo dzavachazivisa asi kwete muzvikoro. Hatina kukwanisa kunzwa kubva kubazi re zvedzidzo kuti izvi zvichibvumidzwa here nemitemo yenyika. No media source currently available

headline: NAAZ yotumira shangwiti kuNigeria
text: SANGANO reNational Athletics Association of Zimbabwe (NAAZ) rinoti rakanyorera kuHurumende richikumbira mvumo kuti rigotumira shangwiti dzerelay kunokwikwidza kumujaho weMoC relays (4×100) uyo uchaitirwa kuLagos kuNigeria svondo rino.   NAAZ yakashevedzwa kumutambo uyu neThe Athletics Federation of Nigeria (AFN) uye chikwata cheZimbabwe chinofanirwa kunge chave kuNigeria musi weChishanu chino chichigadzirira mujaho uyu uchamhanywa musi weMugovera neSvondo.   Mutungamiri weNAAZ — Tendai Tagara — anoti sangano ravo richiri rakamira mhinduro kubva kuHurumende uye kunzwa kubva kuAFN nevakotsveri vemutambo uyu kuti vagotumira matikiti endege nemaVisa evamhanyi vavo vavachatumira.   “Takangomirira kunzwa kubva kuHurumende yedu kuti tozvifambisa sei parwendo urwu uye kubva kuAFN nevakotsveri vemutambo uyu vekuNigeria avo vakatidana kuti tiende kunokwikwidza. Mujaho uyu uchashanda mukurwira zvekare tikiti rekuenda kumaOlympics saka tiri kuukoshesa zvakanyanya. Kana tapihwa mvumo, chikwata chedu chinofanira kunge chave kuNigeria musi weChishanu, choswera chakazorora chiriko nekuti musi weMugovera chinenge chakatobvondoka kumujaho uhu,” anodaro Tagara.   Anoti iye zvino havasati vaziva kuti ndevapi vatambi vavachasarudza kuti vapinde muchikwata ichi sezvo vari kumbomirira mvumo yekuenda ndipo vozotanga kudoma vatambi vekutakura.   “Pari zvino hatisati tave nechikwata asi vatinogona kutumira ndevari kurwira kuenda kumaOlympics vanosanganisira Ngoni Makusha, Chengetai Mapaya, Kundai Maguranyanga, Tinotenda Matienda nevamwe vari kurwira kuenda kuIAAF World championships,” anodaro Tagara.

headline: Ongororo Yoratidza Kuti Vanhu Vari Kutarisira Mutungamiri Anovawanisa Mabasa
text: Ongororo yaitwa neAfrobarometer inoti rutsigiro rweveruzhinji kumutungamiri wenyika, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, rwuri kudzikira kana zvichienzaniswa neimwe ongororo yavakaita masvondo mashoma adarika. Vachizivisa zvakabuda muongororo yavo, mukuru anoona nezvekutsvakiridza musangano reMass Public Opinion Institute iro rakaita tsvagiriridzo iyi richishanda nesangano reAfrobarometer Institute of Justice and Reconciliation, VaStephen Ndoma, vati huwandu hwevanhu vakati vachavotera VaMnangagwa musarudzo dzemwedzi uno hwaderera kubva pakaitwa ongororo yekutanga. Ongororo iyi inotiwo panyaya yevanhu vari kutarisira mukana wekuwana mabasa, vanhu vakawanda vanoti izvi zvinoitika chete kana mutungamiri weMDC Alliance, VaNelson Chamisa, vari ivo vari panyanga. Nyanzvi munyaya dzezvematongerwo uye vachiwanzotaura vakarere kubatika reZanu PF, VaGadzira Chirumhanzu, vati zvaburitswa neAfrobarometer zvinoratidza kuti VaMnangagwa vane rutsigiro kudarika mutungamiri weMDC Alliance, VaNelson Chamisa. Imwe nyanzvi munyaya dzezvematongerwo enyika uye vachishanda vakazvimirira, VaVivid Gwede, vati zvakabuda muongororo yeAfrobarometer iyi zvinoratidza kuti sarudzo dzemusi wa30 Chikunguru dzichapindwa rwepiri pakati paVaMnangagwa naVaChamisa. VaNdoma vati ongororo yavo yakabiritsawo zvakare kuti ruzhinji rwuri kutyira kuti vari muchiuto havazotambire zviri zveveruzhinji mushure mesarudzo. Vatiwo vakaona zvakare kuti vanhu vane chitsama havasi kuziva kuti magwaro anoratidza kuti munhu akanyoresa kuvhota haasi kuzoshandiswa musi wesarudzo uye vazhinji vakataurwa navo vakati vanotyawo mhirizhonga ine chekuita nesarudzo.
