headline: Zim Cricket yotarisira kuna Houghton
text: ZIMBABWE Cricket inoti iri kutarisira zvikuru kubva kumurairidzi mutsva wemaChevrons – Dave Houghton – uyo akagadzwa pachigaro chinopisa ichi svondo radarika.   Houghton akatsiva Lalchand Rajput zvichitevera kupihwa kwaakaitwa chigaro chitsva chatechnical director.   Givemore Makoni anove managing director weZC anoti Houghton inyanzvi yecricket muZimbabwe nekudaro chikwata chemaChevrons chichange chiri mumaoko akanaka.   Aka kachange kari kechipiri Houghton achiraidza maChevrons uye akambochitambira chikwata ichi ari kaputeni asati atanga kurairidza mutambo uyu.   “Dave Houghton igamba recricket munyika yedu uye anoziva zvinodiwa kuti mutambo uyu usimukire zvikuru. Saka takamupa basa iri nechinangwa chekuti asimudzire mutambo uyu sezvo tange tadzikira.   “Munhu akatambira maChevrons ari mutungamiri wevatambi ndokuzorairidza chikwata ichi zvekare makore ayo chaitamba mhando yecricket yepamusoro-soro. Saka tinotarisira zvikuru kwaari uye tinovimba kuti achasimudzira zvekare matambiro echikwata chedu,” anodaro Makoni.    Givemore Makoni   Zvichitevera kugadzwa kwake, Houghton ari kutarisirwa kutungamira maChevrons mumutambo we2022 ICC Men’s T20 World Cup Global Qualifier B wekurwira kuenda kuICC 2022 T20 World Cup uyo uchatambirwa kuAustralia munaGumiguru gore rino.   Mutambo wekurwira kuenda kumakwishu aya uchatambirwa muno mwedzi unotevera uye uchange uine zvikwata zvisere. MaChevrons ari muboka rekutanga rine zvimwe zvikwata zvinoti Jersey, Indonesia neUnited States of America kuchiti rimwe boka rine zvikwata zvinoti Hong Kong, Netherlands, Papua New Guinea neUganda.   Muboka rega-rega muchabuda zvikwata zviviri izvo zvichaenda kumasemi-final.   Zvikwata zvinohwina musemi-final ndizvo zvichabudirira kuenda kuAustralia.

headline: Dare reHigh Court Rinobvuma Chikumbiro chevana vaMushakabvu Mugabe Chekuti Vapikise Kufukunyurwa kweMutumbi Wavo
text: Dare repamusoro reHigh Court nemusi weChina rakabvuma chikumbiro chevana vevaimbove mutungamiri wenyika mushakabvu VaRobert Mugabe chekuti vapikise mutongo wekuti mutumbi wababa vavo ufukunyurwe unovigwa kunovigwa magamba enyika kuHeroes Acre. Vachipa mutongo wavo kuburikidza negwaro, vatongi vedare repamusoro vanoti Justice Fatima Maxwell naJustice Amy Tsanga vakawirirana kuti vana vaVaMugabe vanoti Bona Mutsahuni Mugabe, Tinotenda Robert Mugabe Jnr. naBellarmine Chatunga vane kodzero pamutemo kupikisa mutongo waMambo Zvimba wekuti mutumbi wababa vavo ufukunyurwe kwavakavigwa kumusha kwavo kwaZvimba kuti vanovigwa kumarinda anovigwa magamba kuHeroes Acre kuHarare. Vana vaVaMugabe vainge vapikisa mutongo waMambo Zvimba kudare ramejasitiriti muChinhoyi asi mutongi Amai Ruth Moyo vainge varasa chikumbiro ichi vachiti vana ava havakwanise kupikisa mutongo waMambo Zvimba sezvo vainge vasiri ivo vainge vaendeswa kudare raMambo asi Amai vavo Grace Mugabe. Asi dare repamusoro iri rakati vana ava vane kodzero yakazara. Rimwe remagweta evana vaVaMugabe, VaFungai Chimwamurombe vaudza Studio 7 kuti mutongo uyu unopa vana ava kodzero yekupikisa mutongo waMambo. VaChimwamurombe vati vave kutonyorera Mejasitiri Moyo nezvemutongo wedare repamusoro uyu kuti vavape zuva richanzwikwa nyaya iyi. Mutauriri wemhuri yekwaMugabe ari muzukuru waVaMugabe, VaLeo Mugabe, vaudza Studio 7 kuti vanga vasati vapirwa nezvemutongo uyu. Studio 7 yakundikana kubata Mambo Zvimba kuti tinzwewo divi ravo pamutongo uyu sezvo nharembozha yavo yanga isingadairwi. Nyaya yenzvimbo yekuvigwa kwaVaMugabe yakanetsa kubva pavakafa makore maviri apera kusvika nhasi. Vamwe vanoti dai varega mutumbi wevaive mutungamiri wenyika ava wazorora murugare.

headline: VaJuly Moyo Votarisirwa Kupa Rekupedzisira Pakuti Harare Yokwereta Here Mari Inodarika Bhiriyoni yemuNyika
text: Gurukota rinoona nezvematunhu VaJuly Moyo vave kutarisirwa kupa rekupedzisira pachikumbiro chekanzuru yeHarare chekuti ikwanise kupihwa mukana wekukwereta mari inodarika bhiriyoni imwe chete nezviuru mazana mana emunyika. Nyaya iyi yaunza kusawirirana pakati pekanzuru nemasangano anomirira vagari. Vakafanobata chigaro chameya wemuHarare VaStewart Mtizwa vebato reMDC- Alliance vaudza Studio 7 kuti sezvinodiwa pamutemo vakaendesa kuhofisi yaVaMoyo chikumbiro chavo pamwe nezvakataurwa nevagari. Hatina kukwanisa kubata VaMoyo sezvo nharembozha yavo yange isiri kudairwa. VaMtizwa vaatti kanzuru yavo haikwanise kuita mabasa makuru kana vakasapihwa mvumo yekukwereta mari iyi. Vagari vainge vapihwa kusvika musi wa 7 Kubvumbi kuti vape pfungwa dzavo uye vakawanda vari kutsika madziro. Mutungamiri werimwe sangano revagari reHarare Residents Trust vaPrecious Shumba varamba zviri kutaurwa naVaMtizwa. Asi mutauriri weguta reHarare vaMichael Chideme vatiwo zvakakosha kuti kanzuru ikwereteswe mari iyi.nekuti izvi ndizvo zvinoiutwawo nemakanzuru ose pasi rino kana vachida kuita mabasa makuru. Izvi zvapikiswa nevanoona nezvekufambiswa kwemabasa mune rimwe sangano rinomiririra vagari reCombined Harare Residents Association VaReuben Akili vati kanzuru haibude pachena kuti yawana marii pazvirongwa zvakafanana nekubhadhariswa kwevanhu mari dzekumbosiya motokari muguta reHarare. Pamutemo, kana kanzuru ichida kukwereta mari inofanira kutanga yagara yobuda nechisungo chinozotambirwa nameya. Kanzuru inozozivisa vanhu kuburikidza nekushambadzira mumapepanhau uye vanhu vane mazuva makumi maviri nerimwe kuti vapindure. Kana izvi zvapera chikumburo uye zvinenge zvataurwa nevanhu zvinozoendeswa kugurukota rezvematunhu kuti rione kuti kanzuru yebvumidzwa here kana kuti kwete kukwereta mari. headline: Hupfu Hwowedzedzerwa Mutengo Zvakanyanya
text: Mutengo wehupfu hwakwira zvakanyanya mushure mekunge gurukota rinoona nezvemari Muzvinafundo Mthuli Ncube vabvisa mari yange ichibhadharwa nehurumende kuti chibage chinotengeswa kuGrain Marketing Board kana kuti GMB chinge chakaderera mutengo. VaNcube vakazivisa nezvedanho iri pavakaparura hurongwa hwavo hwekushandiswa kwemari kana kuti bhajeti regore rinouya. Kunyangwe hazvo vemuzvitoro vange vatowedzera mutengo nemadhora makumi matatu, veGrain Millers Association of Zimbabwe GMAZ vanoti vachaita musangano wechimbi chimbi kuti vaone kuti voita sei nenyaya yemutengo. Mutauriri weGMAZ VaGarikai Chaunza vaudza Studio 7 kuti ivo havatare mitengo yehupfu sezvo ravo basa riri rekugaya chete chibage chavanenge vatenga kuGMB. No media source currently available Kuwedzerwa kwemutengo hwehupfu kuri kuuya apo nyika yakatarisana nenzara inotyisa yapa kuti masangano anopa rubatsiro aparure hurongwa hwekupa vanhu vemumadhorobha vanodarika mamiriyoni maviri chikafu. Kumaruwa vanhu vanodarika mamiriyoni mashanu vakatarisanawo nenzara.

headline: Vakawanda Vokurudzira Kuti VaTomana Vasiye Basa
text: Vanhu vakawanda munyika kusanganisira mapato anopikisa vave kukurudzira kuti muchuchisi mukuru wenyika, VaJohannes Tomana vasiye basa mushure mekuwanikwa kwavo nedare reConstitutional Court vaine mhosva yekuzvidza matare. VaTomana vakapiwa mutongo wekugara mujeri kwemazuva makumi matatu, mushure mekuwanikwa vaine mhosva yekuramba kuti mumiriri weBikita West muparamende VaMunyaradzi kereke pamwe nemuzvinabhizimusi Amai Jane Mutasa vatongwe. Dare iri rakazosendeka parutivi mutongo uyu richipa VaTomana mazuva gumi ekuti vatevedzere mutongo uyu vachipa mvumo yekuti vaviri ava vatongwe, kutadza kwavo kuita izvi vokandwa mujeri kwemazuva ambosendekwa pautivi aya, uye rezinesi ravo rehugweta rokanzurwa. VaKereke vari kupomerwa mhosva yekubhinya mwanasikana wehama yavo aive nemakore gumi nerimwe muna 2010, ukuwo Amai Mutasa vachipomerwawo mhosva yekuba makadhi ekufonesa ekambani yeTelecel anokosha $1.7 million mugore rimwechetero ra2010. VaTomana ndivo vakanga vakwira kudare reConstitutional Court vachida kuti vapiwe masimba ekuita basa ravo vakasununguka pasina anopindira. Mutauriri webato reMDC T VaObert Gutu vanoti bato ravo riri kukurudzira kuti VaTomana vasiye basa sezvo izvi zvichi svibisa zita ravo pamwe nehofisi yemuchuchisimukuru. Vanoti vari kutarisirawo kuti mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe vaumbe dare rinoongorora nyaya yaVaTomana iyi. Asi nhengo yeZanu PF uye vachiongorora zvematongerwo enyika, VaGoodson Nguni vanoti VaTomana havamanikidzwi kusiya basa nenyaya iyi sezvo vasina kuramba kutevera zviri kudiwa nedare. Vanoti danho rekuenda kwavo kuConstitutional Court raive rekuti vajekeserwe chete kuti vanoshanda sei. VaNguni vanorambawo mashoko ekuti VaTomana vairamba kuchuchisa panyaya dzevanhu vaviri ava zvine chekuita nezvematongerwo enyika. No media source currently available

headline: Varwere Voshaya Anorapa muZvipata zveHurumende Vakoti naVanaChiremba Vachiramwa Mabasa
text: Vashandi vemuzvipatara kusanganisira vakoti navanachiremba vasvika mazuva makumi matatu nematatu vakanda mapadza pasi vachiti mari yavari kutambiriswa haichakwani kuti vaende kumabasa pasina kana tarisiro yekuti dambudziko iri richagadziriswa. Zvinhu muzvipatara zvehurumende zvabva zvaita manyama amire nerongo zvopa kuti vamwe varwere vadzoserwe kumba vasina kurapwa. Zvinhu muzvipatara zviri kutarisirwa kutonyanyoipa sezvo sangano ravanachiremba vakuru reSenior Health Doctors Association vakatozivisa kuti kana nyaya dzemari nekuramwa mabasa kwavanachiremba vadiki nevakati dzikasagadziriswa naivo vachapindawo mukuramwa mabasa. Mutauriri wesangano ravanachiremba vakuru iri Dr Aaron Musara vaudza Studio 7 kuti zvinhu hazvina kumira zvakanaka muzvipatara. Dr Musara vanoti kunyangwe hazvo vakazivisa hurumende nezvedanho ravo rekuda kukanda mapadza pasi kuburikidza nemagwaro avakanyorera mapazi akasiyana siyana hapana mhinduro yavati vawana. Vanamukoti muzvipatara zvehurumende havasi kuenda kumabasa uye vari kuda kuti hurumende ivape mihoro yavo nemari yekuAmerica yavaitambira muna Gumiguru 2018 pamwe nekuvapa zvekushandisa kuzvidzivirira kubva kuzvirwere kana vari pamabasa. Mutungamiri wesangano rinomirira vanamukoti reZimbabwe Nurses Association, ZINA VaEnock Dongo vanoti hurukuro nehurumende kutungana kwembudzi. Mutauriri weZimbabwe Hospital Doctors Association kana kuti ZHDA Dr Tapiwa Mungofa vatiwo kusagadziriswa kwenyaya dzevashandi vezvehutano nehurumende kwave kusiya varwere vasina anovarapa. VaMungofa vatiwo panguva iyo vana mukoti vakaramwa mabasa dzimwe nhengo dzavo dzakawanda dzave kumba senzira yekudzivirira kutapurirwa chirwere cheCOVID-19 inonzi pachirungu Self quarantine. Studio 7 haina kukwanisa kunzwa divi rehurumende panyaya yekugadzirisa zvichemo zvevashandi vezvehutano sezvo vakafanobata chigaro chagurukota rezvehutano Muzvinafundo Amon Murwira vanga vasingadaviri nharembozha yavo. Asi vhiki rapera, VaMurwira vakazivisa kuti vanga vatanga hurukuro nana mukoti. Mutevedzeri wavo VaJohn Mangwiro vaudzawo Studio 7 kuti vanga vakabatikana nekudaro vange vasingakwanise kutaura. Sachigaro weHealth Services Board, Dr. Paulinus Sikosana, vatiwo vange vari mumusangano unechekuita nedenda reCOVID-19 nekudaro vanga vasingakwanisi kutaura nesu. Nyanzvi dzezvehutano dzinotiwo kana hurumende ikasagadzirisa nyaya yevakoti kuti vadzokere kumabasa uyewo kudzivirira vana chiremba kuti vasaenderera mberi kuzvigokera moto muziso kunyanya panguva ino nyika yakatarisana nedenda reCOVID-19 iro rauraya vanhu makumi maviri nevashanu kusvika parizvino. headline: Zvizvarwa zveZimbawe Zvofarira Kuvhurwa kweBhodha neBotswana Svondo Rinouya
text: Varidzi vemabhazi anofamba pakati peHarare neGaborone nemamwe maguta ari munyika dzakatenderedza Zimbabwe vanoti vafadzwa zvikuru nedanho ratorwa neBotswana rekuti vatange kushanda musi wa1 Zvita. Gurukota rinoona nezvekutakurwa kwevanhu nezvinhu uye kufambiswa kwemashoko muBotswana, VaThulaganyo Segokgo vaivisa nezvedanho iri vachitaura nevatori venhau nemusi weMuvhuro. VaSegokgo vazivisa kuti rimwe remabhodha mashanu ari kuvhurwa zvizere kubva musi wa1 Zvita ndere Plumtre-Ramokgwebana iro rinoshandiswa zvikuru nezvizvarwa zveZimbabwe. Botswana yakavhara mabhodha ayo nenyika dzakaitenderedza muna Kubvumbi gore rino senzira yekudzivirira kupararira kwehutachiwana hweCovid-19. Kuvharwa kwemabhodha uku kwakakanda ruzhinji rwezvizvarwa zveZimbabwe mukanwa mamupere sezvo zvichirarama nekutenga zvinhu kunyika dzakatenderedza Zimbabwe zvichinotengesa kumusha. Mukuru kukambani yeMangongongo Logistics ine mabhazi anobva mudhorobha reFrancistown muBotswana achienda kuHarare VaMartin Vumbani vati bhizimisi range radzokera kumashure zvakanyanya nekuvharwa kwemabhodha. Chimwe chizvarwa cheZimbabwe chinotyaira kukambani imwe cheteyo VaThompson Moyo vatsinhira mashoko aya. Kunyange hazvo vachigamuchira kuvhurwa kwemabhodha nemaoko maviri, VaMoyo vaenderera mberi vachiti vachatenda maruva vadya chakata nokuti zvinoda kutevedza kuti kusaparadzirwa hutachiwana hhweCovid-19 hazvisi nyore kuzadzikisa. Vachitsigira mashoko aVaMoyo, VaThomas Muzavazi vaudza Studio 7 kuti dai nyika dziri mudunhu reSADC dzataurirana kuti vanhu vasabhadhariswe mari zhinji pakuvhenekwa hutachiwana hweCoronavirus. Vafambi vanotarisirwa kuva nechitambi chinoratidza kuti havana chirwere cheCOVID-19 uye kutewedzera zvinodikanwa kuti hutachiwana husapararire kusanganisira kupfeka maface mask, kugeza maoko nguva dzose uye kusaungana kwenguva refu. Vakuru mubazi rezvekupinda nekubuda kwevanhu muZimbabwe vakatozivisa dare reparamende kuti havana zvimwe zvikwanisiro zvekuona kuti vanhu havapinde here pamabhodha nemapepa ekunyeba vachiti vanoda mari yekutenga michina yechizvinozvino. headline: Telecel Zimbabwe Yoronga Kuendesa Hurumende kuMatare eKunze
text: Kambani yeTelecel Zimbabwe yapa hurumende mwedzi mitanhatu yekugadzirisa nyaya yekukanzurirwa kwayo rezinesi nehurumende. Kambani iyi inoti izvi zvikakundikana inenge yokwira kudare re International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes riri muWashington DC rine hukama hwakasimba neWorld Bank. Telecel Zimbabwe yakanyorera tsamba mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, gurukota rezvehumhizha mukufambiswa kwemashoko, VaSupa MaMushowe, uye mukuru we Potraz, VaBaxton Sirewu. Telecel Zimbabwe yakakanzurirwa rezenisi ichipomerwa mhosva yekusatevedzera mutemo wekuendesa hupfumi kuvatema unoti makambani ekunze anofanira kupa zvikamu makumi mashanu nechimwe kubva muzana kuvatema vemunyika. Izvi zvinonzi zvapawo kuti VaMandiwanzira vaite musangano nevamiriri vekune dzimwe nyika vachitsanangura mamiriro akaita zvinhu muTelecel Zimbabwe. Zimbabwe yave nenhoroondo yekuendeswa kumatare ekunze ichipomerwa mhosva dzekutyora zvibvumirano zvekudyidzana nedzimwe nyika uye kutyora mitemo yayo. Hatina kukwanisa kubata VaMandiwanzira kuti tinzwe zviri kuitika. Muzvibabhizimisi vachishanda nesangano reResource Exploitation Watch, VaTafadzwa Musarara, vanoti Telecel Zimbabwe haifanire kumhanyira kumatare ekunze isina kupedza emunyika. headline: Vanhu Vabatwa neCoronavirus Vosvika Mazana Matatu neMakumi Masere neManomwe
text: Bazi rezvehutano rinoti huwandu hwevanhu vabatwa nechirwere checoronavirus munyika yose hwasvika pamazana matatu nemakumi masere nemanomwe kana kuti 387. Vanhu vafa vachiri vana uye vapora vave makumi mashanu nevana kana kuti 54. Vanhu vavhenekwa kusvika parizvino vadarika zviuru zvishanu nemakumi mapfumbabwe kana kuti 59, 000. Vanhu vakawanda vobatwa nechirwere ichi vari kubva kuSouth Africa. Vanhu vose vari kubva kune dzimwe nyika vari kumbonzi vagare vakachengetedzwa munzvimbo dzakasiyana siyana kwemazuva makumi maviri nerimwe kuti vasatapurirwa vamwe chirwere kana vainacho. Asi vamwe vanhu vave kutiza kunzvimbo dzinochengeterwa vanhu vachiti hadzina kushambidzika. Izvi zvapa kuti vamwe vakaita sekambani yePerch Media vari kufamba vachidzidzisa vanhu vapindewo mumaruva vachikurudzira vanhu kuti vamhan’arire vanhu vanenge vatiza ava. Mukuzeya nyaya iyi, Blessing Zulu weStudio 7 abata mukuru wePerch Media VaCollen Magobeya. Zvichakadaro, mashoko atumirwa studio 7 neAfrican Union achibva kuAfrica Centers for Disease Control and Prevention anoratidza kuti vanhu vanodarika zviuru mazana maviri nemakumi mana nemaviri kana kuti 242,000 vabatwa nechirwere checoronavirus muafrica. Vashaya vadarika zviuru zvitanhatu nemazana maviri nemakumi mana nemana kana kuti 6,244. Vapora vanodarika zviuru zana nemapfumbamwe kana kuti 109,000 Huwandu hwevanhu vabatwa nechirwere checoronavirus pasi rose hwadarika mamiriyoni manomwe nezviuru zvipfumbamwe kana kuti kuti 7,9 million. Johns Hopkins University yemuAmerica iyo iri kuongorora kupararira kwechirwere ichi pasi rose vanhu vafa nechirwere ichi vanodarika zviuru mazana mana nemakumi matatu nemana kana kuti 434, 000.  Vapora vachidarika mamiriyoni matatu nezviuru zvinomwe kana kuti 3, 7 million.

headline: Nakamba Otarisana neNguva Yakaoma muEPL
text: Mutambi weZimbabwe ane mukurumbira Marvelous Nakamba atarisana nemasvondo mashanu akaomesesa muhupenyu hwake munhabvu, panguva iyo Knowledge Musona ar ikutsvagawo basa. Nakamba uyo anotambira Aston Villa muEnglish Premier League atarisana nemutoro mukuru wekuedza kupunyutsa chikwata chake icho chatarisana nehondo yekuti chisabude muEPL. Hupenyu hweAston Villa mugungano iri huri patambo sezvo chikwata ichi chiri pachinhanho chegumi nepfumbamwe, mugungano rine zvikwata makumi maviri. Zvikwata zvitatu zvepasi ndizvo zvichabuda muEPL pachapera mitambo iyo ichatambwa kubva musi wa 17 Chikumi kusvika 25 Chikunguru. Aston Villa ine mitambo neLiverpool, Chelsea, Man U, Arsenal, Sheffield United neWolves, idzo dzirikurwira zvinzvimbo zvekumiririra England muEurope gore rinouya. Mune mimwe mitambo, Aston Villa irikusangana neNewcastle, Everton, West Ham ne Crystal Palace, idzo dzisinganyanyo vhundutsa. Stewart Murisa uyo akambotambira, Caps United, Dynamos neHighlanders, anoti ane chivimbo chekuti Aston Villa inorarama sezvo isina kunyanyosiyana pamapoinzi nezvikwata zvakati wandei. Bournemouth, Watford neWest Ham, dzine mapoinzi makumi maviri nemanomwe, mapoinzi maviri chete pamusoro peAston Villa. Norwich iyo iri pasi pasi ine mapoinzi makumi maviri nerimwechete. Asi Nakamba haasiriye ega ari panguva yakaoma sezvo kaputeni wemaWarriors, Knowledge Musona asati awana chikwata chekutambira. Chikwata chake cheAnderlecht chazivisa kuti Musona haasisina nzvimbo muchikwata ichi vachiti ivo ngaatsvage basa kune imwe kambani. Anderlecht yanga yamboendesa Musona kuAS Eupen uko akanwisa zvibodzwa zviviri asi chibvumirano chavo chakapera. Mashoko arikufamba anoti Eupen yacho, pamwe neKaiser Chiefs neMamelodi Sundowns dzekuSouth Africa, dzirikumudawo, asi zvichienderana nekuti Anderlecht yacho irikuda marii pakumutengesa. Musona naNakamba varikudiwa vaine pfungwa dzakagadzikana, apo Zimbabwe iri kusimudzira rwendo rwe 2021 Africa Cup of Nations ne 2022 World Cup. MuWorld Cup, Zimbabwe iri mugungano rimwechete neGhana, Ethiopia neSouth Africa umo muongorori wemutambo wenhabvu VaTakudzwa Mushinga vanofunga kuti Zimbabwe ikakunda mumitambo yese yepamusha inobudirira. Asi mutsigiri weCaps United VaPhillip Regede vanoti makundano maviri aya arikuda gadziriro yakasimba. Zifa yave nemari kubva kuFIFA yekurongera maWarriors mitambo yekuedzana masimba ine mitsindo nedzimwe nyika Mumakwikwi eNations Cup Zimbabwe irikusangana neBotswana, Zambia neAlgeria, iyo ine mukombe uyu. Parizvino, Zimbabwe iri pachinho chechipi nemapoinzi mana, mapoinzi maviri pasi peAlgeria iyo irikutungamira gungano iri. Botswana ine poindi imwechete asi Zambia haina kana poindi imwechete zvayo. Asi mitambo iyi yakambomiswa pari zvino nekuda kwechirwere checoronavirus kunyangwe dzimwe nyika dzatanga kutamba nhabvu dzakaita seGermany. No media source currently available

headline: Zimbabwe Yokundikana Kuzadzikisa Zvayakazvitarira neZvaitarisirwa neWHO paNyaya yeNhomba yeCovid-19
text: Zimbabwe iyo yave nenhomba dzinodarika mamiriyoni gumi nematanhatu kana kuti 16 million ichiri kutatarika kubaya vanhu nhomba sezviri kuitikawo munyika dzakawanda dzemuAfrica. Vanhu zvikamu makumi maviri kubva muzana ndivo vabayiwa nhomba mbiri munyika kusvika parizvino kunyangwe chinangwa chehurumende chaive chekuti vanhu mamiriyoni gumi kana kuti zvikamu makumi matanhatu kubva muzana vange vabayiwa nhomba yeCovid-19 mukupera kwegore rapera. Asi kunyangwe Zimbabwe isati yasvitsa huwandu uhu, yatangawo kubaya vamwe nhomba kechitatu. Nhomba yeCovid-19 yakatanga kubayiwa muZimbabwe musi wa 17 Mbudzi gore rapera. Nhomba dziri kubayiwa munyika dzinoti Sputnik V yekuRusssia pamwe nedzekuChina dzinoti Sinopharm neSinovac, Covaxin yekuIndia uye Janssen yeJohnson and Johnson dziri kushandiswa muZimbabwe. Kunyangwe hazvo vanhu vakawanda vachiri kuzengurira kubayiwa nhomba, mukuru anoona nezvekudzivirira chirwere cheCovid-19 munyika Dr Agnes Mahomva vanoti, nhomba inobatsira nekuti. Zimbabwe haina kungokundikana pane zvayainge yazvitarira chete pakubaya nhomba yeCovud-19 asi pane zvimwe zvainge zvatarwa nesangano reWorld Health Organization kana kuti WHO. WHO yainge yatiwo yainge iine chivimbo chekuti panopera gore ra2021, nyika dzemuAfrica dzinenge dzabaya vanhu vadzo zvikamu makumi mana kubva muzana nhomba. A si nyika shoma shoma dzisingadarike gumi kusanganisira, Seychelles, Mauritius, Morrocco, Rwanda neBotswana chete kuchamhembe kweAfrica ndidzo dzakwanisa kuita izvi. MuAfrica yose, vanhu zvikamu zviviri nechidimbu kubva muzana kana kuti 2, 5% ndivo vabayiwa nhomba zvichienzaniswa nezvikamu makumi matanhatu kubva muzana kana kuti 60% kubva kunyika dzakabudirira. Kunyangwe hazvo nyanzvi munyika nekunze dziri kuti zvave pachena kuti vanenge vabayiwa nhomba kaviri kana katatu vane mukana wakakura wekuti vakabatwa nechirwere cheCovid-19 vasafe, vanhu vashoma zvikuru vemuAfrica havana kubayiwa nezvikonzero zvakasiyana siyana. Vamwe vachiri kutya kutivanogona kutadza kuita mbereko vamwe vachiti chitendero hachivabvumidze zvose izvi zviri kutenderedzwa pamadandemutande akasiyana siyana pasi rose. Vamwe vanhu vari kushaya chivimbo nenhomba vachiti vamwe vakabayiwa nhomba dzose mbiri kana nhatu vari kungorwara. Asi nyanzvi munyaya dzezvezvirwere zvekutapuriranwa, Muzvinafundo Davison Sangweme vatiwo kushanduka kwechirwere kana kuti virus ndiko kunopa kuti chiiuye nedzimwe mhando chobata vakabayiwa nhomba ava. Ko huurumende yeZimbabwe ingaite sei kuti vanhu vakawanda vabayiwe nhomba? Tabvunza mukuru wesangano rinorwira kodzero dzevanhu munyaya dzezvehutano reCommunity Working Group on Health, VaItai Rusike vanoti hurumende inofanira kunyengetedza vanhu kuti vabayiwe nhomba. Nhomba muAfrica dziri kuuyawo kuburikidza nesangano reAfrican Union pasi pechirongwa chinonzi Vaccine Acquisition Trust kana kuti AVAT nechimwe cheWorld Health Organization chinonzi COVAX. Asi munyika dzakaita seNigeria, Malawi neSouth Sudan, dzimwe nhomba dzakapiswa sezvo mazuva akatarwa kuti dzinge dzashandiswa ainge adarika dzichiri mumatura. African Union iri kuchema chema kuti dzimwe nhomba dziri kuita zvekuraswa kuAfrica. Sangano iri rinotiwo chimwe chiri kupa kuti zvinetse kubaya vanhu nhomba inyaya yekuti dzimwe nyika dzemuAfrica hadzina zvimwe zvinodiwa mukushandiswa mukubaya nhomba zvakaita semafacemask, donje nemotokari dzekutakurisa nhomba kuendesa kune mamwe matunhu kanawo mafiriji ekuchengetera dzimwe nhomba. Sangano reTony Blair Institute for Global Change rinoti nhomba dzinosvika zvikamu makumi mana kubva muzana dziri muAfrica hadzina kushandiswa nezvikonzero zvakasiyana siyana. Mukuru weAfrica Centres for Disease Control VaJohn Nkengasonga vanoti dzimwe nyika hadzisiwo kana kutouya kuzotora mishonga kumatura avo. Asiwo vakawanda vanoti nyika dzakabudirira ndidzo dzakonzera dambudziko kunyanya nekusada kubatsira dzevarombo nenhomba. No media source currently available

headline: Vanhu Mazana Mana neMakumi Matanhatu neVaviri (462) Vakafa neCovid-19 Mumazuva Manomwe Chete
text: Bazi rezvehutano rinoti vanhu makumi mashanu nevapfumbamwe vakafa nechirwere cheCovid-19 nemusi weMugovera zvasiya huwandu hwevanhu vafa nechirwere ichi kubva zvachatanga kupararira gore rapera hwave zviuru zviviri nezana nemakumi masere nemashanu kana kuti 2,185. Mumazuva manomwe adarika chete, vanhu mazana mana nemakumi matanhatu nevaviri kana kuti 462 vakafa zvichienzaniswa nemazana maviri nemakumi matanhatu nevanomwekana kuti 267 vakafa munguva imwe chete svondo rapera. Vanhu chiuru chimwe chete nemazana mana nemakumi mana nevashanu kana kuti 1, 445 vakabatwa nechirwere ichi neMugovera. Izvi zvasiya vanhu vabatwa nechirwere ichi kubva zvachatanga kupararira vave zviuru makumi masere nemaviri zvine mazana matanhatu negumi nevatatu kana kuti 82, 613. Vanhu mazana manomwe nemakumi masere nevana vakapora kubva kuchirwere ichi zvasiya vapora kubva zvachatanga kupararira vave zviuru makumi mashanu nechimwe zvine mazana mapfumbamwe nemakumi maviri nevatatu kana kuti 51, 923. Vanhu vachiri kurwara zviuru makumi maviri nemasere zvine zana nevaviri kana kuti 28, 102. Pavanhu ava mazana manomwe nemakumi mapfumbamwe nevasere kana kuti 798 ndivo vari muzvipatara kunyangwe chipatara cheInyathi chisina kuzivisa huwandu hwevari kurawara. Bazi rezvehutano rinotiwo Nzvimbo dziri kupararira chirwere ichi zvinotyisa dzinoti Chegutu, Hurungwe, Sanyati, kuMashonaland West, kochiti Guruve, Mazowe kuMashonaland Central, Marondera, Murewa kuMashonaland East, Bikita neMasvingo, nemuHarare, kuchizotiwo Northern Suburbs, Nkulumane, Emakhandeni kuBulawayo uye Kwekwe mudunhu reMidlands. Bazi rezvehutano rinotiwo vanhu miriyoni imwe chete nezviuru zana nemakumi matatu nevaviri ne mashavashanu kana kuti 1, 132 05 vabayiwa nhomba kekutanga kudzivirira Covid-19. Vanhu vabayiwa kaviri sezviri kukurudzirwa vave zviuru mazana matanhatu nemakumi matatu nepfumbamwe zvine mazana matatu nemakumi masere nepfumbamwe kana kuti 639, 389. Hurumende inoti ine hurongwa hwekubaya vanhu mamiriyoni gumi nhomba kuti inyatsoshanda zvakanaka. Gurukota rinoona nezvekuburitswa kwemashoko Amai Monica Mutsvangwa vanoti chinangwa chehurumende ikozvino ndechekuona kuti vanhu vakawanda vabayiwa nhomba yekudzivirira kupararira kwechirwere cheCovid-19. Vati vachatora vanachiremba nevakoti kubva kumauto nemapurisa. No media source currently available Vaimbova gurukota rezvehutano varizve munyori munyaya dzezvehutano mubato rinopikisa reMDC Alliance Dr Henry Madzorera vati vanhu vanofanira kuziva kuti kudzivirira Covid-19 kunotanga naivo nekutevedzera kurudziro iri kupihwa nenyanzvi munyaya dzezvehutano zvikuru kupfeka zvivhara muromo nemhuno. headline: WARRIOR AFCON 2019: DeMbare 0, Bosso 0
text: ZVIKWATA zvinoti Dynamos FC neHighlanders hazvina kana mutambi mumwechete akasarudzwa kuti anotambira maWarriors kumakwishu eAfrica Cup of Nations (Afcon) pamwechete neCosafa Cup izvo zvasiyana nakare apo zvaibura vatambi vakawanda vaive shasha vaitambira chikwata chenyika ichi.   Kubva kare, DeMbare neBosso ndizvo zvaive zvikwata zvikuru muZimbabwe asi parizvino zvinotaridza kuti masamba asiyana sezvo matambiro ezvikwata izvi muPremier Soccer League adzikira zvikuru.   Kune zvimwe zvikwata izvo zvainonekwa sezvidiki zviri kutamba nhabvu inonwisa mvura.   Semuenzaniso, Herentals FC ine mutambi wayo Richard Hachiro ari muchikwata chemaWarriors,  Yadah Stars ina Leeroy Mavhunga kozoti Chapungu ina Talbert Shumba neFC Platinum ina Lawrence Mhlanga.   Svondo rino, Kwayedza yakaita hurukuro nevakuru veBosso neDeMbare pamusoro pekudzikira kwaita zvikwata izvi munyaya dzenhabvu.   Sachigaro weHighlanders – Kenneth Mhlophe – anoti ivo sechikwata vari panguva yekuvaka izvo vakatanga gore radarika.   Anoti chikwata chavo ndicho chimwe chine vatambi vechidiki muPSL saka makore anotevera vanogona kubura vatambi vakawanda vachazotambira maWarriors.   “Isu tiri panguva yekuvaka zvakatanga gore radarika, izvi zvinozivikanwa nemunhu wese, vatambi vedu vachiri vechidiki.   “Kutaura kuno tine vatambi vaviri vakashevedzwa kuchikwata chemaUnder-23 saka zvinorakidza kuti tiri kufamba negwara chairo,” anodaro.   Anoenderera mberi achiti Prince Dube – uyo akashavedzwa kumaU-23 – ane ramangwana rakanaka.   “Tina Prince Dube, mutambi ane tarenda rinonwisa mvura. Akaenda kuSouth Africa akanokanganiswa ikoko sezvo aisatambiswa asi akadzoka tiri kumubika patsva, gore rinotevera muchamuona ari kumaWarriors.   “Iye zvino ari kumaU-23, kutoshevedzwa ikoko kunorakidza kuti varairidzi vemaYoung Warriors vanozviziva kuti ane tarenda rinodadisa,” anodaro Mhlophe.   Maneja weDeMbare – Richard Chihoro – anoti chikwata chavo gore rino chakavakwa patsva saka vatambi vavo vachiri kumbodzidzana.   “Zvamunongoziva isu gore rino takatenga vatambi vatsva saka vange vachiri kumbodzidzana, mukatarisa matambiro atiri kuita vave kuita vachibatana, vachigona uye vachisimuka.   “Zvinonetsa kuti vangotanga nekupinda musquad asi tinoziva kuti munguva inotevera kuDeMbare kuchabva vatambi vakawanda vachienda kumaWarriors. Hazviite kuti kushaye vatambi vanobva kuDeMbare vachienda kumaWarriors, kana chikwata chedu changobatana vakawanda vachaenda,” anodaro Chihoro.   Paakabvunzwa neKwayedza kuti pavatambi vari muchikwata chavo parizvino ndevapi vaanofungira kuti vanogona kukwana kumaWarriors, Chihoro anoti, “Parizvino kutaura chokwadi hapana mutambi watinaye anokwana kumaWarriors.”   Zvakadai, nemusi weMugovera uno maWarriors achatanga kurwira kuchengetedza mukombe wavo weCosafa Cup apo achasangana nechikwata chichapedza chiri pamusoro muboka reGroup A kuDurban, kuSouth Africa.   Chikwata chaSunday ‘Mhofu’ Chidzambwa chiri kushandisa makwishu aya segadziro dzemutambo weAfcon uyo uchatanga nemusi wa21 Chikumi apo maWarriors achasangana neEgypt.   Mumakwishu ekupedzisira eAfcon ayo akaitirwa kuGabon mugore ra2017, DeMbare yaive nevatambi vaviri vaive muchikwata chemaWarriors vaiti Tatenda Mkuruva uyo aive mubati wepagedhi naElisha Muroiwa uyo aivhara bhora pamwechete naCosta Nhamoinesu.   Bosso yakapedzisira kuita vatambi vakapinda muchikwata chemaWarriors mugore ra2017 apo paiva naPrince Dube naHonest Moyo avo vakatakurwa naMhofu kuenda kuCosafa Cup. Muchikwata ichi maive zvakare naOcean Mushure weDynamos uyo akatamba zvainwisa mvura.

headline: Nyanzvi Dzinoti Zimbabwe Ngaitaurirane neBhanga Guru Repasi Rose
text: Imwe nyanzvi munyaya dzezvehupfumi inoshanda nesangano re Labour and Economic Development Research Institute of Zimbabwe, Doctor Godfrey Kanyenze, vanoti Zimbabwe haina chimwe chekuita kunze kwekutaurirana nebhanga guru rinokweretesa mari reWorld Bank mkuitira kuti zvinhu zvifambe zvakanaka munyaya dzehupfumi. No media source currently available Zimbabwe ine chikwereti chemari inopfuura bhiriyoni imwe chete yemadhora. Mashoko aVaKanyenze anotsinhirwawo nevaimbova gurukota rezvehupfumi, VaTendai Biti. Vaviri ava vanoti pasina rubatsiro nyaya yekugadzirisa hupfumi hwenyika inoramba iri zviroto. VaKanyenze vanotiwo Zimbabwe inofanirwa kutaurirana zvakare nesangano rinokweretesa pasi rose reInternational Monetary Fund. Zimbabwe ine zvikwereti zvekunze kwenyika zvinodarika mabhiriyoni mapfumbamwe ane zviuru zvipfumbamwe zvemadhora.

headline: Vashandi veNRZ neMhuri Dzavo Vorara paMahofisi eKambani Yavo muHarare Vachiratidzira
text: Vashandi vekambani yeNational Railways of Zimbabwe muHarare vari pakuramwa mabasa vanonzi vaungana nemhuri dzavo kumahofisi ekambani iyi ekuLochnivar, kuRugare vachiti havachina kwekugara, vamwe vachiti vakaburitswa mudzimba dzavairoja. Mutungamiri werimwe sangano rinomirira vashandi veNRZ reZimbabwe Amalgamated Railways Workers’ Union, ZARWU, VaKamurai Moyo vanoti madzimai evashandi ava nevana vavo vakabatana nevarume vavo kubva neChishanu chapfuura vachirara pamwe nekuswera panze pemahofisi ekambani iyi. Vanonzi vari kuda kuti NRZ ibhadhare mari dzavo dzemihoro dzemwedzi gumi nemishanu dzavasati varipwa, uyewo dzekubatsirika nekufamba dzavasati varipwa kwemwedzi mishanu. “Vashandi havana zvimwe zvavaikwanisa kuita kunze kwekuenda kunogara pakambani iyi sezvo pari ipo chete pavasingabhadhare rendhi,” vanodaro VaMoyo. Vanoti chimwe chakanyanya kutsamwisa vashandi idanho ravanoti rakatorwa nekambani yavo rekuenda kudare rinoona nezvemabasa ichida kuti vashandi vatsanangure zvikonzero zvavari kuramwira mabasa. “Panzvimbo yekuti vashandi vakwire ivo kumatare, kambani ndiyo yave kumhan’ara, zvakafanana nekuti munhu anenge akurova ndiye futi anomhanya kuno kukwirira kumatare,” VaMoyo vanodaro. Mutauriri weNRZ VaFanuel Masikati vatenda kuti vashandi vari pakuramwa mabasa uye vari kurara pamahofisi ekambani yavo muHarare. VaMasikati vaudza Studio 7 kuti kambani yavo ine chido kwazvo chekuti ibhadhare vashandi vayo asi mamiriro akaita zvinhu munyika munyaya dzeupfumi ndiwo ari kuvatadzisa kuzadzisa chido ichi. Vati bhizimusi rekutakura vanhu pamwe nezvinhu iro rinosiraramisa NRZ mazuva ano rakadzikira zvikuru, vakati nhaurirano pakati pevashandi nevashandirwi dziri kuenderera mberi. Vashandi veNRZ muHarare, Mutare, Gweru neBulawayo vari kuramwa mabasa kubva svondo rapera vachida kubhadharwa mari dzavo idzi. No media source currently available

headline: ZESN Inoti Mauto Haafaniri Kushandiswa Munyaya dzeSarudzo
text: Mashoko anonzi akataurwa negurukota rinomirira dunhu reMasvingo, VaJosiah Hungwe, pamwe chete nechipangamazano chemutungamiri wenyika, VaChris Mutsvangwa, ekuti bato riri kutonga reZanu-PF richashandisa mauto mukutsvaga rutsigiro musarudzo dzegore rinouya, ari kushorwa zvikuru neveruzhinji. Mumwe wevari kushoropodza mashoko aya ndisachigaro weZimbabwe Election Support Network, ZESN, VaAndrew Makoni. VaMakoni vanoti zvekushandisa mauto mukutsvaga rutsigiro hazvisi pamutemo, uye pane mimwe mitemo ine chekuita nesarudzo inofanirwa kuvandudzwa kana nyika ichida kuita sarudzo dzakachena uye dzisina mutauro gore rinouya. “Kuti sarudzo yegore rinouya iitwe zvakanaka, tinofanira kuve ne voters’ roll itsva, munoziva kuti pane chirongwa cheBVR chirikuitwa nguva ino, chinonzi chingangopamidzirwa mazuva, saka tinofanira kuva tine voters’ roll itsva uyezve tinofanira kuvatagadzirisa mitemo inechokuita nesarudzo uye nemitemo inongombundikidza kodzero dzevanhu,” VaMakoni vanodaro. Vanoti kana vanoita zvematongerwo enyika vaine chido chekugadzirisa zvinhu, nguva yacho ichiripo yekuzvigadzirisa. Panyaya yasachigaro weZimbabwe Election Commission, ZEC, VaMakoni vanoti havasati vanzwa kuti sachigaro uyu achadomwa riini asi vanokuridzira hurumende kuti ikurumidze kuwana sachigaro weZEC vachiti pane basa rakawanda rinofanira kuitwa sarudzo dzisati dzaitwa. headline: Vanhu Vaviri Vofa neCovid-19 Kusanganisira Mumwe Mukuru weChikoro kuMasvingo
text: Huwandu hwevanhu vari kufa nechirwere cheCovid-19 huri kuramba huchikwira mushure mekunge vamwe vanhu vaviri vafa nechirwere ichi. Munhu mumwe chete akafa kuManicaland neMasvingo. Bepanhau reThe Masvingo Mirror rinoti akashaya mudunhu iri mukuru wechikoro cheMukaro High Amai Pauline Dzapasi avo vakashaya neChishanu vakavigwa neSvondo. Varairidzi vose vapachikoro ichi vanzi vambondogara pavo voga pasina mhuri pachityirwa kupararira kwechirwere ichi. Vana vechikoro avo vakavhara neChishanu vanziwo vari kuongororwa. Mukuru wezvehutano mudunhu reMasvingo Dr Amadeu Shamu vakatenda kuti Amai Dzapasi vakashaya mushure mekurwara nechirwere cheCovid-19. Vanhu vafa nechirwere ichi kubva zvachatanga kupararira vave mazana matatu nemakumi maviri kana kuti 320. Vanhu zana nemakumi manomwe nevana vabatwa nechirwere ichi nemusi weSvondo. Vakawanda vacho vari muHarare uye matunhu ose ane vanhu vakabatwa nechirwere ichi nezuro kunze kwekuMashonaland West. Izvi zvasiya huwandu hwevanhu vabatwa nechirwere ichi kubva zvachatanga hwave pazvuru gumi nezviri zvine mazana matatu nemakumi maviri nemashanu kana kuti 12, 325. Vanhu pora kubva kuchirwere ichi vave zvuru gumi zvine nemakumi maviri nevana kana kuti 10, 024 mushure mekunge vamwe vanhu makumi mana vapora kubva kuchirwere ichi. Vanhu vachiri kurwara vave churu chimwe chete chine mazana mapfumbamwe nemakumi masere nemumwe kana kuti 1,981. Asi kunyangwe hazvo vanhu vari kurwara nekufa nechirwere ichi, mutungamiri wesangano revakoti reZimbawe Nurses Association VaEnock Dongo vanoti hurumende haisi kuvapa zvekuzvidzivirira kubva kuchirwere cheCovid-19 zvopa kuti vakawanda vavo varware. No media source currently available Zvichakadaro, mashoko atumirwa Studio 7 neAfrican Union achibva kuAfrica Centers for Disease Control and Prevention anoratidza kuti vanhu vanodarika mamiriyoni maviri nezvuru mazana mana kana kuti 2,4 million vabatwa nechirwere cheCovid-19 muAfrica. Vanhu vafa vasvika zvuru makumi mashanu nemasere zvine mazana manomwe nemakumi matanhatu nevaviri kana kuti 58,762. Vapora vadarika mamiriyoni maviri kana kuti 2 million. South Africa ndiyo ine vanhu vakawandisa vabatwa nekufa nechirwere ichi muAfrica. Dunhu reSADC ndirowo rine vanhu vakawandisa vabatwa nechirwere ichi muAfrica vanodarika miriyoni imwe chete. Huwandu hwevanhu vabatwa nechirwere cheCoronavirus pasi rose hwadarika mamiriyoni makumi manomwe nematanmhatu ane zvuru mazana manomwe kana kuti 76,7 million. Johns Hopkins University yemuAmerica iyo iri kuongorora kupararira kwechirwere ichi pasi rose inoti muAmerica ndimo mune vanhu vakawandisa vabatwa nekufa nechirwere ichi. Vafa muAmerica vanodarika zviuru mazana matatu negumi nevanomwe kana kuti 317,000 vabatwa nechirwere ichi vachidarika mamiriyoni gumi nemanomwe nezvuru mazana masere kana kuti 17,8 million. Pasi rose vanhu vafa nechirwere ichi vanodarika miriyoni imwe chete nezviuru mazana matanhatu kana kuti 1,6 million. Asi vapora vachidarika mamiriyoni makumi mana nematatu kana kuti 43 million.

headline: Paramende Inoti VaChiwenga Havana Simba reKumisa Sarudzo
text: Danho rehurumende rekumbomisa kuitwa kwesarudzo dzemaby-elections riri kukonzera mutauro wakanyanya munyika komiti yeparamende inoona nezvemitemo uye vesangano reZimbabwe Human Rights Commission kana kuti ZHRC vachibatana nemamwe masangano vachikurudzira hurumende kuti ione kuti sarudzo idzi dzaitwa sezviri kuitwa kune dzimwe nyika dzakaita seMalawi neTanzania. Mutevedzeri wemutungamiri wenyika VaConstantino Chiwenga vanovazve gurukota rezvehutano vakadzika mutemo wechimbi chimbi wekumisa kuitwa kwesarudzo kana kuti Statutory Instrument, ( SI 225A /2020 of the Public Health COVID-19 prevention, Containment and Treatment) (Amendment) Regulations 2020, No. 4.). Asi paramende inoti uku kutyora bumbiro remitemo. ZHRC inoti kudzingwa kwemakanzura nenhengo dzeparamende kuri kusiya vanhu vakawanda vasina anovamiririra zvopa kuti vasawane zvavanotarisira kuhurumende nemakanzuru. Mutungamiri wenyika VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, VaChiwenga neZimbabwe Electoral Commission vakatoendeswa kumatare nevari kuda kukwikwidza musarudzo idzi nemamwe masangano vachinzi vari kutyora mutemo nekusaita sarudzo idzi. VaChiwenga vakati sarudzo dzamiswa nenyaya yekutyira kupararira kweCovid-19. Sachigaro weZEC Amai Priscilla Chigumba vaudza Studio 7 kuti havachakwanise kutaura sezvo nyaya yave kumatare. Mutauriri webato reNCA VaMaddock Chivasa vati vanotambira danho rekumiswa kwesarudzo. Asi mutevedzeri wemutauriri weMDC Alliance VaClifford Hlatywayo vati uku kutyora mutemo. headline: Vanotengesera Mumigwagwa Vanobviswa neMapurisa muHarare
text: Mapurisa pamwe nevashandi vekanzuru yeHarare vadzinga zvechisimba vanhu vanotengesera mumigwagwa pakati peguta reHarare zvichitevera kurudziro yakaitwa nemutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, mukupera kwesvondo. Mapurisa anga akapakatira zvombo pamwe nevashandi vekanzuru yeHarare vadzinga mumigwagwa avo vanorarama nekutengesa mumigwagwa zvaita kuti vatengesi ava vaswere vachiita hwekiti negonzo mukati padhorobha. Mumwe wevanotengesera mumigwagwa, Amai Maidei Chimuka, vati pane vanotengesera mumigwagwa varohwa zvakaipisisa vakakuvara uye vamwe vavo vanonzi vasungwa. VaMike Muvadi vati havadi kuenda kunotengesera zvinhu kunzvimbo dziri kunze kwedhorobha kwavari kunzi nekanzura vanoshandira. VaGwinyai Gandanzara, avo vanotegesawo mbatya, vati kurudziro yakaitwa naVaMugabe pakupera kwesvondo yekuti vanotengesera mumigwagwa vabude mudhorobha inoratidza kuti VaMugabe havana hany’a nehupenyu hwevanhu. Zvichakadai, nhengo yeboka reTajamuka, VaDenford Ngadziore, vati vachashanda zvakasimba nevanotengesera mumigwagwa kuti vasarambe vachishungurudzwa nemapurisa pamwe nevashandi vekanzuru. Munyori muboka revechidiki reMDC-T, VaLovemore Chinoputsa, vati bongozozo raitwa nemapurisa iri inzira yehurumende yekukanganisa vanhu kunyoresa kwavari kuita sevavhoti pakati pedhorobha sezvo vachiti bato ravo rine vatsigiri vakawanda mumadhorobha mazhinji. Hatina kukwanisa kutaura nemutauriri wemapurisa, Amai Charity Charamba, kuti tinzwe divi remapurisa panyaya iyi. Kanzuru yeHarare inoti vanotengesera mumigwagwa vanofanira kutengesera munzvimbo dzakatarwa dzavanenge vachibhadhara mitero kwete kuti vanhu vangomera kunge hohwa pakati pedhorobha. headline: Asensio orambira kuMadrid
text: (22) acharamba ari kuReal Madrid mwaka unotevera, semashoko akabva kumumiriri wake.   Mutambi uyu ange achinzi ari kudiwa neLiverpool mushure mekunge angotamba mitambo 11 yaakatanga kubva pa38 mwaka wadarika kuLa Liga.   Achipindura apo ari World Cup kuRussia nenyika yake mushure mekunge abvunzwa nevatori venhau nezvekuenda kuLiverpool, Asensio anoti, “Kana World Cup yapera, ndipo ndichataura nezvenyaya idzodzo. Izvezvi ndiri kungofunga zvekusarudzwa kuzotambira nyika yangu.”   Kunyangwe mashoko aya achitenderera, mumiriri wake Horacio Gaggioli akasimbisa kuti haasi kuzobva kuSantiago Bernabeu pari zvino.   “Marco haasi kuzobva, acharamba ari neReal Madrid,” Gaggioli akaudza Calciomercato.   “Ari kuramba achisimukira nguva dzese. Mwaka unotevera, ndinofunga kuti achave mutambi mukuru weMadrid.”   Asensio ange achitamba nhabvu inonwisa mvura kubva zvaakaenda kuchikwata ichi icho chine mukombe weChampions League mugore ra2014 uye akamboenda kune zvimwe zvinosanganisira Mallorca neEspanyol nechikwereti. — SportsMail football

headline: VaChamisa Vanotaura Zvakadzama Pamusoro peChirwere cheCovid-19
text: Mutungamiri weMDC Alliance, VaNelson Chamisa, vaita musangano padandemudande vachitenda vanhu vose vari kushanda panguva ino nyika yakatarisana nedenda reCovid-19. VaChamisa vatiwo hurumende inofanirwa kupanga mazano nenyanzvi kuitira kuti ipedze denda reCovid-19. VaChamisa vati chirwere cheCovid-19 chinoda kuti vana veZimbabwe vaite muonerapamwe kuitira kuti vakwanise kukunda chirwere ichi. VaChamisa vati bato ravo rinotenda zvikuru zvizvarwa zveZimbabwe zviri kunze kwenyika izvo zviri kubatsira kusimudzira zvipatara zvemunyika apo nyika yakatarisana nechirwere chedzihwa mupengo ichi. VaChamisa vatiwo havaoni zvine huchenjeri kuvhara nyika yese vakati vanoona sekuti zvingabatsire zvakanyanya kana kukaitwa tsvakurudzo kwoonekwa kuti chirwere cheCovid-19 chakawandira nzvimbo dzipi, kovharwa idzodzo. VaChamisa vati hurumende inofanirwa kutanga zvirongwa zvekuderedza huwandu hwevanhu vari mumajere pamwe nekuona kuti vanhu vanopara mhosva diki vapihwa mitongo isingavaise mumajeri senzira yekudzivirira kuapararira kwechirwere ichi mumajeri umo vanhu vari kugara vakamanikidzana. VaChamisa vakurudzirawo hurumende kuti ibatsire vanhu vari kutambura panguva ino vachiti vana veZimbabwe vakawanda vanorarama nekuzvishandira nekudaro kuvharwa kwenyika kuri kuvasiya vari parumananzombe. VaChamisa vakurudzirawo hurumende kuti iite tsvakurudzo dzakazara vanhu vasati vatanga kubaiwa nhomba yeCovid-19. Mumwe muongoroi wezvematongerwo enyika, uye vachishanda nesangano rePlatform for Youth Development, VaOwen Dhliwayo, vati mashoko ataurwa naVaChamisa ekubatana nekuitwa kwetsvakurudzo pasati patorwa matanho ekudzivirira chirwere ichi akakosha. VaDhliwayo vatsigirawo kuti zvakakosha kuti panguva ino nyika iri panguva ye National Lockdown, vanhu vawaniswe rubatsiro. Studio7 haina kukwanisa kunzwa divi rehurumende nemashoko aVaChamisa aya sezvo nharembozha dzemunyori mubazi rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko, VaNick Mangwana, yanga ichinetsa kubata. Asi vachitaura kunyika neMugovera, mutungamiriri wenyika, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, vakatiwo vanhu vashande pamwe chete kurwisa chirwere cheCovid-19. VaMnangagwa vakavimbisawo rubatsiro rwavakati rwuchange rwuchipihwa veruzhinji, asi havana kutaura kuti rubatsiro urwu rwuchapiwa vanhu rinhi. Nyanzvi munyaya dzehutano pamwe nedzematongerwo enyika dzarumbidza zvaitwa naVaChamisa zvekushandisa dandemutande reFacebook kutaura neveruzhinji dzichiti izvi zvinoita kuti vanhu vasaungane munguva ino yechirwere cheCovid-19. Mashoko aVaChamisa ndeekutanga gore rino vachitura mashoko kunyika yose. No media source currently available

headline: South Africa Yopa Magwaro Vakanga Vanyimwa Zviuru Gumi neZviviri
text: Sangano re Global Zimbabwe Forum rinoti riri kufara zvikuru nedanho ratorwa nehurumende yemu South Africa rekuwedzera mazuva ekuti vanhu vaende kunotora magwaro anovapa mvumo yekugara nekushanda vari munyika iyi. Magwaro aya ari kupihwa pasi pechirongwa che Zimbabwe Special Permit (ZSP) kusvika musi wa 31 Ndira gore rinouya. Hurumende yeSouth Africa inoti vanhu zviuru gumi nezviviri vakambenge vanyimwa magwaro vava kupihwa magwaro aya kunze kwevanhu makumi maviri nevashanu. Sachigaro wesangano re Global Zimbabwe Forum, Va Solomon Chikowero, vanoti kuwedzerwa kwenguva yaphiwa vanhu kuchabatsira zvikuru sezvo vakambenge vanyimwa pakutanga vava kupihwa magwaro aya mushure meongororo itsva yakaitwa. "Tiri kufadzwa nedanho iri sezvo takaita misangano nebazi rehurumende rinoita nezvemapepa aya kutanga kwemwedzi uno tichivazivisa kuti zvange zvakakosha kuti vawedzere mazuva ekuti vanhu vapihwe mapepa aya uye kuti vawongorore zvakare avo vavange vanyima kuti vawaniswe mukana mutsva saka," Va Chikowero vaudza Studio7. headline: Vatsigiri vorumbidza Nakamba
text: Villa vari kurumbidza zvikuru chizvarwa chemuZimbabwe Marvelous Nakamba padandemutande reTwitter zvichitevera kutamba kwaakaita zvinodakadza svondo radarika apo chikwata chake chakaita mangange 2-2 neBurnley kuVilla Park.   Rakange risiri zuva rekufara reAston Villa iyo mwaka uno yarasa zvibodzwa zvisere zvayainge ichifanirwa kuwana muPremier League.   Asi Nakamba ari kurakidza kuti mutambi wepamusoro izvo zvakaona murairidzi wechikwata chake ichi, Deam Smith, achimutenga nemari inosvika 11 miriyoni paunzi.   Mumutambo wavo neBurnley, Nakamba  akatamba zvemhando yepamusoro.   Kubva paakatengwa neAston Villa mwaka uno achibva kuClub Brugge yekuBelgium, Nakamba akwanisa kutamba mitambo mina kuchikwata ichi iyo inoti mitatu yemuEnglish Premier League kozoti mumwechete mumakwishu eCarabao Leagu Cup uyo wakave mutambo wake wekutanga.   Chikwata chake parizvino muEPL chatamba mitambo minomwe asi Nakamba haana kukwanisa kutamba yose sezvo akambenge akakuvara apo aitambira chikwata chenyika chemaWarriors mumutambo weAfrica Cup of Nations uyo wakaitirwa kuEgypt nguva yadarika.   Asi kubva apora, Nakamba ari kurakidza kuti arovera hoko muchikwata chaSmith zvichitevera kutamba kwaaita mitambo mitatu yadarika.   Izvi zvamuona zvakare achigarisa pabhenji vamwe vatambi vakaita saDouglas Luiz chizvarwa chekuBrazil uyo aimbotambira Manchester City naHenri Lansbury chizvarwa chemuEngland uyo akambotambira Arsenal.   Ane bhora kunyangwe asina, Nakamba anorakidza kuti mutambi wepamusoro.   Mashoko anotevera ndiwo mamwe ezvakataurwa nevatsigiri veAston Villa padandemutande reTwitter. headline: Zifa yoronga kudzoka kwenhabvu
text: SANGANO rinotungamirira nhabvu reZimbabwe Football Association (Zifa) rinoti riri kushanda siku nesikati kuti nhabvu ichidzoswe kutanga kwemwedzi unotevera (Kubvumbi) zvichitevera kunyevenutswa kwakaitwa matanho ekurwisa kupararira kwechirwere cheCovid-19 neHurumende svondo rino.   Muhurukuro, mutungamiri weZifa — Felton Kamambo — anoti sangano ravo rakatotanga kare gadziriro dzekudzosa mutambo uyu izvo zvange zvichivaona vachiongorora nhandare dzose dzenhabvu dziri munyika.    Anoti chasara pari zvino kuti vachipihwa mvumo neSports and Recreation Commission (SRC) yekuti nhabvu ichitanga kutambwa.   “Isu takatotanga kare gadziriro dzekuti mutambo uyu udzoswe nekuongorora nhandare dzose dzenhabvu dziri munyika. Tichiri kuenderera mberi nekuongorora kuti nhandare dzedu dziri munyika dzakamira sei kuitira kuti tigare takagadzirira.   “Saka iye zvino takamirira kupihwa mvumo neSRC kuti tichitange kuronga mitambo ichitambwe,” anodaro Kamambo.   Anoti seZifa, vakanga vaine chivimbo chekuti nhabvu itange muna Kurume asi hazvichakwanisike saka vave kutarisira kuna Kubvumbi.   “Taida chaizvo kuti nhabvu itange mwedzi uno asi hazvichakwanisike, tave kutarisira mwedzi unotevera. Takamirira kunzwa kubva kuSRC kuti toita sei.    “Tiri kupedzisa gadziriro dzose kuitira kuti tikapihwa mvumo yekuti nhabvu ichitanga pasawanikwe chikoneso chinoita kuti isatambwe,” anodaro.   Kamambo anoti sangano ravo rakaudza hutungamiri hwemaligi ose ari muno anosanganisira Premier Soccer League, Division One neTwo kuti vavanyorere vachivazisa zvikwata zvichakwanisa kukwikwidza mumwaka wegore rino.   “Takati kumaligi ose ngavatizivise zvikwata zvichange zvichikwikwidza kuitira kuti patinotanga kuronga mafambiro anoita mitambo yegore rino tinge tichiziva kuti pachange pane zvikwata zvipi uye kuti zvitiitire nyore pakuita hurongwa hwacho,” anodaro Kamambo.   Kutanga mwaka wegore rino kana nhabvu ikatanga kutambwa, Kamambo anoti Zifa ndiyo ichange yave kubhadhara varidzi vepembe izvo zvakasiyana nezvaiitwa kare sezvo vaibhadharwa nezvikwata zvinenge zvichitamba.   “Gore rino tinoda kuti zvikwata zvisanyanyoremerwa saka isu seZifa takazvipira kubhadhara varidzi vepembe kutanga mwaka uno, zvikwata hazvichabhadhare zvega varidzi vepembe,” anodaro Kamambo.

headline: Kanzuru yeHarare Yobhadharisa Mitero Ichishandisa Madhora ekuAmerica
text: Kanzuru yeHarare yatanga kubhadharisa vagari mari yemvura nemimwe mitero nemadhora ekuAmerica zvichitevera kupihwa kwayakaitwa mvumo yekuita izvi nehurumende. Sangano rinomirira maguta nemadhorobha munyka reUrban Councils Association of Zimbabwe, kana kuti UCAZ, ranyorerawo kuhurumende richtsvaga mvumo yekuti maguta nemadhorobha ese munyika abhadharise vagari mari nemadhora ekuAmerica. Hurumende yakapa kanzuru yeHarare mvumo yekubhadharisa vagari nemakambani vachishandia madhora ekuAmerica kutanga mwedzi uno. Mutauriri wekanzuru yeHarare, VaMichaeil Chideme, vaudza Studio 7 kuti vasingakwanise mari yekunze vacharamba vachishandisa mari yemuno, asi inenge yakatarwa ichienzaniswa nedhora rekuAmerica. Mamwe maguta akaita seMasvingo, Kwekwe neRedcliff akaitawo zvisungo zvekuti vanokwanisa vabhadhare mitero vachishandisa madhora ekuAmerica. Mutungamiriri weUrban Councils Association of Zimbabwe, zvakare mari meya weGweru, VaJosiah Makombe, vaudza Studio 7 kuti vakatonyorera kugurukota rinoona nezvemadhorobha nematunhu, VaJuly Moyo, vachikumbira mvumo yekuti maguta nemadhorabha ese munyika makumi matatu nemaviri abvimidzwe kubhadharisa mitero nemvura nemadhorobha ekuAmerica. VaMakombe vati maguta nemadhorobha ange ave kutatarika kuita basa ravo sezvo vese vanovatengesera zvinhu zvekushandisa zvakaita semishonga yekuchenesa mvura vave kutengesa nemari yekunze. Vati kubhadharisa mari yekunze kunoita kuti makanzuru akwanise kuita basa ravo zvakanaka asingapedzi nguva ari mumitsetse yekutsvaga mari yekunze kubva kuReserve Bank of Zimbabwe. Mukuru werimwe remasangano anomirira vagari vemuHarare, reHarare Residents Association, VaPrecious Shumba, vaudza Studio7 kuti vanotambira danho rekubhadharisa mitero nemari yekunze vachiti zvinoita kuti makunzuru aya asagare achishandura mitero nekuda kwekushaya simba kunogara kuchiita mari yemuno. VaShumba vaenderera mberi vachiti danho iri rinoita kuti maguta nemadhorobha asagare achikumbira mari kuReserve Banj nehurumende. Vanoona nezvekufambiswa kwebasa musangano rreCommunity Water Alliance, VaHardlife Mudzingwa, vaudza Studio 7 kunyange hazvo iri riri danho rakanaka uye richikwanisa kuvandudza mabasa emakanzuru, dambudziko guru nderekuti vagari nevashandi vakawanda munyika vari kutambira mari yemuno, izvo zvichanetsa kuti vawane mari yekunze iyi. Mukuru wesangano reMasvingo United Residents and Ratepayers Association, VaAnoziva Muguti, vaudza Studio 7 kuti danho rekushandisa mari yekunze rakanaka chose uye chinofadza ndechekuti vasingawane marii iyi havasi kumanikidzwa kubhadhara nemari yekunze, sezvo vachibhadhariswa mari yemunyika asi yakatarwa nemutengo wedhora rekuAmerica. Hatina kukwanisa kubata VaJuly Moyo kuti tinzwe divi ravo panyaya iyi. Mumwe mushandi mukuru mubazi ravo uyo asina kuda kudomwa nezita, audza Studio 7 kuti VaMoyo vachapindurachikumbiro cheUCAZ, nguva ipi zvayo kubva pari zvino. Hurumende yadzika mutemo unobvumidza vemabhizimisi bhadharisa vatengi nemari yekunze neyemuno, kana kuti Dual Pricing System, asi haina kunge yapa makanzuru mvumo yekuita izvi. headline: Nyanzvi dzeHutano Dzoshushikana neKukwira kweHuwandu hweVanhu Vari Kubatwa neCovid-19 Munyika
text: Bazi rezvehutano rakazivisa kuti vanhu makumi matanhatu nevashanu kana kuti 65, vakabatwa vaine chirwere cheCovid-19 munyika yose, uye vamwe vanhu vana vakafa nacho kuBulawayo pavanhu chiuru nezana rine makumi maviri nevatatu, kana kuti 1123 ,vakavhenekwa nemusi weChina. Dunhu reBulawayo, iro ratarisana nedambudziko rekuve nevanhu vakawandisa vari kubatwa nechirwere ichi, rine vanhu makumi matatu nemumwe kana kuti 31 vakabatwa vaine chirwere, kuchitiwo dunhu reMashonaland West rine vanhu gumi nevatatu kana kuti 13. Matabeleland North ine vanhu vashanu, vana kuManicaland, vana kuMashonaland Central nevamwe vana kuMashonaland East, Matabeleland South vaviri, kuchitiwo matunhu anoti Midlands neMasvingo aine munhu mumwe chete padunhu. Dunhu reHarare harina munhu akabatwa aine chirwere ichi. Izvi zvakasiya huwandu hwevanhu vabatwa neCovid-19 munyika yose vave zviuru zvipfumbamwe nemakumi mana nevatanhatu, kana kuti 9 046, kuchitiwo vanhu vapora vave zviuru zvisere nezana rine makumi mapfumbamwe nevashanu, kana kuti 8 195. Vanhu vachiri kurwara nyika yose vave mazana mashanu nemakumi masere nevatanhatu, kana kuti 586. Nyanzvi mune zvehutano vachitungamira sangano reCommunity Working Group on Health, VaItai Rusike, vanoti vari kushushikana zvikuru nekukwira zvakare kwehuwandu hwevanhu vari kubatwa nechirwere ichi, zvikuru kumatunhu ari kuchamhembe kwenyika. Pave nekutyirwawo kuti chirwere ichi chinogona kusazokwanisa kurwiswa kana kudzivirirwa kana hurumende yakaenderera mberi nekuvhura miganho yenyika musi wa 01 Zvita sezvakayavimbisa pachitariswa kuti vanhu vazhinji vanenge vopinda nekubuda muSouth Africa, iyo inove nyika ine vanhu vakawandisa vabatwa nechirwere ichi muAfrica yose. Studio 7 yakundikana kubata mukuru anoona nezvekurwisana neCovid-19, Doctor Agnes mahomva kuti tinzwe nezvematanho avari kutora mukudzivirira kupararira kwechirwere ichi. Mukuru anoona nezvezvirwere zvinotapuriranwa mubazi rezvehutano, Doctor Portia Manangazira, vati vanga vari mumusangano vakati tivabate neMugovera. Asi VaRusike vanoti zviri kuonekwa kuBulawayo mucherechedzo wemamiriro akaita zvinhu munyika ekuti vanhu havachakoshesa kuzvichengetedza kubva kuchirwere ichi kubva pakanyevenutswa mutemo wairambidza vanhu kufambafamba uye pakabviswa mapurisa nemauto vaimanikidza mutemo wekuti vanhu vapfeke mamasiki nekutevedzera zvimwe zvose zvinokurudzirwa nebazi rezvehutano. Vanoti chitsvambe chave kune vanhu pachavo kuti vaone kuti vachengetedza hutano hwavo sezvo vari kuona kuti vanhu vakawanda havachina shungu nekutyira kuti chirwere chingangovabatawo, vachiti veruzhinji vanofanirwa kuziva kuti chirwere chichiriko. VaRusike vanoti chimwe chinogona kunge chiri kukanganisa mabasa ekurwisana nechirwere ichi kushaikwa kwemvura yekugeza maoko munzvimbo nemaguta zvakawanda, uye vari kukurudzira makanzuru pamwe nehurumende kuti vaone kuti vawanisa vanhu mvura yekushandisa kuzvishambidza. headline: Covid-19 Inobata Vanhu Vanodarika Zviuru Zvina neMazana Masere
text: Bazi rezvehutano rakazivisa nezuro kuti vanhu vakanga vabatwa nechirwere che Covid-19 munyika vaive vasvika pazviuru zvina nemazana masere negumi nevasere, kana kuti 4 818. Vanhu vafa nechirwere cheCovid-19 munyika yose vachiri zana nevana kana kuti 104, uye vapona vasvika kuchiuru nemazana mashanu nemakumi mana nevana, kana kuti 1 544. Vanhu vanoita makumi manomwe, kana kuti 70, ndivo vakawanikwa vaine chirwere ichi pavanhu chiuru nemazana manomwe nemakumi mapfumbamwe nevashanu, kana kuti 1 795 vakavhenekwa pachishandiswa nzira ye Polymerase Chain Reaction kana kuti PCR. Vanhu vose vakawanikwa vaine chirwere ichi ndevaya vagara vari munyika vasina nhoroondo yekubuda kunze. Nhepfenyuro yeZBC yakazivisawo nezuro kuburikidza nedandemutande reTwitter kuti vashandi vayo makumi matatau vakabatwa ne Covid-19. Studio7 haina kukwanisa kunzwa divi reZBC pamusoro pevanhu vakabatwa neCovid-19 ava. Imwe nyanzvi munyaya dzezvehutano vari chiremba, Doctor Gilson Mandigo, vanoti vari kuona kuti pave nemusiyano mukuru pahuwandu hwevanhu vave kubatwa nekushaya nechirwere ichi, zvichienzaniswa nepakatanga chirwere ichi kuwanikwa munyika sezvo vanhu vave kuwanikwa vaine chirwere ichi vari vanhu vagara vari munyika, kwete vari kubva kunze kwenyika. Doctor Mandigo vanoti zvinoratidza kuti vanhu vanofanirwa kusimbisa nyaya dzekudzivirira kupararira kwechirwere ichi. No media source currently available

headline: VeMuzvitoro Voramba Kutambira Makadhi ekuBhanga
text: Veruzhinji muHarare vanoti havasi kufara nezvave kuitwa nevezvimwe zvitoro zvekunzi vatenge nemari chaiyo pakutenga zvimwe zvinhu kwetese kushandisa makadhi ekubhanga. Zvimwe zvitoro zvinonzi zvakumanikidza vatengi kuti vashandise mari kutenga zvimwe zvinhu zvakaita semafuta kwete kushandisa makadhi ekubhanga kana dzimwe nzira dzakaita seEcocash. Mumwe mugari wemuHarare, Amai Takudzwa Dzumbunu vati dambudziko iri rafararira nezvitoro zvakawanda zvavanoti zviri kukonzera kuti vashaye zvekuita sezvo vanhu vazhinji vanga vorarama nekushandisa makadhi ekubhanga kana kubhadhara neEcocash sezvo mari dziri kushyaikwa kumabhanga. Asi Amai Winnet Bhasera vanoti ivo semunhu ave pamudyandigere zviri kuvawomera kuti vanzi vasashandise makadhi ekubhanga pakutenga zvimwe zvinhu muzvitoro vachiti havakwanise kuswera vakamira pamitsetse yekumbhanga kuti vakwanise kuwanisa mari yekutenga zvavanenge vachida. Asi Muzvare Kudzai Chaparadza vatiwo kunyangwe hazvo iri riri dambudziko kuvatengi, vezvitoro vanenge vachidawo kubhadhara vashandi nemari yacho saka zvakakoshawo kuti veruzhinji vashandise musvo wemari pakutenga. Vaenderera mberi vachiti makambani anogadzira zvinhu akaita semafuta anodawo mari yekutenga kubva kunze kwenyika zvaanoshandisa mukugadzira zvinhu. Vamwe vakuru munezvimwe zvitoro zvashanyirwa neStudio 7 varamba kutaura nezvenyaya iyi vachiti havabvumidzwe kutaura pamhepo nevakuru vavo. Kunyangwe hazvo varamba kutaura, zvinyorwa zvanga zvakanamatidzwa muzvitoro izvi zvanga zvichiti vanhu vanofanira kutenga nemari chaiyo kwete makadhi sezvo kwavanohodha kuchidiwa musvo wemari. Umwe mushandi pane imwe kambani inogadzira mafuta iri muHarare uyo aramba kudomwa nezita ati imwe yemichina yavanoshandisa pakusvina mafuta inoda kutengerwa zvinhu kana kuti ma parts kubva kunze kwenyika saka zviri kuvatorera nguva yakareba kuti vawane mvumo yekuburitsa mari iyi kubva kubhanga guru renyika reRBZ. Kubva pakatanga kunetsa kushayikwa mari kumabhanga, RBZ yakabva yatora danho rekuti vese vanoda kutenga zvinhu kunze vanofanira kutanga vapihwa mvumo neRBZ. Zvichakadai, tsvangiridzo yaitwa neStudio 7 yaburitsa pachena kuti zvimwe zviteshi zvinotengesa mafuta edzimotokari zvavekuti munhu awedzere imwe mari pamusoro kana achishandisa kadhi rekubhanga pakutenga mafuta emotokari. Vashandi pane chimwe chiteshi chepeturu chiri pakati pedhorobha vati chikonzero chiri kuita kuti vaite izvi ndechekuti vanobatirwa mari kubhanga kana voda kutora mari iyi zvavati zvinoita kuti varuze mari yakawanda kana vasingawedzere mari shomanana pamusoro pemari yakatarwa kuti vatengese nayo mafuta edzimotokari. Hatina kukwanisa kutaura nevasangano rinomirira vatengi reConsumer Council of Zimbabwe kuti tinzwe divi ravo panyaya iyi. No media source currently available

headline: Mufundisi Oramba Ari Mutirongo Mushure Mekutadza Kuunganidza Mari yeChibatiso
text: Pastor Patrick Phillip Mugadza, avo vakasungwa neChishanu chapfuura mushure mekuratidzira kuVictoria Falls, vachiri muhusungwa mushure mekukundikana kuunganidza mari yechibatiso yakatarwa nedare. Mutongi wedare ramejasitiriti kuVictoria Falls, Amai Lindiwe Maphosa, neChipiri vakazotara madhora mazana mashanu semari inofanirwa kubhadharwa naVaMugadza kuti vakwanise kutongwa vari kunze. Pastor Mugadza, vanove mukuru weRemnant Church iri kuKariba, vakasungwa vachipomerwa mhosva yekuita zvisina maturo kana kuti criminal nuisance, vachinzi vakatyora Section 46 of Criminal Law (Codification and Reform) Act Chapter 9:23. Mfundisi ava vakasungwa mushure mekunge varatidzira kumusangano wepagore weZanu PF vaine chinyorwa chakanzi “Mr President The People Are Suffering, Proverbs 21.13”. Sangano remagweta anorwira kodzero dzevanhu, reZimbabwe Lawyers for Human Rights, iro riri kumirira mufundisi uyu, rinoshora zvikuru kumbunyikidzwa kwekodzero dzaPastor Mugadza. Mutauriri wesangano iri, VaKumbirai Mafunda, vanoti bumbiro remitemo idzva rinobvumidza munhu kuita sezvakaitwa naPastor Mugadza pamwe naVaItai Dzamara, avo vaikurudzirawo VaMugabe kuti vasiye chigaro. VaMafunda vanoti gweta riri kumirira Pastor Mugadza, VaThulani Nkala veZimbabwe Lawyers for Human Rights, vave kuronga kukwira kumatare makuru kuti atarisisewo nezvenyaya iyi. VaDzamara vairatidzirawo vari muAfrica Unity Square vachikurudzira kuti VaMugabe vasiye basa vachiti vari kutadza kutonga. Asi vakazotsakatika mushure mekupambwa nevanhu vasingazivikanwi musi wa 9 Kurume wegore rino. Pastor Mugadza vakanzi vadzoke zvakare kudare nemusi wa 5 Ndira 2016. headline: Pivac ave panyanga

headline: VaKenyatta naVaOdinga Vovimbisa Kugadzirisa Makakatanwa Avo MuKenya
text: Mutungamiri weKenya VaUhuru Kenyatta vaita musangano nemutungamiri webato guru rinopikisa munyika iyi, VaRaila Odinga, mukuedza kwevatungamiri vaviri ava kutsvaga nzira dzekupedza gakava munyika iyi. Mutungamiri weKenya VaUhuru Kenyatta vaita musangano nemutungamiri webato guru rinopikisa munyika iyi, VaRaila Odinga, mukuedza kwevatungamiri vaviri ava kutsvaga nzira dzekupedza nadzo gakava rakakonzerwa nezvakabuda musarudzo dzemutungamiri wenyika dzakaitwa gore rapera. VaOdinga Vaipikisa zvakabuda musarudzo idzi, mushure mekunge VaKenyatta vanzi ndivo vakanga vakunda sarudzo dzekutanga, idzo dzakazonzi dzaive dzisina kufambiswa zvakanaka. Izvi zvakazoita kuti dzidzokororwe, asi VaOdinga vakaramba kupinda musarudzo dzepiri idzi vachiti pane zvavaida kuti zvitange zvagadziriswa, izvo zvakazoita kuti VaKenyatta vapinde voga vachibva vakunda zvakare. Izvi zvanga zvakonzera kusagadzikana kwenyika iyi, uye kuurayiwa kwevanhu vanodarika chiuru. Kusangano kwetungamiri vaviri ava ndekekutanga kubva pakaitwa sarudzo idzi, uye vaudza vatori venhau kuti vachashanda pamwechete kuti nyika yavo iende mberi murunyararo. “Tave kutanga nhaurirano dzekutsvakurudza chakanyanya kuita kuti tive nemaonero akasiyana azokonzera kuti tive nekusawirirana pakati pedu,” VaKenyatta vadaro. "Yakwana nguva yekuti tigadzirise zviri kuita kuti tisawirirane,” VaOdinga vatsinhirawo mashoko aVaKenyatta aya. Asi dzimwe nyanzvi mune zvematongerwo enyika dzinoti kugadzirisa makakatanwa pakati pevatungamiri vaviri ava kwakaoma sezvo nyika yavo ichinetseka zvikuru nenyaya yemarudzi. Asi mumwe anoongorora zvematongerwo enyika, VaPromise Sande, vatiwo dai vanoita zvematongerwo enyika muZimbabwe vaonawo gwara iri, vadzidzawo kuti zvakakosha kuti vatungamiriri vemapato anopikisana vaise zvido zvevanhu pamberi pekupokana kwavo. headline: Mumwe Mudzimai Ourayiwa neMatombo Aidhuurwa neLarfage Cement
text: Mumwe mudzimai Amai Shupikai Chitsina vakashaya musi wa 15 Nyamavhuvhu pedyo nemugodhi unodhuurwa matombo nekambani yelafarge papurazi repangoula pedyo neguta reharare mushure mekutemwa nedombo rainge radhuurwa nekambani yainge yapihwa basa neLafarge Cement. Amai Chitsina avo vainge vari mumba mavo vakabva vashaya uye imwe hama yavo yakakuvara mushure mekutemwa nematombo aya. Mumwe mukuru anoona nezvekudyidzana nevanhu mukambani iyi VaTawanda Njerere vaudza Studio 7 kuti itumire tsambambozha nemibvunzo vachivimbisa kuti vachapindura. Asi hatina kukwanisa kubata mutauriri wemapurisa Senior Assistant Commissioner Paul Nyathi kana gurukota rezvezvicherwa VaWinston Chitando sezvo vange vasiri kudaira nharembozha dzavo. Mukuru wesangano reCentre for Natural Resources Governance VaFarai Maguwu vane vamwe musangano ravo vakashanyira mhuri yamuchakabvu Chitsina vanoti vari kushushikana nerufu urwu. headline: VaMugabe Voparura Hurongwa hweGwaro Idzva reVavhoti kuState House
text: Mutungamiri wenyika VaRobert Mugabe nemusi weChina vari kutarisirwa kuparura chirongwa chekutanga kwekunyorwa kwegwaro revavhoti kuState House. Sachigaro weZimbabwe Electoral Commission Amai Rita Makarau vaudza Studio 7 kuti pavachabva kuState House vachaenda kuHarare International Conference Centre. Izvi zvinotevera kuziviswa naVaMugabe mashoko akaburitswa naVaMugabe ekuti hurongwa uhu hutange zviri pamutemo kubva musi wa14 Gunyana kusvika musi wa 1 Ndira gore rinouya. VaMugabe vakaburitsa hurongwa uhu mugwaro rehurumende regovernment gazette. Amai Makarau vati vamwe vanhu vachazotanga kunyoreswa zviri pamutemo kana michina yose yekunyoresa vanhu kuvhota yebiometric voter registration. Parizvino michina yakauya inosvika mazana mana uye iri kushandiswa mukudzidzisa vanhu avo vachanodzidzisa vamwe mumatunhu nezvenyaya yekuvhota. No media source currently available

headline: Zimbabwe Yovimbiswa neChina Nhomba yeChirwere cheCovid-19
text: China yazivisa kuti Zimbabwe ndeimwe yenyika gumi neina dzichatanga kuwana rubatsiro rwemajekiseni enhomba yekudzivirira Covid-19 pasi pechirongwa chayo chekubatsira nyika dzichiri kubudirira kuti dziwane mishonga iyi. Izvi zvaziviswa nemutauriri webazi rekuChina rinoona nekudyidzana nedzimwe nyika, VaWang Wenbin, avo vati mishonga iyi yakagadzirwa munyika mavo uye zvavari kuita izvi kuzadzisa chitsiidzo chaikaitwa nemutungamiri wenyika yavo, VaXI Jingpin. China yatiwo ichabatsira zvekare dzimwe nyika dzichiri kubudirira makumi matatu nesere pachikamu chinotevera uye ichapinda muchirongwa cheWorld Health Organisations cheCOVAX. Nyika iyi inotiwo mishonga yakaita seichapihwa Zimbabwe iyo yakagadzirwa nekambani yeSinopham neSinovac, yakatoendeswa kunyika dzakaita seUnited Arab Emirates, Brazil neChile. VaWenbin vati nyika dzepasi rese dzinofanira kubatana mukurwisa Covid-19 vachiti China icharamba ichibatsira nyika dzichiri kubudirira nedzinotambura nemishonga. Vatiwo vanovimba kuti nyika dzakabudirira dzichaita zvimwezvo kuitira kuti munhu wese awane mushonga wekudzivirira Covid-19. Muchiziviso chavo, VaWenbin havana kuzivisa kuti Zimbabwe ichawana mishonga yakawanda zvakadii pasi pechirongwa ichi. Dzimwe nyika dzichawanda rubatsiro neZimbabwe in Pakistan, Brunei, Nepal, Philippines, Myanmar, Cambodia, Laos, Sri Lanka, Mongolia, Palestine, Belarus, Siera Leone neEquatorial Guinea. Hatina kukwanisa kunzwa kubva kudivi rehurumende sezvo mukuru anoona nezvekufambiswa kwemabasa edenda reCovid-19 mumahofisi emutungamiriri wenyika, Dr Agnes Mahomva, vange vakabatikana panguva yataenda pamhepo. Mutungamiri werimwe remasangano anomirira machiremba anoshanda akazvimirira, reMedical and Dental Private Practitioners Association of Zimbabwe, Dr Johannes Marisa, vati zvaitwa neChina zvakanaka nekuti hurumende yeZimbabwe inogona kunge isina mari yekutenga mishonga inokwanira munhu wese. Vati mabatirwe ari kuitwa vanhu nehutachiwana hweCovid-19 anoratidza kuti mishonga yenhomba iyi ndiyo yakakosha pakubatsira kudzivirira kupararira kweCovid-19. Vaenderera mberi vachiti vakazvipira kushanda nehurumende mukudzidzisa vakoti vevamwe kuti mishonga iyi inoshandiswa sei. Vatiwo zvakakosha kuti zvipatara nemakirinika zvitange kugadzirira nzvimbo dzekuchengetera mishonga iyi sezvo ichinzi inofanira kuchengetedzwa panotonhora. Zvichakadai, vaimbove nhengo yekomiti yeparamende inoona nezvehutano, VaPrince Dubeko Sibanda, vaudza Studio 7 kuti kunyange hazvo zviri kuitwa neChina zvakanaka, zvinosuwisa kuti hurumende haisati yazivisa veruzhinji kuti hurongwa hwayo pakutenga nekupa vanhu mishonga yeCovid-19 hwakamira sei. VaSibanda vatiwo hapana kuchejeka pakushandiswa kwezvinhu zvinenge zvapihwa pachena nedzimwe nyika. Mashoko eChina anouuya apo hurumende yakazivisa nezuro kuti masangano anopa rubatsiro ari kubatsira nyika nemari inoita mazana maviri nemakumi matatu nemana emamiriyoni emadhora ekuAmerica kurwisana neCovid-19 pamwe nezvirwere zvakaita seBP neDiabetes. Mari iyi inosanganisira mamiriyoni makumi mana nemapfumbamwe nemadhora ekuAmerica yakabva kuGlobal Fund iyo yave kutoshandiswa kutenga zvekudzivirira varapi kana kuti Personal Protective Equipment, mishonga pamwe nezvinoshandiswa kuongorora hutachiwana hweCovid-19. Hurumende pachayo inoti ine mamiriyoni zana emadhora ekuAmerica ekutenga mishonga yekudzivirira Covid-19 munyika ine vanhu vanodarika mamiriyoni gumi nenshanu, kana kuti US$15 million. headline: Dare rePamusoro Rotonga Kuti Makurukota Ataurire Ruzhinji nezveMabhizimisi Avainawo
text: Dare repamusoro reHigh Court rinoti gurukota rezvemitemo VaZiyambi Ziyambi nemuchuchisi mukuru wehurumende, VaPrince Machaya vakatyora bumbiro remitemo nekutadza kwavakaita kudzika mutemo unosungira vakuru-vakuru muhurumende kubuditsa pachena hupfumi hwavo. Izvi zvinotevera chikumbiro chakasvitswa kudare nenhengo yeparamende inomirira Harare North, VaAllan Rusty Markham kuti bumbiro remutemo ritevedzerwe. Mutongi wedare repamusoro, VaJacob Manzunzu, nezuro vakatura mutongo wekuti VaZiyambi naVaMachaya havana kudzika mutemo unosungira vakuru-vakuru muhurumende kuti vaburitse pachena hupfumi zvavakati zvinopesana nezvavanosungirwa kunge vakaIta zviri mubumbiro remitemo renyika. Pasi pechikamu 198 (a) chebumbiro remitemo, paramende inofanira kudzika mutemo unoona kuti vakuru-vakuru muhurumende vaburitsa hupfumi hwavo pachena nguva nenguva nekutara zviga zvinofanira kuetevdzerwa nemakambani ehurumende pamwe nekurangwa kwevanenge vatyora mutemo uyu. Nokudaro, VaManzunzu vakapa VaZiyambi naVaMachaya mwedzi mitatu yekuona kuti mutemo uyu wadzikwa. VaMarkham vaudza Studio 7 kuti vari kufara zvikuru nemutongo uyu. VaManzunzu vakati zviri mubumbiro remitemo zvinofanira kuzadziswa uye hazvifanire kutora nguva kuzviita nekudaro vakakurudzira VaZiyambi naVaMachaya kuti vatore matanho ekuti mutemo unobata nyaya iyi wadzikwa. Mumiririri weHighfield West muparamende uye vari nhengo yekomiti yePublic Accounts mudare iri, VaHappymore Chidziva, vati chinhu chakakosha zvikuru kuti mutemo uyu udzikwe vachiti izvi zvinobatsira zvikuru mukurwisana nehuori uhwo hunonzi hwatambarara serunyemba munyika. Mukuru wesangano reTransparency International Zimbabwe, VaTafadzwa Chikumbu, vati zvakakosha kuti veruzhinji vazive kuti vatungamiri vavo vari kuwana sei mari dzavo kuti pasaite huori. Vanokokera bato reZanu-PF mudare reparamende VaPupurai Togarepi vaudza Studio 7 kuti mutemo unofanira kutevedzerwa asi vakati zvakakosha kuti nekune vamwe vemabhizimisi zviitwe kuti vasaite huori. VaMachaya vati titaure naVaZiyambi nezvenyaya iyi asi VaZiyambi vanga vasiri kudaira nharembozha yavo uye vanga vasati vapiundura mibvunzo yatavatumira kuti tinzwe kuti vachapikisa mutongo uyu here kana kuti kwete uye kuti matanho api avachatora. Asi pakunzwikwa kwenyaya iyi, vaviri ava vakaudza dare kuti kudzikwa kwemutemo uyu hachisi chinhu chinofanirwa kuitwa naivo chete vachiti vedare reparamende nedare remakurukota ehurumende vanofanirawo kuunzwa kudare kuti vazvipindurire sezvo vane chekuita nekudzikwa kwemutemo uyu. Hatina kukwanisa kutaura nemutauriri wedare reparamende, VaJacob Mudenda, sezvo vari kuRwanda kwavari kupinda mumwe musangano vachimirira paramende.  No media source currently available

headline: Vana Chiremba Vanoti Havadzokeri kuBasa Kusvika Hurumende Yagadzirisa Zvichemo Zvavo
text: Apo kuramwa mabasa kwaana chiremba kwasvitsa masvondo maviri nemusi weChitatu, vamwe vana chiremba vamboratidzira kwekanguva kadiki pachipatara cheUnited Bulawayo Hospitals. Studio7 yasvika pachipatara cheUnited Bulawayo Hospitals, UBH, kuratidzira uku kuchangopera. Mutungamiri weZimbabwe Hospital Doctors’ Association, Dr Mxolisi Ngwenya, vanoti kuratidzira uku yange iri nzira yekuyeuchidza hurumende kuti igadzirise zvichemo zvaana chiremba. Dr Mxolisi Ngwenya vati zvinhu hazvina kumira zvakanaka muzvipatara zvikuru zvehurumende munyika yose. Vati kunyange zvakadaro, vana chiremba vadiki havazi kuzodzokera shure panyaya yekuramwa mabasa kusvika hurumende yagadzirisa zvichemo zvavo, sezvo vati pave nenguva vachiudzwa kuti zvichemo zvavo zvichagadziriswa asi pasina chinobuda. Mumwe mukoti mukuru paUBH uyo asina kuda kudomwa nezita kana kutaura pamhepo sezvo asingabvumirwe kutaura nevatapi venhau, ati vanhu vari kungorapwa pachipatara apa ndevaye vanenge vachirwara zvakaipisisa, sezvo vana chiremba vakawanda kunyanya vachangopedza zvidzidzo zvavo, vari kuramwa mabasa. PaRichard Morris Hospital, chinove chikamu cheUBH panorapwa vanhu maziso, vamwe vanhu vange vauya kuzorapwa vange vachiudzwa kuti vadzokere kumba sezvo panga pasina vana chiremba vanga vachikwanisa kuvaona. Ongororo yaitwa neStudio 7 paMpilo Central Hospital, chimwezve chipatara chikuru muBulawayo, yaratidzawo kuti kuchikamu chechipatara ichi chinorapa vanhu vachibva kumba - kana kuti Outpatients Department - kwange kusina vanhu. Chiremba mukuru paMpilo, Dr Solwayo Ngwenya, vaudza Studio 7 kuti kunyange hazvo vari kungokwanisawo kurapa vanhu vari kurwara zvakaipisisa, zvinhu hazvina kunyanya kuipa sezvo vana chiremba vakuru nevamwe vanoshanda vachibva kunze, kana kuti consultants, vari kushanda semazuva ose. Dr Solwayo Ngwenya vabvuma mashoko ekuti vana mukoti vanonzi vari kuda kutanga kuramwawo mabasa mangwana, asi vakurudzira vana chiremba pamwe naana mukoti kuti vakoshese varwere sezvinotarisirwa mubasa ravo. Studio7 haina nkukwanisa kunzwa divi rehurumende panyaya iyi, kanawo kunzwa kugurukota rezvehutano, Va David Parirenyatwa. Vana chiremba naana mukoti vanogara vachiramwa mabasa nguva nenguva vachitsutsumwa pamusoro pemashandiro avo uye mari shoma yavanowana. Nekune rimwe divi hurumende inogarawo ichichema nerekuti haina mari. Asi Fortune Moyo, mumwe mutori wenhau anoshanda akazvimirira, ndemumwe wevanhu vanoti matambudziko ana chiremba pamwe nemamwe ane chekuita nezvehutano munyika anogona kugadziriswa, kana hurumende ikakoshesa nyaya yehutano munyika sezvainofanirwa kuita. Kunze kwemari yavanohora, zvimwe zvezvichemo zvaana chiremba ava zvinosanganisira nyaya yekushaya zvikwanisiro zvekushandisa muzvipatara. No media source currently available

headline: MDC Alliance Yoronga Kuratidzira muHarare Svondo Rinouya
text: Mubatanidzwa wemapato anopikisa weMDC Alliance unoti uri kuzoratidzira muHarare nemusi weChitatu svondo rinouya uchinyunyuta nemabatirwo awunoti ari kuitwa gadziriro yesarudzo nekomisheni yezvesarudzo ye Zimbabwe Electoral Commission kana kuti ZEC. Mubatanidzwa uyu unoti ZEC haisi kubuda pachena panyaya yegwaro remazita evavhoti uye nyaya yekudhindwa nekuchengetedzwa kwemagwaro ekuvhotesa. Asi ZEC inoti iri kungozorwa mafuta enguruve yaisina kudya ichiti zvimwe zviri kudiwa nemapato anopikisahazvikwanisike. Munyori mukuru weMDC-T inotungamirirwa naVaNelson Chamisa VaGouglas Mwonzora, vanove zvakare munyori mukuru weMDC Alliance, vaudza Studio 7 kuti vachafora kubva kuAfrica Unity Square kuenda kumahofisi eZEC nekudzoka. Izvi zvatsinhirwawo nemunyori anoona nezvekurongwa kwemabasa muMDC-T VaAmos Chibaya avo vanoti chavari kungoda chete ndechekuti ZEC ivazivise kuti mapepa ekuvhotesa achadhindwa kupi uye achachengetedzwa kupi uye nani. VaChibaya vanoti hapana sarudzo dzinoitwa munyika kana pasina gwaro revavhoti rakachena uye pasina kugadziriswa nyaya yekuti mapepa ekuvhotesa achadhindwa nani. No media source currently available

headline: Malawi yapinda mu’Round of 16′
text: APO maWarriors ari kudzoka kumusha mushure mekuburitswa mumutambo weAFCON, zvimwe zvikwata zvainge zviri muboka rimwe chete nechikwata chenyika ichi reGroup B zvinoti Malawi, Guinea neSenegal zvose zvabudirira kuenda muRound of 16 yemakwikwi aya.   Malawi yabudirira kuenda muRound of 16 zvichitevera kukunda kwayakaita Zimbabwe apo yakahwina 2-1 nemusi weChishanu svondo radarika uye nekuita mangange 0-0 neSenegal mumutambo uyo yakapotsa nepadiki yahwina apo yakazonyimwa pena mushure mekupindira kweVideo Assistant Referee (VAR).   CAF yazivisa nezvekubudirira kweMalawi kuenda kuRound of 16 apo yanyora padandemutande rayo reTwitter ichiti, “Nhoroondo. Chikwata cheMalawi chabudirira kuenda ku#TotalEnergiesAFCON knockout stages kekutanga munhoroondo yacho. Izuva rakakosha zvikuru kunyika yose.”   MaWarriors – ayo akapedza ari pasi muboka rawo – ane zvibodzwa zvitatu uye ari kutarisirwa kusvika munyika achibva kuCameroon.

headline: VaMugabe Votaura paKutoreswa Mhiko kwaVaLungu vekuZambia
text: Mutungamiri wenyika yeZambia VaEdgar Lungu vakatoreswa mhiko nemusi weChipiri mushure mesarudzo dzakaitwa mwedzi wapera. VaLungu vakatora mhiko kunhandare yeHeroes Stadium muLusaka. Asi vemapato anopikisa vanoti sarudzo idzi dzakabirirwa uye VaLungu vaishandisa mhirizhonga. Valungu vanoti vari kuzorwa mafuta enguruve yavasina kudya. Mutungamiri wenyika VaRobert Mugabe ndevamwe vatungamiri venyika dzemuAfrica vashoma shoma vakange vari kuZambia. VaMugabe ndivo vakataura vakamirira vamwe vatungamiri venyika dzemuAfrica. VaMugabe vati nyika dzine hutongo hwejekerere hadzidi vanhu vanoda kushandisa mhirizhonga kutora masimba. Vakatiwo Zambia yainge yabuda pachena kuti sarudzo ndidzo dzinofanira kushandiswa munyaya dzezvematongerwo enyika. Nyanzvi munyaya dzezvematongerwo enyika kuMulungushi University of Zambia VaShakespeare Hamauswa vanoti mashoko aVaMugabe akatambirwa zvakasiyana muZambia vamwe vachiti vainge vabaya dede nemukanwa asi vamwe vachishora vachiti makudo ndemamwe zvikuru vachitarisa nyaya yemhirizhonga. headline: Sangano reCoomunity Working Group on Health Ropa Dzidziso Pamusoro peCovid-19
text: Mukuru wesangano reCoomunity Working Group on Health, VaItai Rusike, vanoti sangano ravo riri kushanda mumatunhu akawanda emunyika richidzidzisa vanoita zvehutano munharaunda pamwe vechidiki pamusoro pekudzivirirwa kwechirwere cheCovid-19, avo vanozodzidzisawo vamwe. Izvi zvinouya panguva iyo matunhu anoti Bulawayo, Matabeleland North neMatabeleland South ari kusangana nedambudziko rekukwira kwehuwandu hwevanhu vari kufa pamwe nekubatwa nechirwere kubva mwedzi wapera. VaRusike vanotiwo sangano ravo riri kushandawo mumatunhu anoti Manicaland, Masvingo neMidlands, uko vari kubatana nanambuya hutano mukupa dzidziso kuti veruzhinji vazive nzira dzekudzvirira kupararira kwedenda iri. Sangano reCommunity Working Group on Health riri kukwanisa kupinda mumaruwa kuburikidza nemabhasikoro arakapiwa nesangano reWorld Bicycle Relief. Asi vanoti kuti nyika ibudirire kudzivirira kupararira kwehutachiwana hunokonzera chirwere ichi, hurumende pamwe nemakanzuru zvinofanirwa kuona kuti vanhu vawaniswa mvura kayachena yekushandisa kugeza maoko pamwe nekuzvishambidza, uyewo vari kukurudzira veruzhinji kuti vachengetedze mitemo yakatarwa nebazi rezvehutano pamwe neWorld Health Organisation. Asi VaRusike vanoti kana hurumende yakazofunga kutora matanhu ekurambidza veruzhinji kufambafamba, haifanirwe kubva yavhara nyika yose sezvakamboitika pakutanga, sezvo vazhinji vevanhu munyika vachirarama nekuzviitira mabasa emaoko.
