headline: UManitz angalahlekelwa ngumsebenzi kwiBulls
text:
Kulindeleke utshintsho kakhulu eLoftus Versfeld nje- ngokuba ifikelele esiphelweni isizini yeSuper Rugby kumaqela amaninzi oMzantsi Afrika. 
Umqeqeshi weBulls kwiSuper Rugby, uNollis Marais nguye ozakuxhuzula imikhala engena endaweni kaHendre Manitz. 
UMarais bekulindeleke ukuba athathe ikhefu ekuqeqesheni xa iphelile iSuper Rugby, alungiselele unyaka ozayo kodwa akuzokuba njalo. 
Ngenxa yokungadlali kakuhle kweBulls, abaphathi beli qela bathathe isigqibo sokuba uMarais ibenguye ozakuqeqesha eli qela. Akukachazwa ukuba uMarnitz nabancedisi bakhe bazwakwenza de uphele lo nyaka. 
Ingqonyela yeBulls uBarend van Graan ukhethe ukuthi cwaka ngotshintsho elwenzekayo ngoku eLoftus kwaye akukho zimpendulo bazikhuphayo. 
IBulls ibonise ukuphucuka sele izakugqitywa imidlalo yokuza kwiCurrie Cup, kodwa abaphathi beli qela kuye kwacaca ukuba abonelisekanga yindlela eliqhube ngayo eli qela. 
 IBulls khange ikwazi ukuzibonakalisa amandla ayo xa bekudlalwa imidlalo yobukhaya yokulwela ukuza kwiCurrie Cup. Iphele le midlalo eli qela lihleli kwindawo yesixhenxe. Kudala kuvakala amazwi abantu abathile eLoftus nabathi kufike ixesha lokuba uMarais awaqeqeshe ngokwakhe omabini amaqela, eleCurrie Cup neSuper Rugby. 
Kukho inqwaba yabadlali ababalulekileyo abazakuhamba eLoftus ekupheleni konyaka baye kumazwe aphesheya. Kunyanzelekile uMarais anikwe ithuba lokuba ahlale nabadlali abaqhele, phambi kokuqala kwesizini entsha.

headline: Mabuyane: ‘Abantu baseMpuma Koloni bonke baphethe, abanye abafuni kukhokelwa’
text:
INKULUBAPHATHISWA uOscar Mabuyane uthi umsebenzi owenziwa ngurhulumente wephondo uyanconywa ngabantu abadala ephondweni, kodwa ukwaveze ukuba kukho ukubangelwa “komdintsi netyheneba” komsebenzi wabo ngabantu abakumaqonga onxibelelwano afana noFacebook noTwitter. 
Ebethetha ngentseni yangoLwesine kwinkqubo ebhexeshwa nguSiphiwo Magoda yoMhlobo Wenene FM ethi Umxholo kuMhlobo. 
“EMpuma Koloni yonke into iyathethisa. Abantu baseMpuma Koloni banento yokuthetha. Abantu baseMpuma Koloni bonke baphethe, bonke bakhokele. Abanye zizisalakuphathwa, abanye abafuni kukhokelwa. Lo ukhokeleyo bamdibela izigingqi. Abantu bayonyeliswa nangezinto ezingekhoyo,” utshilo uMabuyane. 
UMabuyane uthi kukho iqela labantu elihlala ligxeka umsebenzi karhulumente wephondo. 
“Ubomi babo kukuhlala begxeka, umntu akananto ayibonayo ebhetele. Ingathi akusetyenzwa, kodwa kube kukho abantu abangalaliyo njengokuba singalalanga ngoku sizama ukuthetha into enye, sibongoza ngelithi indlela yokuyoyisa le ntsholongwane kukuqinisekisa ukuba abantu abaphithizeli. 
“Bendisithi komnye umntu ebendithetha naye, ukuba iMpuma Koloni ibingakhange ivale amalwandle ngesikwimeko embi kakhulu ngoku xa ujonga indlela amanye amaphondo akuyo malunga nokukhula kolosuleleko [lweCovid-19]. 
“Into endomelezayo kuxa ndifika ezilalini kubantu abadala, kuthwe ‘mntwanam niyasebenza, siyayibona le nto niyenzayo, siyabulela’. Ilizwe eli linabantu ngabantu, bakhona abo ungasoze ubancede kodwa abanengxolo enkulu, abathi bayise kumakhasi onxibelelwano igqibe ihlabathi, nyhani nibonakale ninuka umzondo, banibangele umdintsi netyheneba,” utshilo uMabuyane.

headline: UTau usendleleni ebuyela kwiGenerations
text:
Umdlali oyindumasi kumdlalo iGenerations-The Legacy, uRapulana Seiphemo uyabuyela kwakhona emsebenzini.  
Eli gqala lomdlali kamabonakude, nelagaxeleka kwingozi emasikizi neyasuba imiphefumlo emithathu ngenyanga yoMdumba, kuthiwa lichacha kuhle. 
 Ngokutsho kompapashi weGenerations uGaaratwe Mokheti, uSeiphemo kulindeleke ukuba abuyele emsebenzini wakhe kwiiveki ezimbini ezizayo. “Unesivumelwano sengqesho nathi. Useyinxenye yosapho. Ingathi akasafiki,” utshilo. “Akakachachi ukufikelela kwinqanaba lika-100%, nanjengoko ezakuqhubekeka ethabatha amachiza akhe emsebenzini.”  
USeiphemo ubanga ngelithi, kubusuku bengozi, waqweqwediswa ngamadoda amabini ambonzeleka emotweni yakhe ngethuba esalindile kwiirobhothi. Kwingxelo yakhe efungelweyo yamapolisa, utyhola ngelithi, la madoda amnyanzelisa ukuba aqhube ukubhekisa kuhola wendlela uN14 osingise eMogale City.  
 USeiphemo ubanga ngelithi wawaxelela la madoda ukuba akasoze awavumele athabathe imoto yakhe, aze ambulale. “URapulana wonyusa umcephe wemoto, waze umtyholwa owayekwisitulo esingasemva wamemeza ngelithi makame, nanjengoko wayeqhuba ngamendu aphezulu, waze (uSeiphemo) wabaxelela ukuba kungcono bafe bonke endaweni yokuthabatha imoto yakhe, baze bambulale,” ifundeka olo hlobo ingxelo yamapolisa.  
“URapulana uthi, baqala ukulwa ngevili lokuqhuba de batshayisana nemoto emhlophe.” USeiphemo, nodlala indawo kaTau Mogale kwiGenerations, ufika kanye emva kweendaba zokulahla kukaConnie Ferguson (uKarabo Moroka-Mogale) oyinkosikazi yakhe kulo mdlalo.

headline: Ukhuselwa ngubani uMkhuseli woLuntu?
text:
Ininzi ke into eqhubeka pha phezulu kweli laseMzantsi Afrika. Asazi nokuba ngubani oleqa bani, emleqela ntoni, ngenxa kabani. Kodwa ecace gca yona yeyokuba ukhona lo mlo uliwayo. 
 Ewe, iANC yona iqhekekile, abangaphakathi bathi kudala kwaba njeya kodwa ke isisila senkukhu sibonwa mhla ligquthayo. Silapho ngoku. Kuyagqutha. Phakathi naphakathi kuso sonke esi siphithiphithi kukho noMkhuseli woLuntu, uBusisiwe Mkhwebane.  
Endaweni yokuphanda ukuxhatshazwa kwabantsundu kwiinkampani zabo babesakuba ngabacinezeli nokulandelela izikhalazo zoluntu, uqonde ukuba makahambe ayokuqala ngentloko yeli, uCyril Ramaphosa.  
Phofu ke nalapho ebeceliwe ukuba aphande emva kwamarhe obuqhophololo bemali yokugaya iivoti. Kubonakala ngathi umongameli weli uwuphumelele lowo umjikelo, kodwa ke kusafuneka exelele ipalamente ‘inyani’.  
Kwelinye icala kukho noMphathiswa wamaQumrhu kaRhulumente, uPravin Gordhan, othi uMkhuseli woLuntu ngomnye wabantu abahlakulela ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ubanjwe ngobhongwane ngoosomashishini abathile kweli.  
UGordhan ukutsho oku emva kokuba uMkhwebane ebhentsise, kwingxelo yakhe, ukuba uGordhan wayeyinxalenye yokusekwa kwecandelo labacuphi abangekho semthethweni pha kwaSARS ngo2007.  
Eyokuba ke lakhe lakhona eli candelo yenye yolunye nje usuku esaqhubayo nayo. Sibhala nje kukho ingxolo eninzi kumaqonga onxibelelwano ethi uMkhwebane makagxothwe, akafanelanga nokuba ukuluhlu lwabantu ekuthiwa ngamagqwetha kweli.  
Yena uMkhwebane ume kwelokuba wenza umsebenzi wakhe qha. Ayingomadoda nje la ajamelene nawo uMkhwebane; ngabantu abanamandla mpela kweli. Xa kunjalo iye ibe ngubani okhusela uMkhuseli woLuntu?  
Napha kwiNkundla yoMgaqosiseko ifane yaba nguMogoeng Mogoeng yedwa okwicala likaMkhwebane, ezinye iijaji ziyikhaba yonke lo nto. Kwakhona, siyabuza: ngubani okhusela uMkhuseli woLuntu xa kunje?  
Ngoba ngoku ubethwa ngemiqathango yokwenza izinto hayi ngokuba uthetha izinto ezingekhoyo ncam. Sakukhe siyibone le ukuba iya phi.

headline: IBaroka izenzela igama kwiNedbank Cup
text:
IPolokwane City ehleli kwindawo yeshumi elinesithathu kwiPremier Soccer League iza kufumana inkuthazo kumdlalo wayo wangoMgqibelo ophelileyo, emva kokubetha iChippa United. 
Eli qela libethe iChippa United ngegowuli elinye eqandeni kumdlalo wePSL. 
Abafana bakaJulo Leal bakwazile ukuzisusa ezembeni elijamelene namaqela ase msileni kwiPSL. NgeCawa iRise and Shine izakube ijamelene nelinye lamaqela asokolisa kakhulu, ingakumbi kukhuphiswano le ndebe, iBaroka FC. IBaroks ihleli kwindawo yokuqala kwiNational First Division, kwaye sele iyinikiwe intshinga yeNFD kule sizini. 
 IBaroka ayingomtshakazi kwiNedbank Cup. Bazenzele igama kolu khuphiswano ngokubetha iKaizer Chiefs neMoroka Swallows kwiminyaka embalwa edlulileyo. Ukuze bazibone bekule ndawo bakuyo baqale ngokubhuqa iChippa United ngamagowuli amathathu kwamabini, kumjikelo wokuqala. Okwesibini iBaroka ishiye uninzi lubambe ongezantsi xa ibetha iGolden Arrows ngamagowuli amabini kwelinye.  
Uxinizelelo olwenzeka kwiNFD mhlawumbi lungayiphazamisa iBaroka. Babethwe okwesithathu ngoMgqibelo kwiNFD xa besothuswa yiVasco Da Gama ngamagowuli amane kwelinye. Amandla abo aleli kwifolosi uThabiso Kutumela. 
 Omnye umdlalo ozakunika umdla kwiNedbank ngumdlalo phakathi kweFree State Stars neBidvest Wits, ngoMgqibelo. IStars ibambe iWits ngeqanda macala kumdlalo weveki ephelileyo, eBidvest Stadium, nto leto ithe yaphazamisa umzamo weWits wokuvala isikhewu phakathi kwayo neMamelodi Sundowns ehleli kwindawo yokuqala kwiPSL.

headline: Iyaphokoka imiyalezo yovelwano emva kokusweleka kukaMfundisi Stofile
text:
IYAPHOKOKA imiyalezo yovelwano ejoliswe kusapho lakwaStofile emva kokusweleka kwegqala lomzabalazo wenkululeko yeli uMfundisi Makhenkesi Stofile. UStofile usweleke ngentseni yanamhlanje, akukabikho lwazi lithe vetshe ngokusweleka kwakhe.  
Inkulumbuso yeMpuma Koloni uPhumulo Masualle umchaze okaStofile ngelithi, “Obezinikele ekusebenzeleni uluntu, ukususela ngexesha awathi wazibandakanya nomzabalazo wenkululeko eselula.” Nomongameli weli uJacob Zuma, ugxwale emswaneni, emchaza okaStofile njengomntu obezinikele kwinkonzo yoluntu, kungekho luxanduva alijongele phantsi. Emva kokuzibandakanya kwakhe nomzabalazo wenkululeko yeli, kwanokuvunyelwa kwemibutho yopolitiko yabantsundu kweli uStofile ubambe izikhundla eziliqela kumbutho weANC nakwinkonzo yoluntu.  
Wabekwa njengenkulumbuso yephondo leMpuma Koloni ukususela ngonyaka ka1999 ukuya ku2004. Emva koko wayishiya ipolitiki yephondo, wayinxalenye yabathunywa beliphondo beANC ePalamente kazwelonke, nalapho watyunjwa njengomphathiswa wezemidlalo kweli loMzantsi Afrika ukusuela ngo2004 ukuya ku 2010. OkaStofile ube ngunozakuzaku weli kwelase Jamani emva kokushiya isebe lezemidlalo. Ebutsheni balonyaka ubekwe njengentloko yeYunivesithi yaseFort Hare. Nemibutho yezemidlalo kweli equka iSARU ithumele imiyalezo yokugcwala emswaneni, neyovelwano kusapho lwakhe, nakumbutho kaKhongolose emva kokuba ethe walishiya eli.

headline: Ziyaqosheliswa iingxoxo ngowona mvuzo uphantsi kubasebenzi
text:
AMAQELA abandakanyeka kwiingxoxo ngowona mvuzo uphantsi athi akufutshane kwisisombululo, emva kokungaboni ngasonye. Amaqela abandakanyekayo kwiNEDLAC – aquka urhulumente, iimanyano zabasebenzi, imibutho yasekuhlaleni kwakunye neyezoshishino – atyumbe iingcaphephe nezizakuhlola indlela ezakumiliselwa ngayo imivuzo. Iingxoxo ngowona mvuzo uphantsi ziqale kwiminyaka emibini edlulileyo, kwaye zithathe ixesha phambi kokuba kubekho isivumelwano ngenxa yamagingxigingxi avele ngethuba lezingxoxo. Abamele abasebenzi kwakunye nemibutho yasekuhlaleni bakhe bagrogrisa ngelithi bazakubamba uqhankqalazo ukuba akukho ntshukumo iya phambili kwezingxoxo. Imifela-ndawonye yeemanyano zabasebenzi ebandakanyekayo kwezingxoxo iCOSATU kwakunye neFEDUSA ithe iyakuvuyela ukutyunjwa kweengcaphephe nezizakunika ingxelo equlunqiweyo kwiintsuku ezingamashumi asixhenxe. I-NEDLAC ineqela labaphandi engakhetha kubo, kuquka iiyunivesithi eziliqela kweli kwakunye neminye imibutho ephanda iindlela zokusebenza kweli. Ingxelo ekhutshe yiNEDLAC ihambisa ithi, “Onke amaqela abandakanyekayo ayavumelana ngelithi ukutyunjwa kwezingcaphephe linyathelo eliya phambili, lokuhlola liphonononge iziphumo zokumiliselwa kwalo mvuzo.” Isithethi seCOSATU uSizwe Pamla uthe eli linyathelo eliya phambili nelilangazelelwa yilemanyano. “Bakwazile ukuqhawula amatyathanga phakathi kwabezoshishino nabasebenzi.” Nangona kunjalo iFEDUSA ithi isivumelwano ngowona mvuzo uphantsi yinto enobuzaza nenganeziphumo ezibi kwingqesho. Abezoshishino sebelumkise ngelithi ukusungulwa komvuzo ophantsi kungabeka imisebenzi emininzi emngciphekisweni, kwilizwe esele lithwaxwa yintswela ngeqsho. Noxa kunjalo uphando oluqhutyiweyo ngalo mba aliboni bungqina boko. UDennis George weFEDUSA uthi ukubekwa kwemihlambi eyalanayo kwiingxoxo ngomvuzo ophantsi, ziwasondeze ndawonye la maqela.  
“Into eyinkuthazo kukuba sonke sikhangela isisombululo sokunciphisa intlupheko yoluntu, nokunciphisa umsantsa wokungalingani ngemivuzo. Kodwa kufanele silumke singayibeki phezulu kakhulu imivuzo, kuba oko kungakhokelela ekulahlekeni kwemisebenzi,” utshilo uGeorge. Kuvakala ukuba inani lowona mvuzo libekwa phakathi kweR3 500 yamawaka eerandi ukuya kumawaka amahlanu eerandi (R5 000).  
Xa kuthe kwafikelelwa kwesi sivumelwano, elinyathelo liyakubuyela ePalamente nezakuwisa umthetho ogunyazisa ixesha ongaqala ngalo ukusebenza lo mvuzo.

headline: Ndlela-ntle Masebotsana!
text:
UMasebotsana sele emkile na? Zingqinile iindaba zokumka kukaMasebotsana kumdlalo ka-SABC2 uMuvhango. 
Akukudala, * ’solezwe lesiXhosa lisamkela uLerato Kganyago kulo mdlalo uyintandane kumabonakude, kodwa ngoku kubonakala ngathi sele eqokelele imithwalana yakhe ephuma ngomnyango. 
Lo saziwayo kumabonakude nonomathotholo ushiya abalandeli bakhe benyembezana xa bekubonakala ngoLwesihlanu ukuba uKganyago ngokwenene uyawushiya uMuvhango, kwaye akabuyi. 
UKganyago uthi ukuwufulathela kwakhe lo mdlalo kukuzinika ixesha eloneleyo losapho lwakhe nezinye izinto. Akukabikho zwi lokuba le nzwakazi iyakubuya kwakho ngenye imini kulo mdlalo kwisini na. 
Ukanti bekusandul’ukuvela iingxelo zokuba uKganyago lo, ekunye noPearl Thusi bazokungena ezihlangwini zikaBonang Matheba njengabasasazi benkqubo entsha kamabonakude wamazwe. 
UKganyago ususe uQueen B njengomsasazi omtsha wenkqubo ethi “Moments South Africa”, neyinxenye yenkqubo yencoko yaseNigeria ethi “Moments with Mo.” 
Le nkqubo iza kuboniswa kumabonakude i-Ebony Life TV jikelele kumazwe akwilizwekazi le-Afrika afana neNigeria, iGhana kunye neKenya.

headline: Iintshatsheli zaseTsomo zinqwenela ukuya kwiSasol League!
text:
Kunzima ukwakha iqela lebhola ekhatywayo lamanenekazi. Kunzima ngakumbi xa ulakha ezilalini ngoba kunqabe kwa iindawo zokudlalela futhi kube nzima nokufumana abadlali ngenxa yemo yentlalo yale mihla. Amanenekazi afana noNomakhwezi Dlali atyhala ngesifuba enethemba lokuguquka kwezinto ngenye imini. Nangona iTsomo iyidolophi encinci ingenawo namabala asemgangathweni – kodwa ityebile kwezemidlalo kakhulu. Umdla wabantu abatsha emidlalweni entlobontlobo iyamangalisa. Kwiveki ephelileyo, ulutsha belubuthelene kwindawo ekuthiwa yiTsomo Mission – apho bekubanjelwe khona itumente yamanenekazi adlala ibhola ekhatywayo. Amaqela athathe inxaxheba ngala: yiKhwezi Ladies, iVutha Ladies, iFuture Stars nePioneer Ladies. 
Emidlalweni yokuqala, iKhwezi FC ibethe iVutha FC kumapenela ngo’3-1 emva kokubambana ngo’1-1 emdlalweni. Yona iFuture Stars ivuthulule iPioneer ngo’6-0 emdlalweni wesibini. Emdlalweni wokutshayelela owokugqibela, iVutha FC ibethe iPioneer ngo’1-0. Kungene oompondozihlanjiwe kowokusonga usuku olubalulekileyo ngumdlalo omhle obuphakathi kweKhwezi FC neFuture Stars. Emva kokuswantsulisana emdlalweni wokugqibela weTsomo Ladies Tournament, iKhwezi iphakamise indebe emva kokubetha iFuture Stars ngo’3-1. Amagowuli ephumelele ngawo iKhwezi afakwe nguBoni Thandikazi noSimi Mhlali. Ibikokwesibini iKhwezi ithatha indebe kwitumente yaseTsomo edinga inkxaso koosomashishini. 
Ethetha neli phephandaba, uNomakhwezi Dlali, uvakalise uchulumanco olukhulu – kodwa wayiveza indlela ekunzima ngayo kubo manenekazi anomdla ebholeni ekhatywayo. “Ngaphandle kokusokola ukuqokelela abadlali nokuswela kwabo izihlangu zokudlala, ndingatsho ndithi ndonwabile. Iqela lam liyathembisa noko. Kokwesibini siphumelela indebe yale tumente futhi ndingatsho ukuba ikamva labadlali bam liqaqambile. Impumelelo iza kubakhuthaza abadlali ngoba eyona nto esiyifunayo kukuba badlale kwiSasol League. Okwangoku badlala kwiChris Hani District nangona iinengxaki zayo,” utshilo uDlali oqeqesha iKhwezi FC.

headline: Zikwimeko embi iintsana ezitye iipilisi
text:
Ngabantwana abathathu abaphakathi kweminyaka emibini ukuya kwemihlanu bezelwe abakwimeko emaxhongo esibhedlele emva kokuba betye iipilisi ezingaziwayo ukuba zezantoni KwaMashu kumazantsi eTheku.  
Othethela abezohlangulo KwaZulu Natal uRobert McKenzie uthi baqale ngokuzinyanga ezi ntsana ngoncedo lokuqala kwindawo leyo yexhwayelo, phambi kokubasa esibhedlele. 
UMcKenzie ulumkise abazali ekwababongoza ukuba amayeza neepilisi mayingabizozinto ezisekuhleni ebantwaneni kuba zinobungozi.  
Uthi, abazali mababafundise abantwana ngobungozi bokutya ipilisi.

headline: UVergil Vries uncede Amakhosi emdlalweni weTelkom Knockom
text:
Amakhosi adlulela kumjikelo olandelayo weTelkom Knockout emva kokubetha iBlack Leopards ngo’4-2 kumapenela kumdlalo ophele ngo’1-1 otsale imizuzu engaphaya kwamashumi alithoba emizuzu eFNB Stadium ngale njikalanga yanamahlanje. Unozinti weKaizer Chiefs, uVergil Vries uzibonakalisile ukuba kungathenjelelwa kuye xeshikweni evala amapenela amabini weLeopards. Umqeqeshi weChiefs, uGiovanni Solinas, ukhethe ukuqala umdlalo ngabadlali abafana nooVeries, uErick Mathoho, uHendrick Ekstein noPhilani Zulu. Abadlali abaliqela bonzakele – kodwa abanye babekelwe umdlalo omkhulu kwiveki ezayo. Emva kokudlala umdlalo ophucukileyo kwisiqingatha sokuqala – iBlack Leopards ayikwazanga ukusebenzisa amathuba ewafumeneyo ukuze isonge umdlalo iChiefs ibhidekile. Abuyile kekambe Amakhosi kwisigaba sesibini futhi ukudlala kwawo kakuhle kuye kwabonakala ngegowuli elifakwe ngu-Ekstein. 
Isiqingatha sokuqala siphele iBlack Leopards inkqenkqeza phambili ngegowuli elinye elifakwe nguPhathutshedzo Nange kumzuzu wamashumi amathathu anesithathu. Umdlalo uqale ngezinga eliphezulu. Kwakumzuzu wokuqala, uMwape Musonda ufumene ibhola ephakathi kwabadlali basemva beChiefs – kodwa kuye kwanceda uVergil Vries uye waphuma epalini wayoxutha ezinyaweni ibhola. Amakhosi ngawo abenebhola emdlalweni – kodwa yiLeopards ebisenza into ecacileyo ngebhola xa iphethwe ngabadlali bayo. UBernard Parker ugobe ibhola entle esenxele; khange kubekho mntu wokubeka emnatheni lo bhola. UHendrick Ekstein ukhethe ukuziyela endaweni yokunikela ugxa wakhe – ithuba lokubhalisa ebhodini liphelele emoyeni. Isicwangciso seBlack Leopards sokufumana igowuli kuqala sisebenzile – kodwa umsebenzi wayo wenziwe lula ngabadlali beChiefs abadlale into engacacanga. 
Amakhosi abuye enyuse iikawusi emva kwexesha lokuphumla. Abadlali baquqe bebuyelela kumhlaba weBlack Leopards – kodwa iinzame zikaParker noBoyseen aziphumelelanga kwimizuzu yokuqala kwisigab sesibini somdlalo. Kumzuzu wamashumi amathandathu iChiefs ibuwulawula ngokupheleleyo umdlalo; qha ingxaki ebenayo kukungakwazi ukugqobhoza udonga leLeopards emva. Kumzuzu wamashumi amathandathu anesibini, uHendrick Ekstein ufake igowuli lokulinganisa. Igowuli lize emva kokuba uGiovanni Solinas ekhuphe  uGustavo Paez noPhilani Zulu. Iindawo zabo zithathwe nguRyan Moon noKabelo Mahlasela. UJoel Masutha ufake iTumelo Kutlang endawo kaJoseph Mhlongo. Ibhola ebintle ikhatywe nguMusonda ibethwe ngenqindi nguVries emva komdlalo omhle weLeopards. Kuyiwe kwixesha elongezelelweyo emva kokuba kuphele amashumi alithoba emizuzu kungeko qela eliphumeleleyo. 
Kaizer Chiefs: Vries, Mphahlele, Mathoho, Booysen, Walusimbi, Ekstein, Katsande, Ntshangase, Zulu, Parker, Páez. 
Amalalela: Khune, Cardoso, Ntiya-Ntiya, Maluleka, Jayiya, Moon, Mahlasela.

headline: #NAF: Intlungu ngokuxhatshazwa kwabantwana
text:
UMBONISO weqonga ovangwe sisiqhazolo kodwa ube ubeka elubala intlungu yokubiwa kwabantwana eMzantsi Afrika, bethengiswa okanye babulawe, ushiye uninzi luchiphichiphiza kwiHolo leSixeko saseMakhanda. 
Lo mdlalo othi Bhuti is the Beast, uvula amehlo ngokuxhatshazwa kwabantwana kwiindawo esihlala kuzo, benukunezwa ngabo babaziyo nababathembayo. 
Iindaba zendoda egqugqisayo ekuhlaleni ebizwa iBeast zikhawuleza zithi ndi ekuhlaleni. Abazali nabantwana abasexhaleni babiza intlanganiso nosodolophu wesixeko, ekubonakalayo ukuba unkone bubuqhophololo nokunyoluka kwaye nekucaca phandle ukuba akanalo kwaxesha lakuphulaphula isikhalo sabahlali, kwelinye icala ngoongantweni bamapolisa, abefundisi bobuxoki kuquka namagqirha omgunyathi nabashiya kungekho mpendulo nechiza lale nkohlakalo. 
Bakumashumi amahlanu abantwana belokishi yaseWalmer eGqeberha abebemane betshintsha iimpahla kwiziqendu ezininzi zeli bali, bezama ukuzoba umfanekiso nobunkenenkene bemeko yokubiwa kwabantwana. 
Italente yokucula, ukudanisa nokulinganisa kwaba bantwana ishiye wonke ubani eqhwaba izandla. 
Eli bali lingentsomi yemoto eba abantwana libhalwe laze laphononongwa nguXabiso Zweni okhulele kule lokishi yaseWalmer. 
Kunyaka ophelileyo uZweni, ebeze nomdlalo othi So What Sarafina kulo Mnyhadala wezoBugcisa ekwasebenzisa abantwana bakhe beMasifunde Academy. 
IMasifunde iqeqesha abantwana abangaphaya kwama200 eGqeberha kwizakhono ezokuhlekeneyo zobugcisa. 
Emculweni nguSivuyile Scott Msizi, kwezomdaniso nguSibabalwe Ngewu, encediswa nguManoah Sonwabo noBanele Njadayi kwicala lempahla yeqonga.

headline: Ufuna abadlali abaqhelileyo * -Owen Da Gama
text:
Umqeqeshi weqela lesizwe lebhola ekhatywayo, * -Owen Da Gama, ugxekwe kakhulu izolo ngabantu abaninzi emva kokuvakala kweendaba ezithi ufuna ukusebenzisa ihlokondiba labadlali abadala kakhulu kwimidlalo ye-Olimpiki ezakube iseBrazil ekuthambekeni kwalo nyaka. 
 UMzantsi Afrika uthelekiswe neBrazil, i-Iraq neDenmark kuGroup A kumsitho obungoLwesine weveki ephelileyo. Umdlalo we-Under 23 neBrazil yimpinda yomdlalo wobuhlobo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini emva kwalowo obuhlobo owaphunyelelwa  
yiBrazil ngo’3-1 kutshanje. Nangona engalikhuphanga latsola uDa Gama, kodwa intetho yakhe ithi, uMzantsi Afrika awunalo ithuba lokudlulela kumjikelo olandelayo kwi-Olimpiki. “Ndicinga ukuba nokuba asihambeli phambili kangako, kodwa kufanele sisebenzise abadlali abanamava ukuze bazenzele igama. Ndiqinisekile uxinizelelo lukwiBrazil, kwaye ukuba singaphuncuka kula midlalo kungafakwanga magowuli kuthi singaya phambili.  
Umcelimngeni esijongene nawo sizimisele ukuwusebenzisa ibeliqonga lokusuka italente yabadlali esinabo,” utsho uDa Gama.Iingxelo zithi umqeqeshi weli qela unoluhlu lwamagama abadlali abangaphantsi kwamashumi amabini anesithathu oluquka abadlali abafana noSurprise Moriri, uNhlapo noMpontshane. Okunxakamisa abalandeli kukuba abanye babadlali abafunayo uDa Gama abadlali kwakumaqela abo.  
Uninzi luthi endaweni yokufaka abadlali abadala kufanele anike ithuba abadlali abazakudlalela iBafana Bafana kwixesha elizayo. “Kufuneka ndisebenze nabadlali endibaqhelileyo. 
 Ndizakuba nentlanganiso nengqonyela yeSAFA, uDennis Mumble, esizakubona kuyo ukuba asinokwazi na ukufumana abadlali abathile kumaqela aphesheya abanje ngo-Andile Jali,” ucatshulwe esitsho uDa Gama. 
Le tumente ye-Olimpiki ivumela iqela lesizwe ngasinye lifake abadlali abathathu abaneminyaka engaphezulu kwama-23

headline: ‘Lungelani ukumngcwabela eKapa, oswelekele eKapa’
text:
INKULUBAPHATHISWA uOscar Mabuyane uthi uluntu maluyithathe intsholongwane yeKhorona njengexesha lemfazwe, luguqule indlela yokwenza izinto. 
UMabuyane ulumkise ngelithi amanani wabo bosuleleke yintsholongwane yeKhorona aseza kunyuka ngenxa yesicwangciso abanaso sokuhlola abantu. 
“Sisesenyeleni, umcimbi uza kuba shushu njengoko ziqengqeleka iinyanga. Hlala endlini, ukhusele usapho lwakho,” utshilo uMabuyane. 
UMabuyane uthi abantu abanale ntsholongwane eKapa bayayichaphazela iMpuma Koloni. 
“Ukonyuka kwamanani entsholongwane yeKhorona eNtshona Koloni kusenza inkxalabo kuba abo bantu banoqhakamshelwano neMpuma Koloni. Zonke iimpelaveki kukho abantu abasuka eNtshona Koloni bezokungcwaba.” 
Lo kaMabuyane ukhuthaza uluntu ukuba lulithathe njengexesha lemfazwe eli xesha. 
“Emfazweni akukho joni libuzayo ukuba lingcwatyelwa phi. Yiyo le nto sisithi ngoku abantu mabalungele ukungcwaba eKapa xa umntu ebhubhele eKapa, mabalungele ukungcwaba naseRhawutini xa umntu ebhubhele eRhawutini. 
“Masiguqule indlela yokwenza izinto, kuba imeko iyasinyanzelisa. Abantu mabalungele noqhusheka nje umzimba, umngcwabo ubuye wenziwe,” kutsho uMabuyane. 
INkulubaphathiswa ikwamemelele kubafana basezilalini abomba amangcwaba ukuba balandele imiqathango yokuzikhusela. 
“OoMasipala bethu sithi mabasondele abo bakufutshane, bancedise ekombeni. Kodwa ke siyaqonda ukuba zikude kunedolophu ezinye iilali.  
Xa kunjalo ke sikhuthaza abafana abomba amangcwaba ukuba umntu aziphathele iiglavu zakhe futhi kuhlanjwe izandla rhoqo, xa umfana egqiba komba.” 
UMabuyane ukwathe okwangoku iphondo lineebhedi ezingamawaka amabini (2 000) zokujongana nabo banentsholongwane yeKhorona. Iphondo lifuna iibhedi ezingamawaka asibhozo (8 000) ukuqubisana nomthamo wabo banentsholongwane yeKhorona xa amanani esonyuka. 
“UVolkswagen uyasincedisa nanjengoko kwisibhedlele sethutyana esigxunyekwa eNelson Mandela Bay Stadium apho kuza kube kukho iibhedi ezingamawaka amane (4 000).” 
UMphathiswa wezeMpilo ephondweni uSindiswa Gomba uthe: “Sithathe isigqibo sokuba izigulana zityelelwe kanye ngosuku imizuzu elishumi elinesihlanu futhi abantu bangaphatheli izihlobo ukutya okuphekiweyo, baphathe okugqunyiweyo.”

headline: UCoetzee uqukiwe kwiqela leCaf
text:
Emva kwexesha elide ekhonkxwe kukonzakala, kubonakala ngathi uRivaldo Coetzee angabuyela ebaleni nangawuphi na umzuzu.  
Lo mdlali weBafana Bafana uqukiwe yiMamelodi Sundowns kuluhlu lwabadlali abaza kudlala imidlalo yeCaf Champions League eqale kule veki.  
UCoetzee wathengwa yiSundowns kunyaka ophelileyo – kodwa ngelishwa zange akwazi ukuyidlalela ngenxa yokwenzakala okwamphosanisa nethuba lokudlala eYurophu.  
Kukhangeleka ngathi uCoetzee ukulungele ukubuyela kwibhola yePSL emva kokudlala kwiMultiChoice Diski Challenge.

headline: Abahlali bazisikela iziza ngenkani!
text:
Abahlali baseZimbane Valley eMthatha bathi abazukubukela umasipala ezithathela umhlaba wabo ngokungekho mthethweni.  
Oku kulandela inyathelo labahlali abasondele ekhulwini lokuzisikela amanxiwa ngenkani kule mpela veki. Ngethuba intatheli yeli phepha ndaba, Isolezwe – igaleleka kule ndawo ekufuphi nerenki yezithuthi eZimbane Valley, abahlali bebezidaphela kulo mhlaba logama itele – tele ibinyuka isihla icanda amanxiwa olutsha lwale ndawo. 
Inkokheli yabahlali uRodgers Zwakala, uthi emveni kweengxelo zokuba umasipala uwuthengisile lo mhlaba, kwaye omnye kuzokwakhiwa kuwo izindlu zikarhulumente, bavumelene ekubeni bacandele ulutsha amanxiwa.  
“Abantwana bethu abaphangeli, abanamanxiwa, kwaye xa umasipala enikezela ngezindlu zikarhulumente abaxhamli. Asizukuhlala sibukele sithathe isigqibo sokuwasika kumhlaba wethu. Asibangisani namntu,” utshilo uZwakala. 
Ukwathi ukusuka namhlanje [uMvulo] ulutsha luzokwakha izindlu zalo kula manxiwa amatsha.  
“Sinolwazi ukuba umba webango lomhlaba usenkundleni yamatyala kodwa umasipala uyaqhuba nokwenza unothanda kulo mhlaba engakhathaleli nenkosi yethu,” kucacisa le nkokeli. 
Ngokwengxelo yabahlali, inkosi yelali uNkosikazi Nosizwe Maxhwele, ubefikile wathetha nabo ngoMgqibelo ezokusabela ngenjongo yokuzisikela amanxiwa. Unike umyalelo wokuba kuthiwe xha ngeli nyathelo nanjengoko ibango lomhlaba lisaqhuba enkundleni yamatyala aphakamileyo. 
Omnye wabantu abatsha abasikelwe amanxiwa kule ndawo, noneminyaka engamashumi amathathu anesithandathu ubudala uthe:  
“Kudala silinde ithuba lokusikelwa amanxiwa, siyavuya abazali bethu besisikela amanxiwa. Abantu abanikwa izindlu zikarhulumente ayingobantu balapha eZimbane ngabezinye iindawo. Asiphangeli kodwa sizokwazi ukuzakhela imizi yethu.” 
Inkosi yaseZimbane, uMaxhwele uthe: “Mna njengenkosi andinalwazi ngocando lwamanxiwa ngabahlali. Lo mhlaba kucandwa kuwo asikawunikwa yinkundla ngokwebango lomhlaba. Ndiyile phaya ngoMgqibelo ndiyokusabela, kodwa ndaxelelwa ukuba kunqandwa umasipala ozakuthatha lo mhlaba akhe izindlu zikarhulumente” 
UMasipala weKing Sabata Dalindyebo (KSD) uligxekile inyathelo labahlali ngelithi oku kubambezela inkqubo yophuhliso, kwaye wonke umntu ofuna inxiwa makatyelele umasipala angazithatheli umhlaba.

headline: UMzwakhe  Mbuli kumdlalo ‘Isibaya’
text:
Imbongi eyaziwayo kweli, uMzwakhe Mbuli, uzifumanele indima kumdlalo kamabonakude ‘Isibaya’.  
Indima kaMbuli kulo mdlalo ngeyomphathi weeteksi othathe umhlala-phantsi, noqhuba ishishini lesilarha kufutshane naseBergville, kwaBulawayo.  
UEmmah Ngomane ongumpapashi kwiMzansi Magic, uzingqinile ezi ndaba, esitsho esithi “lo kaMbuli ungena njengomnye welungu losapho olutsha lakwaNgwenya”. Kolu luhlu lutsha luquka uMenzi Ngubane, Thuli Thabethe, Abdul Khoza noLinda Mtoba ngenyanga kaCanzibe.  
UMbuli uzakudlala indima kaNgonyama Ngwenya, umkhuluwa kaJudas, nozakudlalwa nguMenzi Ngubane. Kuvakala ukuba uMbuli uzakuman’esithi tshe kwiziqendu ezimbalwa kule sizini intsha yalo mdlalo.  
“Sichulumancile ukuba iPeople’s Poet izibandakanya neSibaya okwexeshana, siyakholwa ukuba uzakuza nomfutho kweli bali,” utshilo uNondumiso Mabece oyintloko yopapasho yolonwabo kweli jelo. 
 U-Abdul Khoza, kulindeleke ukuba adlale umtshana kaMbuli kweli bali.

headline: UMsinga weSithathu ephondweni kwanosuleleko labagonyiweyo
text:
IPHONDO leMpuma Koloni liza kube likuMsinga weSithathu (Third Wave) wolosuleleko lweCovid-19 kwezi veki zimbini zizayo ukuba akukho tshintsho kwinani eliphezulu lolosuleleko lwabantu yile ntsholongwane. 
Noxa kunjalo, yona ingingqi yaseNelson Mandela Bay sele idizwe njengeyona ngingqi esele ikuMsinga weSithathu wololuseleleko lweCovid-19. 
Oku kuthethwe nguMphathiswa wezeMpilo ephondweni, uNomakhosazana Meth, eMthatha kule veki ngethuba ebebambe inkomfa noonondaba. 
“Iyaxhalabisa iNelson Mandela Bay, kuba nangexesha loMsinga wokuQala noweSibini, yayiyiyo eyayiphala phambili. Iinzululwazi zifumanise ukuba intlalubela yeDelta eNelson Mandela Bay naseSarah Baartman. 
“Le ntlalubela yeDelta iyaxhalabisa kuba ibangela ukuba abantu baye ezibhedlele,” utshilo uMeth. 
UMeth uthi bakwafumene iingxelo zokuba amagosa abo ezempilo eNelson Mandela Bay ayosoluleleka yiCovid-19 nangona nje sele egonyile. “Okuhle kukuba nangona nje esosuleleka, ubani xa egonyile akade asiwe esibhedlele okanye asweleke ngenxa yale ntsholongwane”. 
Ukuqinisa inkqubo yogonyo, uMeth uthi iphondo lineziza ezingama-774 ukuqinisekisa abantu abaselungelweni bayagonywa. “Siyabavumela abantu abaselungelweni ukuba bangqawuze baye kumaziko ogonyo, kodwa bayazi ukuba abona baza kuthatyathelwa ingqalelo ngabo babhalisileyo,” utshilo uMeth. 
Kwiphulo lokugonya abantu abangama-30 000 ngosuku ephondweni, uMeth uthi baseke intsebenziswano nequmrhu iSASSA kwanenkampani uClicks kuquka neevenkile uRhino, Boxer noShoprite – ukuze kugonywe abantu abatyelela la maziko ngeenjongo zokuya kufumana imali yendodla. 
NgoLwesibini iphondo besele ligonye abantu abangama-386 605. Injongo kukugonya abantu abakwizigidi ezine nangaphaya ukuze iphondo lifikelele kwinkcochoyi yengqiniseko yokuba uninzi lwephondo lugonyile. 
UMeth ukwabhengeze ukuba abantu abaneminyaka engamashumi amane nangaphaya baza kuqala ukubhalisela ugonyo kwinyanga ezayo.

headline: Axhaswe ngeetoni zelusini amafama athwaxwa yimbalela
text:
ISebe loPhuhliso loLuntu kwanezoLimo eMpuma Koloni likhuphe iitoni eziliqela zelusini ukuncedisana namafama athwaxwa yimbalela kwimimandla yaseMpuma Koloni. 
Indawo ezithe zafumana inkxaso kule veki yiAdelaide, Dikeni neRhafu, itshilo ingxelo yesebe. 
Kwindawo yaseAdelaide kukhutshwe iitoni ezingamashumi amathathu anesibini zelusini ukunceda amafama kwimbalela ethathe ixesha elide kula ndawo. 
 EDikeni amafama anikwe iitoni ezingamashumi amathathu zelusini. 
Kwindawo yaseRhafu amafama anikwe iingxowa (50kg) zombon’ obomvu ezingamakhulu amathandathu aneshumi kwanelusini ekwiwaka elinamakhulu amathathu anamashumi asixhenxe anesithandathu, logama eNieu-Bethasda, kude kufuphi naseRhafu, ithe yanikwa amabhali welusini akumakhulu amahlanu aneshumi elinesibini kwaneengxowa zombon’ obomvu ezikumakhulu amabini anamashumi amathathu anesihlanu. 
Kwakhona, iitoni ezingamashumi amabini anesihlanu zelusini zinikwe amafama waseQonce. 
Amafama athe axhamla kolu ncedo lukarhulumente ngalawo wasezilalini, lawo akhasayo kwanalowo angoongxowankulu. 
Kusenjalo, obesakuba yinkokheli yeANC Youth League eMpuma Koloni, uAyanda Matiti, ongumthelekisi wamanqindi kwanomfama, ubhale kuFacebook wakhe ngoMvulo ekhalazela ukungahoywa kwamafama ngokwenkxaso esuka kurhulumente. 
UMatiti, efake umfanekiso wegusha nebhokhwe ezibulewe yimbalela, uthi bazifaka izicelo zoncedo kwiinyanga eziliqela kodwa nkqi uncedo. 
“Kufuneka kufe zibe ngaphi phambi kokuba [kumanyelwe isikhalo sethu]. Sifuna amanzi kwanoncedo olufana nelusini ukuze kusinde imfuyo yethu,” utshilo uMatiti, ongumfuyi eBuffalo City.

headline: UZuko SA wenza amahololo emculweni
text:
“Hamba ngala mandl’ endikunike wona, qhawe lam, mntan’ am! Uzungafun’ ukufana nabanye ngoba izinto zakho ziding’ idolo, zonke mntanam! ” 
Ukuba ungumthandi womdlalo iThe Wife, oboniswa kwiShowmax uya kuyazi le ngoma. Yingoma enomthandazo nenkuthazo yokuvuselel’ ithemba. KwiThe Wife, le ngoma ihlala isitsho njalo xa kukho okungahambi kakuhle ebomini bomlinganiswa. 
Iculwa ngesingqi esimnandi esincamis’ umxhelo seAfroSoul. Iphakathi kweengoma ezimnandi ezikwicwecwe elitsha likaZuko Kupiso elithi No One Is Safe. 
UKupiso, owaziwa njengoZuko SA, uzalelwe eNgcingwane eDutywa. Le ikwayilali elikhaya kuMongameli Thabo Mbeki. 
Esengumfundi eKhanyisa High eMthatha, kulapho uKupiso wafikelwa khona lubizo lomculo. 
“Umculo ndawuqala phaya, ukuma phambi kwabantu ndikufundiswe phaya,” kutsho uKupiso encokolela I’solezwe lesiXhosa. 
Oku kwanyanzela uKupiso, 26, ayokufundela umculo eRhawutini ngo2018.  Akungazigqibi ezo zifundo zomculo ngenxa yeemeko zemali, waye wakhupha ingoma yakhe yokuqala ethi ‘Best In Me’ athi yadlala koonomathotholo nomabonakude. 
Le mvumi ithi xa sele iqokelele imali eyaneleyo iya kubuyela esikolweni kwakhona, iyokugqibezela izifundo zayo zeSound Engineering. 
“Kudala ndawuthanda umculo, kodwa kwaye kwafuneka ndigqibe uGrade 12 phambi kokuba ndilandele umculo,” itshilo. 
Icwecwe lakhe elithi No One Is Safe lineengoma ezifana noEgumbini, Ityala Lam, Ixesha Lam noQhawe Lam. 
Ebalisa ngale ngoma ithandwa ngumntu wonke ethi Qhawe Lam. 
“UQhawe Lam yingoma endayibhala ndisemekweni engekho ntle. Kobunye ubusuku ndafika kwam ndibelwe zonke izixhobo zam zomculo, kwabe kwelinye icala kunzima ukuqatshelwa ukuze umculo wam ube kwelinye izinga,” kubalisa uKupiso. 
Le mvumi ithi yaye yaphantsi konxinzelelo, ingazi ukuba iza kubabhatala njani abantu ebithathe kubo izixhobo zomculo. 
“Ndafowunela umama notata wam, bandikhumbuza ngomthandazo abawenza phambi kokuba ndiye eGoli, kwaneemfundiso zabo zokuphila. Besithi uzungafun’ ukufana nabanye ngoba iinto zakho ziding’ idolo zonke mntanam.” 
Kule ngoma ithi Qhawe Lam, uZuko SA ukunye nemvumikazi engasekhoyo uNwabisa Gcilitshana. 
UGcilitshana, osweleke kwiveki ephelileyo, ungcwatyelwe kokwabo eMpuma Koloni ngoLwesibini kule veki. 
UKupiso udibene noNwabisa G kunyaka ophelileyo. 
“Ndakube ndibone ukuzimisela kwakhe ndeva nelizwi lakhe, ndalangazelela ukusebenza naye. Ndaye ndamvisa le ngoma, wayithanda naye, sobabini sathanda umyalezo okuyo, kwabe oko kukuzalwa kwayo,” kubalisa uKupiso. 
Uthi wavuya xa ebona kuTwitter abantu besithi bave ingoma yakhe kwiShowmax, wabe sele ebizwa ngabavelisi beThe Wife ukuvuyisana naye kuba le ngoma ithandwe kakhulu ngababukeli balo mdlalo. 
UKupiso uthi okumenza ohluke kunabanye kukuba yena uyimamela ngentliziyo ingoma ukuze aphile emoyeni. 
Le mvumi ikhe yakhwela kwiqonga loMnyhadala wezobuGcisa eMakhanda,  ithi oku kwenza iqwalaselwe ngabantu abaninzi kwicandelo lomculo.

headline: UMtsi kwiinzame zokuphelisa ugwayimbo
text:
Usodolophu womasipala ombaxa iBuffalo City uAlfred Mtsi uthi unethemba lokuba iinzame zabo zokulwa nengxaki yoqhankqalazo oluqhutywa ngabasebenzi izakuzala amaduna namathokazi.  
“Kukho ungenelelo le- nkampani yabucala eyenza uthethwano phakathi kwethu kunye nabasebenzi ngee- njongo zokuba kufunyanwe isisombululo kule ngxaki,” uthethe watsho uMtsi.  
Iidolophu eziphambili kulo masipala eziquka iMonti kunye neQonce zivutha umlilo, abasebenzi befuna uchatha kwimivuzo yabo. Izitalato eziphambili kwezi dolophu eziquka iOxford zizele inkunkuma. 
I’solezwe lesiXhosa lithethe noosomashishini bedolophu yaseMonti ngelizama ukukhangela umonakalo owenziwe lolu qhankqalazo.  
Oyimanejala yenkampani yakwaBrands Exclusive uPercy Shaw uthi bayalahlekelwa ngenxa yolu qhankqalazo olusele luthathe iiveki ezimbini liqhubeka.  
“Sineevenkile ezisixhenxe apha eMonti ezine kuzo zilapha kanye kumbindi wedolophu, abantu bayoyika ukuthenga kuba kungatsha nezo mpahla bazithengayo,” uthethe watsho uShaw.  
Lo kaShaw uthi unyanzeleke ukuba aqeshe abasebenzi bethutyana ukuba bacoce isitalato esiphambi kweshishini lakhe. “Esi sitalato iOxford kunye neStevenson sizithathele kuthi ingakumbi apha phambi kweevenkile zethu siyazicoca kusasa nasemva kwemini kuba sifuna kungene abathengi bathenge iimpahla esizithengisayo,” utsho uShaw. 
Nangona engakwazanga ukuqinikelela ilahleko eyenzeka ngenxa yolu qhankqalazo uShaw uthi ilahleko yemali iphezulu.  
“Iintengiso zethu zihlile, iimpahla zihleli evenkileni abantu abathengi, lo nto ithetha ukuba akukho mali ingenayo kwezi veki zimbini, ngoko ke sisengxakini ngenxa yolu qhankqalazo,” uthethe watsho uShaw. 
Abasebenzi bathi ooceba benyuselwe nge7% ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka, lo gama bona bengawufumananga loo chatha.

headline: iQatar icanjalaliswe phambi kwabalandeli bayo yiEcuador kwiNdebe yeHlabathi
text:
Yenze imbali iQatar ngokuba liqela lokuqala eliphulukene nomdlalo wokuvula iNdebe yeHlabathi ukusukela mhla yasungulwa. Oku kwenzeke emva kokuba iQatar, esingethe itumente yehlabathi kulo nyaka (2022), icanjalaliswe ngamagowuli amabini eqandeni (2-0) yiEcuador emdlalweni weNdebe yeHlabathi obungorhatya lwanamhlanje eAl Bayt Stadium ebesigcwele ngabalandeli bebhola ekhatywayo. Imidlalo yokuvula itumente isoloko itaka iintlantsi, kodwa kule yalo unyaka – khange kube njalo. Umdlalo obuphakathi kweQatar nayo iEcuador ububanda ceke okwempumlo yenja. Kodwa okwakuxolisa iEcuador kukuba izithathele amanqaku amathathu ngaphandle kokutsala nzima emdlalweni wokuqala kaGroup A. 
Umdlali ophambili we-Ecuador, uEnner Valencia, ubhakuzelise umnatha ngebhola kwangoko kakhulu kwisigaba sokuqala somdlalo. Emizuzwini elithoba emva kokufaka igowuli lokuqala kwitumente yehlabathi, uValencia ufumene ipenela emva kokuwiswa ngunozinti weQatar, uSaad Al Sheeb, ongakwazanga ukuchitha ibhola ebiyingozi. Uyithathe ngokwakhe uValencia watsho wakhokela ngamagowuli amabini kwitumente yalo nyaka. Emva kwethutyana iQatar ikwazile ukudlala umdlalo ozinzileyo nangona iEcuador ibiyeyona inamandla emdlalweni. Ikhe yazama ukushukumisa, yangathi ingafumana into ngebhola ebikhatywe nguAlmoez Ali phambi kokuphela kwesigaba sokuqala somdlalo. Ngelishwa iinzame zakhe azizelanga nto. 
Kuyiwe kwixesha lokuphumla iqengqa iqanda iQatar ekwindawo yamashumi amahlanu kumanqwanqwa weFifa – indawo ephezulu kunamazwe afana noMzantsi Afrika ongakwazanga ukuzibekela indawo kwitumente yalo nyaka. Akukho nto engako engabaliswa ngomdlalo weQatar ngoba ayinamdla ebholeni. Umdlalo wayo ubuphucukile kancinci kwisigaba sesibini – kodwa ibiyidlalela emhlabeni wayo ibhola. Libathwana lamathuba ezamileyo ukuwadala – kodwa nawo ebengacacanga kakuhle. Kulindeleke iSenegal, elinye lamaqela amele izwekazi le-Afrika, izibethe iQatar emdlalweni olandelayo ngoLwesihlanu ozayo. Abathandi bebhola ekhatywayo baza kufumana umdlalo obhetele ngomso xa kudibana iNgilane ne-Iran ngentsimbi yesithathu oya kulandelwa ngomnye ophakathi kweSenegal neNetherlands.

headline: INkunz’ encane ikhumbul’ uZintle kwingoma entsha
text:
Ilanga litshone endleleni, sendimkhumbule uZintle. Hamba kahle moto sendimkhumbule, ngoba mandihleli naye kubamnandi. Le yingoma entsha kraca yeNkunz’ encane ethi  Ndimkhumbule. 
INkunz’ encane ingene estudiyo kwinyanga yoKwindla ikunye noSolwazi oyimvumi yaseMzimkhulu, kwaphuma le ngoma imnandi kunene yeMaskandi. 
Le ngoma sele ifumaneka kuzo zonke iivenkile zonxibelelwano lweintanethi. 
“Le ngoma ndiyenze kuba ndingakhange ndikhuphe ngoma kunyaka ophelileyo ngenxa yeCovid. Abalandeli baye bacela ukuba ndikhuphe nokuba inye, ndasele ndisenza njalo,’’ kutsho iNkunz’ encane incokolela I’solezwe lesiXhosa. 
“Ndisebenzise igama likaZintle kuba iligama elingene lula kule ngoma,” kubalisa iNkunz’ encane ngale ngoma iyibhale ngokwayo. 
INkunz’ encane ithi abantu xa bemamele le ngoma soze bangabakhumbuli abo bancuma nabo. 
INkunz’ encane, egama lokuzalwa inguSilungile Mralatya, ngunyana wegqala lemvumi yeMaskandi uNkunzemdaka. 
INkunz’ encane, 26, izakhel’ udumo ngengoma ezifana nePalamente nethi eMampondweni. 
Ezi ngoma zidlalwe kakhulu koonomathotholo abaquka iTruFM noMhlobo Wenene. Le nzalelwane yaseNkantolo, eMbizana, iza kukhupha ividiyo yale ngoma kungekudala. 
INkunz’ encane ithi ixakekile isebenza kwiEP eza yikhupha ekuzeni kuphela konyaka. 
“Andifuni mntu oza kuphoxeka, ndifuna wonke umntu ayonwabele. Ndithathe ixesha ukusebenza kuyo,” kutsho iNkunz’ encane. 
INkunz’ encane ikwadize ukuba iceba ukukhupha icwecwe elihlonipha uyise uNkunzemdaka nanjengoko edlale indima enkulu kuthando lwakhe lomculo wesintu. 
Le mvumi ithi ikwanawo nomdla wokusebenza neemvumi zolunye uhlobo lomculo ofana negospile. 
“Ndifuna nokuvula inkampani yam yokuvelisa izakhono zolutsha olunomdla wokucula,” kutsho iNkunz’ encane, ekwaliphelo kuyise  kuNkunzemdaka. 
Zikhangelele le ngoma kwiivenkile zeintanethi.

headline: Naba oomasipala baseMpuma Koloni abaneencwadi ezicocekileyo
text:
OOMASIPALA abasixhenxe baseMpuma Koloni, kuquka namaqumrhu amathathu ee-arhente zophuhliso, bafumene iincwadi ezicocekileyo (clean audit) kwingxelo ebhengezwe ngoLwesithathu nguMphicothi ziNcwadi jikelele uKimi Makwetu. 
  
UMakwetu ubhengeze le ngxelo yonyaka-mali ka2015/16 kwinkomfa noonondaba kwisixeko sasePitoli. 
  
Oomasipala abafumene ingxelo yeencwadi ezicocekileyo yiJoe Gqabi, Engcobo, INgquza Hill, Matatiele, Nyandeni, Senqu noMzimvubu. Kwicandelo lee-arhente zophuhliso, iMandela Bay Development Agency, Chris Hani Development Agency neNtinga OR Tambo Development nazo zifumene iincwadi ezicocekileyo. 
  
Oku kuthetha ukuba oomasipala abangamashumi amathathu anesibhozo eMpuma Koloni, abazifumenanga iingxelo zeencwadi ezicocekileyo. 
  
UMakwetu utyibele umasipala waseNgcobo esithi ungumzekelo worhulumento olucocekileyo nolusekezelwe kuphuhliso loluntu. “Iyasikhuthaza kakhulu into yokubona urhulumento olucocekileyo kumasipala waseNgcobo apho sibone ukuba iinkqubo zezicwangciso zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali zisenziwa ngendlela eyonelisayo,” utshilo uMakwetu. 
  
UMakwetu uthi umasipala waseNgcobo ukwazile ukuchitha imali engange-R8.5 yezigidi zeerandi yofakelo-mbane ngendlela esemgangathweni, kwaye kwankqu nomsebenzi lowo ugqitywe ngethuba obuqingqelwe lona. 
  
Kusenjalo uMakwetu ugxeke umsebenzi wesigaba sesihlanu (Phase 5) wokulungiswa kwesitalato iFleet eMonti esithi ungumzekelo wobubhutyubhutyu bomsebenzi ongakhathalelwanga. 
  
Kulo msebenzi, ngokokutsho kukaMakwetu, unokontraka wokuqala – okwanyanzeleka ukuba atshintshwe ngenxa yomsebenzi ongekho semgangathweni – wahlawulwa iR11.3 yezigidi zeerandi kodwa wawushiya phakathi lo msebenzi ze umasipala waseBuffalo City wahlawula enye imali engange-R15.7 yezigidi zeerandi kunokontraka wesibini.

headline: Libhengeziwe iqela elizakumela iphondo
text:
NgoMvulo babhengeziwe abadlali abaneminyaka engaphantsi kwamashumi amabini ananye abazakumela eli phondo kwimidlalo kazwelonke yeSAB under 21 Championship ezakubanjelwa ePolokwane kule nyanga. 
Kubhengezwe nomqeqeshi omtsha kulo nyaka, njengoko kunyaka ophelileyo ibinguNkululeko Malgas obeqeqesha amakhwenkwe eli phondo. 
Umbutho webhola ekhatywayo kweli phondo, iSAFA, ipapashe amagama abadlali abalishumi elinesibhozo abazakuthatha inxaxheba kule midlalo.  
Nanga amagama abo, Mawethu Gwagwa (Chris Hani), Lukhanyo July, Anga Jacobs ( BC), Sibusiso Majomana (Sarah Baartman), Abongile Twani, Sinethemba Ngudle (NMB), Toboho Moet (OR Tambo), Wonke Phalele (BC), Cox Troy, Sivuyile Zozi ( Alfred Nzo), Vuyolwethu Mazizi (Sarah Baartman), Zamile Daniels ( Alfred Nzo), Ongeziwe Matika (BC) ,Thozama Mbonomnyama (OR Tambo), Keketso Kakole (Alfred Nzo), Sixolile Ndamse, Sonwabile Wulani (NMB), kunye noTisetso Maifo (Sarah Baartman). 
U- Ongeziwe Seku wase-O.R.Tambo uchazwe njengomqeqeshi, umanejala weqela kwachongwa umhlekazi Siyolisile Thuthani wase-Amathole. 
Imbalelwano kanobhala weSAFA kweli phondo, umhlekazi * -Isaac Klaas, iqhuba ithi yonke le veki amakhwenkwe asenkampini eBhayi apho aphekwa khona, kwaye izakuqosheliswa ngolwesine. 
Le midlalo kazwelonke yeSAB League under 21 Championship izakuqala ngomhla wesibhozo kule nyanga ePolokwane ze isongwe ngomhla weshumi elinesithandathu kwakule nyenga. 
Kunyaka ophelileyo iqela leli phondo loyisakala ukuqhuba kakuhle kule tumente. 
Le tumente idume ngokuvelisa abadlali abasakhulayo, kuba no-Andile Jali wakhe wathatha inxaxheba kuyo kwiminyaka eyadlalulayo.

headline: ICameroon ziintshatsheli ezivunyiwe ze-Afrika!!!!!!
text:
ICameroon ziintshatsheli ze-Afrika kwakhona emva kokulinda iminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu yonke. Igowuli elifakwe ngu-Aboubakar lilo eliqinisekise impumelelo phambi kokuphela komdlalo ephumelele kuwo iCameroon ngo’2-1 ibetha i-Egypt, eStade de Franceville, namhlanje ebusuku. Nangona ingamaYiphutha angcangcazelise umnatha kuqala – kodwa ekugqibeleni aphise ngawo umdlalo kwiCameroon ebonakele inxanelwe impumelelo kakhulu kwisigaba sesibini somdlalo. Idlale kakuhle kakhulu kule tumente iCameroon – kodwa ngenxa yamava abadlali be-Egypt abanawo, uninzi belucinga ukuba yiyo (i-Egypt) enethuba lokugoduka nale ndebe ibalulekileyo.   AmaYiphutha akaphozisanga maseko umdlalo usaqala, u-El Said uvuthulule imbumbulu yebhola ayifumene kugxa wakhe esiswini – kuye kwanyanzeleka asebenze u-Ondoa (unozinti) ngomzuzu wokuqala emdlalweni. Emva koko umdlalo uye wathi thimbilili okwexeshana – kodwa wabe ulawulwa yi-Egypt. Kuphele imizuzu emihlanu iCameroon idlalela emhlabeni wayo futhi ingakwazi ukungena kumhlaba weYiphutha.    Ngomzuzu wesithandathu abadlali-siswini beCameroon badibanise iibhola kakuhle esiswini, baya phambili bedlokova – kodwa ibhola yabo ibanjwe ngu-El Hadary ngaphandle kobunzima. Emva kokuba u-Ondoa ebambe ibhola ye-Egypt ebisuka ekoneni, iCameroon yenze ezinye iinzame – kodwa ibhola ibhabhe phezulu. Igowuli le-Egypt lifakwe nguM. Elneny emva kokunikelwa ibhola entle sisiququ esidlala esiswini uM. Salah, olinxele elihle kakhulu ebholeni ekhatywayo.    Kuye kwanyanzeleka iCameroon yenze utshintsho emva kokonzaka kukaTeikeu – oyena mdlali onamava kubadlali basemva kwiCameroon. Indawo yakhe ithathwe ngu-Aboubbakar. Kutshintshwe amacala i-Egypt ihamba phambili ngo’1-0. Umdlalo uye watshintsha mpela kwisigaba sesibini ngoba iCameroon ifake uxinizelelo ekubuyeni kwayo.UNkoolou, ongene endaweni kaTeikeu ufake igowuli lokulinganisa. Icinezele mpela iCameroon yade yavuzwa kushiyeke imizuzu emibini kuphele umdlalo ngebhola efakwe ngu-Abbobakar. headline: Umqol’ uphandle kwabadyarhaza imali kaMandela
text:
UMkhuseli woLuntu uAdvocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane uyikhuphile ingxelo malunga nokudyarhazwa kwemali eyayihlelelwe imisitho yezikhumbuso sokubhubha kobesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela, watsho igxeke eliphosa kumlawuli-jikelele karhulumente waseMpuma Koloni uMarion Mbina-Mthembu ngelithi, watyeshela imithetho ngethuba ephumeza imali yale misitho. 
UMbina-Mthembu wayeyintloko yesebe lezezimali ephondweni ngelo xesha. 
NgoMvulo, uMkhwebane ubhengeze ingxelo kulandela imali ekwizigidi ezithandathu zeerandi ezachithwa nguMasipala iBuffalo City ngethuba lokubhubha kukaMandela ngonyaka ka2013. 
Yimali engangezigidi ezikumakhulu amathathu eerandi (R300 million) eyaphunyezwa ngurhulumente waseMpuma Koloni, phantsi kwentende yeArhente yezoPhuhliso yaseMpuma Koloni (ECDC), ukuze ijongane nomsebenzi wokuququzelela ukubhubha kukaMandela. 
Endaweni yokuba isebenze eyona nto iphunyezelwe yona le mali, amagosa karhulumente aseMpuma Koloni ayehlisa ngomlenze enye yale mali. 
Ngenxa yoku, ibutho lophando lwamapolisa iiHawks labamba owayesakuba nguSodolophu waseBuffalo City uZukiswa Ncitha, obesakuba lisekela likaSodolophu uThemba Tinta, uNobhala onqunyanyisiweyo weANC eBCM uPhumlani Mkolo, uceba weANC uSindiswa Gomba, obesakuba ngusomlomo waseBCM uLuleka Simon-Ndzele, owayeligosa laseBCM uOndela Mahlangu, oosomashishini uZintle Nkuhlu, Viwe Vazi, Nosiphiwo Mati kwakunye noDean Fanoe. 
UMkhwebane uthi inyathelo lokuphunyezwa kwale mali lwalungekho semthethweni, watsho esithi izenzo zikaMbina-Mthembu zazingekho semthethweni futhi zizimpawu zolawulo olunobubhutyu-bhutyu. 
Lo kaMkhwebane uthi inyathelo lokufakwa kwemali engange-R250 000 kwibhanki kaNkulumbuso uPhumulo Masualle, owayengumphathiswa wezezimali ngelo xesha, lalingekho semthethweni. 
UMkhwebane ukwakhankanye umasipala waseNelson Mandela Bay, King Sabata Dalindyebo nase-OR Tambo, esithi nabo bachitha imali ngokungekho semthethweni ngethuba lemisitho yokulungiselela ukungcwatywa kukaMandela. 
Kwizindululo zakhe, uMkhwebane uyalele ukuba kuphandwe uMbina-Mthembu, uGomba, Simon-Ndzele kwakunye namagosa aseBCM, Nelson Mandela Bay, OR Tambo naseKSD awayesemfuthweni wolwazi ngethuba kuphunyezwa ezi mali. 
UMkhwebane ukwayalele isebe lezezimali kuzwelonke ukuba licele uMongameli Jacob Zuma ukuba aphumeze ukuphandwa libutho lophando elikhethekileyo (SIU) kobu butyadidi bokudyarhazwa kwemali kaMandela.

headline: Umongi ongeqeshekiyo
text:

headline: UShalulile ukhulule iDowns emizuzwini yokugqibela kwiStellenbosch
text:
Ibethelele indawo yayo phezulu iMamelodi Sundowns namhlanje emva kokubetha iStellenbosch ngamagowuli amabini kwelinye (2-1) emdlalweni weDStv Premiership obushushu eDani Craven Stadium ngale njikalanga. Nangona iSundowns ibikhe yaxakekiswa yimidlalo yeCaf Champions League – kodwa amaqela asemva kwayo oyisiwe kukucutha umsantsa ophakathi kwayo nawo kwaye isakhokela ngamanqaku amane onke. Umdlalo ububambene ekuqaleni njengoko bekulindelekile xa kudibene la maqela mabini. 
ULyle Lahay noRivaldo Coetzee bakhe bazama ukuyihlasela iStellenbosch – kodwa amadoda afana noMogamad De Goede ebeqine ethe ngqi emva. Itsazise igazi kuqala iStellenboch ngebhola efakwe nguStanley Dimgba emva kwebhola ebikhatywe ngugxa wakhe, uAshely Du Preez. Nangona iStellies ngesikwazile ukufumana igowuli lesibini – kodwa asikwazanga ukusebenzisa elinye ithuba ebe lilihle. 
Njengeentshatsheli zokwenene, iSundowns ithathele kuyo umdlalo kwisigaba sesibini. Iyisebenzele lo nto ngoba ikwazile ukuqhufuza iqanda emzuzwini wamashumi amahlanu ananye ngebhola entle efakwe sisiququ – uGaston Sirino, ofumene ibhola entle kuPeter Shalulile obethe amadoda ebhokisini. 
Ifolosi yeDowns, uKermit Erasmus, ikhutshelwe ngaphandle ngenxa yokonzakala. Indawo yayo ithathwe nguMaurizio Affonso – onethuba elide engasabonakala emidlalweni yeDowns. Abadlali beStellenbosch badlalile kakhulu ngoba bakwazile ukuyibamba iDowns ixesha elide. Kodwa izinto zonakele emizuzwini yokugqibela ngethuba bevumela uPeter Shalulile afake ibhola emnatheni ngentloko. 
Ligowuli elo elinike iSundowns impumelelo ebalulekileyo. Ngolo hlobo, iqela likaSteve Barker liphoswe lithuba lokuphumelela imidlalo emithathu ilandelelana emva kokutsala nzima ekuqaleni kwesizini. URushine De Reuck udlalele iDowns okokuqala kwiDStv Premiership ukusukela oko wathengwa kwiMaritzburg United kunyaka ophelileyo.

headline: iRoyal AM naBafana Bes’thende baqengqe iqanda eChatsworth Stadium
text:
Amaqela aKwaZulu-Natal agoduke egoqoza nenqaku elinye macala emva komdlalo wedabi lobukhaya namhlanje. Oku kwenzeke emva kokuba Abafana Bes’thende bebambene ngeqanda neRoyal AM ebibuthuntu emdlalweni weDStv Premiership obubanjelwe eChatsworth Stadium. Omabini amaqela aqale umdlalo ngesantya esiphezulu futhi kubonakala ukuba alambele amanqaku amathathu. Nangona bekunjalo – kodwa akubangakho nalinye elikwazileyo ukubhalisa ebhodini kwisigaba sokuqala somdlalo. 
Izitshovutshovu zeRoyal AM ezifana noNdumiso Mabena noMenzi Masuku zizamile ukudala amathuba okufaka amagowuli – kodwa yala iGolden Arrows emva ikhokelwa ngunozinti wayo odlale kakuhle, uNkosingiphile Gumede. Emva kokubhutyuza kwisigaba sokuqala, omabini amaqela aphinde athathana kwesesibini isiqingatha. Naso isigaba sesibini siziqaqambise ngomdlalo omhle – kodwa into ebimbi kukunqaba kwamagowuli nangona amathuba ebekhona emdlalweni. 
Emizuzwini yokugqibela yomdlalo, uKnow Mutizwa noNqobeko Dlamini bazamile ukufaka igowuli – wala kwaphela uNyame ezipalini. Naye uGumede kwelakhe icala unqande amanzi engena endlini emizuzwini yokugqibela. Emva komdlalo wanamhlanje, iRoyal AM ihleli kwindawo yesine emva kokuqokelela amashumi amabini anesithathu amanqaku emidlalweni elishumi elinesihlanu. Yona iGoldena Arrows ihleli kwindawo yethoba, iqokelele ishumi elinethoba lamanqaku emidlalweni elishumi elinane.
